description.en: Double encoding survives WAFs that match CRLF after a single decode. Success: the header injects after the app's second decode.

name.zh: PHP 短 Echo 标签与反引号执行边界
name.en: PHP Short-Echo Tag and Backtick Execution Boundary

description.zh: 使用三条短 echo 标签变体验证 PHP 版本、数组偏移语法与反引号命令运算符的处理，并区分当前方括号语法和已移除的花括号语法。
description.en: Uses three short-echo-tag variants to test PHP-version handling of array offsets and the backtick command operator while separating current bracket syntax from removed curly-brace syntax.

overview.zh: PHP 短 Echo 标签与反引号执行边界针对 PHP 版本与语法差异影响利用结果的场景：<?= 自 5.4 起不依赖 short_open_tag，花括号偏移在 PHP 8 已移除。验证三条变体在目标版本的解析对照。
overview.en: The PHP short-echo tag and backtick execution boundary targets PHP version and syntax differences shaping outcomes: <?= works without short_open_tag since 5.4, while curly offsets were removed in PHP 8. It contrasts parsing of the three variants on the target version.

vulnerability.zh: 若上传或模板内容被 PHP 解释，且不可信参数进入反引号运算符，攻击者可能跨越数据与命令边界；WAF 放行只是前置条件，必须证明有效 PHP 语法到达解释器并启动受控子进程。
vulnerability.en: If uploaded or template content is interpreted as PHP and untrusted parameters reach the backtick operator, attackers can cross the data-to-command boundary; WAF pass-through is only a precondition—prove valid PHP syntax reached the interpreter and spawned a controlled child process.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步保留三条原始变体作版本追溯，实际执行时参数仅指向无副作用 marker-helper；命中判据为反引号命令执行并返回标记输出。在 PHP 8 目标上 <?=`$_GET{0}`?> 与 <?=`$_POST{0}`?> 两条花括号偏移应作为解析失败对照，<?= `$_POST[0]`?> 的方括号语法应正常执行；逐版本记录解析与执行差异，构建版本能力基线。
exploitation.en: Keep the three original variants from step 1 for version traceability, but point parameters only at a side-effect-free marker-helper when executing; a hit is the backtick command executing and returning marker output. On PHP 8 targets the two curly-offset lines <?=`$_GET{0}`?> and <?=`$_POST{0}`?> should serve as parse-failure controls while <?= `$_POST[0]`?> bracket syntax executes normally; record parsing versus execution differences per version to build a version-capability baseline.

mitigation.zh: 上传目录禁止脚本解释，模板不接受用户代码，移除反引号及其他进程 API，并以参数化业务操作替代命令；WAF 只作纵深防御。修复后重放第 1 步变体并覆盖 PHP 7.4/8.x 语法差异回归，确认标签与反引号均不产生执行。
mitigation.en: Forbid script interpretation in upload directories, keep user code out of templates, remove backticks and other process APIs, and replace commands with parameterized business operations; WAF is defense in depth only. After the fix, replay the step-1 variants with regression covering PHP 7.4/8.x syntax differences, confirming neither tags nor backticks produce execution.

title.zh: 冻结 PHP 与 WAF 基线

description.zh: 记录目标版本、SAPI、文件映射和无害 PHP 页面经过 WAF 与解释器的完整路径。
description.en: Record target version, SAPI, file mapping, and the full WAF-to-interpreter path for a harmless PHP page.

title.zh: Lint 后提交单个有效变体
title.en: Submit one valid variant after linting

description.zh: 逐行 lint，仅将通过当前版本语法的行与 marker-helper 参数提交一次。
description.en: Lint each line and submit only a form valid for the current version with the marker-helper parameter once.

title.zh: 关联解释与子进程证据

description.zh: 匹配 WAF 决策、PHP 请求、父子 PID 与随机输出，明确花括号行的版本阴性。
description.en: Match WAF decision, PHP request, parent-child PIDs, and random output while documenting version-negative curly-brace forms.

title.en: Disable script interpretation and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放有效/无效对照，确认上传内容不再解释，并删除页面、帮助程序和日志令牌。
description.en: After remediation replay valid and invalid controls, confirm uploaded content is no longer interpreted, and delete pages, helpers, and log tokens.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认文件会由目标 PHP 版本解释，并记录 PHP 版本、SAPI 与 short_open_tag 配置
prerequisites.en: The file is confirmed to be interpreted by the target PHP version, with PHP version, SAPI, and short_open_tag setting recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离实例把请求参数限制为固定 marker-helper，且可审计 PHP 父进程与唯一子进程
prerequisites.en: The isolated instance restricts request parameters to a fixed marker-helper, and the PHP parent and sole child process are auditable.

analysis.zh: 完整阳性要求语法在目标版本有效、WAF 后到达 PHP、反引号启动受控 marker-helper 并返回唯一输出。WAF 放行、短标签被识别、PHP 8 的花括号解析错误或命令字符串回显都只是部分或阴性证据。
analysis.en: A complete positive requires syntax valid for the target version, delivery through the WAF to PHP, a backtick-launched controlled marker-helper, and unique output. WAF acceptance, short-tag recognition, PHP 8 curly-brace parse errors, and command-string reflection are partial or negative evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅允许签名 marker-helper 且执行一次；出现其他 shell、文件读取或网络事件立即停止
opsecTips.en: Permit only the signed marker-helper for one execution; stop immediately on any other shell, file read, or network event.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除 PHP 页面和帮助程序，清空 opcode/WAF 缓存，并撤销请求令牌
opsecTips.en: After testing delete the PHP page and helper, clear opcode and WAF caches, and revoke request tokens.

name.zh: ASP 内联表达式解释边界

description.zh: 使用单条 `<%= "test" %>` 识别 Classic ASP/ASP.NET 风格内联表达式是否由服务器解释；该行只输出常量，不构成 WebShell 或命令执行。
description.en: Uses one <%= "test" %> expression to identify server interpretation of Classic ASP or ASP.NET-style inline output; the line emits a constant and is neither a web shell nor command execution.

overview.zh: ASP 内联表达式解释边界针对识别 Classic ASP/ASP.NET 风格内联表达式是否由服务器解释的场景：<%= "test" %> 只输出常量，可安全用作处理器识别与 WAF 传递的阴性对照。验证单条常量表达式的服务端处理。
overview.en: The ASP inline-expression interpretation boundary targets identifying whether Classic ASP/ASP.NET-style inline expressions are interpreted server-side: <%= "test" %> outputs only a constant, safe as a negative control for handler identification and WAF pass-through. It validates server-side handling of the single constant expression.

vulnerability.zh: 只有当攻击者能让不可信内容成为服务器端表达式，或控制表达式调用危险对象时，才可能形成代码注入；静态页面输出 test 只是配置证据，不能升级为 WebShell、SSTI 或 RCE。
vulnerability.en: Code injection becomes possible only when attackers can make untrusted content a server-side expression or control expression-invoked dangerous objects; a static page outputting test is configuration evidence only and must not escalate to webshell, SSTI, or RCE claims.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把 <%= "test" %> 单独放入对应测试页面并请求；命中判据为响应输出常量 test 而非原始标记，证明服务器端页面引擎解释了内联表达式。同时记录 WAF 对该请求的动作作为传递对照；不得扩展为动态命令或对象调用，识别到处理器后按对应 WebShell 条目另行验证执行能力。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, place <%= "test" %> alone into the matching test page and request it; a hit is the response outputting the constant test rather than the raw markup, proving the server-side page engine interpreted the inline expression. Also record the WAF action on the request as a pass-through control; never extend to dynamic commands or object invocation—after handler identification, verify execution capability separately under the matching webshell entries.

mitigation.zh: 上传和用户内容目录禁用 ASP/ASP.NET 脚本映射，模板只能来自受信构建产物，动态数据采用上下文编码。修复后重放第 1 步表达式，确认用户文件始终按静态内容返回且已批准页面正常渲染。
mitigation.en: Disable ASP/ASP.NET script mappings for upload and user-content directories, source templates only from trusted build artifacts, and encode dynamic data contextually. After the fix, replay the step-1 expression and confirm user files always return as static content while approved pages render normally.

description.zh: 记录扩展名、应用池、Classic ASP/ASP.NET 版本和纯文本基线。
description.en: Record extension, application pool, Classic ASP or ASP.NET version, and the plain-text baseline.

description.zh: 只部署原始一行，不拼接变量、请求参数或对象方法。
description.en: Deploy only the original line without variables, request parameters, or object methods.

title.zh: 限定结论为表达式解释
title.en: Limit the conclusion to expression interpretation

description.zh: 匹配模板处理日志与常量输出，明确没有命令、文件或网络副作用。
description.en: Match template-processing logs with constant output and document the absence of command, file, or network side effects.

title.zh: 移除上传目录脚本映射
title.en: Remove script mapping from upload storage

description.zh: 修复后在批准页面和上传目录分别回归，确认前者渲染、后者返回静态源码。
description.en: After remediation regress an approved page and upload storage separately, confirming rendering in the former and static source in the latter.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认测试文件映射到隔离 Classic ASP 或 ASP.NET 处理器，并记录具体运行时
prerequisites.en: The test file is confirmed to map to an isolated Classic ASP or ASP.NET handler, and the exact runtime is recorded.

prerequisites.zh: 页面仅包含常量表达式且无用户输入、文件 API、组件创建或进程调用
prerequisites.en: The page contains only the constant expression with no user input, file API, component creation, or process call.

analysis.zh: 该条目的最大可证结论是 ASP 页面引擎解释了常量内联表达式。响应 test、WAF 放行或模板编译均不证明命令执行；只有后续存在用户可控表达式和危险调用时才需要独立升级评估。
analysis.en: The strongest conclusion for this entry is that an ASP page engine interpreted a constant inline expression. A test response, WAF acceptance, or template compilation does not prove command execution; any user-controlled expression and dangerous invocation requires a separate escalation assessment.

opsecTips.zh: 页面只输出固定常量且部署在隔离站点；禁止加入请求数据、COM/.NET 对象或文件操作
opsecTips.en: Keep the page in an isolated site with constant output only; do not add request data, COM or .NET objects, or file operations.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除页面、回收应用池并清理模板缓存，确认上传目录未获得脚本权限
opsecTips.en: After validation delete the page, recycle the application pool, clear template caches, and confirm upload storage gained no script permission.

name.zh: JSP Runtime.exec 服务端执行边界

description.zh: 使用两条 JSP scriptlet 验证用户可控页面是否由 Servlet 容器编译，以及请求参数是否进入 Runtime.exec；第二条还依赖 Apache Commons IO 回显进程输出。
description.en: Uses two JSP scriptlets to test whether user-controlled pages are compiled by a servlet container and whether request parameters reach Runtime.exec; the second also depends on Apache Commons IO to return process output.

overview.zh: JSP Runtime.exec 服务端执行边界针对用户可控页面被 Servlet 容器编译以及请求参数进入 Runtime.exec 的场景：第二行依赖 Commons IO 回显输出。验证两条 scriptlet 的编译与执行行为。
overview.en: The JSP Runtime.exec server-side execution boundary targets user-controllable pages compiled by the Servlet container with request parameters entering Runtime.exec: the second line relies on Commons IO to echo output. It validates compilation and execution of the two scriptlets.

vulnerability.zh: 若用户可写内容进入可执行 JSP 路径，或业务 JSP 把请求参数交给 Runtime.exec，数据可跨越为 JVM 子进程；文件上传成功、JSP 源码可见或编译错误都不能证明进程创建。
vulnerability.en: If user-writable content reaches executable JSP paths, or business JSPs hand request parameters to Runtime.exec, data crosses into JVM child processes; upload success, visible JSP source, or compile errors do not prove process creation.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步原行仅作追溯；验证版本去除任意请求命令，只调用签名 marker-helper 后部署到授权路径并触发编译。第一行启动进程不回显，需以进程审计或副作用确认；第二行经 IOUtils.toString 回显，命中判据为响应输出 marker-helper 的固定标记。部署前先确认 Commons IO 是否在应用类路径；逐条记录编译类名与容器日志。
exploitation.en: The step-1 originals are for traceability only; the validation version removes arbitrary request commands and calls only a signed marker-helper before deploying to authorized paths and triggering compilation. Line one spawns without echo—confirm via process audit or side effects; line two echoes via IOUtils.toString, and a hit is the marker-helper's fixed marker in the response. Confirm Commons IO is on the application classpath before deploying; record compiled class names and container logs per line.

mitigation.zh: 上传和用户内容存储在 Web 根目录外且禁用 JSP 映射，不允许动态编译不可信页面；移除请求驱动的 Runtime.exec，使用固定 Java API，并限制容器子进程、文件与网络权限。修复后重放第 1 步验证版本，确认编译被拒绝且正常业务可用。
mitigation.en: Store uploads and user content outside the web root with JSP mapping disabled, never dynamically compiling untrusted pages; remove request-driven Runtime.exec in favor of fixed Java APIs, and restrict container child-process, file, and network permissions. After the fix, replay the step-1 validation version and confirm compilation is rejected while normal business works.

title.zh: 确认 JSP 编译与类路径

description.zh: 记录页面映射、生成 Servlet、容器身份，并检查第二行所需 Commons IO。
description.en: Record page mapping, generated servlet, container identity, and the Commons IO dependency required by the second line.

title.zh: 固定 Helper 后单行请求
title.en: Request one line after pinning the helper

description.zh: 移除外部 cmd 参数，只保留一次 marker-helper 调用，并为请求绑定唯一令牌。
description.en: Remove external cmd input, retain one marker-helper invocation, and bind a unique token to the request.

title.zh: 关联 Servlet 与子进程
title.en: Correlate the servlet and child process

description.zh: 匹配容器日志、生成类、父子 PID 和输出，排除静态返回或其他任务进程。
description.en: Match container logs, generated class, parent-child PIDs, and output while excluding static serving and unrelated jobs.

title.zh: 关闭 JSP 映射并清理
title.en: Disable JSP mapping and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放静态上传和标记 JSP，确认用户内容不再编译，并删除生成类与帮助程序。
description.en: After remediation replay a static upload and marker JSP, confirm user content is no longer compiled, and delete generated classes and the helper.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离目标明确把测试文件映射到 JSP/Servlet 编译器，并可查看生成类与容器日志
prerequisites.en: The isolated target explicitly maps the test file to a JSP or servlet compiler, and generated classes and container logs are observable.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 cmd 参数替换为固定 marker-helper，且 Java 服务身份只能启动这一无副作用程序
prerequisites.en: The original cmd parameter is replaced by a fixed marker-helper, and the Java service identity can launch only this side-effect-free program.

analysis.zh: 完整证据是目标 JSP 被容器编译，生成的 Servlet 以 Java 服务身份启动受控 marker-helper。页面可访问、JSP 标签被识别、编译异常或仅有固定文本均不足；第一行没有输出时必须有进程遥测。
analysis.en: Complete evidence is the target JSP being compiled by the container and its generated servlet launching the controlled marker-helper as the Java service identity. Page accessibility, recognized JSP tags, compilation errors, and fixed text alone are insufficient; the first line requires process telemetry because it returns no output.

opsecTips.zh: 只允许签名 marker-helper 且限制一次子进程；不得向 Runtime.exec 传入用户命令
opsecTips.en: Permit only the signed marker-helper and one child process; never pass a user command to Runtime.exec.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除 JSP、生成 Servlet/class、工作目录缓存和帮助程序，并确认 URL 失效
opsecTips.en: After validation delete the JSP, generated servlet or class, work-directory caches, and helper, and confirm the URL is gone.

description.zh: 经 JS 引擎求值执行，JSP 源码层无 Runtime 直调特征；成功判据：cmd 命令被执行。
description.en: Evaluates via a JS engine so the JSP surface shows no direct Runtime call. Success: the cmd command executes.

description.zh: 命令 base64 传入并回显输出，规避命令明文与无回显盲执行特征；成功判据：响应含命令输出。
description.en: Passes the command base64-encoded and echoes output, evading plaintext commands and blind-execution signatures. Success: response contains command output.

description.zh: 去掉 page 指令改用 ProcessBuilder 全限定名，规避常见 JSP 木马模板指纹；成功判据：进程创建可观测。
description.en: Drops the page directive and uses fully-qualified ProcessBuilder to evade common JSP shell template fingerprints. Success: process creation observable.

name.zh: ASP/.NET 进程与动态求值边界
name.en: ASP and .NET Process and Dynamic-Evaluation Boundary

description.zh: 使用两条 ProcessStartInfo 片段和两条 eval 形态验证 Microsoft Web 运行时是否将请求数据交给系统进程或动态脚本求值。
description.en: Uses two ProcessStartInfo fragments and two eval forms to test whether a Microsoft web runtime passes request data into an operating-system process or dynamic script evaluation.

overview.zh: ASP/.NET 进程与动态求值边界针对 Microsoft Web 运行时把请求数据交给系统进程或动态脚本求值的场景：ProcessStartInfo 与 eval 属不同运行时语法。验证四条片段的归属识别与执行行为。
overview.en: ASP and .NET process and dynamic-evaluation boundaries target Microsoft web runtimes handing request data to system processes or dynamic script evaluation: ProcessStartInfo and eval belong to different runtime syntaxes. It validates attribution and execution of the four fragments.

vulnerability.zh: 若请求参数进入 ProcessStartInfo 参数拼接或服务端 eval，攻击者可从数据边界进入进程或动态代码；处理器映射、语言选择和应用池权限共同决定影响，语法错误、源码回显或 Base64 解码成功不证明执行。
vulnerability.en: If request parameters enter ProcessStartInfo argument splicing or server-side eval, attackers cross from data into processes or dynamic code; handler mapping, language selection, and application-pool permissions jointly decide impact—syntax errors, source echo, or Base64 decode success prove no execution.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步先匹配实际语言和处理器：ProcessStartInfo 两行属 .NET，eval 两行需已确认支持 eval 的动态运行时解释；执行版本不接受 cmd 参数，只允许固定标记输出。命中判据为对应片段在正确处理器上执行并返回标记（cmd.exe 输出经 RedirectStandardOutput 回显）。语法错误的行明确记录为归属失败，不得跨运行时混用。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, first match the actual language and handler: the two ProcessStartInfo lines belong to .NET, while the two eval lines need a dynamic runtime confirmed to support eval; the execution version accepts no cmd parameter, only fixed marker output. A hit is the matching fragment executing on the correct handler and returning the marker (cmd.exe output echoed via RedirectStandardOutput). Explicitly record syntactically invalid lines as attribution failures—never mix across runtimes.

mitigation.zh: 移除请求驱动的 ProcessStartInfo 和服务端 eval，改用固定业务 API 与参数数组；上传/模板目录禁用动态处理器，应用池采用最小权限和进程启动限制。修复后重放第 1 步片段并覆盖所有处理器映射回归，确认动态执行不可达。
mitigation.en: Remove request-driven ProcessStartInfo and server-side eval in favor of fixed business APIs with argument arrays; disable dynamic handlers in upload/template directories and run application pools least-privileged with process-launch restrictions. After the fix, replay the step-1 fragments with regression across all handler mappings, confirming dynamic execution is unreachable.

title.zh: 按处理器分类四条语法
title.en: Classify all four forms by handler

description.zh: 记录扩展名、编译器/脚本宿主、语言版本和应用池身份，保留语法结果。
description.en: Record extension, compiler or script host, language version, and application-pool identity and preserve syntax results.

title.zh: 改写为固定标记后单行验证
title.en: Validate one line after rewriting to a fixed marker

description.zh: 去除请求命令和危险可执行文件，只提交与当前运行时匹配的一行。
description.en: Remove request commands and dangerous executables and submit only one line matching the current runtime.

description.zh: 关联服务端标记、处理器日志和父子 PID，明确动态表达式与系统进程的不同证据。
description.en: Correlate server marker, handler logs, and parent-child PIDs and distinguish dynamic expression evidence from OS process evidence.

title.zh: 移除动态入口并回收应用池
title.en: Remove dynamic entry points and recycle the pool

description.zh: 修复后重放静态内容与四个负向输入，确认不再求值或启动进程，并清理缓存。
description.en: After remediation replay static content and all four negative inputs, confirm no evaluation or process launch, and clear caches.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认具体处理器是 ASP.NET、JScript.NET 或其他支持对应语法的 Microsoft 服务端运行时
prerequisites.en: The exact handler is confirmed as ASP.NET, JScript.NET, or another Microsoft server runtime supporting the selected syntax.

prerequisites.zh: cmd.exe、PowerShell 和 eval 输入均替换为固定常量或 marker-helper，且应用池子进程可审计
prerequisites.en: cmd.exe, PowerShell, and eval inputs are replaced by a fixed constant or marker-helper, and application-pool child processes are auditable.

analysis.zh: 结论必须按运行时分层：编译/解析成功、服务端固定表达式求值、ProcessStartInfo 启动帮助程序是不同证据。后两条在标准 C# 中无效，只有目标动态宿主明确支持时才可测试，不能因字符串含 eval 就认定 RCE。
analysis.en: Conclusions must be layered by runtime: successful compilation or parsing, server-side evaluation of a fixed expression, and ProcessStartInfo launching the helper are distinct evidence. The final two lines are invalid in standard C# and may be tested only when the target dynamic host explicitly supports them; the word eval does not establish RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 禁止启动原始 cmd.exe/PowerShell；进程型行只允许一次签名 marker-helper，eval 型行只返回常量
opsecTips.en: Do not launch the original cmd.exe or PowerShell; process lines may invoke one signed marker-helper and eval lines may return only a constant.

opsecTips.zh: 验证后删除页面、动态编译产物和帮助程序，回收应用池并确认无残留子进程
opsecTips.en: After validation delete pages, dynamic compilation artifacts, and the helper, recycle the application pool, and confirm no child remains.

description.zh: 用静态 Process.Start 一步拉起进程，规避 new ProcessStartInfo 对象构造特征；成功判据：进程执行可观测。
description.en: Uses the static Process.Start shortcut, evading new ProcessStartInfo construction signatures. Success: process execution observable.

description.zh: 经 powershell -enc 执行 base64 命令，绕过 cmd.exe 与命令明文检测；成功判据：编码命令被执行。
description.en: Executes a base64 command via powershell -enc, evading cmd.exe and plaintext command detection. Success: the encoded command runs.

description.zh: 改走 VisualBasic 运行时 Shell 函数，规避 Diagnostics 命名空间特征；成功判据：命令执行且窗口隐藏。
description.en: Routes through the VisualBasic runtime Shell function to evade Diagnostics namespace signatures. Success: command executes with a hidden window.

name.zh: Fastjson InetAddress DNS 解析边界

description.zh: 使用 Inet4Address 与 Inet6Address 的 @type JSON 变体验证特定 Fastjson 配置是否实例化网络地址类型并由应用服务器发起 DNS 解析。
description.en: Uses Inet4Address and Inet6Address @type JSON variants to test whether a specific Fastjson configuration instantiates network-address types and causes application-origin DNS resolution.

overview.zh: Fastjson InetAddress DNS 解析边界针对特定 Fastjson 配置实例化网络地址类型并由应用服务器发起 DNS 解析的场景：Inet4Address 与 Inet6Address 是两种 @type 变体。验证类型实例化与解析边界的出站行为。
overview.en: The Fastjson InetAddress DNS-resolution boundary targets specific Fastjson configurations instantiating network address types with the application server issuing DNS resolution: Inet4Address and Inet6Address are the two @type variants. It validates outbound behavior of type instantiation and resolution boundaries.

vulnerability.zh: 当不可信 JSON 可选择网络相关类型，解析器可能在业务校验前产生外部解析，造成盲副作用或成为更高风险 gadget 的前置条件；DNS 查询本身不能证明任意类实例化、JNDI 查找或 RCE。
vulnerability.en: When untrusted JSON can select network-related types, the parser may produce external resolution before business validation, creating blind side effects or preconditions for higher-risk gadgets; a DNS query alone proves neither arbitrary class instantiation, JNDI lookup, nor RCE.

exploitation.zh: 按第 1 步把两个 @type 变体的 val 分别替换为自有随机子域，每次解析一行并记录请求 ID、类型选择与权威 DNS 日志；命中判据为应用服务器对子域发起 DNS 解析，证明类型实例化与网络副作用成立。原始第三方域只作追溯，绝不使用；两类地址行为分开记录，命中后再评估是否具备升级到 JdbcRowSet 等链路的条件。
exploitation.en: Per step 1, replace val in both @type variants with your own random subdomains, resolving one line per request while logging request ID, type choice, and authoritative DNS records; a hit is the application server resolving your subdomain, proving type instantiation and network side effects. The original third-party domain is traceability only and must never be used; record both address classes separately, then assess upgrade conditions toward chains like JdbcRowSet after a hit.

mitigation.zh: 升级受支持 Fastjson 版本，关闭或严格允许 AutoType，反序列化到固定 DTO，并在网络层限制解析与出站。修复后同时重放合法地址字段、未知 @type 和两个 InetAddress 类型，确认合法字段正常且两个类型不再产生解析。
mitigation.en: Upgrade to supported Fastjson versions, disable or strictly allowlist AutoType, deserialize into fixed DTOs, and limit resolution and egress at the network layer. After the fix, replay legitimate address fields, unknown @type, and both InetAddress types together, confirming legitimate fields work while the two types no longer resolve.

title.zh: 冻结解析器与无查询基线
title.en: Freeze the parser and no-query baseline

description.zh: 记录 Fastjson/JDK 版本、AutoType 策略和普通 DTO 解析期间的 DNS 空白窗口。
description.en: Record Fastjson and JDK versions, AutoType policy, and a DNS-quiet window during ordinary DTO parsing.

title.zh: 替换域名后逐类型解析
title.en: Replace domains and parse each type

description.zh: 为两条输入分别签发一次性域名并绑定不同请求 ID，不使用公共 dnslog 服务。
description.en: Issue a separate one-time domain and request ID for each input without using a public dnslog service.

title.zh: 关联类型实例化与 DNS

description.zh: 匹配解析日志、线程、请求 ID、出口地址和权威查询，排除扫描器与客户端。
description.en: Match parser log, thread, request ID, egress address, and authoritative query while excluding scanners and clients.

title.zh: 限制 AutoType 并撤销域名

description.zh: 修复后重放 DTO 与两条 @type，确认业务解析保留且 DNS 不再发生，再删除测试记录。
description.en: After remediation replay the DTO and both @type inputs, preserve business parsing with no DNS, then delete test records.

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结 Fastjson 与 JDK 版本、AutoType 配置、解析入口和目标 Java 类型允许策略
prerequisites.en: Fastjson and JDK versions, AutoType configuration, parser entry point, and Java-type allow policy are frozen.

prerequisites.zh: dnslog.cn 在执行前替换为自有一次性权威 DNS 名称，且应用与操作者解析流量可区分
prerequisites.en: dnslog.cn is replaced before execution with a controlled one-time authoritative DNS name, and application traffic is distinguishable from operator resolution.

analysis.zh: 可确认结果限于 Fastjson 在目标配置下选择 InetAddress 类型并触发应用源 DNS。仅 JSON 解析成功、域名出现在异常、公共 DNS 有记录或响应不同都不足；该结果不能被表述为反序列化 RCE。
analysis.en: A confirmed result is limited to Fastjson selecting an InetAddress type under the target configuration and triggering application-origin DNS. Successful JSON parsing, a domain in an exception, public-DNS records, or response differences are insufficient and must not be described as deserialization RCE.

opsecTips.zh: 每条只使用一次性自有 DNS 令牌并限制单次查询；首次应用源解析后停止
opsecTips.en: Use one controlled one-time DNS token per line and limit it to one query; stop after the first application-origin resolution.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除权威记录和令牌映射，清理包含域名与出口地址的临时日志
opsecTips.en: After testing delete authoritative records and token mappings and clean temporary logs containing domains and egress addresses.

description.zh: 键名 @ 以 \u0040 书写，规避 "@type":java.net 特征；成功判据：{LAB_OAST} 仍收到 DNS 解析。
description.en: Writes @ as \u0040 to evade the "@type":java.net signature. Success: {LAB_OAST} still receives the DNS query.

description.zh: 外层键包裹打断首键即 @type 的结构特征，换 Inet6 验证双栈；成功判据：AAAA 解析请求到达。
description.en: An outer key breaks the @type-as-first-key shape while Inet6 probes dual-stack. Success: the AAAA query arrives.

description.zh: 换 InetSocketAddress 类型触发解析，规避仅拦截 Inet4/6Address 的规则；成功判据：OAST 域名被解析。
description.en: Switches to InetSocketAddress to trigger resolution, evading Inet4/6Address-only rules. Success: the OAST domain is resolved.

name.zh: Fastjson JdbcRowSet JNDI 查找边界

description.zh: 使用 RMI 与 LDAP dataSourceName 的 JdbcRowSetImpl JSON 验证 Fastjson AutoType、setter 调用与 JNDI 网络查找是否形成可观察链。
description.en: Uses JdbcRowSetImpl JSON with RMI and LDAP dataSourceName values to test whether Fastjson AutoType, setter invocation, and JNDI network lookup form an observable chain.

overview.zh: Fastjson JdbcRowSet JNDI 查找边界针对 AutoType、setter 调用与 JNDI 网络查找形成可观察链的场景：RMI 与 LDAP 是两种 dataSourceName 形式。验证捕获端回连与链路分层证据。
overview.en: The Fastjson JdbcRowSet JNDI-lookup boundary targets AutoType, setter invocation, and JNDI network lookup forming an observable chain: RMI and LDAP are the two dataSourceName forms. It validates captor callbacks and layered chain evidence.

vulnerability.zh: 如果 Fastjson 允许实例化该类并调用相关 setter，解析不可信 JSON 可能在业务逻辑前触发 RMI/LDAP；后续影响受 JDK 信任限制、类路径和网络控制约束，建立连接并不等于类加载或代码执行。
vulnerability.en: If Fastjson allows instantiating the class and invoking its setters, parsing untrusted JSON can trigger RMI/LDAP before business logic; downstream impact is bounded by JDK trust limits, classpath, and network controls—establishing a connection does not equal class loading or code execution.

exploitation.zh: 先部署只记录连接、立即关闭且不返回任何可加载内容的隔离捕获端，再按第 1 步把 ATTACKER 替换为捕获端地址，一次只解析一个协议（rmi:// 与 ldap:// 各一次）；命中判据为捕获端记录到目标回连。分层记录：类型实例化、setter 调用、出站连接与任何后续加载尝试，捕获端不提供对象工厂内容，命中后按 JDK 版本评估升级条件。
exploitation.en: Deploy isolated captors that only log connections, close immediately, and return no loadable content first; then per step 1 replace ATTACKER with captor addresses, parsing one protocol per request (rmi:// and ldap:// once each); a hit is the captor logging the target's callback. Layer the records: type instantiation, setter invocation, outbound connection, and any subsequent load attempts—the captor provides no object-factory content; after a hit, assess upgrade conditions per JDK version.

mitigation.zh: 升级 Fastjson，关闭或精确允许 AutoType，绑定固定 DTO；限制应用到 RMI/LDAP 端口的出站，并采用受支持 JDK 安全默认值。修复后重放两个协议变体并对照普通 DTO 请求，确认普通 DTO 正常且两个捕获端均无连接。
mitigation.en: Upgrade Fastjson, disable or precisely allowlist AutoType, bind to fixed DTOs; restrict application egress to RMI/LDAP ports and adopt supported JDK security defaults. After the fix, replay both protocol variants against a normal DTO control, confirming the DTO works while both captors receive nothing.

title.zh: 建立无对象 JNDI 捕获器

description.zh: RMI 与 LDAP 监听器只记录来源、令牌和首包，绝不返回 Reference 或类数据。
description.en: RMI and LDAP listeners record only source, token, and first bytes and never return a Reference or class data.

description.zh: 替换主机并为两条输入分配独立请求 ID，每个环境只执行一次。
description.en: Replace the host and assign distinct request IDs to both inputs, executing each environment only once.

title.zh: 证明 Setter 到网络查找

description.zh: 关联 Fastjson 类型/setter 跟踪、解析线程与捕获器连接，并确认没有对象返回。
description.en: Correlate Fastjson type and setter traces, parser thread, and capture connection, and confirm that no object was returned.

title.zh: 阻断 AutoType 与 JNDI 出站

description.zh: 修复后重放普通 DTO 和两条 JSON，确认无捕获连接并删除监听器与令牌。
description.en: After remediation replay the ordinary DTO and both JSON inputs, confirm no captured connection, and remove listeners and tokens.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境固定 Fastjson/JDK 版本与 AutoType 策略，并确认解析入口会绑定属性 setter
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment pins Fastjson and JDK versions and AutoType policy and confirms that the parser entry binds property setters.

prerequisites.zh: RMI/LDAP 地址改为只记录连接、不返回 Reference、对象或类字节的自有捕获器
prerequisites.en: RMI and LDAP addresses are replaced with controlled capture services that log connections but return no Reference, object, or class bytes.

analysis.zh: 阳性仅证明目标 Fastjson/JDK 组合实例化 JdbcRowSetImpl、设置 dataSourceName/autoCommit 并发起应用源 RMI/LDAP 连接。没有 Reference、对象或类字节返回时，不能声称 JNDI 类加载或 RCE。
analysis.en: A positive proves only that the target Fastjson and JDK combination instantiated JdbcRowSetImpl, set dataSourceName and autoCommit, and initiated an application-origin RMI or LDAP connection. With no Reference, object, or class bytes returned, JNDI class loading and RCE cannot be claimed.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获器设置首包即断开和全局超时，禁止返回任何序列化对象、Reference 或远程类
opsecTips.en: Configure capture services to close after the first bytes with a global timeout and return no serialized object, Reference, or remote class.

opsecTips.zh: 完成后关闭两个端口、删除请求令牌并核对 JVM 没有类加载、线程残留或后续连接
opsecTips.en: Afterward close both ports, delete request tokens, and verify the JVM has no class load, residual thread, or follow-up connection.

description.zh: @type 键以 \u0040 开头书写，绕过对 "@type":com.sun 特征串的匹配；成功判据：LDAP 服务收到 JNDI 连接。
description.en: Writes the @type key with a leading \u0040 escape to evade the "@type":com.sun signature. Success: LDAP service receives the JNDI connection.

description.zh: 外层再包一层对象键，打断 JSON 首键即 @type 的结构特征；成功判据：RMI 端口收到回连。
description.en: Adds an outer object key to break the pattern of @type as the first JSON key. Success: RMI port receives the callback.

title.zh: LADP 错拼缓存绕过变体

description.zh: 利用 JNDI URL 解析按前缀截断的缺陷，ladp:// 被当作 ldap 处理，绕过 ldap:// 明文检测；成功判据：LDAP 服务端仍收到请求。
description.en: Exploits JNDI URL prefix parsing that treats ladp:// as ldap, evading plaintext ldap:// detection. Success: the LDAP server still receives the request.

name.zh: Jackson 多态类型网络副作用边界

description.zh: 使用 JEditorPane HTTP 页面与 JdbcRowSet RMI 数据源两个数组式多态 JSON，验证 Jackson 默认类型配置是否允许网络能力类型产生出站副作用。
description.en: Uses array-form polymorphic JSON for a JEditorPane HTTP page and JdbcRowSet RMI data source to test whether Jackson default typing permits network-capable types to produce outbound side effects.

overview.zh: Jackson 多态类型网络副作用边界针对启用默认类型时数组式多态 JSON 携带具体类名的场景：JEditorPane 的 page 与 JdbcRowSet 的 dataSourceName 具有网络副作用。验证类型边界宽度的出站证据。
overview.en: The Jackson polymorphic-type network side-effect boundary targets array-style polymorphic JSON carrying concrete class names when default typing is enabled: JEditorPane's page and JdbcRowSet's dataSourceName carry network side effects. It validates outbound evidence of type-boundary breadth.

vulnerability.zh: 不可信 JSON 若能选择任意多态类型，解析器可能调用具有 I/O 副作用的 setter；出站 HTTP/RMI 证明类型边界过宽，但在捕获器不返回内容时不能推导类执行，类型被拒绝或模块不可访问是阴性。
vulnerability.en: If untrusted JSON can select arbitrary polymorphic types, the parser may invoke I/O-side-effecting setters; outbound HTTP/RMI proves the type boundary is too broad, but class execution cannot be inferred when captors return nothing—rejections or inaccessible modules are negative.

exploitation.zh: 把 ATTACKER 分别替换为隔离 HTTP/RMI 捕获端后按第 1 步逐条解析两个数组式 JSON，每次只解析一个类型，服务端不返回 class、对象或可执行内容；命中判据为捕获端记录到出站请求，证明默认类型配置允许网络能力类型实例化。记录 Jackson 版本、类型验证器与模块可见性；类型被拒绝时记录为阴性并核对 PolymorphicTypeValidator 配置。
exploitation.en: Replace ATTACKER with isolated HTTP/RMI captors respectively, then parse the two array-style JSON payloads one by one per step 1—one type per request, with the server never returning classes, objects, or executable content; a hit is the captor logging an outbound request, proving default typing allows network-capable type instantiation. Record Jackson version, type validators, and module visibility; rejections are negative—verify PolymorphicTypeValidator configuration alongside.

mitigation.zh: 禁用不需要的默认类型，使用 PolymorphicTypeValidator 精确允许业务类型，绑定固定 DTO 并升级受支持 Jackson/JDK；网络层阻断应用到任意 HTTP/RMI 目标。修复后重放第 1 步两个输入并对照合法 DTO，确认合法反序列化正常且捕获端无连接。
mitigation.en: Disable unneeded default typing, precisely allowlist business types via PolymorphicTypeValidator, bind to fixed DTOs, and upgrade to supported Jackson/JDK; block application egress to arbitrary HTTP/RMI targets at the network layer. After the fix, replay both step-1 inputs against a legitimate DTO control, confirming valid deserialization works while captors receive nothing.

title.zh: 记录 ObjectMapper 类型策略

description.zh: 保存默认类型、验证器、声明基类、JDK 模块和固定 DTO 的无连接结果。
description.en: Preserve default typing, validator, declared base type, JDK modules, and the fixed DTO's no-connection result.

title.zh: 逐类型连接空响应捕获器
title.en: Connect each type to an empty-response capture service

description.zh: HTTP 与 RMI 使用不同令牌和端口，单次解析且不提供任何响应对象。
description.en: Use distinct tokens and ports for HTTP and RMI, parse once, and provide no response object.

description.zh: 匹配 Jackson 跟踪、解析线程、目标属性和首包日志，限定为网络副作用。
description.en: Match Jackson traces, parser thread, target property, and first-packet log and limit the finding to a network side effect.

title.en: Constrain type validation and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放 DTO 与两个多态输入，确认类型在连接前拒绝，再关闭捕获器。
description.en: After remediation replay the DTO and both polymorphic inputs, confirm type rejection before connection, and close capture services.

prerequisites.zh: 已冻结 Jackson/JDK 版本、ObjectMapper 默认类型设置、允许类型验证器和解析目标类型
prerequisites.en: Jackson and JDK versions, ObjectMapper default-typing settings, polymorphic type validator, and declared target type are frozen.

prerequisites.zh: HTTP 与 RMI 目标改为自有首包捕获器，既不提供 class 文件也不返回远程对象
prerequisites.en: HTTP and RMI targets are replaced with controlled first-packet capture services that provide neither class files nor remote objects.

analysis.zh: 可证结论是 Jackson 在目标设置下接受网络能力类型并产生应用源 HTTP 或 RMI 连接。捕获器不返回 class/object，因此不能声称远程类加载、反序列化 gadget 完成或 RCE；错误和 DNS 只是诊断信号。
analysis.en: The supportable conclusion is that Jackson accepted a network-capable type under the target settings and produced an application-origin HTTP or RMI connection. Because capture services return no class or object, remote class loading, a completed gadget, and RCE cannot be claimed; errors and DNS are diagnostic only.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获器只接收首包并立即断开，禁止托管 Exploit.class、RMI 对象或重定向
opsecTips.en: Capture only the first packet and disconnect immediately; never host Exploit.class, RMI objects, or redirects.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭 HTTP/RMI 端口、清除 token 与连接日志，并核对 JVM 无新增类或线程
opsecTips.en: After testing close HTTP and RMI ports, clear tokens and connection logs, and verify no new JVM class or thread remains.

description.zh: 类名整体 \u 转义书写，规避 JEditorPane 明文黑名单；成功判据：{ATTACKER_HOST} 收到 class 请求。
description.en: Fully \u-escapes the class name to evade the JEditorPane plaintext blacklist. Success: {ATTACKER_HOST} receives the class request.

description.zh: RMI 换 LDAP 端口规避 rmi:// 明文与服务端口过滤；成功判据：LDAP 服务收到连接。
description.en: Swaps RMI for LDAP to evade the rmi:// literal and port filtering. Success: the LDAP service receives the connection.

description.zh: 属性名大小写变形并混入空白，规避 page 属性精确匹配；成功判据：目标仍发起页面加载请求。
description.en: Mutates property case with whitespace to evade exact page-attribute matching. Success: the target still fetches the page.

name.zh: GraphQL 变量文件路径边界

description.zh: 使用父目录字符串验证 GraphQL String 变量是否被 resolver 当作文件名或资源路径并越过服务端根目录。
description.en: Uses a parent-directory string to test whether a GraphQL String variable is treated as a filename or resource path and escapes the server root.

overview.zh: GraphQL 变量文件路径边界针对 GraphQL String 变量被 resolver 当作文件名或资源路径的场景：类型合法与路径安全是两层问题。验证父目录字符串在变量位置的路径行为（以代码确认进入路径 API 为前提）。
overview.en: The GraphQL variable filesystem path boundary targets GraphQL String variables treated by resolvers as filenames or resource paths: type validity and path safety are separate layers. It validates path behavior of parent-directory strings at the variable position, premised on code confirming the variable enters path APIs.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 resolver 复用 id 作为文件名、模板或对象路径，直接拼接到目录且只做原始字符串过滤；GraphQL schema 不理解文件系统语义，无法替代规范路径与根目录校验。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is resolvers reusing id as filename, template, or object path, splicing it into directories with raw-string filtering only; GraphQL schemas do not understand filesystem semantics and cannot substitute for canonical-path and root validation.

exploitation.zh: 先以代码或日志确认 id 变量确实进入路径 API（若只是数据库键该样例不适用），再按第 1 步提交 variables 中 id 为 ../../etc/passwd 的标准 query，并把系统路径替换为根目录外测试标记；命中判据为 resolver 按注入路径打开文件并返回标记内容。记录 schema 类型、resolver 实现与最终解析路径；命中后评估读取、写入或包含三类影响。
exploitation.en: First confirm via code or logs that the id variable genuinely enters path APIs (the sample does not apply if it is only a database key), then submit the standard query with variables.id set to ../../etc/passwd per step 1, replacing system paths with an out-of-root test marker; a hit is the resolver opening the file per the injected path and returning marker content. Record the schema type, resolver implementation, and final resolved path; after a hit, assess the read, write, and inclusion impact classes.

mitigation.zh: 把 GraphQL id 映射到服务端对象而非路径；必须处理路径时，完全解码后解析规范绝对路径并强制固定根目录、禁止符号链接越界；文件服务身份最小权限，schema 使用语义明确的 ID scalar。修复后重放第 1 步变量，确认路径被拒绝且正常查询可用。
mitigation.en: Map GraphQL ids to server-side objects rather than paths; when paths must be handled, resolve canonical absolute paths after full decoding, enforce a fixed root, and forbid symlink escape; run the file-service identity least-privileged and use semantically clear ID scalars in schemas. After the fix, replay the step-1 variables and confirm paths are rejected while normal queries work.

title.zh: 确认变量到路径的数据流

description.zh: 从 GraphQL validation 追踪 id 到 resolver、路径拼接和最终文件 API。
description.en: Trace id from GraphQL validation through resolver, path composition, and final file API.

description.zh: 替换系统目标后发送一次 JSON，并保留规范路径和请求 ID。
description.en: Replace the system target, send the JSON once, and retain canonical path and request ID.

description.zh: 匹配文件审计、标记内容和 resolver 日志，排除数据库键错误。
description.en: Match file audit, marker content, and resolver logs, excluding database-key errors.

title.en: Switch to object mapping and regress

description.zh: 修复后重放合法 ID 和路径变量，确认前者可用且后者不会触发文件访问。
description.en: After remediation replay valid IDs and path variables to preserve the former without filesystem access from the latter.

prerequisites.zh: resolver 的 id/String 变量实际参与文件或对象路径解析
prerequisites.en: A resolver's id or String variable actually participates in file or object-path resolution.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离文件根目录外有无敏感标记并启用访问审计
prerequisites.en: A nonsensitive marker exists outside the isolated file root with access auditing.

analysis.zh: 如果 resolver 只做数据库查询，该样例属于 SQL/类型输入而非文件漏洞。报告必须给出路径 API 和真实规范路径，不能从 `../` 字符串下结论。
analysis.en: If the resolver only queries a database, this sample is a type or SQL input, not a file flaw. Report the path API and actual canonical path rather than concluding from ../ text.

opsecTips.zh: 将 `/etc/passwd` 替换为测试标记，禁止读取真实系统文件。
opsecTips.en: Replace /etc/passwd with a test marker and never read a real system file.

opsecTips.zh: 只在确认路径数据流后发送一次，避免无意义探测污染 GraphQL 审计。
opsecTips.en: Send once only after confirming the path data flow to avoid meaningless GraphQL audit noise.

description.zh: Windows 分隔符入 GraphQL 变量。判据：返回文件内容或错误泄露。
description.en: Windows separators inside the variable. Success: file content or leaky error.

description.zh: 编码遍历过 WAF。判据：解析后命中文件。
description.en: Encoded traversal passes the WAF. Success: resolves to the file.

description.zh: 绝对路径加空字节。判据：读取成功。
description.en: Absolute path with null byte. Success: read succeeds.

description.zh: 双写遍历抵消一次过滤。判据：读出 passwd。
description.en: Doubling defeats one filtering pass. Success: passwd read.

name.zh: SameSite Cookie 浏览器发送边界

description.zh: 验证 Lax、Strict、None 和未声明 Cookie 在顶级导航、子资源、弹窗回调、Schemeful Site 与客户端重定向中的实际附带行为。
description.en: Validate actual Lax, Strict, None, and unspecified cookie inclusion across top-level navigation, subresources, popup callbacks, schemeful sites, and client redirects.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SameSite Cookie 属性在跨站场景下的发送边界，检验不同 SameSite 值的会话 Cookie 在导航、子资源、弹窗回调与重定向中是否被浏览器附带。验证维度为顶级导航与 img 子资源对照、noopener 弹窗回调两类样例，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the sending boundary of SameSite cookie attributes in cross-site scenarios, testing whether session cookies with different SameSite values are attached during navigation, subresources, popup callbacks and redirects. Validation covers a top-level navigation versus img subresource comparison and a noopener popup callback, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Cookie 的 SameSite 属性缺省或配置过宽：未声明或 None 的 Cookie 在跨站子资源与重定向中仍被浏览器发送，服务端又只凭该 Cookie 鉴权，跨站请求因此天然携带受害者身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a missing or overly permissive SameSite attribute: cookies without SameSite or set to None are still sent on cross-site subresources and redirects, and since the server authenticates by that cookie alone, cross-site requests naturally carry the victim identity.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在同一跨站页面放置顶级链接与 img 子资源并分别触发，比较服务端收到的 Cookie marker，子资源仍附带 Cookie 即暴露发送边界；第 2 步用 noopener 弹窗访问回调 marker，观察顶级上下文中的附带行为。逐个 SameSite 值重复即得完整矩阵。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；扩展时参考 wafBypass 的 Schemeful Site 对照。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place a top-level link and an img subresource on the same cross-site page and trigger both, comparing cookie markers at the server; a subresource still carrying cookies exposes the sending boundary. In step 2, visit the callback marker via a noopener popup to observe top-level attachment. Repeat per SameSite value for a full matrix. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass Schemeful Site comparisons for extensions.

mitigation.zh: 会话 Cookie 显式设置 SameSite=Lax 或 Strict 并配 Secure；跨站回调流程改用 Token 而非 Cookie 承载身份。修复后重放第 1、2 步，跨站子资源与弹窗请求应不再携带会话 Cookie。
mitigation.en: Set session cookies explicitly to SameSite=Lax or Strict with Secure; carry identity in cross-site callback flows via tokens instead of cookies. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: cross-site subresource and popup requests should no longer carry the session cookie.

description.zh: 保存 Lax、Strict、None 与未声明 Fixture 的完整 Set-Cookie Header。
description.en: Preserve complete Set-Cookie headers for Lax, Strict, None, and unspecified fixtures.

description.zh: 从独立 Site 触发顶级导航和 img 子资源，比较 Cookie 是否附带。
description.en: Trigger top-level navigation and an img subresource from a separate site and compare cookie inclusion.

title.zh: 运行 Chromium Cookie 矩阵

description.zh: 自动覆盖四种 Cookie 配置和多种请求类型，逐项保存浏览器与服务端证据。
description.en: Automatically cover four cookie configurations and multiple request types, preserving browser and server evidence per case.

description.zh: 要求跨站状态请求无会话，同时同站登录与必要回调仍按设计工作。
description.en: Require no session on cross-site state requests while preserving same-site login and required callbacks by design.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 Chromium 与本地 Cookie Fixture，为每个用例创建独立 Context 和合成 Cookie。
prerequisites.en: Use Chromium and a local cookie fixture with a separate context and synthetic cookie for every case.

prerequisites.zh: 记录 Set-Cookie 属性、请求类型、top-level site、Cookie 是否附带、服务端 marker 与浏览器版本。
prerequisites.en: Record Set-Cookie attributes, request type, top-level site, cookie inclusion, server marker, and browser version.

analysis.zh: 阳性结论必须指出具体 Cookie 属性、浏览器版本、请求类型、top-level site 和实际附带结果。仅看到 SameSite=None、存在子域或使用重定向不能直接证明 CSRF。
analysis.en: A positive conclusion must identify cookie attributes, browser version, request type, top-level site, and actual inclusion result. Seeing SameSite=None, a subdomain, or a redirect alone does not prove CSRF.

opsecTips.zh: 所有 Cookie 值为合成 marker，不记录真实 Session；每个用例使用全新浏览器 Context。
opsecTips.en: Every cookie value is a synthetic marker, with no real sessions recorded and a fresh browser context per case.

opsecTips.zh: 只观察 Cookie 附带和日志 marker，不把 GET、OAuth 回调或重定向连接到真实状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Observe only cookie inclusion and log markers without connecting GET, OAuth callback, or redirects to real state changes.

name.zh: CSRF Token 绑定与解析边界
name.en: CSRF Token Binding and Parsing Boundary

description.zh: 验证 Token 的会话绑定、必填行为、一次性重放、方法覆盖和 JSON/Form 解析一致性，并把统计与代码审计迁入工具区。
description.en: Validate token session binding, required-token behavior, one-time replay, method overrides, and JSON/form parser consistency, moving statistics and code inspection into tools.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 CSRF Token 校验逻辑的边界场景，检验 Token 是否真正绑定会话且在缺失、为空时被拒绝。验证维度为跨 Session 的攻击者 Fixture Token 组合与缺失、空值拒绝矩阵，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers boundary conditions of CSRF token validation, testing whether tokens are truly session-bound and rejected when missing or empty. Validation covers combining a victim session with an attacker fixture token and a missing/empty rejection matrix, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 Token 校验不完整：Token 未与当前会话绑定，缺失或空值时校验被跳过，或仅做存在性检查，攻击者持任意合法格式 Token 或不带 Token 即可让写请求通过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is incomplete token validation: tokens are not bound to the current session, checks are skipped when the token is missing or empty, or only existence is verified, letting attackers pass write requests with any well-formed token or none at all.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以受害者 Session 头搭配攻击者 Fixture 的 X-CSRF-Token 发送 POST，服务端返回绑定不匹配拒绝即证明绑定生效，被接受即为漏洞；第 2 步分别发送缺失与空 Token 两种请求，任一放行即确认校验缺陷。成功判据以响应状态与服务端日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；被拦截时参考 wafBypass 的方法覆盖与 JSON 解析一致性样例。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send a POST combining the victim session header with an attacker fixture X-CSRF-Token; a binding-mismatch rejection proves the binding works, acceptance indicates the flaw. In step 2, send requests with a missing token and an empty token; any acceptance confirms the validation defect. Judge success by response status and server logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; if blocked, see the method-override and JSON-parsing consistency samples in wafBypass.

mitigation.zh: 校验逻辑要求每个状态变更请求携带与会话绑定的随机 Token，缺失、空值或不匹配一律拒绝并告警。修复后重放第 1、2 步，所有异常组合应返回 403 且无状态变化。
mitigation.en: Require every state-changing request to carry a random, session-bound token; reject missing, empty or mismatched tokens and raise alerts. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: all abnormal combinations should return 403 with no state change.

description.zh: 用同一合成 Session 与 Token 执行 marker 请求，记录接受与消费状态。
description.en: Execute a marker request with a matching synthetic session and token and record acceptance plus consumption state.

description.zh: 把攻击者 Fixture Token 与受害者 Session 组合，要求明确返回绑定不匹配。
description.en: Combine the attacker fixture token with the victim session and require an explicit binding-mismatch denial.

attackChain.payload: curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/lab/csrf/token-binding" -H "X-Lab-Session: CSRF_VICTIM_B2" -H "X-CSRF-Token: CSRF_ATTACKER_TOKEN_B2" --data "marker=CSRF_BINDING_B2" | jq -e '.accepted == false and .reason == "token_session_mismatch"'

description.zh: 分别测试缺失、空值、方法覆盖和 JSON Content-Type，保持 marker 不变。
description.en: Test missing, empty, method-override, and JSON content types separately while holding the marker constant.

description.zh: 使用工具统计、泄露检索和两次重放定位缺陷，修复后重放全部矩阵。
description.en: Use statistics, leakage search, and two-request replay tools to locate flaws, then replay the full matrix after remediation.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两套合成 Session 和独立 Token Fixture，服务端只修改一次性 marker。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic sessions with independent token fixtures, and let the server modify only one-time markers.

prerequisites.zh: 能够记录 Token 来源、Session ID 摘要、消费次数、解析器和拒绝原因。
prerequisites.en: Record token source, session-ID digest, consumption count, parser, and denial reason.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要服务端在错误 Session、缺失 Token 或绕过解析路径下接受请求并改变合成状态。随机性看起来较弱、Token 重复出现或日志检索命中都只是需要进一步验证的线索。
analysis.en: A positive requires the server to accept a request and change synthetic state under the wrong session, missing token, or bypass parser path. Weak-looking randomness, repeated tokens, or a static-search hit is only a lead requiring further validation.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用合成 Token 和 Session 摘要，禁止读取、打印或重放真实用户 Token。
opsecTips.en: Use only synthetic tokens and session digests and never read, print, or replay real user tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 重放工具固定两次请求，不执行预测、字典、并发或无界 Token 采样。
opsecTips.en: The replay tool is fixed to two requests and performs no prediction, dictionary use, concurrency, or unbounded token sampling.

name.zh: 凭据型 CORS 响应可见性边界

description.zh: 从 CSRF 分类中拆出 CORS，验证反射 Origin、null Origin、正则允许列表和携带凭据的跨源响应是否可被浏览器脚本读取。
description.en: Separate CORS from CSRF and validate whether reflected origins, null origins, regex allowlists, and credentialed cross-origin responses are readable by browser scripts.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖凭据型 CORS 响应可见性场景，检验服务端是否把带凭据的跨源响应暴露给攻击者页面脚本读取。验证维度为反射 Origin 与 sandbox 派生 null Origin 两类读取样例，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers credentialed CORS response visibility, testing whether the server exposes credentialed cross-origin responses to attacker page scripts. Validation covers reflective-Origin and sandbox-derived null-Origin read samples, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 CORS 校验把请求 Origin 原样反射进 Access-Control-Allow-Origin 并同时放行 Allow-Credentials：任意站点因此能在受害者浏览器中读取仅对其会话可见的响应内容。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is CORS validation that reflects the request Origin verbatim into Access-Control-Allow-Origin while also allowing credentials: any site can then read responses visible only to the victim session inside the victim browser.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步从独立本地 Origin 以凭据发起请求，页面读回唯一 marker 即确认反射 Origin 的凭据响应可读；第 2 步在 sandbox srcdoc 的 null Origin 中重复请求，浏览器允许读取即确认 null 源放行。以 marker 显示与 ACAO、ACAC 头记录为判据留证。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；对照参考 wafBypass 条目。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send a credentialed request from a separate local origin; the page reading back the unique marker confirms the reflective-origin response is readable. In step 2, repeat from a sandbox srcdoc null origin; browser readability confirms null-origin allowance. Use the displayed marker and ACAO/ACAC records as evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; see wafBypass entries for controls.

mitigation.zh: CORS 允许列表精确匹配预注册 Origin，禁止通配或反射；带凭据响应仅回给可信源。修复后重放第 1、2 步，浏览器应阻断读取且响应不含 ACAO 反射头。
mitigation.en: Match CORS allowlists exactly against pre-registered origins, banning wildcard or reflection; return credentialed responses only to trusted origins. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: the browser should block reads and responses should carry no reflected ACAO header.

title.zh: 采集 CORS Header 基线

description.zh: 比较允许源、跨站源和 null Origin 的 ACAO、ACAC 与 Vary。
description.en: Compare ACAO, ACAC, and Vary for allowed, cross-site, and null origins.

title.zh: 运行反射 Origin 浏览器样例

description.zh: 从未批准本地 Origin 发起带凭据请求并只显示返回 marker。
description.en: Send a credentialed request from an unapproved local origin and display only the returned marker.

attackChain.payload: pending

title.zh: 覆盖 null 与正则允许列表

description.zh: 使用 Sandbox null Origin 和三个混淆 Origin 分别验证解析与响应可见性。
description.en: Validate parsing and response visibility separately for a sandboxed null origin and three confused origins.

title.zh: 修复后重放可见性矩阵
title.en: Replay the visibility matrix after remediation

description.zh: 要求未批准 Origin 无法读取 marker，且允许 Origin 仍保留正常业务读取。
description.en: Require unapproved origins to lose marker visibility while approved origins retain normal business reads.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个本地 Origin 和只返回 marker 的 CORS Fixture，Cookie 仅代表合成身份。
prerequisites.en: Use two local origins and a marker-only CORS fixture whose cookie represents only a synthetic identity.

prerequisites.zh: 在 Chromium 中记录 Request Origin、预检、ACAO、ACAC、Vary、响应可见性和控制台错误。
prerequisites.en: Record request Origin, preflight, ACAO, ACAC, Vary, response visibility, and console errors in Chromium.

analysis.zh: CORS 阳性证据是浏览器脚本实际获得带凭据 marker，而不只是响应 Header 看起来宽松。状态变更是否发生属于独立 CSRF/授权结论，应分别报告。
analysis.en: Positive CORS evidence is actual browser-script access to a credentialed marker, not merely permissive-looking response headers. Whether a state change occurs is a separate CSRF or authorization conclusion and must be reported separately.

opsecTips.zh: 响应只包含合成 marker 或长度，禁止读取用户资料、Token、邮箱或业务对象。
opsecTips.en: Responses contain only synthetic markers or lengths, never user profiles, tokens, email, or business objects.

opsecTips.zh: 使用独立浏览器上下文验证每个 Origin，完成后删除合成 Cookie 与 CORS 日志。
opsecTips.en: Use a separate browser context per origin and remove synthetic cookies plus CORS logs afterward.

name.zh: GraphQL Schema 暴露边界验证

description.zh: 使用最小只读内省查询验证指定角色是否能够看到 Query 类型名称，并把类型映射、Schema 导出和角色矩阵迁入工具卡。
description.en: Use a minimal read-only introspection query to validate whether a designated role may view the Query type name, moving type maps, schema export, and role matrices into a tool card.

subCategory.zh: API 与 RPC 攻击面发现

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 GraphQL Schema 可见性场景，检验指定角色能否看到 Query 类型名称等内省信息，衡量 Schema 暴露面与角色可见性策略的一致性。验证维度为最小只读内省查询单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers GraphQL schema visibility, testing whether a given role can see introspection data such as the Query type name, measuring consistency between schema exposure and role visibility policy. Validation runs a minimal read-only introspection query in a single step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于内省功能对所有角色开放或与登记的可见性策略不一致：低权限主体也能枚举 Query 类型与字段结构，攻击者据此绘制完整攻击面再定向寻找敏感字段与 Mutation。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is introspection open to every role or inconsistent with the registered visibility policy: low-privileged principals can enumerate Query types and field structure, letting attackers map the full attack surface and then target sensitive fields and mutations.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以固定实验角色向 graphql 端点发送只查询 queryType.name 的最小内省请求，把返回的 data 或 errors 与登记的可见性策略比对；返回类型名而策略禁止即确认 Schema 暴露，错误拒绝则说明边界一致。成功判据以响应结构为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；类型映射与 Schema 导出可使用平台工具卡完成。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send a minimal introspection query fetching only queryType.name to the GraphQL endpoint as a fixed lab role, comparing the returned data or errors against the registered visibility policy; a type name returned despite the policy confirms schema exposure, an error rejection shows consistent boundaries. Judge success by response structure. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use platform tool cards for type mapping and schema export.

mitigation.zh: 生产环境关闭或按角色限制内省，敏感类型与字段纳入可见性策略并定期导出核对。修复后重放第 1 步，低权限角色的内省应返回错误且不含类型信息。
mitigation.en: Disable or role-restrict introspection in production, put sensitive types and fields under a visibility policy, and review exports regularly. After the fix, replay step 1: introspection for the low-privileged role should error without type information.

description.zh: 记录受测角色应允许或拒绝的最小 Schema 元数据及预期错误。
description.en: Record minimal schema metadata and expected errors allowed or denied for the tested role.

description.zh: 只查询 queryType.name，并保留角色、请求 ID、data 与 errors。
description.en: Query only queryType.name and retain role, request ID, data, and errors.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/graphql" -H "Authorization: Bearer graphql-lab-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: graphql-introspection-boundary-001" --data '{"query":"query SchemaExposure{__schema{queryType{name}}}"}' | jq -e '.data.__schema.queryType.name or .errors'

description.zh: 判断返回元数据是否超出角色策略，不把内省成功自动记录为漏洞。
description.en: Determine whether returned metadata exceeds role policy rather than treating successful introspection as a vulnerability.

description.zh: 统一解析级策略后重放匿名、普通用户和审核者矩阵，确认预期可见性。
description.en: After unified parsed-operation policy, replay anonymous, ordinary-user, and reviewer roles to confirm expected visibility.

prerequisites.zh: 定义匿名、普通用户和审核者角色的 Schema 可见性策略。
prerequisites.en: Define schema-visibility policy for anonymous, ordinary-user, and reviewer roles.

prerequisites.zh: 使用 localhost GraphQL Fixture，并确保查询只选择 queryType.name。
prerequisites.en: Use a localhost GraphQL fixture and ensure the query selects only queryType.name.

analysis.zh: 有效发现需要明确的角色可见性策略、非预期 Schema 元数据和可解释的安全价值。最小内省成功、公开类型名、统一错误或审核者按设计导出 Schema 都不是漏洞。
analysis.en: A valid finding requires an explicit role-visibility policy, unexpected schema metadata, and explainable security relevance. Minimal introspection success, public type names, generic errors, or reviewer schema export by design are not vulnerabilities.

opsecTips.zh: Payload 只请求 queryType.name，不下载完整 Schema 或字段说明。
opsecTips.en: The payload requests queryType.name only and does not download a complete schema or field descriptions.

opsecTips.zh: Schema 导出仅由审核者工具保存到本地实验文件，并在比较后删除。
opsecTips.en: Only the reviewer tool may save a schema to a local lab file, which is deleted after comparison.

description.zh: 用别名 _service{ sdl } 拉取 SDL 绕过 __schema 内省禁用。成功判据：返回完整 Schema 定义。
description.en: Uses _service{ sdl } aliases to fetch SDL past disabled introspection. Success: full schema definition returns.

wafBypass.command: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST http://127.0.0.1:18080/graphql -H "Authorization: Bearer {TOKEN}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"query($n:String!){__type(name:$n){fields{name args{name type{name kind}}}}}","variables":{"n":"Query"}}'

description.zh: 用变量传类型名绕过查询体中 __type 特征。成功判据：逐类型还原出字段清单。
description.en: Passing the type name via a variable bypasses __type signatures in the query body. Success: field lists are reconstructed type by type.

description.zh: 把内省字段包进带指令的查询绕过基于内省字段名的拦截。成功判据：返回 queryType 信息。
description.en: Wrapping introspection fields in directive-bearing queries evades field-name-based blocking. Success: queryType information returns.

name.zh: API 属性级授权边界验证

description.zh: 验证低权限主体提交允许属性与一个服务器管理属性时，API 是否明确拒绝或忽略不可写字段且不发生持久化变化。
description.en: Validate that an API explicitly rejects or ignores one server-managed property submitted alongside an allowed property without persisting unauthorized state.

subCategory.zh: 对象与属性级越权 BOLA/IDOR

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 API 属性级授权场景，检验低权限主体提交允许属性叠加服务器管理属性时，接口是否拒绝或忽略不可写字段。验证维度为单一管理属性在无副作用契约端点的检查，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers API property-level authorization, testing whether the API rejects or ignores non-writable fields when a low-privileged principal submits an allowed property alongside a server-managed one. Validation checks a single managed property against a side-effect-free contract endpoint, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端把请求体直接绑定到实体对象而缺少可写字段清单：客户端携带 review_tier 等管理属性即可篡改本应仅由服务端维护的字段，形成批量赋值越权。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is binding the request body directly onto the entity without a writable-field list: client-supplied managed properties such as review_tier can alter fields that only the server should maintain, enabling mass-assignment privilege escalation.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步向无副作用评估端点提交包含允许显示名与一个 review_tier 的请求体，观察响应与规范化结果；管理字段被显式拒绝或忽略且无持久化变化即通过，被接受入库即确认属性级授权缺失。成功判据以响应字段与持久化状态对照为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；测试前后各查询一次对象状态以便留证。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a body containing the allowed display name plus one review_tier to the side-effect-free evaluate endpoint and observe the response and normalization; explicit rejection or ignoring of the managed field with no persistence passes, acceptance confirms the property-level authorization gap. Judge success by response fields versus persisted state. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; query the object state before and after for evidence.

mitigation.zh: 服务端维护字段级可写清单，管理属性仅由特权接口更新；绑定层忽略未知字段并记录告警。修复后重放第 1 步，管理字段应被拒绝且对象无变化。
mitigation.en: Maintain a field-level writable list server-side, update managed properties only through privileged APIs, and have the binding layer ignore unknown fields with alerts. After the fix, replay step 1: the managed field should be rejected and the object unchanged.

description.zh: 从 schema 与实现记录允许字段、服务器管理字段和预期拒绝行为。
description.en: Record writable fields, server-managed fields, and expected rejection behavior from schema and implementation.

description.zh: 在允许的显示名旁加入 review_tier，并请求无副作用契约评估结果。
description.en: Add review_tier beside an allowed display name and request the side-effect-free contract evaluation result.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/contracts/property/evaluate" -H "Authorization: Bearer lab-user-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: api-property-001" --data '{"display_name":"PROPERTY_CANARY_A1","review_tier":"elevated"}' | jq -e '.accepted.display_name == "PROPERTY_CANARY_A1" and (.rejected | index("review_tier"))'

title.zh: 核对映射与持久化边界

description.zh: 确认管理字段进入拒绝列表，并核对领域对象和持久化日志没有状态变化。
description.en: Confirm the managed field appears in the rejection list and no domain or persistence state changed.

title.zh: 应用 DTO 允许列表回归

description.zh: 使用专用 DTO 修复后重放平面、嵌套和类型变化样例，保持正常字段可写。
description.en: After dedicated DTO remediation, replay flat, nested, and type variants while preserving valid writable fields.

prerequisites.zh: 使用无持久化副作用的属性契约评估端点，并准备一个允许字段和一个服务器管理字段。
prerequisites.en: Use a side-effect-free property-contract evaluator with one writable field and one server-managed field.

prerequisites.zh: 从 OpenAPI schema 和服务实现确认字段的 readOnly、writeOnly 与角色策略。
prerequisites.en: Confirm readOnly, writeOnly, and role policy from the OpenAPI schema and service implementation.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明低权限主体提交的服务器管理属性进入领域或持久化状态。响应回显、schema 中存在字段、未知字段被静默丢弃或类型错误都不能单独证明批量赋值缺陷。
analysis.en: A positive requires a server-managed property submitted by a low-privilege principal to reach domain or persisted state. Reflection, schema visibility, silent dropping, and type errors do not independently prove a mass-assignment flaw.

opsecTips.zh: 使用 evaluate 端点和合成属性，不修改真实角色、密码、余额、配额或租户。
opsecTips.en: Use an evaluation endpoint and synthetic properties; never modify real roles, passwords, balances, quotas, or tenants.

opsecTips.zh: 一次只增加一个服务器管理字段，并保留请求前后状态摘要用于确认无副作用。
opsecTips.en: Add one server-managed property at a time and retain before-and-after state summaries to prove no side effects.

title.zh: 嵌套 select 越权字段

description.zh: 把敏感字段藏进嵌套 include 绕过顶层字段白名单。成功判据：响应包含 secretToken/apiKey。
description.en: Hiding sensitive fields inside nested include bypasses top-level field whitelists. Success: the response contains secretToken/apiKey.

description.zh: PATCH 局部更新通道未复用属性级授权。成功判据:只读属性被修改。
description.en: The PATCH channel skips property-level authorization reuse. Success: read-only properties are modified.

description.zh: 非标准 Accept 触发的序列化路径包含未过滤字段。成功判据：返回超集字段。
description.en: Non-standard Accept values trigger serialization paths that leak unfiltered fields. Success: a superset of fields returns.

name.zh: REST 对象级授权边界验证

description.zh: 使用两个固定实验主体和三个合成对象验证 REST 资源读取是否在每次请求中校验主体、租户、对象与操作关系。
description.en: Validate whether REST resource reads enforce principal, tenant, object, and action relationships on every request using two fixed lab identities and three synthetic objects.

subCategory.zh: 对象与属性级越权 BOLA/IDOR

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 REST 对象级授权场景，检验资源读取是否在每次请求中校验主体、租户、对象与操作的关系。验证维度为双实验主体读取同一合成对象的对照请求，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers REST object-level authorization, testing whether resource reads validate the principal-tenant-object-action relationship on every request. Validation compares two lab principals reading the same synthetic object, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于控制器仅凭对象 ID 取数而未比对归属：任何持有合法令牌的主体都能访问他人对象，形成对象级越权即 IDOR 的基础形态。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is fetching objects by ID alone without ownership comparison: any principal with a valid token can access others' objects, forming the basic IDOR shape of object-level privilege escalation.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用对象所有者与第二个低权限实验主体分别读取同一合成对象，比较两者的授权结果、状态码与服务端请求 ID；第二主体仍获得对象内容即确认越权，返回 404 或 403 则说明校验到位。成功判据以响应与请求 ID 对照为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅使用合成对象以避免触碰真实数据。
exploitation.en: In step 1, read the same synthetic object as the owner and as a second low-privileged lab principal, comparing authorization results, status codes and server request IDs; the second principal still receiving content confirms the escalation, while 404 or 403 shows validation. Judge success by response and request-ID comparison. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use synthetic objects only to avoid touching real data.

mitigation.zh: 每个数据访问点强制执行主体、租户与对象三元校验，未命中归属关系一律返回 404 并记录审计日志。修复后重放第 1 步，非属主主体应无法读取对象。
mitigation.en: Enforce principal-tenant-object checks at every data access point, return 404 on failed ownership and log audits. After the fix, replay step 1: non-owners should be unable to read the object.

description.zh: 由对象所有者读取固定测试对象，记录允许字段、响应状态和授权决策日志。
description.en: Have the owner read the fixed test object and record allowed fields, response status, and authorization-decision logs.

description.zh: 重放受控双主体请求，只改变令牌并保持对象、方法与其他参数完全一致。
description.en: Replay the bounded two-principal request, changing only the token while keeping object, method, and all other parameters identical.

attackChain.payload: for token in owner-a-token reviewer-b-token; do curl --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -o /dev/null -w "$token %{http_code}\n" "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/documents/doc-owner-a" -H "Authorization: Bearer $token" -H "X-Request-ID: bola-boundary-001-$token"; done

description.zh: 比较本人、他人和不存在对象结果，并用请求 ID 关联服务端授权与数据访问日志。
description.en: Compare self, peer, and missing-object results and correlate server authorization and data-access logs by request ID.

description.zh: 修复后重放四维授权矩阵，确认正常访问保留且所有越权读取稳定拒绝。
description.en: After remediation, replay the authorization matrix to preserve legitimate access and consistently reject unauthorized reads.

prerequisites.zh: 准备两个权限明确的实验账户，并分别创建一个带固定 Canary 的测试对象。
prerequisites.en: Prepare two lab accounts with explicit privileges and create one fixed-canary test object for each account.

prerequisites.zh: 记录所有者读取、他人读取和不存在对象三种响应及对应服务端授权日志。
prerequisites.en: Record owner, non-owner, and missing-object responses together with the matching server authorization logs.

analysis.zh: 确认结果必须同时具备低权限主体、非其所有的对象、受保护字段真实返回和服务端授权证据。对象存在性差异、公开字段、缓存响应或统一错误页均不能单独证明 BOLA。
analysis.en: Confirmation requires a low-privilege principal, an object it does not own, actual protected fields, and server authorization evidence. Existence differences, public fields, cached responses, or generic error pages do not independently prove BOLA.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用专用测试租户、合成对象和固定 Canary，不访问任何真实用户对象。
opsecTips.en: Use only a dedicated test tenant, synthetic objects, and fixed canaries; never access real user objects.

opsecTips.zh: 限制为三个已知对象和两个主体，发现越权字段后立即停止并清理测试数据。
opsecTips.en: Limit the matrix to three known objects and two principals, stopping on protected-field disclosure and removing test data afterward.

title.zh: UUID 大小写与连字符变形

wafBypass.command:
curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer reviewer-b-token" http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/resources/7ecdb08a-94be-4a57-8ea9-a9bf3f5b6b9c
curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer reviewer-b-token" http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/resources/7ECDB08A94BE4A578EA9A9BF3F5B6B9C

description.zh: UUID 大小写与去连字符形态绕过资源归属比对。成功判据：他人资源返回 200。
description.en: UUID case and hyphen-less forms bypass ownership comparison. Success: another user's resource returns 200.

description.zh: 路径中编码首字符绕过 ID 匹配与 WAF 特征。成功判据：解码后命中目标资源。
description.en: Encoding the first path character bypasses ID matching and WAF signatures. Success: resolves to the target resource after decode.

wafBypass.command:
curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer reviewer-b-token" http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/v2/lab/resources/1
curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer reviewer-b-token" http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/resources/1.json

description.zh: 版本路径或扩展名后缀落到未实现对象级授权的旧控制器。成功判据：旧通道返回他人资源。
description.en: Version paths or extension suffixes land on legacy controllers without object-level auth. Success: the legacy channel returns another user's resource.

name.zh: API 输入解释边界验证

description.zh: 使用固定无害 Canary 验证 API 输入是否保持数据语义，并把 SQL、结构化过滤、目录过滤和主机参数的解析编排迁入工具卡。
description.en: Use fixed harmless canaries to validate that API inputs remain data while moving SQL-shaped, structured-filter, directory-filter, and host-parameter orchestration into a tool card.

subCategory.zh: 参数污染与输入解释差异

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 API 输入解释边界场景，检验固定无害 Canary 经接口处理后是否保持数据语义、不进入危险解释器。验证维度为单值输入在无副作用评估端点的规范化观察，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the API input-interpretation boundary, testing whether a fixed harmless canary retains its data semantics after processing and never enters dangerous interpreters. Validation observes normalization of a single value at a side-effect-free evaluate endpoint, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于输入在存储、查询或模板等多个环节被差异化解码与解释：同一字符串在不同解析器中出现语义漂移，注入类漏洞因此获得二次触达的机会。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is differential decoding and interpretation of inputs across storage, query and template stages: the same string shifts meaning between parsers, giving injection-class flaws a second touchpoint.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步向本地评估端点提交带单个撇号的固定 Canary，观察响应中的请求 ID 与规范化输入；输入被原样保存或明确拒绝即边界一致，出现解释器特征报错或语义变化即记录为可疑点并转入对应专项测试。成功判据以规范化输出对照为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；SQL、目录与主机参数的解析编排使用平台工具卡完成。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a fixed canary containing a single apostrophe to the local evaluate endpoint and observe the request ID and normalized input in the response; verbatim storage or explicit rejection means consistent boundaries, while interpreter-style errors or semantic drift should be logged as suspicious and routed to specialized tests. Judge success by normalized-output comparison. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use platform tool cards for SQL, directory and host-parameter orchestration.

mitigation.zh: 输入按目标解释器做统一编码与白名单校验，参数化查询与模板自动转义保持一致。修复后重放第 1 步，Canary 的输入输出应保持同义且无解释器报错。
mitigation.en: Apply unified encoding and allowlist validation per target interpreter, keeping parameterized queries and template escaping consistent. After the fix, replay step 1: canary input and output should stay semantically identical with no interpreter errors.

description.zh: 提交普通 Canary 并保存原始输入、规范化值、绑定参数与请求 ID。
description.en: Submit a plain canary and save raw input, normalized value, bound parameters, and request ID.

description.zh: 重放同一请求，仅在固定 Canary 末尾加入一个撇号形状并观察解释差异。
description.en: Replay the same request with one apostrophe-shaped boundary added to the fixed canary and observe interpretation differences.

attackChain.payload: curl --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --max-time 5 -X POST "http://127.0.0.1:18080/api/lab/search/evaluate" -H "Authorization: Bearer lab-token" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-ID: api-input-sqlshape-001" --data '{"query":"INPUT_CANARY_APOSTROPHE_A1\u0027"}' | jq -e '.request_id and .normalized_input'

description.zh: 核对输入是否仍位于单一绑定参数中，并排除错误页、回显和编码差异。
description.en: Verify that the input remains one bound parameter and exclude error pages, reflection, and encoding differences.

description.zh: 应用类型约束和参数绑定后重放普通值与 Canary，确认语义一致且业务输入可用。
description.en: After type constraints and parameter binding, replay the control and canary to confirm stable semantics and valid business input.

prerequisites.zh: 使用仅返回规范化结果和请求 ID 的 localhost 评估端点，不连接真实数据库或系统命令解释器。
prerequisites.en: Use localhost evaluation endpoints that return normalized input and request IDs without connecting to a real database or command interpreter.

prerequisites.zh: 准备普通字符串对照与固定 INPUT_CANARY，并启用最终查询或参数绑定日志。
prerequisites.en: Prepare a plain-string control and fixed INPUT_CANARY values with final-query or parameter-binding logs enabled.

analysis.zh: 阳性必须证明输入改变了最终解释结构或后端操作，而不是仅触发错误、转义、拒绝或 WAF 命中。固定 Canary 不包含数据提取、文件路径或系统命令，因此证据聚焦输入边界本身。
analysis.en: A positive requires proof that the input changed the final interpreted structure or backend operation, not merely an error, escape, rejection, or WAF event. The fixed canary contains no extraction query, file path, or system command, keeping evidence focused on the input boundary.

opsecTips.zh: 只对无真实后端副作用的 evaluate 端点发送 Canary，并设置五秒超时。
opsecTips.en: Send canaries only to side-effect-free evaluation endpoints and enforce a five-second timeout.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只改变一个字符或输入形状，禁止附加数据提取和命令执行内容。
opsecTips.en: Change one character or input shape per request and never append data-extraction or command-execution content.

description.zh: 数字类型与嵌套 proto 键混入输入解释层。成功判据：非字符串输入被解释执行。
description.en: Numeric types plus nested proto keys reach the input interpretation layer. Success: non-string input is interpreted.

description.zh: Unicode 转义在解码后还原通配与关键字，绕过传输层特征。成功判据：还原值触发解释器行为。
description.en: Unicode escapes resolve into wildcards/keywords past transport-layer signatures. Success: resolved values trigger interpreter behavior.

description.zh: JSON 重复键使校验层取 safe 值、执行层取 * 值。成功判据：执行层以未校验值运行。
description.en: Duplicate JSON keys let validation see safe while execution sees *. Success: execution runs with the unvalidated value.

name.zh: SQL 登录查询边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SQL 登录查询边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a SQL Login Query Boundary validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: 凭证注入与弱类型登录绕过

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SQL 登录查询边界场景，检验登录接口的凭据拼接是否可被恒真条件与注释符改变查询语义。验证维度为经典 SQLi 登录绕过语句在合成主体下的执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SQL login-query boundary, testing whether credential concatenation in the login flow can be altered by tautology conditions and comment markers. Validation executes classic SQLi login-bypass payloads against a synthetic principal, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于登录 SQL 将用户输入直接拼进 WHERE 子句：攻击者用引号闭合凭据再注入 OR 恒真与注释符，查询即无条件命中，口令校验被绕过并直接建立会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is user input concatenated directly into the login WHERE clause: closing the credential with a quote and injecting an OR tautology plus a comment makes the query match unconditionally, bypassing password checks and establishing a session.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以合成主体在隔离环境执行 admin 加注释符与 OR 恒真两条样例并提交登录端点，返回已认证会话或跳转即确认查询边界失守，同时比对服务端 SQL 日志确认注入语句进入执行。成功判据以只读标记与会话证据为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；全部测试在书面授权范围内进行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, execute the two samples (quote-plus-comment and OR tautology) against the login endpoint as a synthetic principal in an isolated environment; an authenticated session or redirect confirms the query boundary is breached, and server SQL logs should show the injected statement executing. Judge success by the read-only marker and session evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run all tests within written authorization.

mitigation.zh: 登录查询改用参数化绑定并禁止字符串拼接，对凭据字段做长度与字符白名单。修复后重放第 1 步样例，应统一返回认证失败且日志无异常查询。
mitigation.en: Switch login queries to parameterized binding, forbid string concatenation, and apply length and character allowlists to credential fields. After the fix, replay the step 1 samples: uniform authentication failure with no anomalous queries in logs.

description.zh: 为SQL 登录查询边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SQL Login Query Boundary.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 准备未认证、普通用户和管理员三类合成主体，并为登录与受保护对象记录正常拒绝和允许基线。
prerequisites.en: Prepare synthetic unauthenticated, regular-user, and administrator principals and record normal deny and allow baselines for login and protected objects.

prerequisites.zh: 确认每个输入最终到达 SQL、MongoDB 查询、PHP 比较、反向代理还是应用路由，禁止跨解释器推断。
prerequisites.en: Identify whether each input reaches SQL, a MongoDB query, PHP comparison, a reverse proxy, or an application route; do not infer behavior across interpreters.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一无权限主体仅改变一个输入后获得已认证主体或读取同一受保护对象，并由应用授权日志、数据库查询或代理到后端的规范化路径共同确认。登录页返回 200、错误文本变化、前端状态被修改、伪造头被回显、语法错误或不同路由返回公开内容都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same unauthorized principal to gain an authenticated principal or read the same protected object after one input change, corroborated by authorization logs, database queries, or proxy-to-backend canonical paths. HTTP 200 on a login page, changed error text, client-side state edits, reflected spoofed headers, syntax errors, or public content from another route are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取一个不含敏感字段的固定标记对象；不得调用 DELETE、写入、管理员变更或真实账户操作。
opsecTips.en: Read only one fixed marker object without sensitive fields; do not invoke DELETE, writes, administrator changes, or real-account operations.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试账户与标记对象，清空 Cookie 和代理缓存，恢复可信代理与统一规范化配置，并核对未产生状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Delete test accounts and marker objects, clear cookies and proxy caches, restore trusted-proxy and canonicalization settings, and verify that no state changed.

title.zh: 全量 URL 编码变形

description.zh: 绕过匹配明文 admin'/OR/'1'='1 特征的 WAF：将注入载荷全量百分号编码，传输层还原后进入 SQL 查询。成功判据：返回登录成功或与管理员登录一致的响应特征。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs matching plaintext admin'/OR signatures by fully percent-encoding the payload. Success: response matches a successful admin login.

description.zh: 绕过按整词匹配 OR/-- 的规则：用 MySQL 内联注释 /**/ 打散关键字，语义等价。成功判据：登录成功或 SQL 错误特征消失。
description.en: Bypasses whole-word OR/-- rules by breaking keywords with /**/ inline comments. Success: login succeeds or SQL error signature disappears.

description.zh: 绕过大小写敏感与空格特征规则：用 %09 制表符替代空格、LiKe 等价 =、数字免引号。成功判据：登录成功响应。
description.en: Bypasses case- and space-sensitive rules using %09 tabs, mixed case, and LiKe as = equivalent. Success: successful login response.

description.zh: 绕过一次解码后校验的 WAF/中间件链：双重百分号编码，第二次解码发生在应用层。成功判据：登录成功。
description.en: Bypasses WAF/middleware chains that validate after a single decode by double percent-encoding; the second decode happens at the app layer. Success: login succeeds.

name.zh: PHP 凭证类型混淆

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为PHP 凭证类型混淆验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a PHP Credential Type Confusion validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: 凭证注入与弱类型登录绕过

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 PHP 凭据类型混淆场景，检验认证接口把数组等非字符串凭据传入比较函数时是否触发松散比较或异常放行。验证维度为数组参数与结构化 JSON 凭据两组样例，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers PHP credential type confusion, testing whether non-string credentials such as arrays trigger loose comparison or exceptional acceptance in the authentication path. Validation covers array-parameter and structured-JSON credential samples, mapped to steps 1 and 2.
