vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 PHP 参数解析允许同名参数携带方括号语法生成数组，而弱比较或未做类型断言的校验逻辑遇到数组时行为异常，攻击者借此绕过口令比较。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is PHP parameter parsing that turns bracket-suffixed parameters into arrays, while loose comparison or missing type assertions behave abnormally on arrays, letting attackers bypass the password check.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以 user 与 pass 的数组语法提交登录参数，认证通过或返回特征报错即确认类型混淆；第 2 步按脚本提交数组与结构化 JSON 凭据的阴性对照，任何非字符串值被接受即为漏洞，全部拒绝则说明已做类型断言。成功判据以认证结果与日志为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；样例仅用于授权测试。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit login parameters using array syntax for user and pass; authentication success or a characteristic error confirms type confusion. In step 2, submit the array and structured-JSON negative controls per the script; any accepted non-string value is the flaw, uniform rejection shows type assertions are in place. Judge success by authentication results and logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use samples only in authorized tests.

mitigation.zh: 认证入口显式断言凭据为字符串类型，比较使用恒时严格函数而非松散相等。修复后重放第 1、2 步，非字符串凭据应全部被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Assert explicitly that credentials are strings at the authentication entry, and compare with constant-time strict functions instead of loose equality. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: all non-string credentials should be rejected.

description.zh: 为PHP 凭证类型混淆准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for PHP Credential Type Confusion.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 准备未认证、普通用户和管理员三类合成主体，并为登录与受保护对象记录正常拒绝和允许基线。
prerequisites.en: Prepare synthetic unauthenticated, regular-user, and administrator principals and record normal deny and allow baselines for login and protected objects.

description.zh: 绕过仅检查表单键值对的 WAF 规则：改为 JSON 体提交并保持数组类型混淆。成功判据：非字符串凭据被接受或类型错误处理差异暴露。
description.en: Bypasses WAF rules that only inspect form pairs by switching to a JSON body while keeping array type confusion. Success: non-string credentials accepted or type-error divergence exposed.

description.zh: 绕过匹配字面 pass[]= 的特征规则：百分号编码中括号，服务端仍解析为数组。成功判据：数组凭据触达 PHP 弱比较逻辑。
description.en: Bypasses literal pass[]= signature matching by percent-encoding the brackets; the backend still parses them as arrays. Success: array credentials reach the weak comparison.

description.zh: 绕过按 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 解析体检查的 WAF：改用 multipart 编码携带数组参数。成功判据：类型混淆仍生效。
description.en: Bypasses WAFs inspecting only urlencoded bodies by switching to multipart while carrying array parameters. Success: type confusion still triggers.

name.zh: NoSQL 凭证操作符边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为NoSQL 凭证操作符边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a NoSQL Credential Operator Boundary validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: 凭证注入与弱类型登录绕过

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 NoSQL 凭据操作符注入场景，检验登录接口是否把客户端 JSON 直接展开为查询条件，允许操作符键进入凭据匹配。验证维度为操作符注入样例在合成主体下的执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers NoSQL credential operator injection, testing whether the login endpoint expands client JSON directly into query conditions, letting operator keys enter credential matching. Validation executes an operator-injection sample against a synthetic principal, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于文档数据库的查询构造直接信任客户端结构：pass 字段携带操作符对象时，等值匹配被替换为不等于空这类恒真条件，口令校验被整体绕过。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is query construction that trusts the client structure outright: an operator object in the password field replaces equality with an always-true not-equal-null condition, bypassing the password check entirely.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以合成主体提交 pass 字段为操作符对象的 JSON 登录请求，返回认证会话即确认操作符注入成立，被拒绝则说明查询层已做类型白名单。成功判据以会话建立与只读标记为准，并核对服务端查询日志中的条件结构。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；测试仅在隔离环境执行。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a JSON login request with an operator object in the password field as a synthetic principal; an authenticated session confirms operator injection, rejection shows a type allowlist at the query layer. Judge success by session establishment and the read-only marker, and inspect the condition structure in server query logs. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; run tests only in isolated environments.

mitigation.zh: 凭据字段在进入查询前强制为标量类型，禁用操作符键或启用 ODM 净化选项，并返回统一认证失败信息。修复后重放第 1 步，操作符对象应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Coerce credential fields to scalar types before querying, disable operator keys or enable ODM sanitization, and return a uniform authentication-failure message. After the fix, replay step 1: operator objects should be rejected.

description.zh: 为NoSQL 凭证操作符边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for NoSQL Credential Operator Boundary.

description.zh: 绕过仅拉黑 $ne 的过滤器：用 $gt 空串实现同一"任意非空口令"语义。成功判据：登录成功。
description.en: Bypasses filters that only blacklist $ne by using $gt with an empty string for the same any-password semantics. Success: login succeeds.

description.zh: 绕过操作符黑名单：$regex 一步匹配任意首字符口令。成功判据：返回认证通过。
description.en: Bypasses operator blacklists with $regex matching any first character of the password. Success: authentication passes.

description.zh: 绕过仅检查 JSON 体的 WAF：用 qs 括号语法在表单编码里构造操作符对象。成功判据：登录成功。
description.en: Bypasses JSON-only body inspection by building the operator object via qs bracket syntax in a form body. Success: login succeeds.

name.zh: 可信代理头认证边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为可信代理头认证边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Trusted Proxy Header Authentication Boundary validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖可信代理头认证边界场景，检验应用是否把客户端可伪造的 X-Forwarded-For 与 X-Original-URL 等头当作身份或路由依据。验证维度为转发头与内部路径覆盖头的组合样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the trusted-proxy-header authentication boundary, testing whether the app treats client-forgeable headers such as X-Forwarded-For and X-Original-URL as identity or routing inputs. Validation combines a forwarded-IP header with an internal-path override header, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于代理信任配置过宽或缺失：应用把任意来源的代理头解析为可信元数据，攻击者直接注入头即可伪装内网来源或改写后端路由判定。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is overly broad or missing proxy trust configuration: the app parses proxy headers from any source as trusted metadata, so injected headers can spoof intranet origins or rewrite backend routing decisions.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以合成主体提交同时携带 X-Forwarded-For 指向 LAB_HOST 与 X-Original-URL 指向受保护 marker 路径的请求，观察服务端日志解析出的客户端地址与路由对象；访问控制被头值改变即确认信任边界失守。成功判据以服务端证据与只读标记为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；同时对比正常请求的解析结果以便留证。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a request as a synthetic principal carrying X-Forwarded-For set to LAB_HOST together with X-Original-URL pointing at the protected marker path, then inspect the client address and routing object parsed in server logs; any change in access control driven by header values confirms the trust boundary breach. Judge success by server-side evidence and the read-only marker. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; compare against a normal request's parsed results for evidence.

mitigation.zh: 仅在直接边界代理层清洗覆盖类头，应用侧配置可信代理网段，未列来源的头一律丢弃。修复后重放第 1 步，伪造头应被剥离且路由按真实请求行解析。
mitigation.en: Strip override-class headers only at the directly adjacent edge proxy, configure trusted proxy CIDRs on the app, and drop such headers from unlisted sources. After the fix, replay step 1: forged headers should be stripped and routing resolved from the real request line.

description.zh: 为可信代理头认证边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。

description.zh: 绕过头名精确匹配的清洗规则：大小写变体与重复头叠加，不同中间件取值不同。成功判据：受保护资源返回 200。
description.en: Bypasses exact header-name sanitization by stacking case variants and duplicate headers; different middlewares pick different ones. Success: protected resource returns 200.

description.zh: 绕过只清洗 X-Forwarded-For 的防护：改用 X-Real-IP/True-Client-IP 等同义头命中白名单逻辑。成功判据：授权通过。
description.en: Bypasses defenses that sanitize only X-Forwarded-For by switching to synonymous headers like X-Real-IP/True-Client-IP. Success: authorization passes.

description.zh: 绕过取首段 IP 的校验逻辑：伪造多级代理链使末段为可信地址。成功判据：以可信身份访问成功。
description.en: Bypasses first-IP extraction by forging a multi-hop chain whose last entry is the trusted address. Success: access granted as trusted client.

name.zh: 方法与路径规范化授权边界
name.en: Method and Path Normalization Authorization Boundary

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为方法与路径规范化授权边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Method and Path Normalization Authorization Boundary validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖方法与路径规范化授权边界场景，检验方法变换与 HTTP/2 路径解析差异是否绕过统一授权。验证维度为 GET、HEAD、OPTIONS 方法矩阵与 HTTP/2 prior-knowledge 请求两步，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers method and path-normalization authorization boundaries, testing whether method switching and HTTP/2 path parsing differences bypass unified authorization. Validation covers a GET, HEAD and OPTIONS method matrix plus HTTP/2 prior-knowledge requests, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权中间件只覆盖部分方法或按规范化前的路径判定：方法白名单遗漏 HEAD 与 OPTIONS，或 H2 路径与 H1 规范化不一致，攻击者借变换抵达受保护资源。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is authorization middleware covering only some methods or judging paths before normalization: method allowlists miss HEAD and OPTIONS, or H2 paths normalize differently from H1, letting attackers reach protected resources through variants.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步对受保护 marker 路径逐一发送 GET、HEAD、OPTIONS 等方法变体，任一方法返回 200 或数据即确认方法级授权缺失；第 2 步以 HTTP/2 prior-knowledge 重复请求并附带 X-Original-URL 对照，观察路由与授权判定是否随协议改变。成功判据以响应状态与只读标记为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send GET, HEAD and OPTIONS method variants one by one against the protected marker path; any method returning 200 or data confirms missing method-level authorization. In step 2, repeat over HTTP/2 with prior knowledge and add an X-Original-URL control to see whether routing and authorization shift with the protocol. Judge success by response status and the read-only marker. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 授权统一收敛到路由层并覆盖全部方法，显式拒绝未登记动词；路径规范化先于授权执行且跨协议一致。修复后重放第 1、2 步，所有变体应返回一致拒绝。
mitigation.en: Centralize authorization at the routing layer covering every method and explicitly reject unregistered verbs; normalize paths before authorization and keep behavior consistent across protocols. After the fix, replay steps 1 and 2: all variants should be uniformly rejected.

description.zh: 为方法与路径规范化授权边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Method and Path Normalization Authorization Boundary.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
curl -sS --max-time 5 -X GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 -X HEAD http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 -X OPTIONS http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080/MARKER
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker/
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080//marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 --path-as-is http://127.0.0.1:8080/./marker

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 准备未认证、普通用户和管理员三类合成主体，并为登录与受保护对象记录正常拒绝和允许基线。
prerequisites.en: Prepare synthetic unauthenticated, regular-user, and administrator principals and record normal deny and allow baselines for login and protected objects.

prerequisites.zh: 确认每个输入最终到达 SQL、MongoDB 查询、PHP 比较、反向代理还是应用路由，禁止跨解释器推断。
prerequisites.en: Identify whether each input reaches SQL, a MongoDB query, PHP comparison, a reverse proxy, or an application route; do not infer behavior across interpreters.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据是同一无权限主体仅改变一个输入后获得已认证主体或读取同一受保护对象，并由应用授权日志、数据库查询或代理到后端的规范化路径共同确认。登录页返回 200、错误文本变化、前端状态被修改、伪造头被回显、语法错误或不同路由返回公开内容都不是绕过证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the same unauthorized principal to gain an authenticated principal or read the same protected object after one input change, corroborated by authorization logs, database queries, or proxy-to-backend canonical paths. HTTP 200 on a login page, changed error text, client-side state edits, reflected spoofed headers, syntax errors, or public content from another route are not bypass evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只读取一个不含敏感字段的固定标记对象；不得调用 DELETE、写入、管理员变更或真实账户操作。
opsecTips.en: Read only one fixed marker object without sensitive fields; do not invoke DELETE, writes, administrator changes, or real-account operations.

opsecTips.zh: 删除测试账户与标记对象，清空 Cookie 和代理缓存，恢复可信代理与统一规范化配置，并核对未产生状态变更。
opsecTips.en: Delete test accounts and marker objects, clear cookies and proxy caches, restore trusted-proxy and canonicalization settings, and verify that no state changed.

description.zh: 绕过路径字面匹配的访问控制：百分号编码首字母，代理透传后由后端规范化命中路由。成功判据：200 响应且返回 marker 内容。
description.en: Bypasses literal path matching by percent-encoding a letter; the proxy passes it through and the backend normalizes it to the route. Success: 200 with marker content.

title.zh: 绝对 URI 请求形式

wafBypass.command:
printf 'GET http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker HTTP/1.1
Host: irrelevant
Connection: close

' | nc 127.0.0.1 8080

description.zh: 绕过反向代理按 Host/相对路径分流的授权规则：绝对 URI 形式直连命中后端路由。成功判据：返回 marker 内容。
description.en: Bypasses reverse-proxy authorization keyed on Host/relative path by issuing an absolute-URI request that hits the backend route directly. Success: marker content returned.

description.zh: 绕过按完整路径匹配的授权：分号后的参数在 Tomcat/Spring 解析时被剥离。成功判据：200 响应。
description.en: Bypasses full-path authorization since Tomcat/Spring strip semicolon parameters during parsing. Success: 200 response.

name.zh: 点击劫持对齐边界验证

description.zh: 验证敏感页面能否被第三方页面嵌入并与诱导界面对齐，同时区分响应头缺失、浏览器实际拦截和业务操作是否可被触发。
description.en: Validate whether a sensitive page can be embedded and aligned with a decoy interface while distinguishing missing headers, browser enforcement, and actual business-action reachability.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖点击劫持的 Frame 嵌入与交互对齐场景，检验敏感页面能否被第三方页面嵌入并把用户点击对齐到真实控件上。验证维度含单控件对齐、两步交互对齐与 Pointer 事件路由三类样例，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers clickjacking frame-embedding and interaction alignment, testing whether a sensitive page can be framed by a third party and user clicks aligned onto real controls. Validation covers single-control alignment, two-step interaction alignment, and pointer-event routing, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于页面缺少 X-Frame-Options 或 frame-ancestors 防护且关键操作无需确认：嵌入页面可被透明定位覆盖，用户在诱饵界面上的一次或两次点击被路由到真实按钮。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the absence of X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors protection combined with confirmation-free critical actions: a framed page can be transparently overlaid, routing one or two decoy clicks onto real buttons.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步部署单控件对齐样例页，以低透明度显示本地确认页与 marker，一次点击命中目标按钮即确认坐标对齐可行；第 2 步用 sandboxed 资料预览页验证两步界面定位，两步点击都落在正确控件即确认多步诱导；第 3 步保留可见定位边界并让 guide 不接收指针，观察事件是否穿透到 consent 预览页。以交互命中记录为成功判据。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全部操作仅触达合成 marker。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy the single-control alignment sample showing the local confirm page and marker at low opacity; one click landing on the target button confirms coordinate alignment. In step 2, verify two-step interface positioning with the sandboxed profile preview page; both clicks landing on the right controls confirm multi-step luring. In step 3, keep visible guide borders with pointer-events disabled and watch whether events pass through to the consent preview page. Judge success by interaction hit records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; all actions touch synthetic markers only.

mitigation.zh: 所有敏感页面返回 X-Frame-Options DENY 或 CSP frame-ancestors none，关键操作增加二次确认与重新认证。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，嵌入应被浏览器拦截且交互无法对齐。
mitigation.en: Serve X-Frame-Options DENY or CSP frame-ancestors none on sensitive pages, and add second confirmation or reauthentication for critical actions. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: framing should be browser-blocked and interactions impossible to align.

title.zh: 建立 Frame 策略基线

description.zh: 采集本地敏感页面的状态码、CSP frame-ancestors 与 X-Frame-Options，记录缺失和冲突配置。
description.en: Capture status, CSP frame-ancestors, and X-Frame-Options for the local sensitive page and record missing or conflicting policies.

description.zh: 以低透明度加载实验页面并保留红色定位边界，确认控件坐标而不隐藏用户界面。
description.en: Load the fixture at low opacity with visible alignment boundaries to verify control coordinates without hiding the interface.

description.zh: 使用唯一 marker 对照浏览器请求和服务端日志，判断交互是否真正到达业务处理器。
description.en: Correlate a unique marker across browser requests and server logs to determine whether interaction reached the business handler.

description.zh: 启用 Frame 策略后重复浏览器测试，要求页面拒绝嵌入且敏感操作没有请求记录。
description.en: Repeat the browser test after enabling frame policy and require framing refusal with no sensitive-action request.

prerequisites.zh: 只使用 127.0.0.1 实验页面，并准备一个不会改变真实数据的确认或预览端点。
prerequisites.en: Use only the 127.0.0.1 lab pages and prepare a confirmation or preview endpoint that cannot change real data.

prerequisites.zh: 在 Chromium 中记录 CSP、X-Frame-Options、控制台消息和点击后的服务端请求日志。
prerequisites.en: Record CSP, X-Frame-Options, browser console messages, and server request logs after interaction in Chromium.

analysis.zh: 阳性结论必须同时包含跨站 Frame 成功、认证上下文可用、控件可稳定对齐和状态变更请求四类证据。响应头缺失、页面截图或单次坐标重合都只能作为线索，不能替代浏览器与服务端的关联证据。
analysis.en: A positive conclusion requires evidence for successful cross-site framing, usable authentication context, stable control alignment, and a state-changing request. Missing headers, a screenshot, or one coordinate match is only a lead and cannot replace correlated browser and server evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 实验端点只能写入一次性 marker，不连接生产账号、支付、权限或删除操作。
opsecTips.en: The fixture may write only disposable markers and must not connect to production account, payment, privilege, or deletion actions.

opsecTips.zh: 演示时保持 Frame 可见并限制在本地浏览器会话，结束后清理实验 Cookie 与日志标记。
opsecTips.en: Keep the frame visible and confined to a local browser session, then clear fixture cookies and log markers after testing.

description.zh: 绕过对 style 中 opacity:0 字面值的静态规则：改用 filter 函数实现同等透明；诱饵点击触发目标按钮即成功。
description.en: Use the filter function for equivalent transparency past literal opacity:0 rules; the decoy click triggering the target button confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 opacity/visibility 常规属性的过滤：裁剪路径使框架视觉不可见但可点击；点击落在目标控件上即成功。
description.en: Clip the frame invisible while keeping it clickable, past opacity/visibility filtering; a click landing on the target control confirms success.

description.zh: 经典 likejacking 形态：诱饵按钮跟随光标使其始终覆盖在点赞位之上；用户任意点击命中目标即成功。
description.en: Classic likejacking form: the decoy tracks the cursor over the target position; any user click hitting the target confirms success.

name.zh: 会话固定与登录轮换

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为会话固定与登录轮换验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Session Fixation and Login Rotation validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖会话固定与登录轮换场景，检验应用在认证成功后是否更换会话标识，防止攻击者以预置 ID 继承受害者已认证会话。验证维度为登录前后 Cookie 指纹对照单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers session fixation and login rotation, testing whether the application rotates the session identifier after successful authentication so an attacker cannot inherit an authenticated session via a pre-set ID. Validation compares cookie fingerprints before and after login in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于登录成功后未轮换会话标识：预认证发放的 Cookie 值在认证后继续使用，知道该值的攻击者即可在受害者登录后直接复用同一会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is failure to rotate the session identifier on successful login: the pre-authentication cookie value keeps being used after authentication, so an attacker who knows it can reuse the same session once the victim logs in.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步先以匿名请求获取登录前 Cookie 并计算其哈希，再用同一 Cookie 完成合成主体登录，登录后再次计算哈希并比较：两值不同即确认会话已轮换，相同则确认会话固定缺陷成立。成功判据以哈希对照与服务端会话记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换为目标值；凭据仅使用合成测试账号。
exploitation.en: In step 1, obtain the pre-login cookie anonymously and hash it, then complete a synthetic login reusing the same cookie and hash it again; differing hashes confirm rotation, identical hashes confirm the fixation flaw. Judge success by hash comparison and server session records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only synthetic test credentials.

mitigation.zh: 认证状态变化时调用框架的会话再生接口强制轮换 ID，并使旧会话立即失效。修复后重放第 1 步，登录前后会话标识应完全不同且旧值不可复用。
mitigation.en: Invoke the framework's session-regeneration routine on authentication state changes to force ID rotation and invalidate the old session immediately. After the fix, replay step 1: identifiers before and after login should differ completely and the old value must be unusable.

description.zh: 为会话固定与登录轮换准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Session Fixation and Login Rotation.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
curl -sS --max-time 5 -c prelogin.cookies http://127.0.0.1:8080/
pre_hash=$(sha256sum prelogin.cookies | cut -d" " -f1)
curl -sS --max-time 5 -b prelogin.cookies -c postlogin.cookies -d "user=payloader&pass=PAYLOADER_TEST" http://127.0.0.1:8080/login
post_hash=$(sha256sum postlogin.cookies | cut -d" " -f1)
printf "pre=%s post=%s\n" "$pre_hash" "$post_hash"
curl -sS --max-time 5 -b postlogin.cookies http://127.0.0.1:8080/marker
# Expected: the authenticated session identifier rotates and only the post-login jar reaches the marker.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

description.zh: 绕过登录轮换缺失检测盲区：预置自定义会话 ID 完成登录后检查是否复用。成功判据：post.cookies 中 session 值仍为 ATTACKER_PRESET。
description.en: Tests missing rotation by pre-seeding a custom session ID across login and diffing the jar afterwards. Success: the session value remains ATTACKER_PRESET in post.cookies.

description.zh: 绕过仅接受 Cookie 头传递的假设：会话取自查询参数时同样可固定。成功判据：登录后响应携带同一 session 值。
description.en: Bypasses the assumption that sessions travel only via the Cookie header by seeding through the query string. Success: post-login response carries the same session value.

description.zh: 利用多 Cookie 头解析差异注入预置会话并观察取值优先级。成功判据：固定会话被服务端接受。
description.en: Exploits duplicate Cookie header parsing differences to seed a preset session. Success: the server accepts the fixed session.

name.zh: Cookie 作用域与同名冲突

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为Cookie 作用域与同名冲突验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Cookie Scope and Name Collision validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 Cookie 作用域与同名冲突场景，检验攻击者能否利用 Domain、Path 与同名写入规则让伪造会话值压过真实凭据。验证维度为脚本注入多枚同名冲突 Cookie 的单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers cookie scoping and same-name collision, testing whether an attacker can leverage Domain, Path and same-name write rules to shadow real credentials with forged session values. Validation injects multiple colliding cookies via script in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于服务端解析 Cookie 时未按作用域特异性取值：同名会话 Cookie 可经子域或宽 Path 写入多份，请求头按序拼接后，伪造值可能排在合法值之前被优先读取。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is server cookie parsing that ignores scope specificity: same-name session cookies can be planted multiple times via subdomains or broad paths, and once concatenated in the request header the forged value may precede the legitimate one and be read first.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在目标页面上下文执行脚本写入四枚 marker Cookie，再以 Domain 属性写入伪造 session 值，随后请求受保护路径并核对服务端实际解析到的会话；伪造值生效或出现多值拼接即确认同名冲突可利用。成功判据以服务端会话决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；测试使用可回滚的合成会话。
exploitation.en: In step 1, execute the script in the target page context to write four marker cookies, then plant a forged session value with a Domain attribute, request the protected path, and check which session the server actually resolved; a forged value winning or multi-value concatenation confirms exploitable collision. Judge success by the server session decision. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use rollback-safe synthetic sessions.

mitigation.zh: 统一会话 Cookie 的名称、Domain 与 Path 并避免同名变体，解析时按 RFC 特异性规则取最精确值；设置前缀机制如 __Host 会话 Cookie。修复后重放第 1 步，伪造值应被忽略。
mitigation.en: Unify session cookie name, Domain and Path to avoid same-name variants, resolve per RFC specificity rules taking the most specific value, and use prefixes like __Host for session cookies. After the fix, replay step 1: forged values should be ignored.

description.zh: 为Cookie 作用域与同名冲突准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Cookie Scope and Name Collision.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用两个合成账户、隔离浏览器配置和固定无敏感字段标记对象，记录登录前后会话 ID 的哈希与主体。
prerequisites.en: Use two synthetic accounts, isolated browser profiles, and a fixed nonsensitive marker object, recording session-ID hashes and principals before and after login.

prerequisites.zh: 若检查明文传输，只在自有封闭网络和测试流量中抓包；Cookie 域、路径、SameSite 和浏览器版本必须明确。
prerequisites.en: If reviewing cleartext transport, capture only owned test traffic on an isolated network; document cookie domain, path, SameSite mode, and browser version.

analysis.zh: 阳性会话固定要求登录前受控会话 ID 在登录后未轮换且另一测试客户端可访问同一主体；Cookie Tossing 要求子域可设置的同名 Cookie 被主域安全逻辑选中；SameSite 仅证明凭据随导航发送，不能证明响应可读或状态变更。缺少属性、抓到测试 Cookie 或随机性工具给出低分本身都不是劫持。
analysis.en: Session fixation requires a controlled pre-login ID to survive authentication and authorize the same principal from another test client. Cookie tossing requires a same-name cookie set by a subdomain to be selected by main-domain security logic. SameSite can show credentials sent on navigation but not response readability or state change. A missing attribute, captured test cookie, or low randomness score alone is not hijacking.

opsecTips.zh: 仅复用可撤销的合成会话并读取一个标记对象；不得捕获第三方流量、真实 Cookie 或触发资金与资料变更。
opsecTips.en: Replay only revocable synthetic sessions and read one marker object; do not capture third-party traffic, real cookies, or trigger financial or profile changes.

opsecTips.zh: 注销全部测试会话，删除 Cookie、抓包和临时脚本，清理浏览器站点数据并恢复 HTTPS 与 Cookie 策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out all test sessions, delete cookies, captures, and temporary scripts, clear browser site data, and restore HTTPS and cookie policy.

description.zh: 绕过按单一路径读取 Cookie 的逻辑：父子路径同名 Cookie 并存干扰服务端取值。成功判据：请求头中出现两个同名 Cookie 且解析取到攻击者值。
description.en: Bypasses single-path cookie reads by co-locating the same name on parent and child paths. Success: request carries both cookies and the attacker value wins.

description.zh: 扩大同名 Cookie 作用域干扰子域/父域解析顺序。成功判据：子域请求携带投递的 Cookie。
description.en: Widens the duplicate cookie's scope to interfere with subdomain parsing order. Success: subdomain requests carry the tossed cookie.

description.zh: 绕过按名称精确匹配的清理/校验逻辑：百分号编码下划线。成功判据：同名逻辑键被双重写入。
description.en: Bypasses name-exact cleanup logic by percent-encoding the underscore in the name. Success: the logical key gets written twice.

name.zh: SameSite 导航边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SameSite 导航边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a SameSite Navigation Boundary validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SameSite 导航边界场景，检验顶级导航与脚本弹窗触发的跨站请求是否仍携带 Strict 或 Lax 会话 Cookie。验证维度为链接导航与 noopener 弹窗两类单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SameSite navigation boundary, testing whether cross-site requests triggered by top-level navigation and script popups still carry Strict or Lax session cookies. Validation uses link navigation and a noopener popup in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于会话 Cookie 的 SameSite 策略未覆盖全部导航形态：链接、脚本 window.open 等顶级导航在宽松策略下仍发送会话 Cookie，服务端据此信任跨站发起的请求。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a SameSite policy that fails to cover all navigation forms: under lenient settings, top-level navigations via links or window.open still send session cookies, so the server trusts cross-site-initiated requests.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步部署含顶级链接与 noopener 弹窗脚本的跨站样例页，分别点击与自动打开指向 marker 页面的导航，核对服务端日志中两类请求附带的会话 Cookie；任一导航仍附带 Strict 会话即确认边界缺口。成功判据以 Cookie 附带记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；对照请求 Lax 与 None 配置以获得完整矩阵。
exploitation.en: In step 1, deploy a cross-site sample page containing a top-level link and a noopener popup script, trigger navigation to the marker page both by click and auto-open, and check which session cookies the server logs for each; any Strict-session attachment during navigation confirms the boundary gap. Judge success by cookie-attachment records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; compare Lax and None configurations for a complete matrix.

mitigation.zh: 会话 Cookie 采用 SameSite=Strict 或对登录态区分严格策略，配合 Sec-Fetch-Site 校验拒绝跨站发起的状态变更。修复后重放第 1 步，跨站导航请求应不再携带会话。
mitigation.en: Adopt SameSite=Strict for session cookies or apply stricter policies to logged-in state, and add Sec-Fetch-Site validation to reject cross-site-initiated state changes. After the fix, replay step 1: cross-site navigation requests should no longer carry the session.

description.zh: 为SameSite 导航边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SameSite Navigation Boundary.

description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 绕过仅拦截链接点击场景的防护：meta refresh 同属顶级导航，Lax Cookie 照常附带。成功判据：目标站收到携带会话的请求。
description.en: Bypasses link-click-only defenses since meta refresh is still top-level navigation and Lax cookies attach. Success: target receives the cookied request.

description.zh: 绕过对 <a> 标签的过滤：脚本提交 GET 表单仍属顶级导航。成功判据：导航请求携带会话 Cookie。
description.en: Bypasses <a>-tag filtering since a scripted GET form submission is still top-level navigation. Success: navigated request carries the session cookie.

description.zh: 绕过弹窗拦截与 iframe 限制：_self 目标强制当前窗口导航。成功判据：请求日志记录到会话携带的访问。
description.en: Bypasses popup blockers by targeting _self to force current-window navigation. Success: access logs show the cookied request.

name.zh: 密码重置主机头绑定

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为密码重置主机头绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Password Reset Host Header Binding validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖密码重置链接的 Host 头绑定场景，检验应用生成重置 URL 时是否信任请求中的 Host 与派生头。验证维度为原始报文双 Host 对照、curl 多 Host 变体与 dry_run 触发三步，对应第 1 至第 3 步。
overview.en: This payload covers password-reset link Host-header binding, testing whether the application trusts request Host and derived headers when generating reset URLs. Validation covers a raw dual-Host comparison, curl Host variants, and a dry-run trigger, mapped to steps 1 through 3.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重置链接使用请求头动态拼接主机名而非配置内的固定域名：攻击者提交带恶意 Host 或 X-Forwarded-Host 的重置请求，邮件中的链接即指向受控域并带走一次性令牌。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is building reset links from request headers instead of a configured fixed domain: submitting a reset request with a malicious Host or X-Forwarded-Host makes the emailed link point at the attacker domain, carrying the one-time token with it.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步发送携带不同 Host 的原始 POST 报文，观察响应或模拟邮件中重置链接的主机部分；第 2 步用 curl 分别以 app 与 callback 域名发 Host 请求，比对链接派生结果；第 3 步以 dry_run 参数触发重置流程并留档生成的链接。任一链接指向注入域即确认主机派生可操纵。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全部使用实验收件箱避免打扰真实用户。
exploitation.en: In step 1, send raw POST messages with different Host values and inspect the host portion of the reset link in the response or a simulated email. In step 2, use curl with app and callback domain Host headers and compare link derivation. In step 3, trigger the reset flow with a dry_run parameter and archive the generated link. Any link pointing at the injected domain confirms manipulable host derivation. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use lab mailboxes only to avoid disturbing real users.

mitigation.zh: 重置链接主机固定为服务端配置域名，忽略请求 Host 与转发头；对 Host 异常的请求直接拒绝。修复后重放第 1 至第 3 步，链接始终落在合法域。
mitigation.en: Fix reset-link hosts to the server-configured domain, ignore request Host and forwarded headers, and reject requests with anomalous Host values. After the fix, replay steps 1 through 3: links should always land on the legitimate domain.

description.zh: 为密码重置主机头绑定准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Password Reset Host Header Binding.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
POST /forgot-password HTTP/1.1
Host: callback.example.invalid
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

email=payloader-user%40example.invalid

POST /forgot-password HTTP/1.1
Host: app.example.invalid
X-Forwarded-Host: callback.example.invalid
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

email=payloader-user%40example.invalid
# Inspect only the local mail-sandbox link; no real recipient or external collaborator.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有邮件沙箱、两个合成账户和可回滚密码，记录每个重置请求、令牌哈希、账户 ID 与邮件任务 ID。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned mail sandbox, two synthetic accounts, and rollback passwords, recording each reset request, token hash, account ID, and mail-job ID.

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用公开基址和可信代理配置，所有回调域均为自有测试域，且令牌尝试次数受严格预算控制。
prerequisites.en: Fix the application's public base URL and trusted-proxy configuration, use only owned callback domains, and strictly budget token attempts.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据分别是邮件中的重置链接被不可信 Host 改写并把测试令牌送到受控域；低权限请求可重置另一合成账户；已用或过期令牌再次改变密码；或令牌在预算内可由已知生成规律预测。邮件未到达、响应 200、链接文本反射、状态码差异或脚本猜中自身生成的值都不是证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an untrusted Host changing a mailed reset link and delivering a test token to an owned domain, an underprivileged request resetting another synthetic account, a used or expired token changing a password again, or a token predicted from a known generation rule within budget. Missing mail, HTTP 200, reflected link text, status differences, or a script matching its own generated value are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只对合成账户执行一次可回滚密码变更；不得向真实收件人发信、遍历完整验证码空间或提交真实令牌。
opsecTips.en: Perform at most one reversible password change on a synthetic account; do not message real recipients, enumerate full code spaces, or submit real tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 绕过单 Host 校验与部分代理的重复头拦截：双 Host 头拼接后派生重置链接。成功判据：邮件链接指向 callback 域。
description.en: Bypasses single-Host validation via duplicate Host headers that some proxies concatenate when deriving the reset link. Success: emailed link points to the callback domain.

description.zh: 绕过对 Host 头的清洗：链接主机派生自 X-Forwarded-Host。成功判据：重置链接域名为 callback。
description.en: Bypasses Host sanitization when the link host derives from X-Forwarded-Host. Success: reset link domain is the callback host.

description.zh: 利用代理优先取绝对 URI 主机的差异投毒链接。成功判据：发出的重置邮件使用 callback 域。
description.en: Poisons the link by exploiting proxies that prefer the absolute-URI host. Success: the reset mail uses the callback domain.

name.zh: 重置令牌账户绑定

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为重置令牌账户绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Reset Token Account Binding validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重置令牌与账号绑定场景，检验确认端点是否校验令牌所属账号，防止拿 A 账号令牌改 B 账号口令。验证维度为跨账号令牌使用的单步阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers reset-token account binding, testing whether the confirm endpoint validates the account a token was issued for, preventing use of account A's token to change account B's password. Validation is a single cross-account negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于确认接口只校验令牌有效性而不校验令牌与请求账号的对应关系：令牌被视作万能凭据，攻击者用自有账号令牌即可重置任意目标账号。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the confirm endpoint validating only token validity and not the token-to-account correspondence: the token acts as a universal credential, so an attacker can reset any target account using a token issued for their own account.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以自有账号申请的测试令牌搭配目标账号 payloader-b 提交重置确认请求并携带 dry_run 标记，服务端拒绝且不产生变更即证明绑定生效，接受或返回成功即确认令牌未绑定账号。成功判据以响应与 dry_run 状态为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全程使用可回滚的合成账号。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a reset-confirm request using your own account's test token paired with the target account payloader-b and a dry_run flag; rejection without any change proves binding, acceptance or a success response confirms the token is not account-bound. Judge success by the response and dry_run status. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use rollback-safe synthetic accounts throughout.

mitigation.zh: 重置令牌签发时写入账号标识并签名，确认时校验令牌、账号与会话三者一致；令牌存储做哈希处理。修复后重放第 1 步，跨账号组合应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Embed and sign the account identity at token issuance and verify token, account and session consistency on confirmation; store token hashes. After the fix, replay step 1: the cross-account pairing should be rejected.

opsecTips.en: Perform at most one reversible password change on a synthetic account; do not message real recipients, enumerate full code spaces, or submit real tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 利用前后端取参差异将令牌绑定到他人账户。成功判据：payloader-b 的口令被修改而令牌属 payloader-a。
description.en: Uses front/back-end parameter extraction divergence to bind the token to another account. Success: payloader-b password changes with payloader-a token.

description.zh: 绕过表单层校验：JSON.parse 后键覆盖顺序差异实现账户切换。成功判据：目标账户口令被改。
description.en: Bypasses form-layer validation; JSON.parse key-overwrite order swaps the account. Success: target account password changes.

description.zh: 绕过严格小写键白名单的后端取参映射。成功判据：大写键仍被解析并完成重置。
description.en: Bypasses strict lowercase key whitelisting in backend parameter mapping. Success: capitalized keys still drive the reset.

name.zh: 密码重置流程状态

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为密码重置流程状态验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Password Reset Flow State validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖密码重置流程状态完整性场景，检验设置新口令端点是否要求已通过验证的流程状态，而非接受直连请求。验证维度为跳过验证直接调用设密端点的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers password-reset flow-state integrity, testing whether the set-password endpoint requires a validated flow state instead of accepting direct calls. Validation calls the set-password endpoint directly, skipping verification, in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于重置流程的多步状态仅存于前端或未做服务端串联：设密端点信任请求参数本身，攻击者绕过令牌验证步骤即可直接提交新口令。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is multi-step reset state kept only in the frontend or not chained server-side: the set-password endpoint trusts request parameters themselves, so attackers skip token verification and submit a new password directly.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步携带合成账号与 marker 新口令直接调用设密端点并附加 dry_run 标记，服务端拒绝缺失流程状态即证明串联完整，接受请求即确认流程状态校验缺失。成功判据以响应状态与 dry_run 结果为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；不实际修改任何账号口令。
exploitation.en: In step 1, call the set-password endpoint directly with a synthetic account and a marker new password plus a dry_run flag; rejection for missing flow state proves proper chaining, acceptance confirms the missing state validation. Judge success by response status and the dry_run outcome. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; never actually change any account password.

mitigation.zh: 把验证通过状态写入服务端会话或一次性流程票据，设密端点强制校验该状态并绑定账号；完成后立即作废票据。修复后重放第 1 步，直连请求应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Record verified status in a server-side session or one-time flow ticket, require it at the set-password endpoint bound to the account, and void the ticket on completion. After the fix, replay step 1: direct calls should be rejected.

description.zh: 为密码重置流程状态准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Password Reset Flow State.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有邮件沙箱、两个合成账户和可回滚密码，记录每个重置请求、令牌哈希、账户 ID 与邮件任务 ID。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned mail sandbox, two synthetic accounts, and rollback passwords, recording each reset request, token hash, account ID, and mail-job ID.

prerequisites.zh: 固定应用公开基址和可信代理配置，所有回调域均为自有测试域，且令牌尝试次数受严格预算控制。
prerequisites.en: Fix the application's public base URL and trusted-proxy configuration, use only owned callback domains, and strictly budget token attempts.

analysis.zh: 阳性证据分别是邮件中的重置链接被不可信 Host 改写并把测试令牌送到受控域；低权限请求可重置另一合成账户；已用或过期令牌再次改变密码；或令牌在预算内可由已知生成规律预测。邮件未到达、响应 200、链接文本反射、状态码差异或脚本猜中自身生成的值都不是证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence is an untrusted Host changing a mailed reset link and delivering a test token to an owned domain, an underprivileged request resetting another synthetic account, a used or expired token changing a password again, or a token predicted from a known generation rule within budget. Missing mail, HTTP 200, reflected link text, status differences, or a script matching its own generated value are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只对合成账户执行一次可回滚密码变更；不得向真实收件人发信、遍历完整验证码空间或提交真实令牌。
opsecTips.en: Perform at most one reversible password change on a synthetic account; do not message real recipients, enumerate full code spaces, or submit real tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 绕过流程状态机：直接请求末步端点跳过中间校验。成功判据：无令牌情况下口令被修改。
description.en: Bypasses the flow state machine by hitting the final step directly. Success: password changes without any token.

description.zh: 绕过表单层的状态字段强制检查：换 JSON 通道提交。成功判据：跳步重置成功。
description.en: Bypasses form-layer state enforcement by switching to the JSON channel. Success: step-skipping reset succeeds.

description.zh: 伪造流程步骤字段满足状态检查。成功判据：服务端按已验证状态接受重置。
description.en: Forges the step field to satisfy state validation. Success: server accepts the reset as an already-verified state.

name.zh: 重置令牌单次使用

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为重置令牌单次使用验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a Reset Token Single Use validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖重置令牌单次使用场景，检验已消费令牌再次提交时是否被拒绝，防止同一令牌被多次用于改密。验证维度为已用令牌重放的单步阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers single-use reset tokens, testing whether an already-consumed token is rejected on resubmission so one token cannot be reused to change a password. Validation replays a used token as a single negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌消费后未即时失效或状态更新与口令变更不在同一事务：攻击者截获一次成功请求后重放即可再次改密，或把令牌转卖复用。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is tokens not being invalidated immediately after consumption, or consumption state and the password change living outside one transaction: replaying a captured success request changes the password again or resells the token for reuse.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以标记为已消费的测试令牌提交重置确认并附加 dry_run 标记，服务端返回已失效或拒绝即证明单次使用生效，接受即确认重放缺陷。成功判据以响应状态与令牌状态记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；使用实验环境专用已用令牌夹具。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit a reset-confirm with a test token marked as already consumed plus a dry_run flag; an expired or rejected response proves single-use enforcement, acceptance confirms the replay flaw. Judge success by response status and token-state records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use the lab's dedicated consumed-token fixture.

mitigation.zh: 令牌消费与口令更新放在同一原子事务并立即烧毁令牌记录，同时保留使用日志与告警。修复后重放第 1 步，已用令牌应返回明确的失效错误。
mitigation.en: Perform token consumption and the password update in one atomic transaction, burning the token immediately with usage logs and alerts. After the fix, replay step 1: used tokens should return a clear expired error.

description.zh: 为重置令牌单次使用准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for Reset Token Single Use.

description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

opsecTips.en: Perform at most one reversible password change on a synthetic account; do not message real recipients, enumerate full code spaces, or submit real tokens.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销全部测试令牌，恢复合成账户密码，删除邮件、回调日志和临时脚本，并核对没有未完成重置任务。
opsecTips.en: Revoke all test tokens, restore synthetic passwords, delete mail, callback logs, and temporary scripts, and verify no reset jobs remain pending.

description.zh: 绕过"使用后失效"检查的竞态窗口：并行请求同时通过单次消费校验。成功判据：至少两次返回成功状态码。
description.en: Bypasses single-use checks via a race window with parallel requests. Success: at least two responses report success.

description.zh: 绕过已用令牌黑名单的精确匹配：base64 形态在另一解码层还原。成功判据：重置被接受。
description.en: Bypasses exact-match used-token blacklists via a base64 form decoded at another layer. Success: reset accepted.

description.zh: 利用取参差异让消费计数与验证取不同实例。成功判据：同一令牌完成两次重置。
description.en: Uses extraction divergence so the consumption counter and validator see different instances. Success: the same token resets twice.

name.zh: OAuth state 事务绑定

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为OAuth state 事务绑定验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a OAuth State Transaction Binding validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth state 事务绑定场景，检验回调端点是否把授权响应绑定到发起授权的浏览器会话，阻断跨站伪造回调。验证维度为错误 state 的 img 载荷阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth state transaction binding, testing whether the callback endpoint binds the authorization response to the browser session that started the flow, blocking forged cross-site callbacks. Validation uses an img payload with a wrong state as a negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于回调处理缺少 state 与会话的比对：跨站页面可携带任意 code 与 state 触发回调，受害者在不知情下把攻击者的授权码兑换进自己的会话，形成登录 CSRF。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the callback handler never comparing state against the session: a cross-site page can trigger the callback with arbitrary code and state, silently exchanging the attacker's authorization code inside the victim's session, producing login CSRF.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步在跨站页面放置 img 加载带伪造 code 与错误 state 的回调地址，核对服务端日志与目标会话：回调被拒绝且无账号绑定即证明 state 绑定生效，登录被建立即确认登录 CSRF。成功判据以回调拒绝记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；使用合成 code 避免真实授权流转。
exploitation.en: In step 1, place an img on a cross-site page loading the callback with a forged code and wrong state, then check server logs and the target session; a rejected callback with no account binding proves state binding, an established login confirms login CSRF. Judge success by callback-rejection records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use synthetic codes to avoid real authorization flows.

mitigation.zh: 发起授权时生成加密随机 state 存入会话，回调时严格比对并一次性消费；不匹配立即终止流程。修复后重放第 1 步，错误 state 的回调应被全部拒绝。
mitigation.en: Generate a cryptographically random state at flow start, store it in the session, compare strictly on callback and consume once; terminate immediately on mismatch. After the fix, replay step 1: wrong-state callbacks should all be rejected.

description.zh: 为OAuth state 事务绑定准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for OAuth State Transaction Binding.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有授权服务器、测试客户端、两个合成用户和精确登记的 HTTPS redirect URI，记录授权请求与令牌事件。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned authorization server, test client, two synthetic users, and an exactly registered HTTPS redirect URI, recording authorization and token events.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮使用新的 state、nonce、PKCE verifier 和一次性 code，测试令牌仅包含无敏感字段 scope。
prerequisites.en: Use fresh state, nonce, PKCE verifier, and one-time code for every run, with test tokens limited to nonsensitive scopes.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要证明错误会话可完成账户绑定、未登记 redirect URI 收到可兑换 code/token、未授权 scope 被资源服务器接受，或面向另一个客户端/受众的令牌访问同一标记资源。授权页错误、候选 URI 被反射、浏览器导航、不可兑换 code、fragment 出现在地址栏或资源服务器正确拒绝都不是漏洞证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wrong session to complete account binding, an unregistered redirect URI to receive a redeemable code or token, an unauthorized scope to be accepted, or a token for another client or audience to access the same marker resource. Authorization errors, reflected candidate URIs, browser navigation, unredeemable codes, fragments in the address bar, or correct resource-server rejection are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用短期测试 code/token 并访问一个只读标记资源；不得使用窃取令牌、管理员 scope 或真实第三方客户端。
opsecTips.en: Use only short-lived test codes and tokens to access one read-only marker resource; do not use stolen tokens, administrator scopes, or real third-party clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code、access token 与 refresh token，删除测试绑定和回调日志，恢复客户端登记与 consent 配置。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens, delete test bindings and callback logs, and restore client registration and consent configuration.

description.zh: 绕过对 标签的 CSP 限制：GET 表单脚本提交送达伪造回调。成功判据：回调端点处理了错误 state 的请求。
description.en: Bypasses CSP restrictions on tags by auto-submitting a GET form to the forged callback. Success: the endpoint processes the wrong-state request.

description.zh: 绕过跨域读取限制：no-cors 模式仍能送达请求。成功判据：服务端日志记录该回调访问。
description.en: Bypasses cross-origin read restrictions since no-cors requests still reach the server. Success: callback access appears in server logs.

description.zh: 绕过外链脚本过滤：srcdoc 属性内的导航脚本触发回调。成功判据：回调请求携带错误 state 到达。
description.en: Bypasses external-script filtering via a navigation script inside the srcdoc attribute. Success: callback arrives with the wrong state.

name.zh: OAuth 重定向 URI 精确匹配

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为OAuth 重定向 URI 精确匹配验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a OAuth Redirect URI Exact Matching validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth 重定向 URI 精确匹配场景，检验授权服务器是否只接受预注册的完整回调地址。验证维度为路径追加、斜杠尾缀与编码变体的 redirect_uri 矩阵单步执行，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth redirect_uri exact matching, testing whether the authorization server accepts only the fully pre-registered callback address. Validation runs a redirect_uri matrix of path appends, trailing slashes and encoding variants in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于授权服务器以字符串前缀或包含关系代替完整比对：redirect_uri 追加路径、尾缀斜杠或编码变体仍被视为合法回调，授权码随之发往攻击者可控地址。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the authorization server comparing by string prefix or containment instead of full equality: redirect_uri variants with appended paths, trailing slashes or encodings still count as the registered callback, sending authorization codes to attacker-controlled addresses.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本把注册回调的追加路径、尾缀斜杠、查询占位与编码变体逐条作为 redirect_uri 提交授权端点，观察是否返回 code 或执行跳转：任一未注册变体仍完成签发即确认绑定不严格。成功判据以授权服务器的错误码与重定向行为为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；先用合法值标定基线再比较差异。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit registered-callback variants with appended paths, trailing slashes, query placeholders and encodings one by one as redirect_uri to the authorization endpoint, watching for code issuance or a redirect; any unregistered variant completing issuance confirms loose binding. Judge success by the authorization server error codes and redirect behavior. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; baseline with the legitimate value first, then compare differences.

mitigation.zh: 授权服务器对 redirect_uri 执行注册值的完整字符串比对，禁止通配、前缀与忽略查询的宽松模式。修复后重放第 1 步矩阵，所有未注册变体应返回 invalid_request。
mitigation.en: The authorization server must compare redirect_uri against the registered value in full, banning wildcard, prefix and query-ignoring modes. After the fix, replay the step 1 matrix: every unregistered variant should return invalid_request.

description.zh: 为OAuth 重定向 URI 精确匹配准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for OAuth Redirect URI Exact Matching.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
redirect_uri=https://client.example.invalid/oauth/callback
redirect_uri=https://client.example.invalid/oauth/callback/extra
redirect_uri=https://client.example.invalid/oauth/callback?next=https%3A%2F%2Funregistered.example.invalid%2Fmarker
redirect_uri=https://unregistered.example.invalid/oauth/callback
redirect_uri=https://client.example.invalid:8443/oauth/callback
redirect_uri=https://client.example.invalid/redirect?url=https%3A%2F%2Funregistered.example.invalid%2Fmarker
# Expected: exact registered URI is accepted; every other owned, non-resolving control is rejected before issuing a code.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有授权服务器、测试客户端、两个合成用户和精确登记的 HTTPS redirect URI，记录授权请求与令牌事件。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned authorization server, test client, two synthetic users, and an exactly registered HTTPS redirect URI, recording authorization and token events.

prerequisites.zh: 每轮使用新的 state、nonce、PKCE verifier 和一次性 code，测试令牌仅包含无敏感字段 scope。
prerequisites.en: Use fresh state, nonce, PKCE verifier, and one-time code for every run, with test tokens limited to nonsensitive scopes.

analysis.zh: 阳性需要证明错误会话可完成账户绑定、未登记 redirect URI 收到可兑换 code/token、未授权 scope 被资源服务器接受，或面向另一个客户端/受众的令牌访问同一标记资源。授权页错误、候选 URI 被反射、浏览器导航、不可兑换 code、fragment 出现在地址栏或资源服务器正确拒绝都不是漏洞证据。
analysis.en: Positive evidence requires the wrong session to complete account binding, an unregistered redirect URI to receive a redeemable code or token, an unauthorized scope to be accepted, or a token for another client or audience to access the same marker resource. Authorization errors, reflected candidate URIs, browser navigation, unredeemable codes, fragments in the address bar, or correct resource-server rejection are not evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只使用短期测试 code/token 并访问一个只读标记资源；不得使用窃取令牌、管理员 scope 或真实第三方客户端。
opsecTips.en: Use only short-lived test codes and tokens to access one read-only marker resource; do not use stolen tokens, administrator scopes, or real third-party clients.

opsecTips.zh: 撤销 code、access token 与 refresh token，删除测试绑定和回调日志，恢复客户端登记与 consent 配置。
opsecTips.en: Revoke codes, access tokens, and refresh tokens, delete test bindings and callback logs, and restore client registration and consent configuration.

description.zh: 绕过前缀精确匹配校验：编码的遍历段在后端规范化时逃逸回调目录。成功判据：授权码被重定向到 evil 路径。
description.en: Bypasses prefix matching: encoded traversal segments escape the callback directory after backend normalization. Success: code redirects to the evil path.

description.zh: 绕过字符串全等校验：尾点与大小写在 DNS 解析上等价。成功判据：重定向仍指向合法域但绕过比对。
description.en: Bypasses exact-string validation since a trailing dot and mixed case resolve identically in DNS. Success: redirect still lands on the real domain while evading comparison.

description.zh: 绕过前缀白名单匹配：@ 前的 userinfo 使实际主机为攻击者域。成功判据：授权码发往 {ATTACKER_HOST}。
description.en: Bypasses allowlist prefix matching: the userinfo before @ makes the real host the attacker's. Success: the code is sent to {ATTACKER_HOST}.

name.zh: OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: OAuth 与 OIDC 流程攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界场景，检验授权服务器是否把令牌约束在注册 scope 与目标 audience 内，拒绝 fragment 等非常规承载。验证维度为 fragment 阴性对照的单步样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers OAuth scope and audience boundaries, testing whether the authorization server confines tokens to registered scopes and the intended audience and rejects nonstandard carriers such as fragments. Validation uses a fragment negative control in one step, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于令牌签发未绑定请求的 scope 与 audience，或接受 fragment 承载响应：超范围令牌可被用于更高权限接口，fragment 中的令牌则经浏览器历史与 Referer 泄露。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is token issuance unbound to the requested scope and audience, or accepting fragment-borne responses: over-scoped tokens work against higher-privilege APIs, while fragment tokens leak via browser history and Referer.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本构造携带 access_token 的 fragment 回调样例并输出对照说明，核对授权服务器是否拒绝 fragment 响应类型，以及签发令牌的 scope 与 aud 是否精确匹配注册值；任一超范围令牌可用即确认边界缺失。成功判据以令牌声明与服务端拒绝记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, build the fragment-callback sample carrying an access_token per the script and print the control notes; check whether the authorization server rejects fragment response types and whether issued token scopes and aud exactly match registered values; any usable over-scoped token confirms the missing boundary. Judge success by token claims and server rejection records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 签发时把请求 scope 与 audience 写入令牌并逐接口校验，禁用 fragment 响应类型仅允许 code 流。修复后重放第 1 步，超范围与 fragment 请求应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Embed the requested scope and audience into tokens and verify per API, disabling fragment response types and allowing only the code flow. After the fix, replay step 1: over-scoped and fragment requests should be rejected.

description.zh: 为OAuth Scope 与 Audience 边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for OAuth Scope and Audience Boundary.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
printf "%s\n" "Fragment negative control: https://client.example.invalid/callback#access_token=PAYLOADER_TEST_TOKEN"
printf "%s\n" "URL fragments are not sent in HTTP requests or Referer headers."
curl -sS --max-time 5 "http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/authorize?client_id=payloader-client&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2Fclient.example.invalid%2Foauth%2Fcallback&response_type=code&scope=openid%20profile&state=PAYLOADER_STATE&code_challenge=PAYLOADER_CHALLENGE&code_challenge_method=S256"
curl -sS --max-time 5 -H "Authorization: Bearer PAYLOADER_TEST_TOKEN" http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/marker
curl -sS --max-time 5 -d "grant_type=refresh_token&refresh_token=PAYLOADER_TEST_REFRESH&client_id=payloader-client" http://127.0.0.1:8080/oauth/token
# Expected: only consented scope and matching issuer, audience, client, and token binding reach the read-only marker.

description.zh: 绕过 scope 白名单逐项比对：编码分隔符使前后端解析出不同集合。成功判据：授权结果包含 admin。
description.en: Bypasses per-item scope whitelisting: the encoded separator yields different parsed sets across layers. Success: grant includes admin.

description.zh: 利用取参差异注入附加授权。成功判据：下发的令牌含 admin 权限。
description.en: Injects extra grants via parameter-pollution extraction differences. Success: issued token carries admin.

description.zh: 绕过单一参数名的受众校验假设：探测后端实际读取的字段。成功判据：任一别名字段被接受并跨受众使用令牌。
description.en: Bypasses single-parameter audience assumptions by probing which alias the backend actually reads. Success: any alias is accepted and the token works cross-audience.

name.zh: SAML 签名验证边界

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML 签名验证边界验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a SAML Signature Validation Boundary validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML 签名验证边界场景，检验服务提供方是否对实际引用的 Assertion 执行签名验证。验证维度为剥离签名后的验证失败对照与完整签名验证成功对照，对应第 1 至第 2 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SAML signature-validation boundary, testing whether the service provider verifies the signature of the Assertion actually referenced. Validation contrasts a signature-stripped verification failure with an intact-signature success control, mapped to steps 1 and 2.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证逻辑校验的对象与消费的对象不一致：签名挂在 Response 而 Assertion 被消费，或攻击者剥离签名后服务端仍按未签名断言放行，身份声明可被任意伪造。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is verifying a different object than the one consumed: the signature covers the Response while the Assertion is consumed, or after signature stripping the server still accepts the unsigned assertion, letting identity claims be forged at will.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步用 xmlstarlet 删除样例响应中的 Signature 节点后以 xmlsec1 验证，验证应立即失败；第 2 步对未改动的签名夹具执行同一验证并确认成功。两类结果结合服务端 ACS 行为判断：被剥离签名的响应仍被接受即确认验证边界缺陷。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；全部在隔离 fixture 上操作。
exploitation.en: In step 1, remove the Signature node from the sample response with xmlstarlet and verify with xmlsec1; verification should fail immediately. In step 2, run the same verification on the untouched signed fixture and confirm success. Combine both results with ACS behavior: acceptance of the stripped response confirms the validation boundary flaw. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; operate only on isolated fixtures.

mitigation.zh: 服务端强制 Assertion 级签名验证并校验签名引用的 ID 与消费对象一致，缺失签名直接拒绝。修复后重放第 1 步，剥离签名的响应应被拒绝并记录告警。
mitigation.en: Enforce Assertion-level signature verification, ensure the signed reference matches the consumed object, and reject missing signatures outright. After the fix, replay step 1: signature-stripped responses should be rejected with alerts.

description.zh: 为SAML 签名验证边界准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SAML Signature Validation Boundary.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion saml-response.xml
xmlstarlet ed -d '//*[local-name()="Signature"]' saml-response.xml > saml-unsigned.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion saml-unsigned.xml
# Expected: the signed synthetic assertion verifies and the unsigned negative control fails.

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned IdP and SP, test certificates, and two synthetic principals, recording Response and Assertion IDs, InResponseTo, Audience, Recipient, time, and signature references.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。
prerequisites.en: For XXE, use a local canary resolver without file reads or egress; use a dedicated test key and disposable SP for signature tests.

analysis.zh: 阳性签名缺陷要求 SP 接受未签名或攻击者签名的断言并建立错误主体；重放要求同一 Assertion ID 在过期或已消费后再次建立会话；XSW 要求业务层使用的断言与签名实际覆盖的节点不同；XXE 要求解析器服务端触发受控 canary。删除 Signature 后报错、XML 可解析、NameID 文本变化、Base64 成功或 DTD 出现在请求中都不是阳性。
analysis.en: A signature flaw requires the SP to accept an unsigned or attacker-signed assertion and create the wrong principal. Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node. XXE requires the server parser to trigger a controlled canary. Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed NameID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: 只建立一个合成低权限会话；不得读取系统文件、外带数据、使用真实 IdP 证书或向生产 ACS 提交断言。
opsecTips.en: Create at most one synthetic low-privilege session; do not read system files, exfiltrate data, use real IdP certificates, or submit assertions to a production ACS.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，撤销测试证书，删除断言、XML、resolver 日志和 Burp 项目，并恢复签名及解析器策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out test sessions, revoke test certificates, delete assertions, XML, resolver logs, and Burp projects, and restore signature and parser policy.

wafBypass.command: xmlstarlet ed -d "//*[local-name()='Signature']" fixtures/saml-signed.xml > saml-nosig.xml && curl -sS --max-time 5 --data-urlencode "SAMLResponse@-" --data-urlencode "RelayState=/marker" http://127.0.0.1:8080/saml/acs < <(base64 -w0 saml-nosig.xml)

description.zh: 绕过验签强制缺失：删除 Signature 节点后重放。成功判据：ACS 接受无签名断言并建立会话。
description.en: Bypasses missing signature enforcement by replaying the assertion with Signature nodes removed. Success: the ACS accepts it and establishes a session.

description.zh: 检测验证方是否固定指定信任锚：用攻击者 CA 验证同一文档。成功判据：验证通过说明信任锚可被替换。
description.en: Checks whether the verifier pins its trust anchor by validating the same document against an attacker CA. Success: verification passes, proving the anchor is swappable.

wafBypass.command: xmlstarlet ed -s "//*[local-name()='Conditions']" -t elem -n lab -v "PAYLOADER_UNSIGNED" fixtures/saml-signed.xml | curl -sS --max-time 5 --data-urlencode "SAMLResponse@-" http://127.0.0.1:8080/saml/acs < <(base64 -w0 /dev/stdin)

description.zh: 在已签名断言内追加未签名节点，检验签名是否覆盖整个断言。成功判据：新增节点被接受且断言有效。
description.en: Appends unsigned nodes inside a signed assertion to test whether the signature covers the whole assertion. Success: the new node is accepted and the assertion remains valid.

name.zh: SAML Assertion 重放防护

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML Assertion 重放防护验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a SAML Assertion Replay Protection validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML Assertion 重放防护场景，检验 ACS 是否把已消费断言记入一次性缓存并在重放时拒绝。验证维度为已消费响应重放的单步阴性样例，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers SAML assertion replay protection, testing whether the ACS records consumed assertions in a one-time cache and rejects replays. Validation replays a previously consumed response as a single negative sample, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于 ACS 未维护断言 ID 的已用记录或窗口设置过长：截获的一次合法响应可在时效内反复提交，攻击者借此冒用受害者身份建立会话。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the ACS keeping no used-ID record for assertions or using overly long windows: one legitimately captured response can be resubmitted throughout its validity, letting attackers impersonate the victim session.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步以标记为已消费的 SAMLResponse 夹具配合 RelayState 提交到 ACS，服务端返回已使用拒绝即证明重放防护生效，建立新会话即确认重放缺陷。成功判据以响应状态与断言缓存记录为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换；仅使用实验夹具中的合成断言。
exploitation.en: In step 1, submit the consumed-SAMLResponse fixture with a RelayState to the ACS; a used-token rejection proves replay protection, a new session confirms the replay flaw. Judge success by response status and assertion-cache records. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu; use only synthetic assertions from lab fixtures.

mitigation.zh: ACS 以断言 ID 建立带时效的已用缓存并在验证通过后立即登记，重复提交一律拒绝。修复后重放第 1 步，已消费断言应返回拒绝且日志出现重放告警。
mitigation.en: Maintain a time-windowed used-ID cache at the ACS, register assertions immediately after successful verification, and reject all resubmissions. After the fix, replay step 1: consumed assertions should be rejected with replay alerts in logs.

description.zh: 为SAML Assertion 重放防护准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SAML Assertion Replay Protection.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
curl -sS --max-time 5 --data-urlencode "SAMLResponse=PAYLOADER_PREVIOUSLY_CONSUMED" --data-urlencode "RelayState=/marker" http://127.0.0.1:8080/saml/acs
# Expected: modified signatures and consumed Assertion IDs are rejected; no privileged identity is used.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。
prerequisites.en: For XXE, use a local canary resolver without file reads or egress; use a dedicated test key and disposable SP for signature tests.

analysis.zh: 阳性签名缺陷要求 SP 接受未签名或攻击者签名的断言并建立错误主体；重放要求同一 Assertion ID 在过期或已消费后再次建立会话；XSW 要求业务层使用的断言与签名实际覆盖的节点不同；XXE 要求解析器服务端触发受控 canary。删除 Signature 后报错、XML 可解析、NameID 文本变化、Base64 成功或 DTD 出现在请求中都不是阳性。
analysis.en: A signature flaw requires the SP to accept an unsigned or attacker-signed assertion and create the wrong principal. Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node. XXE requires the server parser to trigger a controlled canary. Rejection after Signature removal, parseable XML, changed NameID text, successful Base64, or a DTD merely present in the request is not positive.

opsecTips.zh: 只建立一个合成低权限会话；不得读取系统文件、外带数据、使用真实 IdP 证书或向生产 ACS 提交断言。
opsecTips.en: Create at most one synthetic low-privilege session; do not read system files, exfiltrate data, use real IdP certificates, or submit assertions to a production ACS.

opsecTips.zh: 注销测试会话，撤销测试证书，删除断言、XML、resolver 日志和 Burp 项目，并恢复签名及解析器策略。
opsecTips.en: Log out test sessions, revoke test certificates, delete assertions, XML, resolver logs, and Burp projects, and restore signature and parser policy.

description.zh: 绕过按完整请求体哈希的重放缓存：仅变换 RelayState 制造新缓存键。成功判据：ACS 仍接受断言。
description.en: Bypasses whole-body-hash replay caches by mutating only RelayState to mint a fresh cache key. Success: the ACS still accepts the assertion.

description.zh: 利用支持 GZip/Deflate 的实现差异改变编码层绕过重放比对。成功判据：压缩形态断言被接受。
description.en: Exploits implementations that accept GZip/Deflate encodings to alter the comparison layer. Success: the compressed assertion is accepted.

description.zh: 改写 Audience 到另一 SP 后重放同一断言，绕过按 SP 维度的重放记录。成功判据：sp2 侧认证成功。
description.en: Rewrites the Audience to another SP and replays the same assertion to bypass per-SP replay records. Success: authentication succeeds on the sp2 side.

name.zh: SAML XML 签名包装验证基线
name.en: SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline

description.zh: 将原混合集中的命令隔离为SAML XML 签名包装验证基线验证卡，使用合成主体、只读标记和服务端证据界定结果。
description.en: Isolates commands from the mixed source into a SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline validation card using synthetic principals, a read-only marker, and server-side evidence.

subCategory.zh: SAML 断言与联邦身份攻击

overview.zh: 该 Payload 覆盖 SAML XML 签名包装验证基线场景，检验验证器在文档包含多个 Assertion 或 Signature 时是否只认引用对象。验证维度为签名模板改签与篡改后复验的两步流程，对应第 1 步。
overview.en: This payload covers the SAML XML signature-wrapper validation baseline, testing whether the verifier honors only the referenced object when documents contain multiple Assertions or Signatures. Validation signs a template and re-verifies after tampering, mapped to step 1.

vulnerability.zh: 根因在于验证器按文档顺序或首个节点取断言而不核对签名引用：攻击者把合法签名挂在恶意 Assertion 上形成包装，验证通过后消费的却是伪造身份。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is selecting assertions by document order or first node without checking signature references: attackers attach a legitimate signature to a malicious Assertion as a wrapper, and after validation the forged identity is consumed.

exploitation.zh: 第 1 步按脚本用 xmlsec1 以测试 IdP 密钥签署模板生成 signed-test.xml，随后篡改其中 NameID 再复验并提交 ACS：复验失败或 ACS 拒绝即证明包装防护生效，验证通过且身份被替换即确认 XSW 缺陷。成功判据以复验结果与 ACS 决策为准。占位符在全局变量菜单替换。
exploitation.en: In step 1, sign the template with xmlsec1 using the test IdP key to produce signed-test.xml, then tamper the NameID, re-verify, and submit to the ACS: failed re-verification or ACS rejection proves wrapper protection, while verified acceptance with a swapped identity confirms the XSW flaw. Judge success by re-verification results and ACS decisions. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 验证器解析签名引用的 URI 并只消费被签名覆盖的 Assertion，禁止文档出现多个未引用断言；同时校验 Subject 与 InResponseTo。修复后重放第 1 步，包装文档应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Parse the signature reference URI and consume only the covered Assertion, forbid unreferenced assertions in the document, and validate Subject and InResponseTo. After the fix, replay step 1: wrapper documents should be rejected.

description.zh: 为SAML XML 签名包装验证基线准备合成主体、固定只读标记和服务端日志基线。
description.en: Prepare synthetic principals, a fixed read-only marker, and server-log baselines for SAML XML Signature Wrapping Validation Baseline.

description.zh: 只执行当前验证卡的第一条样例，并保持账户、会话和目标对象不变。
description.en: Run only the first sample in this validation card while keeping the account, session, and target object unchanged.

attackChain.payload:
xmlsec1 --sign --privkey-pem fixtures/test-idp.key,fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion --output signed-test.xml fixtures/saml-signature-template.xml
xmlsec1 --verify --trusted-pem fixtures/test-idp.crt --id-attr:ID Assertion signed-test.xml

description.zh: 把响应与认证主体、验证器决策和标记对象访问日志关联，排除回显、错误页和客户端状态变化。
description.en: Correlate the response with principal, verifier decision, and marker-object logs, excluding reflection, error pages, and client-side state changes.

description.zh: 撤销测试会话和令牌，清理临时文件，并同时重放合法基线与拒绝样例。
description.en: Revoke test sessions and tokens, remove temporary files, and replay both the valid baseline and rejected sample.

prerequisites.zh: 使用自有 IdP/SP、测试证书和两个合成主体，记录 Response/Assertion ID、InResponseTo、Audience、Recipient、时间与签名引用。
prerequisites.en: Use an owned IdP and SP, test certificates, and two synthetic principals, recording Response and Assertion IDs, InResponseTo, Audience, Recipient, time, and signature references.

prerequisites.zh: XXE 仅使用无文件读取、无外网的本地 canary resolver；签名测试使用专用测试密钥和可销毁 SP。

Replay requires a consumed or expired Assertion ID to create another session. XSW requires business logic to use a node different from the signed node.
