description.en: Groups fetch and synchronous XMLHttpRequest variants for loopback and metadata addresses to test whether headless Chromium requests HTTP resources on behalf of the renderer and exposes responses to page script.

overview.zh: Puppeteer HTTP 资源读取边界覆盖无头浏览器资源访问场景：针对使用 Puppeteer 渲染不可信页面的服务，验证 fetch 与同步 XHR 能否读取内部地址响应并经页面通道交回调用方。验证维度涵盖 fetch 与 XHR 两类脚本变体及元数据目标。
overview.en: Puppeteer HTTP Resource-Read Boundary covers headless-browser resource access: for services rendering untrusted pages with Puppeteer, verify whether fetch and synchronous XHR can read internal-address responses and hand them back to the caller via page channels. Verification dimensions cover fetch and XHR script variants plus metadata targets.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是页面脚本在渲染器上下文执行且渲染器可达内部服务，响应可读性取决于 CORS 与网络位置；攻击者需同时满足脚本执行、目标可达与响应可读三个条件才能把内部内容带出，单看 DNS 或连接尝试不足以判定。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is page scripts executing in the renderer context while the renderer reaches internal services, with response readability governed by CORS and network position; the attacker needs script execution, target reachability, and readable responses simultaneously to exfiltrate internals — DNS or connection attempts alone prove nothing.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用禁止网络的普通页面建立基线；随后提交 fetch 与同步 XHR 变体（指向 169.254.169.254 与 127.0.0.1 并把响应写入 document.title），渲染请求、Chromium 请求、模拟响应与 title 中相同令牌完整关联即确认成立。实际测试必须把两个地址替换为隔离标记端点，响应限制为短随机常量。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first establishes a baseline with an ordinary page denied networking; then submit fetch and synchronous XHR variants (targeting 169.254.169.254 and 127.0.0.1, writing responses into document.title) — full correlation of render request, Chromium request, simulated response, and the same token in title confirms. In testing, replace both addresses with isolated marker endpoints and keep responses to short random constants. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 在解析后与每次跳转前执行地址策略，阻断回环、链路本地、私网及保留网段；禁用不需要的脚本并让渲染进程运行在无内部路由的独立网络。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，脚本对内部地址的请求应全部失败。
mitigation.en: Apply address policy after parsing and before every hop, blocking loopback, link-local, private, and reserved ranges; disable unneeded scripts and run the renderer on an isolated network without internal routes. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: script requests to internal addresses must all fail.

title.en: Isolate networking and establish a baseline

description.zh: 确认普通页面不产生出站请求，并为两个模拟目标配置独立令牌。
description.en: Confirm an ordinary page makes no outbound request and assign separate tokens to the two simulators.

description.zh: 每次只测试一个 API 和一个模拟目标，保存页面与网络跟踪。
description.en: Test one API and one simulated destination at a time and preserve page and network traces.

description.zh: 匹配请求令牌、响应体和 title，区分可达性与内容读取。
description.en: Match request token, response body, and title and distinguish reachability from content read.

description.zh: 修复后确认批准公网目标仍可用，而模拟内部目标在发包前被拒绝。
description.en: After remediation preserve approved public targets while rejecting simulated internal destinations before a packet is sent.

prerequisites.zh: 真实回环和云元数据地址在提交前改写为两个隔离的固定标记端点
prerequisites.en: Real loopback and cloud-metadata addresses are rewritten before submission to two isolated fixed-marker endpoints.

prerequisites.zh: 能够同时记录渲染请求、Chromium 网络事件和页面 title 结果，并禁用重定向与外部出口
prerequisites.en: Renderer requests, Chromium network events, and the resulting page title can be recorded while redirects and external egress are disabled.

analysis.zh: 只有应用发起的 Chromium 请求取得模拟响应，且页面输出出现同一随机标记，才证明 HTTP 响应可读 SSRF。连接失败、CORS 拒绝或空 title 只能说明某一环节被阻断。
analysis.en: Readable-response SSRF is proven only when the application-origin Chromium request receives the simulated response and the same random marker appears in page output. A failed connection, CORS rejection, or empty title shows a blocked stage only.

opsecTips.zh: 模拟端点只返回短随机标记，禁止凭证、实例数据、重定向和二次资源
opsecTips.en: Simulator endpoints return only short random markers, with no credentials, instance data, redirects, or secondary resources.

opsecTips.zh: 每个变体只渲染一次并设置短超时，完成后销毁浏览器 Profile、网络日志和标记
opsecTips.en: Render each variant once with a short timeout, then destroy the browser profile, network logs, and tokens.

description.zh: 绕过对页面内直连元数据地址的检测：先请求外部重定向器再由其 302 到目标；document.title 出现元数据即成功。
description.en: Fetch an external redirector that 302s to the metadata endpoint to bypass direct-connection detection; metadata appearing in document.title confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 script/fetch 语句的静态扫描：用 preload 资源提示触发浏览器预取；服务端访问日志出现内部来源请求即成功。
description.en: Trigger prefetch via a preload hint instead of script statements; an internal-sourced request in server access logs confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 fetch/XHR API 的钩子拦截：直接顶层导航使无头浏览器请求内部地址；时序与日志出现访问即成功。
description.en: Navigate top-level to bypass fetch/XHR API hooks; access appearing in timing and logs confirms success.

name.zh: WeasyPrint HTTP 子资源获取边界

description.zh: 归并外部样式表和 SVG image 两种声明式 HTTP 子资源，验证 WeasyPrint URL fetcher 是否可达渲染服务内部地址。
description.en: Groups external stylesheet and SVG image declarative HTTP subresources to test whether the WeasyPrint URL fetcher can reach renderer-internal destinations.

overview.zh: WeasyPrint HTTP 子资源获取边界覆盖文档渲染子资源场景：针对把 HTML/CSS 交给 WeasyPrint 生成 PDF 的服务，验证 link 样式表与 SVG image 两种声明式入口能否触达渲染服务内部地址。验证维度为 CSS 与 SVG 两类资源引用变体。
overview.en: WeasyPrint HTTP Subresource-Fetch Boundary covers document-rendering subresources: for services generating PDFs from HTML/CSS via WeasyPrint, verify whether the declarative link stylesheet and SVG image entries reach the rendering service's internal addresses. Verification dimensions are the CSS and SVG resource-reference variants.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 WeasyPrint 的 URL fetcher 解析 HTML/CSS/SVG 全部引用且默认不限制解析后地址，攻击者控制资源 URL 即可让渲染进程访问内部 HTTP 服务；输出中仅出现 URL 或渲染失败不构成请求证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is WeasyPrint's URL fetcher resolving all HTML/CSS/SVG references without restricting resolved addresses by default; an attacker controlling resource URLs makes the rendering process reach internal HTTP services, while a URL merely appearing in output or render failure is not request evidence.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步渲染无外部资源的基线文档；随后把 link 样式表与 SVG image 的地址替换为两个带独立令牌的模拟路径分别渲染，模拟端点首包与对应渲染任务关联即确认成立，资源是否呈现作为第二层证据。响应仅需最小有效 CSS 或图片。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 renders a baseline document without external resources; then replace the link stylesheet and SVG image addresses with two simulated paths carrying distinct tokens and render separately — correlation of each endpoint's first packet with its render task confirms, with resource presentation as secondary evidence. Responses need only minimal valid CSS or an image. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 用自定义 URL fetcher 只允许批准的 scheme、域名与解析地址，并在重定向后重复校验；渲染容器网络默认拒绝内部与链路本地路由。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，外部引用应全部被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Use a custom URL fetcher allowing only approved schemes, domains, and resolved addresses with revalidation after redirects; default-deny internal and link-local routing for the render container network. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: external references must all be denied.

description.zh: 保存版本、允许 scheme 和无资源文档的零请求结果。
description.en: Preserve the version, allowed schemes, and zero-request result for a resource-free document.

description.zh: 为 CSS 与 SVG 分配不同令牌并分别生成文档。
description.en: Assign separate tokens to CSS and SVG and generate each document separately.

description.zh: 匹配渲染 ID、首包、User-Agent 和令牌，排除浏览器客户端流量。
description.en: Match render ID, first packet, user agent, and token and exclude client-browser traffic.

description.zh: 确认批准 CDN 资源可用，模拟内部地址在连接前失败。
description.en: Confirm approved CDN resources remain available and the simulated internal address fails before connection.

prerequisites.zh: 127.0.0.1 在渲染前改为隔离的 marker 服务，且无真实内部路由
prerequisites.en: 127.0.0.1 is replaced before rendering with an isolated marker service and no real internal route is available.

prerequisites.zh: 能够记录 WeasyPrint 版本、自定义 URL fetcher 决策和模拟端点首包
prerequisites.en: The WeasyPrint version, custom URL-fetcher decisions, and simulator first packets can be recorded.

analysis.zh: 来自 WeasyPrint 进程并携带当前 marker 的 HTTP 首包证明服务端资源访问。渲染警告、空白图片、DNS 或客户端查看 PDF 时的请求都不是同等证据。
analysis.en: An HTTP first packet from the WeasyPrint process carrying the current marker proves server-side resource access. Render warnings, blank images, DNS, or requests made while viewing the PDF are not equivalent evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 模拟服务无重定向、无认证并在首个请求后关闭，不返回任何内部数据
opsecTips.en: The simulator has no redirects or authentication, closes after its first request, and returns no internal data.

opsecTips.zh: 渲染容器使用一次性网络命名空间、短超时和严格响应体大小上限
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable network namespace, short timeout, and strict response-size cap for the rendering container.

description.zh: 绕过对 link/img 元素的过滤：以样式表导入语句发起子资源请求；渲染器访问日志出现内网请求即成功。
description.en: Fetch through a stylesheet import statement past link/img filtering; an internal request in renderer access logs confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 HTML 资源标签的白名单：改用 SVG 图像元素引用远程资源；内部目标收到连接即成功。
description.en: Reference the remote resource from an SVG image element past HTML tag allowlists; the internal target receiving a connection confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过按主机名取第一个 @ 前内容的解析差异： userinfo 段携带伪装域名；请求实际到达 127.0.0.1 即成功。
description.en: Carry a decoy domain in the userinfo segment to exploit parser divergence; the request actually reaching 127.0.0.1 confirms success.

name.zh: SSRF File URI 本地资源读取

description.zh: 使用 Linux 与 Windows 的九个 file:// 目标验证服务端 URL 获取器是否越过网络资源边界读取本地文件。
description.en: Uses nine Linux and Windows file:// targets to test whether a server-side URL fetcher crosses its network-resource boundary and reads local files.

overview.zh: SSRF File URI 本地资源读取覆盖本地文件读取场景：针对通用服务端 URL 获取功能，验证 file:// 目标能否让服务端组件读取本机文件。验证维度涵盖 Linux 与 Windows 共九个目标路径（/etc/passwd、/proc/self/environ、config.php、hosts、SAM 等）的逐项验证。
overview.en: SSRF File-URI Local Resource Read covers local file reading: for a general-purpose server-side URL fetch function, verify whether file:// targets make the server component read local files. Verification dimensions cover nine Linux and Windows target paths (/etc/passwd, /proc/self/environ, config.php, hosts, SAM, and more), item by item.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是应用接受任意 scheme 并把用户 URL 交给支持 file 协议的获取器，原本只应访问远程业务资源的功能转而承接本地路径；可读范围由应用进程权限决定，scheme 被解析或路径存在并不等于内容已返回。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is the application accepting arbitrary schemes and handing user URLs to a file-capable fetcher, so functionality meant for remote business resources serves local paths instead; readable scope follows the application process's privileges, and a parsed scheme or existing path does not mean content was returned.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用受控 HTTPS 标记端点证明服务端获取基线成立；再按目标操作系统把 file URI 的路径改写到隔离标记文件，逐条提交并记录响应，应用响应包含标记且文件审计显示同一请求 ID 的本地读取才算阳性；客户端读取、静态回显与权限错误均排除。每次只提交一个 file URI。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first proves the server-side fetch baseline via a controlled HTTPS marker endpoint; then rewrite each file URI's path to an isolated marker file per the target OS, submitting one at a time and recording responses — the response containing the marker plus file audit showing a local read under the same request ID is positive; exclude client-side reads, static echoes, and permission errors. Submit one file URI at a time. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: URL 获取器仅允许必要的 http/https，在解析后与每次重定向后校验 scheme 与目标；文件功能改用对象 ID 与固定根目录定位，网络获取与本地文件读取由不同服务身份承担。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，file URI 应在入口被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Restrict the URL fetcher to required http/https and validate scheme and target after parsing and every redirect; relocate file functionality to object IDs within a fixed root, and split network fetching from local file reads across separate service identities. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: file URIs must be rejected at the entrance.

title.zh: 建立服务端 HTTPS 获取基线
title.en: Establish a server-side HTTPS retrieval baseline

description.zh: 用唯一令牌确认请求源、重定向行为和响应处理均属于目标应用。
description.en: Use a unique token to confirm request origin, redirect behavior, and response handling belong to the target application.

title.zh: 改写并提交单个 File URI
title.en: Rewrite and submit one file URI

description.zh: 把系统路径改为对应平台的随机标记文件，每轮仅测试一个保留变体。
description.en: Replace the system path with the platform-specific random-marker file and test only one preserved variant per run.

attackChain.payload:
file:///etc/passwd
file:///etc/shadow
file:///proc/self/environ
file:///proc/version
file:///var/log/apache2/access.log
file:///var/www/html/index.php
file:///var/www/html/config.php
file:///C:/Windows/System32/drivers/etc/hosts
file:///C:/Windows/repair/SAM

title.zh: 关联本地读取与响应标记
title.en: Correlate the local read and response marker

description.zh: 匹配规范化路径、文件审计、应用请求 ID 和返回标记，排除浏览器或代理读取。
description.en: Match canonical path, file audit, application request ID, and returned marker while excluding browser or proxy reads.

title.zh: 收紧 Scheme 并清除标记

description.zh: 修复后重放 HTTPS 基线与 file URI，确认前者正常而后者在文件调用前拒绝，再删除标记文件。
description.en: After remediation replay the HTTPS baseline and file URI, preserving the former and rejecting the latter before any file call, then delete marker files.

prerequisites.zh: 已确认请求由应用服务器发起，且可记录 URL 解析后的 scheme 与最终文件调用
prerequisites.en: The request is confirmed to originate from the application server, and the parsed scheme and final file call are observable.

prerequisites.zh: Linux 与 Windows 测试实例只提供无敏感随机标记文件，禁止访问原始系统路径
prerequisites.en: Linux and Windows test instances expose only nonsensitive random-marker files, and original system paths are off limits.

analysis.zh: 有效证据要求目标应用进程实际读取隔离本地文件并把唯一标记返回到同一请求。file URI 被接受、错误中出现路径、DNS 没有发生或测试浏览器能打开文件都不足以确认服务端本地读取。
analysis.en: Valid evidence requires the target application process to read the isolated local file and return its unique marker in the same request. An accepted file URI, a path in an error, absence of DNS, or a test browser opening the file is insufficient to prove a server-side local read.

opsecTips.zh: 执行前把九个敏感路径全部映射为专用标记文件；任何真实内容出现即停止并升级数据处理
opsecTips.en: Map all nine sensitive paths to dedicated marker files before execution; stop immediately and escalate data handling if any real content appears.

opsecTips.zh: 测试结束删除两种平台的标记文件、响应副本和文件审计导出，并确认未触碰原路径
opsecTips.en: At completion delete marker files, response copies, and file-audit exports from both platforms, and confirm the original paths were untouched.

description.zh: 绕过仅匹配 file:/// 三斜杠特征的规则：插入 localhost 主机段语法等价；文件内容返回即成功。
description.en: Insert the localhost host segment for an equivalent URI that defeats bare file:/// matching; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对标准三斜杠形式的正则匹配：多斜杠冗余仍解析为绝对路径；读取成功即成功。
description.en: Add redundant slashes that still resolve to the absolute path, evading canonical-form regexes; a successful read confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 file 协议黑名单：Java 场景下 netdoc 等价读文件；返回 passwd 内容即成功。
description.en: Use the Java-equivalent netdoc scheme against file-protocol blacklists; returned passwd content confirms success.

name.zh: SSRF 回环地址规范化差异

description.zh: 使用 IPv4、IPv6、八进制、十六进制、整数、缩写和 DNS 名称验证解析器是否把不同表示统一识别为回环或本地目标。
description.en: Uses IPv4, IPv6, octal, hexadecimal, integer, shorthand, and DNS names to test whether parsers consistently classify alternate forms as loopback or local destinations.

overview.zh: SSRF 回环地址规范化差异覆盖地址解析一致性场景：针对带主机名校验的取回功能，验证字面 IPv4、IPv6、八进制/十六进制/整数、缩写与解析到本地的域名是否被统一识别为回环。验证维度涵盖十二种回环与特殊地址表示的逐条对照。
overview.en: SSRF Loopback Address Canonicalization covers address-resolution consistency: for fetch functions validating hostnames, verify whether literal IPv4, IPv6, octal/hex/integer forms, abbreviations, and local-resolving names are uniformly recognized as loopback. Verification dimensions compare twelve loopback and special-address representations item by item.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是校验器和连接库使用不同解析规则，或应用只拒绝少量字面字符串而不检查解析后的全部 A/AAAA 地址；字符串允许列表先于标准地址分类执行时，校验结论与实际连接目标即可分离。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is validators and connection libraries applying different resolution rules, or the application rejecting only a few literal strings without inspecting all resolved A/AAAA addresses; when a string allowlist runs ahead of standard address classification, validation and actual connection targets diverge.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用正常外部 URL 记录请求基线；再给每行变体补上同一固定测试端口（公共 DNS 名称替换为自有记录），逐条提交并保存原始 host、规范 host、DNS、socket 地址与监听日志；监听器收到带请求令牌的应用流量即确认规范化缺口。解析日志、超时或客户端访问不算。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 records the request baseline with a normal external URL; then append the same fixed test port to every variant line (replacing public DNS names with your own records), submitting each and saving the original host, canonical host, DNS, socket address, and listener logs — the listener receiving application traffic bearing the request token confirms the canonicalization gap. Resolution logs, timeouts, or client-side access do not count. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 使用单一标准 URL 解析器，解析全部地址后阻断回环、未指定、链路本地、私网和保留网段，并把连接固定到已批准 IP；对重定向和 DNS 重解析重复同样检查。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，所有等价表示都应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Use a single standard URL parser, block loopback, unspecified, link-local, private, and reserved ranges after resolving all addresses, and pin connections to approved IPs; repeat the checks on redirects and DNS re-resolution. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: every equivalent representation must be denied.

title.zh: 部署单端口回环标记服务
title.en: Deploy a single-port loopback marker service

description.zh: 服务只返回随机常量，并记录源地址、Host、请求令牌和时间。
description.en: The service returns only a random constant and records source address, Host, request token, and time.

title.en: Replay address forms one at a time

description.zh: 为每条输入使用新令牌和同一端口，保留原始字符串与解析/连接记录。
description.en: Use a new token and the same port for each input, preserving the original string and parse or connection records.

title.zh: 核对最终 Socket 目的地

description.zh: 把应用日志、DNS、规范地址和监听器请求关联，区分被拒解析与真实本地连接。
description.en: Correlate application logs, DNS, canonical address, and listener request to distinguish rejected parsing from a real local connection.

description.zh: 修复后重放外部允许地址和全部回环表示，确认仅前者到达并关闭测试端口。
description.en: After remediation replay an allowed external address and every loopback form, confirm only the former arrives, and close the test port.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离主机仅在一个固定端口运行返回随机标记的回环 HTTP 服务
prerequisites.en: An isolated host runs a loopback HTTP service returning a random marker on one fixed port only.

prerequisites.zh: 可记录应用使用的 URL 解析器、DNS 结果、最终 socket 地址和重定向链
prerequisites.en: The application's URL parser, DNS results, final socket address, and redirect chain are observable.

analysis.zh: 确认 SSRF 绕过需要校验阶段接受某一表示、连接库把它规范化为回环、隔离监听器收到带唯一令牌的应用请求。仅 DNS 返回 127.0.0.1、解析器显示数值等价或响应超时都只是部分证据。
analysis.en: Confirming an SSRF bypass requires validation to accept a form, the connection library to canonicalize it to loopback, and the isolated listener to receive an application request with the unique token. DNS returning 127.0.0.1, numeric equivalence in a parser, or a timeout is only partial evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 仅开放一个无敏感标记端口，任何变体首次连接后停止该轮；禁止枚举本地服务
opsecTips.en: Expose only one nonsensitive marker port and stop that run after the first connection from any form; never enumerate local services.

opsecTips.zh: 删除自有 DNS 记录、关闭监听器并清理请求令牌；公共 nip.io/localtest.me 不用于真实执行
opsecTips.en: Delete controlled DNS records, close the listener, and remove request tokens; do not use public nip.io or localtest.me during actual execution.

name.zh: SSRF 带外回调关联验证

description.zh: 保留原始外部主机 URL，用于说明如何以自有唯一令牌域替换静态第三方名称并关联服务端 DNS/HTTP 回调。
description.en: Preserves the original external-host URL to show how a static third-party name must be replaced by a controlled unique-token domain for server-side DNS or HTTP callback correlation.

overview.zh: SSRF 带外回调关联验证覆盖盲 SSRF 取证场景：针对不返回获取结果但可能仍发起 DNS 或 HTTP 请求的应用，验证以自有唯一令牌域名关联服务端回调的方法。验证维度涵盖每请求唯一子域生成、DNS/TLS/HTTP 三层日志关联与假阳性剔除。
overview.en: SSRF Out-of-Band Callback Correlation covers blind-SSRF forensics: for applications that return no fetch result yet may still issue DNS or HTTP requests, verify the method of correlating server callbacks via owned unique token domains. Verification dimensions cover per-request unique subdomains, DNS/TLS/HTTP three-layer log correlation, and false-positive removal.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是用户 URL 能驱动服务端解析或连接任意外部主机时，盲 SSRF 可经带外回调证实；静态公共域名无法可靠归因，只有 DNS 查询还可能是预解析、扫描器或中间件行为，必须以唯一令牌与来源约束证据。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that when a user URL drives server-side resolution or connections to arbitrary external hosts, blind SSRF is provable through out-of-band callbacks; static public domains cannot attribute reliably, and DNS-only hits may be pre-resolution, scanners, or middleware — evidence requires unique tokens and source constraints.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步为单次应用请求生成随机子域 `<request-id>.<owned-zone>` 并记录请求 ID、提交时间与预期窗口；随后在权威 DNS、TLS 与 HTTP 日志中检索该令牌，阳性至少要求令牌唯一且来源属于应用出口 IP 段；本地浏览器解析、邮件扫描或旧令牌重放必须剔除。优先使用 HTTPS。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 generates a random subdomain `<request-id>.<owned-zone>` per application request, recording the request ID, submission time, and expected window; then search authoritative DNS, TLS, and HTTP logs for the token — a positive requires a unique token with a source in the application's egress ranges; exclude local browser resolution, mail scanning, and stale-token replays. Prefer HTTPS. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取功能采用目的地主机允许列表、解析后 IP 分类、重定向复检和受限出站代理，不需要联网的工作负载直接禁止外连；保留回归域验证合法业务目标可达而任意令牌域不可达。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，回调应消失。
mitigation.en: Give the fetch function a destination-host allowlist, resolved-IP classification, redirect rechecks, and a restricted egress proxy, and deny all egress for workloads that need no networking; keep a regression domain proving legitimate business targets resolve while arbitrary token domains do not. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: callbacks must disappear.

description.zh: 把随机子域绑定到应用请求 ID、操作者和短时间窗，并清空此前日志基线。
description.en: Bind a random subdomain to the application request ID, operator, and short time window, and clear the prior log baseline.

title.zh: 替换静态域并单次提交
title.en: Replace the static domain and submit once

description.zh: 保持 URL 输入位置不变，仅将原始域替换为自有令牌域，且不触发第二次请求。
description.en: Keep the URL input location unchanged, replace only the original domain with the controlled token domain, and do not trigger a second request.

title.zh: 关联 DNS、TLS 与 HTTP 事件
title.en: Correlate DNS, TLS, and HTTP events

description.zh: 按令牌、时间、出口地址和协议层关联证据，排除操作者客户端与自动扫描。
description.en: Correlate evidence by token, time, egress address, and protocol layer while excluding operator clients and automated scanners.

title.zh: 阻断任意出站并撤销令牌
title.en: Block arbitrary egress and revoke the token

description.zh: 应用允许列表与出站控制后重放一次，确认无回调，再使子域失效并删除临时日志。
description.en: After applying allowlists and egress controls, replay once to confirm no callback, then invalidate the subdomain and remove temporary logs.

prerequisites.zh: 测试者控制权威 DNS 与 HTTPS 回调端点，并能为每个请求签发不可复用令牌
prerequisites.en: The tester controls authoritative DNS and an HTTPS callback endpoint and can issue a nonreusable token for each request.

prerequisites.zh: 原始 burpcollaborator.net 主机不会直接请求，应用请求 ID 与回调时间窗已定义
prerequisites.en: The original burpcollaborator.net host will not be requested directly, and the application request ID and callback time window are defined.

analysis.zh: 最强证据是唯一令牌对应的应用源 HTTP/TLS 请求，并能和同一提交 ID 关联。仅有 DNS、公共静态域日志、非唯一令牌或操作者浏览器请求无法确认盲 SSRF；必须标注证据层级。
analysis.en: The strongest evidence is an application-origin HTTP or TLS request carrying the unique token and correlated to the same submission ID. DNS alone, public static-domain logs, nonunique tokens, or operator-browser requests cannot confirm blind SSRF; the evidence layer must be stated.

opsecTips.zh: 每次只签发一个短期域名并限制单次 DNS/HTTP 事件；收到应用源回调即停止
opsecTips.en: Issue one short-lived domain per run and limit it to a single DNS or HTTP event; stop when an application-origin callback arrives.

opsecTips.zh: 测试结束撤销 DNS、TLS 证书路由和令牌映射，按保留策略清理包含出口地址的日志
opsecTips.en: At completion revoke DNS, TLS certificate routing, and token mappings, and clean logs containing egress addresses under the retention policy.

description.zh: 绕过对公共回调域名的封禁：为每次探测生成唯一子域标签做关联；DNS 查询携带该标签到达即成功。
description.en: Generate a unique subdomain label per probe for correlation past blocked public collab domains; a DNS query carrying the label arriving confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅审计明文 HTTP 出网的规则：改走 TLS 回调隐藏路径与参数；监听端收到 TLS 握手即成功。
description.en: Move the callback to TLS so egress path and parameters are hidden from HTTP-only auditing; a TLS handshake reaching the listener confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单一回调域名的黑名单：轮换备用公共带外交互域；任一域名收到回连即成功。
description.en: Rotate alternate public interaction domains past single-domain blacklists; a callback on any of them confirms success.

name.zh: Gopher SSRF 到 Redis 协议

description.zh: 使用编码后的 Redis 协议帧验证 URL 获取器是否允许 gopher 连接内网服务并发送应用层字节。
description.en: Uses an encoded Redis protocol frame to test whether a URL fetcher permits gopher connections to internal services and transmits application-layer bytes.

overview.zh: Gopher SSRF 到 Redis 协议覆盖协议桥接场景：针对服务端 URL 获取功能，验证 gopher 能否把编码后的 Redis 协议帧经服务端转发到内网 6379 并写入应用层字节。验证维度涵盖 RESP 帧编码、隔离捕获器字节比对与只读命令复测。
overview.en: Gopher SSRF to Redis Protocol covers protocol bridging: for server-side URL fetching, verify whether gopher forwards encoded Redis protocol frames through the server to intranet 6379 and writes application-layer bytes. Verification dimensions cover RESP frame encoding, isolated-catcher byte comparison, and read-only command retests.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是获取器允许用户控制 scheme、host、port 与数据段，且网络层允许应用访问内网 Redis；百分号解码后的字节被直接写入套接字，可越过无认证或仅绑定内网的服务边界，形成协议级注入。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is a fetcher letting users control scheme, host, port, and data segment while the network allows the application to reach intranet Redis; percent-decoded bytes go straight to the socket, crossing unauthenticated or intranet-only service boundaries as protocol-level injection.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步把目标改为隔离协议捕获器，提交唯一无害帧并核对原始字节、源地址与时间；确认 gopher 传输成立后，最多在专用测试 Redis 上使用只读 PING 类命令复测；生产 Redis 严禁写键、改配置或触发模块。捕获到完整预期字节即确认协议桥接。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 points the target at an isolated protocol catcher, submits one unique harmless frame, and verifies raw bytes, source address, and timing; with gopher transport confirmed, at most retest read-only PING-class commands against a dedicated test Redis; never write keys, change config, or load modules on production Redis. Receiving the complete expected bytes confirms the protocol bridge. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: URL 获取器只允许 HTTP/HTTPS 并使用结构化客户端，拒绝 gopher 与非业务端口，解析后和重定向后都检查地址；网络层阻断到 Redis 等数据服务，Redis 启用认证、TLS、ACL 与受限绑定。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，捕获器不应再收到字节。
mitigation.en: Restrict the URL fetcher to HTTP/HTTPS with structured clients, reject gopher and non-business ports, and check addresses after resolution and redirects; block data services like Redis at the network layer, and enable Redis authentication, TLS, ACLs, and constrained binding. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: the catcher must receive no bytes.

title.en: Deploy an isolated protocol capture service

description.zh: 准备只记录原始字节的测试端点，并确保应用无法访问真实数据服务。
description.en: Prepare a test endpoint that only records raw bytes and ensure the application cannot reach real data services.

description.zh: 将地址替换为捕获器后发送样例，记录应用请求 ID 和精确时间。
description.en: Replace the address with the capture service, send the sample, and record application request ID and exact time.

description.zh: 匹配捕获到的解码字节、来源连接和请求时间，排除客户端请求与背景流量。
description.en: Match decoded captured bytes, source connection, and request time, excluding client traffic and background noise.

title.en: Block the scheme and internal ports

description.zh: 实施协议允许列表和网络分段后重放，确认正常 HTTP 获取保留而 gopher 无法连接。
description.en: After scheme allowlisting and segmentation, replay to preserve normal HTTP retrieval while gopher cannot connect.

prerequisites.zh: 目标 URL 库可能支持 gopher 协议
prerequisites.en: The target URL library may support the gopher scheme.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离网络中提供只读测试 Redis 或协议捕获服务
prerequisites.en: An isolated network provides a read-only test Redis or protocol-capture service.

analysis.zh: 确认点是 URL 输入导致应用服务器向捕获器发送可控协议字节。仅能扫描端口或观察连接失败时，应归为有限 SSRF 线索而非 Redis 协议利用。
analysis.en: The confirmation point is attacker input causing the application server to send controlled protocol bytes. Port scanning or connection failures alone indicate limited SSRF evidence, not Redis protocol exploitation.

opsecTips.zh: 只连接隔离捕获器，禁止对真实 Redis 使用写入、配置或持久化命令。
opsecTips.en: Connect only to an isolated capture service and never use write, configuration, or persistence commands on real Redis.

opsecTips.zh: 单次提交唯一短帧并及时关闭监听，降低内网扫描与日志噪声。
opsecTips.en: Submit one unique short frame and close the listener promptly to minimize internal scanning and log noise.

description.zh: 绕过对 %0d%0a 完整 CRLF 特征的匹配：仅用 %0a 行结束同样构成 RESP 行；键值写入后 keys 可见即成功。
description.en: Use bare %0a line endings against full CRLF signatures while remaining valid RESP; the key being visible afterwards confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 gopher 协议的封锁：dict 协议冒号分词发送等价命令；Redis 端执行成功即成功。
description.en: Send equivalent commands via dict colon-tokenization when gopher is blocked; successful Redis-side execution confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过只解码一次的 gopher 深度检测：载荷二次编码，终端解码两次后还原为 RESP；命令生效即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the payload for gopher inspection that decodes once; the terminal decoding twice restores RESP and effective commands confirm success.

name.zh: FTP、TFTP 与 Netdoc 协议 SSRF
name.en: FTP, TFTP, and Netdoc Scheme SSRF

description.zh: 使用 FTP、TFTP 与 Netdoc URI 验证服务端获取器是否允许访问非 HTTP 协议、受限端口或本地资源处理器。
description.en: Uses FTP, TFTP, and Netdoc URIs to test whether a server-side fetcher can access non-HTTP protocols, restricted ports, or local-resource handlers.

overview.zh: FTP、TFTP 与 Netdoc 协议 SSRF 覆盖非 HTTP 资源协议场景：针对服务端 URL 获取功能，验证获取器是否启用 ftp、tftp 与 netdoc 处理器并访问受限端口或本地资源。验证维度涵盖三类协议的监听器握手与本地读取确认。
overview.en: FTP, TFTP, and Netdoc Scheme SSRF covers non-HTTP resource protocols: for server-side URL fetching, verify whether the fetcher enables ftp, tftp, and netdoc handlers and reaches restricted ports or local resources. Verification dimensions cover listener handshakes for the network protocols and local-read confirmation for netdoc.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是没有在解析后限制 scheme 和目标，通用库自动启用 FTP/TFTP/Netdoc 处理器；过宽的网络或文件权限允许内部服务探测、文件访问或额外协议请求，而 URL 被语法接受并不等于访问成功。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is no post-resolution restriction on scheme and target while the general library auto-enables FTP/TFTP/Netdoc handlers; overly broad network or file permissions allow internal service probing, file access, or extra protocol requests, and syntactic acceptance of the URL is not access success.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用自有 HTTP 端点建立服务端请求基线；再把 ftp 与 tftp 指向隔离监听器、netdoc 指向无敏感标记文件并逐条提交；网络协议需监听器完成握手并关联请求来源，netdoc 需服务端标记读取证据。不下载或上传真实文件。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first establishes the server-side request baseline with an owned HTTP endpoint; then point ftp and tftp at isolated listeners and netdoc at an unsensitive marker file, submitting one by one; network protocols need a completed listener handshake tied to the request source, and netdoc needs server-side marker-read evidence. Do not download or upload real files. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 使用只支持所需 HTTP/HTTPS 的客户端并拒绝其他协议，解析和 DNS 后检查目标，重定向时重复校验；限制网络与文件权限，移除不需要的 FTP/TFTP/Netdoc 处理能力。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，三类协议请求应全部被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Use clients supporting only required HTTP/HTTPS, reject other protocols, check targets after resolution and DNS, and recheck on redirects; constrain network and file permissions and remove unneeded FTP/TFTP/Netdoc handling. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: all three protocol requests must be denied.

title.zh: 建立 HTTP 获取基线

description.zh: 以自有 HTTP 标记确认 URL 由服务端请求并记录其源网络位置。
description.en: Use a controlled HTTP marker to confirm server-side retrieval and record its network source.

title.en: Point each scheme to isolated targets

description.zh: FTP/TFTP 使用授权监听器，Netdoc 使用标记资源，逐条提交并记录请求 ID。
description.en: Use authorized listeners for FTP or TFTP and a marker resource for Netdoc, submit separately, and record request IDs.

description.zh: 匹配握手、来源和时间，排除 DNS 预取、浏览器连接与背景服务。
description.en: Match handshake, source, and timing while excluding DNS prefetch, browser connections, and background services.

description.zh: 修复后重放 HTTP、FTP、TFTP 与 Netdoc，确认业务 HTTP 保留而其他协议拒绝。
description.en: After remediation replay HTTP, FTP, TFTP, and Netdoc to preserve business HTTP while rejecting the other schemes.

prerequisites.zh: 服务端功能接受完整 URL 并由通用传输库处理
prerequisites.en: A server-side feature accepts a full URL handled by a generic transfer library.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境部署无文件内容的 FTP/TFTP 监听器和无敏感 Netdoc 标记
prerequisites.en: An isolated environment hosts empty FTP or TFTP listeners and a nonsensitive Netdoc marker.

analysis.zh: 区分 DNS 解析、TCP/UDP 连接和协议级请求三个层次。只有监听器中的应用源连接与请求内容能证明相应协议可用。
analysis.en: Distinguish DNS resolution, TCP or UDP connection, and protocol-level request. Only an application-origin connection and request content at the listener prove scheme support.

opsecTips.zh: 监听器不提供真实文件且部署在隔离网段，避免测试成为数据传输通道。
opsecTips.en: Listeners should expose no real files and run in an isolated segment so testing cannot become a data channel.

opsecTips.zh: 每个协议只进行一次短连接并设置严格超时，避免阻塞工作线程。
opsecTips.en: Make one short connection per scheme with strict timeouts to avoid blocking worker threads.

description.zh: 绕过对裸 ftp://127.0.0.1 特征的匹配：插入 userinfo 段改变 URL 结构；FTP 服务连接与应答横幅出现即成功。
description.en: Insert a userinfo segment to alter URL structure past bare-target matching; an FTP connection with a banner appearing confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 file 协议的黑名单：Java 系解析器接受 netdoc 等价读文件；返回文件内容即成功。
description.en: Use netdoc as the file-equivalent scheme against file blacklists on Java-family parsers; returned file content confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对全小写协议与默认端口省略形态的规则：大写协议头并显式端口；目标服务 UDP/TCP 交互出现即成功。
description.en: Uppercase schemes with explicit ports against lowercase default-form rules; any UDP/TCP interaction with the target confirms success.

name.zh: Gopher 到 Redis RESP 文件写入序列

description.zh: 使用编码 RESP 命令序列说明 SSRF 获取器如何向 Redis 写键、修改持久化目录并触发保存；仅在隔离协议捕获器中验证字节边界。
description.en: Uses an encoded RESP command sequence to show how an SSRF fetcher could write a Redis key, change persistence paths, and save; validation is limited to an isolated protocol capture service.

overview.zh: Gopher 到 Redis RESP 文件写入序列覆盖协议桥接深水场景：针对允许 gopher 的取回器与可达的内网 Redis，展示从写键、修改持久化目录到触发保存的完整 RESP 编码链。验证维度为离线 RESP 解析核对与隔离捕获器字节匹配，真实服务验证被明确排除。
overview.en: Gopher-to-Redis RESP File-Write Sequence covers deep protocol bridging: for gopher-capable fetchers and reachable intranet Redis, it demonstrates the complete RESP-encoded chain from writing a key to changing the persistence directory and triggering save. Verification dimensions are offline RESP parsing checks and isolated-catcher byte matching, with real-service verification explicitly excluded.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是可利用链要求 URL 获取器允许 gopher、应用网络可达 Redis、Redis 无强认证/ACL、CONFIG/SAVE 可用且持久化目录可与 Web 根共享；任一边界被阻断整条链即终止，因此该序列的价值在于标定各层边界。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is an exploit chain requiring gopher-capable fetching, network reachability to Redis, Redis without strong auth/ACL, usable CONFIG/SAVE, and a persistence directory shareable with the web root; any blocked boundary terminates the chain, so the sequence's value is mapping each layer's boundary.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步在离线脚本中解码 RESP 序列并核对各命令长度与参数（set、config set dir、config set dbfilename、save）；随后仅把 URI 地址改为隔离字节捕获器提交一次，匹配完整字节、来源与请求 ID。捕获到字节只确认 SSRF 协议桥接成立；不得继续对真实 Redis 验证写入或 Web 文件执行。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 decodes the RESP sequence in an offline script, verifying command lengths and arguments (set, config set dir, config set dbfilename, save); then change only the URI address to an isolated byte catcher and submit once, matching full bytes, source, and request ID. Captured bytes confirm only the SSRF protocol bridge; never proceed to verify writes or web-file execution against real Redis. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: URL 获取器只允许 HTTP/HTTPS 并在解析/重定向后阻断内网，网络层隔离 Redis；Redis 启用认证/TLS/ACL，禁用 CONFIG 危险用法或限制管理权限，持久化目录不与 Web 服务共享并采用最小文件权限。修复后用捕获器样例回归，桥接字节应不再到达。
mitigation.en: Restrict the URL fetcher to HTTP/HTTPS and block intranets after resolution/redirects, isolating Redis at the network layer; enable Redis auth/TLS/ACL, disable dangerous CONFIG usage or limit admin rights, keep persistence directories disjoint from web services, and apply minimal file permissions. After the fix, regress with the catcher sample: bridged bytes must not arrive.

title.zh: 离线解析 RESP 序列

description.zh: 核对 URL 解码、命令帧和长度，不向任何网络服务发送。
description.en: Verify URL decoding, command frames, and lengths without sending to any network service.

title.en: Point to an isolated byte capture service

description.zh: 替换地址并提交一次，捕获器不解析或执行 Redis 命令。
description.en: Replace the address and submit once to a service that does not parse or execute Redis commands.

title.zh: 确认 Redis RESP 字节序列
title.en: Confirm the Redis RESP byte sequence

description.zh: 匹配原始请求、捕获字节、源地址和时间，排除客户端工具发送。
description.en: Match raw request, captured bytes, source address, and time, excluding traffic from the client tool.

description.zh: 确认没有连接真实 Redis、没有文件或键变化，并回归协议/内网阻断。
description.en: Confirm that no real Redis was contacted and no key or file changed, then regress scheme and internal-destination blocking.

prerequisites.zh: 已在隔离环境确认服务端 URL 获取器支持 gopher 并可连接专用协议捕获器
prerequisites.en: An isolated environment has confirmed gopher support and connectivity to a dedicated protocol capture service.

prerequisites.zh: 不连接真实 Redis，捕获器只记录字节且无命令执行能力
prerequisites.en: No real Redis is contacted; the capture service only records bytes and cannot execute commands.

analysis.zh: 阳性仅定义为应用服务器向捕获器发送解码 RESP 字节。Redis 命令成功、文件写入和 RCE 均未验证；超时、DNS 查询或端口开放是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the application server sending decoded RESP bytes to the capture service. Redis command success, file write, and RCE remain unverified; timeout, DNS lookup, or an open port are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 取得一次完整字节捕获后立即停止，禁止连接任何真实 Redis。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one complete byte capture and never connect to a real Redis service.

opsecTips.zh: 销毁捕获器日志中的脚本内容，核对隔离网段无 Redis 键、配置或文件变化。
opsecTips.en: Remove script content from capture logs and verify no Redis key, configuration, or file changed in the isolated segment.

description.zh: 绕过对 RESP $ 长度前缀特征的检测：用 Redis 内联命令行格式发送等价序列；webshell 文件生成即成功。
description.en: Send equivalent commands in Redis inline-line format to evade RESP length-prefix signatures; the webshell file being created confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 %0d%0a 完整序列的匹配：RESP 行仅以 %0a 结束；命令执行成功即成功。
description.en: Terminate RESP lines with bare %0a against full CRLF sequence matching; successful command execution confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单条超长 gopher 串的整体检测：把利用链拆成多次短投递；最终 save 落盘成功即成功。
description.en: Split the chain into multiple short deliveries against single-long-gopher detection; the final save writing to disk confirms success.

name.zh: Gopher MySQL 握手片段

description.zh: 使用截断的 MySQL 二进制协议 URI 验证 Gopher SSRF 到 3306 端口的字节转发边界，并明确该样例本身不可执行。
description.en: Uses a truncated MySQL binary-protocol URI to test the byte-forwarding boundary to port 3306 and explicitly documents that the sample is not executable as written.

overview.zh: Gopher MySQL 握手片段覆盖数据库端口字节转发场景：针对允许 gopher 的取回器与 3306 端口，验证截断的 MySQL 二进制前缀能否送达监听器并标定协议/端口边界。验证维度为隔离捕获器的字节匹配，完整握手构造被明确排除。
overview.en: Gopher MySQL Handshake Fragment covers database-port byte forwarding: for gopher-capable fetchers and port 3306, verify whether a truncated MySQL binary prefix reaches the listener and marks the protocol/port boundary. Verification dimensions are isolated-catcher byte matching, with full handshake construction explicitly excluded.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是若获取器允许 gopher 且可达数据库网段，攻击者可把受控字节发送到 MySQL；但实际认证与查询受握手、凭据、TLS 与账户权限约束，样例中的省略号意味着它本身不可执行，仅用于端口边界探针。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that a gopher-capable fetcher reaching the database segment can deliver controlled bytes to MySQL; yet actual authentication and queries remain bound by handshake, credentials, TLS, and account permissions, and the sample's ellipsis means it is not executable by itself — only a port-boundary probe.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步仅把地址改为 9000/3306 字节捕获器并提交一次，匹配 `%a3...` 解码前缀字节与应用来源连接；捕获到前缀即确认端口字节转发成立。不连接真实 MySQL、不补全省略内容、不构造认证包；连接错误或超时不构成证据。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 changes only the address to a byte catcher on the port and submits once, matching the decoded `%a3...` prefix bytes and the application-source connection — a captured prefix confirms port-level byte forwarding. Never connect to real MySQL, complete the ellipsis, or construct auth packets; connection errors or timeouts are not evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器协议允许列表限于 HTTP/HTTPS，解析后阻断数据库地址与端口，网络层禁止应用访问 MySQL 管理面；MySQL 使用 TLS、强认证、最小账户权限和独立网段。修复后用捕获器样例回归，字节转发应被网络策略拦截。
mitigation.en: Limit the fetcher's scheme allowlist to HTTP/HTTPS, block database addresses and ports after resolution, and forbid application access to the MySQL management plane at the network layer; run MySQL with TLS, strong auth, minimal account privileges, and a separate segment. After the fix, regress with the catcher sample: byte forwarding must be intercepted by network policy.

description.zh: 识别省略号与状态化握手，禁止把它描述为可执行 SQL。
description.en: Identify the ellipsis and stateful handshake and do not describe it as executable SQL.

title.en: Point to a port-3306 byte capture service

description.zh: 替换地址、提交一次并只记录前缀字节和连接来源。
description.en: Replace the address, submit once, and record only prefix bytes and connection source.

description.zh: 匹配应用请求、源地址和捕获前缀，不推断握手或认证成功。
description.en: Match application request, source, and captured prefix without inferring handshake or authentication success.

title.zh: 阻断数据库网段并回归
title.en: Block the database segment and regress

description.zh: 修复后重放正常 HTTP 与该 URI，确认前者可用而 3306 连接被阻断。
description.en: After remediation replay normal HTTP and this URI to preserve the former while blocking port 3306.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离获取器已确认支持 gopher，测试端点只是 3306 字节捕获器
prerequisites.en: The isolated fetcher supports gopher and the test endpoint is only a byte capture service on port 3306.

prerequisites.zh: 理解原行中的省略号是不可执行占位，不连接真实 MySQL
prerequisites.en: The ellipsis in the original is understood as a nonexecutable placeholder and no real MySQL is contacted.

analysis.zh: 阳性是应用源向捕获器发送已知前缀；省略号使其无法证明 MySQL 握手、认证或查询。端口开放、DNS、超时和解析错误均是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive is an application-origin connection sending the known prefix. The ellipsis prevents proof of MySQL handshake, authentication, or query; an open port, DNS, timeout, or parse error is a false positive.

opsecTips.zh: 捕获一次前缀后停止，不补全协议、不连接真实 MySQL。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one prefix capture, do not complete the protocol, and never contact a real MySQL service.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭 3306 捕获器并核对数据库网段无连接或账户事件。
opsecTips.en: Close the port-3306 capture service and verify no connection or account event occurred in the database segment afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对握手包十六进制特征的串匹配：整体二次编码，MySQL 客户端协议还原；连接与认证交互出现即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the handshake fragment past hex signature matching while the wire protocol restores it; an appearing connection and auth exchange confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对固定抓包样本特征的检测：调整能力标志位与用户名字段构造变体登录包；服务端进入认证流程即成功。
description.en: Vary capability flags and the username field to evade fixed-capture signatures; the server entering the auth flow confirms success.

title.zh: 协议头大小写与端口伪装

description.zh: 绕过小写协议与标准端口组合特征：大写协议头并尝试镜像端口；数据包到达 MySQL 服务即成功。
description.en: Uppercase the scheme and probe mirrored ports against lowercase-standard-port signatures; packets reaching the MySQL service confirm success.

name.zh: Gopher FastCGI 记录片段

description.zh: 使用截断的 FastCGI 记录 URI 验证服务端获取器向 9000 端口发送二进制前缀的能力，并明确不构造可执行参数。
description.en: Uses a truncated FastCGI record URI to test whether a server fetcher sends a binary prefix to port 9000 without constructing executable parameters.

overview.zh: Gopher FastCGI 记录片段覆盖 FPM 端口字节转发场景：针对允许 gopher 的取回器与 9000 端口，验证截断的 FastCGI 记录前缀能否送达隔离监听器并标定二进制边界。验证维度为 `%01%01%00%01` 固定头字节匹配，参数构造被明确排除。
overview.en: Gopher FastCGI Record Fragment covers FPM-port byte forwarding: for gopher-capable fetchers and port 9000, verify whether a truncated FastCGI record prefix reaches an isolated listener and marks the binary boundary. Verification dimensions are `%01%01%00%01` fixed-header byte matching, with parameter construction explicitly excluded.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是若获取器允许 gopher 且能访问 php-fpm，完整构造可能跨越反向代理预期边界直连解释器；但有效利用还需要完整记录、SCRIPT_FILENAME、文件存在与 FPM 配置配合，截断片段仅证明原始字节可送达。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is that a gopher-capable fetcher reaching php-fpm could cross the reverse proxy's expected boundary straight to the interpreter; but real exploitation additionally needs complete records, SCRIPT_FILENAME, file existence, and FPM configuration, so the truncated fragment proves only raw byte delivery.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步仅把地址改为 9000 字节捕获器并提交一次，匹配 `%01%01%00%01` 解码前缀与应用来源；捕获到固定头字节即确认 gopher 到 9000 的原始字节边界。不补全 FCGI_PARAMS/STDIN、不构造 PHP 参数、不连接真实 FPM；连接失败、端口开放或错误页面都不算字节转发证据。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 changes only the address to a byte catcher on 9000 and submits once, matching the decoded `%01%01%00%01` prefix and the application source — captured fixed-header bytes confirm the raw-byte boundary of gopher to 9000. Never complete FCGI_PARAMS/STDIN, construct PHP parameters, or connect to real FPM; connection failures, open ports, or error pages are not byte-forwarding evidence. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 获取器限制协议和解析后目标，网络层禁止应用访问 FPM 监听端口；php-fpm 仅绑定 Unix Socket 或受限接口，使用最小权限、明确 SCRIPT_FILENAME 根并禁用不需要功能。修复后用捕获器样例回归，字节转发应被网络隔离阻断。
mitigation.en: Constrain the fetcher's protocols and resolved targets, and forbid application access to the FPM listen port at the network layer; bind php-fpm only to a Unix socket or restricted interface with least privilege, an explicit SCRIPT_FILENAME root, and unneeded features disabled. After the fix, regress with the catcher sample: byte forwarding must be blocked by network isolation.

title.zh: 标记截断 FastCGI 前提

description.zh: 确认片段缺少参数和内容记录，不能描述为 PHP 执行 payload。
description.en: Confirm the fragment lacks parameter and content records and cannot be described as a PHP execution payload.

title.zh: 提交到隔离 9000 捕获器
title.en: Submit to an isolated port-9000 capture service

description.zh: 替换地址并发送一次，只采集前缀、来源和请求 ID。
description.en: Replace the address and send once, collecting only prefix, source, and request ID.

description.zh: 匹配捕获字节与请求，不推断 SCRIPT_FILENAME、FPM 处理或代码执行。
description.en: Match captured bytes and request without inferring SCRIPT_FILENAME, FPM handling, or code execution.

description.zh: 修复协议/网络边界后重放，确认正常 URL 获取保留且 9000 无连接。
description.en: After scheme and network fixes replay to preserve normal retrieval while no port-9000 connection occurs.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离环境提供只记录字节的 9000 端口捕获器
prerequisites.en: The isolated environment provides a byte-only capture service on port 9000.

prerequisites.zh: 不连接 php-fpm/FastCGI，也不补全参数或脚本文件名
prerequisites.en: No php-fpm or FastCGI service is contacted and no parameters or script filename are completed.

analysis.zh: 阳性仅为应用服务器向捕获器发送 FastCGI 头前缀。截断内容无法证明有效请求、PHP 文件选择或执行；开放端口和超时是假阳性。
analysis.en: A positive is limited to the application server sending a FastCGI header prefix to the capture service. Truncated content cannot prove a valid request, PHP file selection, or execution; an open port and timeout are false positives.

opsecTips.zh: 取得一次头字节后停止，禁止补全参数、请求 PHP 文件或访问真实 FPM。
opsecTips.en: Stop after one header-byte capture and never complete parameters, request a PHP file, or access real FPM.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后关闭捕获器并核对 FPM 日志没有请求、子进程或文件访问。
opsecTips.en: Close the capture service and verify FPM logs contain no request, child process, or file access afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 FastCGI 记录头字节特征的串匹配：记录整体二次编码后由服务端解码；9000 端口响应记录返回即成功。
description.en: Double-encode the record so its header bytes evade string matching until server-side decoding; a response record from port 9000 confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对单条完整 FCGI 利用串的检测：BEGIN_REQUEST 与_params 分两次投递；最终 SCRIPT_FILENAME 生效即成功。
description.en: Deliver BEGIN_REQUEST and params separately against single-complete-signature detection; SCRIPT_FILENAME ultimately taking effect confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对 gopher:// 前缀的字面匹配：分隔符百分号编码，解析后等价；FastCGI 服务收到记录即成功。
description.en: Percent-encode separators so the prefix evades literal matching while remaining equivalent; the FastCGI service receiving records confirms success.

name.zh: SSRF 通配 DNS 零地址解析

description.zh: 使用解析到 0.0.0.0 的 nip.io/sslip.io URL 验证服务端获取器是否在解析后把未指定地址视为本机或允许目标。
description.en: Uses nip.io and sslip.io URLs resolving to 0.0.0.0 to test whether a server fetcher treats the unspecified address as local or otherwise allowed after resolution.

subCategory.zh: 地址变形与 DNS 解析绕过

overview.zh: SSRF 通配 DNS 零地址解析覆盖特殊地址场景：针对过滤字面 IP 的取回功能，验证解析到 0.0.0.0 的 nip.io/sslip.io URL 能否让连接库把未指定地址当作本机访问 8080。验证维度为自有 DNS 名替代、零地址解析与本地标记服务命中。
overview.en: SSRF Wildcard-DNS Zero-Address Resolution covers special addresses: against fetchers filtering literal IPs, verify whether nip.io/sslip.io URLs resolving to 0.0.0.0 make the connection library treat the unspecified address as local and reach 8080. Verification dimensions cover owned-DNS substitution, zero-address resolution, and local marker-service hits.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是 SSRF 过滤只检查原始 host 字符串或禁止字面 IP，却未分类解析结果与特殊地址；0.0.0.0 是 IPv4 未指定地址，不同操作系统与客户端在连接时可能拒绝或解释为本地，通配 DNS 将可疑地址藏于域名后。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is SSRF filtering that inspects only the raw host string or bans literal IPs without classifying resolved and special addresses; 0.0.0.0 is the IPv4 unspecified address that OSes and clients may reject or interpret as local on connect, and wildcard DNS hides the suspicious address behind a domain name.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用自有外部标记 URL 证明服务端请求成立；再以自有 DNS 名替代两行并解析到隔离实例的 0.0.0.0，记录解析、socket 目标与本地标记请求；服务端连接本地 8080 且携带唯一请求标记才成立。不要依赖公共 nip.io/sslip.io 或扫描其他端口。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first proves the server-side request via an owned external marker URL; then substitute both lines with your own DNS name resolving to 0.0.0.0 on an isolated instance, recording resolution, socket target, and local marker requests — success requires the server connecting to local 8080 carrying the unique request token. Never rely on public nip.io/sslip.io or scan other ports. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 解析全部 A/AAAA 后分类并阻断未指定、回环、链路本地、私网和其他非业务地址，连接到固定已批准 IP，并在重定向/重试时重复校验；网络层限制获取服务出站。修复后用样例回归，零地址目标被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Classify and block unspecified, loopback, link-local, private, and other non-business addresses after resolving all A/AAAA records, connect to fixed approved IPs, and recheck on redirects/retries; restrict the fetch service's egress at the network layer. After the fix, regress with the sample: zero-address targets denied.

title.zh: 建立服务端外部获取基线

description.zh: 使用唯一标记确认请求来自应用服务器并记录其解析/连接流程。
description.en: Use a unique marker to confirm the request comes from the application server and record resolution and connection flow.

description.zh: 替换公共域后逐条请求，并只监听隔离 8080。
description.en: Replace public domains, request one at a time, and listen only on isolated port 8080.

title.zh: 确认最终 Socket 目标

description.zh: 匹配 DNS、连接地址、本地标记日志和请求令牌，排除客户端/健康检查。
description.en: Match DNS, connection address, local marker logs, and request token, excluding client or health-check traffic.

title.en: Block special addresses and clean up

description.zh: 修复后重放合法外部 URL 与零地址域，确认前者可用而后者在连接前拒绝；删除 DNS/服务。
description.en: After remediation replay valid external and zero-address names to preserve the former and reject the latter before connection, then remove DNS and services.

prerequisites.zh: 隔离获取器由服务端发起 URL 请求，且本地 8080 仅运行固定标记服务
prerequisites.en: An isolated server-side fetcher makes URL requests and local port 8080 hosts only a fixed marker service.

prerequisites.zh: 公共域名在验证前替换为自有 DNS 名称，解析和连接日志可审计
prerequisites.en: Public names are replaced with a controlled DNS name and resolution and connection logs are auditable.

analysis.zh: 阳性要求服务端 socket 实际连接隔离本地 8080。域名解析到 0.0.0.0、错误信息、端口超时或浏览器请求是假阳性/不足证据。
analysis.en: A positive requires the server socket to connect to isolated local port 8080. DNS resolving to 0.0.0.0, errors, port timeout, or a browser request is false or insufficient evidence.

opsecTips.zh: 只验证单一 8080 标记服务，禁止扫描其他本机/内网端口，连接成功即停止。
opsecTips.en: Test only one marker service on port 8080, never scan other local or internal ports, and stop on the first connection.

opsecTips.zh: 测试后删除自有 DNS 记录、关闭监听器并清理请求日志中的令牌。
opsecTips.en: Delete controlled DNS records, close the listener, and remove request tokens from logs afterward.

description.zh: 绕过对 0.0.0.0 点分形式的匹配：十六进制零地址解析等价；本机服务响应即成功。
description.en: Resolve the hex zero address identically past dotted 0.0.0.0 matching; a local service responding confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对点分零地址特征的规则：短横线形式同样指向本机；端口服务可达即成功。
description.en: Use the dash form that still points at the local host; a reachable port service confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过仅封禁 0.0.0.0 与 127.0.0.1 的清单：使用 127/8 旁支回环地址；本机端口响应差异出现即成功。
description.en: Use a 127/8 branch address against lists banning only 0.0.0.0 and 127.0.0.1; a differing local port response confirms success.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 HTTP Iframe

description.zh: 验证 wkhtmltopdf 在启用 JavaScript 时是否执行 document.write 并由动态 iframe 发起服务端 HTTP 子资源请求。
description.en: Tests whether wkhtmltopdf executes document.write when JavaScript is enabled and makes a server-side HTTP subresource request from the dynamic iframe.

overview.zh: wkhtmltopdf 脚本化 HTTP Iframe 覆盖动态资源加载场景：针对启用 JavaScript 的 wkhtmltopdf 渲染服务，验证 document.write 动态插入的 iframe 能否触发服务端 HTTP 子资源请求。验证维度涵盖禁用脚本阴性基线、脚本启用复测与一次性 marker 关联三类。
overview.en: wkhtmltopdf Scripted HTTP Iframe covers dynamic resource loading: for wkhtmltopdf rendering services with JavaScript enabled, verify whether document.write-injected iframes trigger server-side HTTP subresource requests. Verification dimensions cover a script-disabled negative baseline, script-enabled retests, and one-time marker correlation.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是该输入包含两个连续条件：JavaScript 必须运行，随后动态插入的 iframe 才可能由渲染器取回；与静态资源引用不同，动态路径把脚本执行与网络访问串联，任一环节被禁用即失效，归因也必须分开。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is two chained conditions: JavaScript must run before the dynamically inserted iframe can be fetched by the renderer; unlike static resource references, the dynamic path serializes script execution with network access — disabling either link kills it, and attribution must be handled separately.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步先用禁用 JavaScript 的同一输入建立阴性基线；随后启用脚本并把 iframe 目标改为无重定向的一次性 marker 端点渲染一次，脚本执行日志、动态 iframe 节点与来自渲染进程的 marker 请求按时间关联即确认成立；最后阻断脚本或私网目标复测确认防护。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 first establishes a negative baseline with JavaScript disabled on the same input; then enable scripts, point the iframe target at a one-time marker endpoint without redirects, and render once — time-correlated script-execution logs, the dynamic iframe node, and a marker request from the renderer process confirm; finally retest with scripts or private targets blocked to verify protection. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 默认禁用 JavaScript；确需脚本时在独立无内部路由容器中运行渲染器，并对所有初始与动态资源执行解析后地址允许列表。修复后用第 1 步样例回归，动态 iframe 请求应被策略拒绝。
mitigation.en: Disable JavaScript by default; where scripting is required, run the renderer in an isolated container without internal routes and apply a resolved-address allowlist to all initial and dynamic resources. After the fix, regress with the step 1 sample: dynamic iframe requests must be denied by policy.

description.zh: 确认同一 HTML 不创建 iframe 且不访问 marker。
description.en: Confirm the same HTML creates no iframe and does not access the marker.

description.zh: 替换目标后设置短延迟，保存进程和网络跟踪。
description.en: After replacing the target, use a short delay and preserve process and network traces.

description.zh: 匹配 DOM 创建、请求令牌和渲染 PID，确认请求由 wkhtmltopdf 发出。
description.en: Match DOM creation, request token, and renderer PID and confirm wkhtmltopdf sent the request.

title.zh: 关闭脚本或出口后回归
title.en: Regress after disabling script or egress

description.zh: 确认业务静态文档仍可生成而动态内部目标不再访问。
description.en: Confirm business static documents still generate while the dynamic internal destination is no longer accessed.

prerequisites.zh: 回环地址在执行前替换为隔离 marker 服务，渲染主机无内部或云元数据路由
prerequisites.en: The loopback address is replaced before execution with an isolated marker service and the renderer has no internal or cloud-metadata routes.

prerequisites.zh: 已记录 wkhtmltopdf 版本、JavaScript 开关、延迟设置和子资源网络日志
prerequisites.en: wkhtmltopdf version, JavaScript setting, delay configuration, and subresource network logs are recorded.

analysis.zh: 完整阳性必须证明 wkhtmltopdf 执行脚本、创建 iframe 并发出带 marker 的 HTTP 请求。任何单一中间信号都不足以把结果定为脚本化 SSRF。
analysis.en: A complete positive proves wkhtmltopdf executed script, created the iframe, and sent the marker-bearing HTTP request. No single intermediate signal is sufficient to classify scripted SSRF.

opsecTips.zh: marker 服务仅记录首包后关闭，禁用重定向、认证和二次引用
opsecTips.en: The marker service records one first packet and closes, with redirects, authentication, and secondary references disabled.

opsecTips.zh: 使用一次性工作目录和短 JavaScript 延迟，任务结束即终止所有子进程
opsecTips.en: Use a disposable working directory and short JavaScript delay and terminate every child process when the job ends.

description.zh: 绕过对整串内网地址与即时注入的静态扫描：拆串延迟重组后再写入框架；渲染时段内请求发出即成功。
description.en: Assemble the URL from split strings after a delay past static scanning; a request issued within the render window confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对内联脚本与 document.write 的过滤：外部脚本由渲染器自动加载并执行 fetch；内部请求到达即成功。
description.en: Load an external script auto-executed by the renderer past inline-script filtering; an internal request arriving confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过渲染器只捕获首个渲染帧的特征：多轮定时请求跨越时间窗；服务端日志出现多次内部请求即成功。
description.en: Issue interval requests beyond the first captured render frame; multiple internal requests in server logs confirm success.

name.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 HTTP 子资源集合

description.zh: 归并 img、link、object、embed、video、audio、source 和 track 标签的静态 HTTP 引用，验证各解析器入口是否共享服务端地址限制。
description.en: Groups static HTTP references across img, link, object, embed, video, audio, source, and track tags to test whether their parser paths share server-side destination controls.

overview.zh: wkhtmltopdf 静态 HTTP 子资源集合覆盖多标签资源加载场景：针对 wkhtmltopdf 渲染服务，验证 img、link、object、embed、video、audio、source、track 八类静态标签是否共享服务端地址限制。验证维度为每标签唯一令牌与最小响应的逐项单独渲染。
overview.en: wkhtmltopdf Static HTTP Subresource Set covers multi-tag resource loading: for wkhtmltopdf rendering services, verify whether eight static tag types — img, link, object, embed, video, audio, source, and track — share the server's address restrictions. Verification dimensions render each tag separately with a unique token and minimal response.

vulnerability.zh: 根因是不同 HTML 标签由 Qt WebKit 的不同加载路径处理，资源类型支持程度也不同；任一受攻击者控制的静态资源能访问渲染环境内部 HTTP 服务都构成服务端请求能力，而某标签不受支持不代表其他标签安全。
vulnerability.en: The root cause is different HTML tags handled by distinct Qt WebKit loading paths with varying resource-type support; any attacker-controlled static resource reaching the render environment's internal HTTP services constitutes server-side request capability, and one unsupported tag never proves the others safe.

exploitation.zh: 按 Payload 列表顺序使用：第 1 步为八类标签分别分配唯一 token 与对应 MIME 的最小响应端点；随后按固定顺序逐标签单独渲染（img src、link rel=stylesheet、object data、embed src、video poster 等），按标签记录来自渲染进程的请求，命中即确认该入口可用；内容是否进入 PDF 另行分级。绝不连接真实元数据或回环服务。占位符在全局变量菜单中替换。
exploitation.en: Use in Payload list order: step 1 assigns each of the eight tag types a unique token plus a minimal-response endpoint with the matching MIME; then render tag by tag in fixed order (img src, link rel=stylesheet, object data, embed src, video poster, etc.), recording per-tag requests from the renderer process — a hit confirms that entry; grade whether content enters the PDF separately. Never touch real metadata or loopback services. Replace placeholders via the global variables menu.

mitigation.zh: 在统一资源加载层执行 scheme、DNS 与解析 IP 允许列表并复查重定向，同时通过容器防火墙阻断私网、回环和链路本地目标。修复后用八类标签样例回归，任一入口的内部请求都应被拒绝。
mitigation.en: Enforce scheme, DNS, and resolved-IP allowlists in a unified resource-loading layer with redirect rechecks, and block private, loopback, and link-local targets via container firewalls. After the fix, regress with all eight tag samples: internal requests through any entry must be denied.

title.zh: 构建标签 Token 矩阵

description.zh: 为九种标签准备独立路径、MIME 和预期加载结果。
description.en: Prepare a separate path, MIME, and expected load result for all nine tags.

description.zh: 每次仅保留一个资源引用并保存渲染与网络日志。
description.en: Keep one resource reference per run and preserve render and network logs.

description.zh: 匹配 PID、token 和首包，不把 MIME 失败误记为无请求。
description.en: Match PID, token, and first packet and do not mistake MIME failure for absence of a request.

title.en: Regress the matrix after unified blocking

description.zh: 确认所有模拟内部目标被拒绝，而批准资源类型仍能加载。
description.en: Confirm all simulated internal destinations are rejected while approved resource types continue loading.

prerequisites.zh: 所有回环和元数据目标改为隔离服务上的独立 token 路径，禁止真实特殊地址访问
prerequisites.en: All loopback and metadata targets are changed to independently tokenized paths on an isolated service, with real special-address access prohibited.

prerequisites.zh: 模拟服务能返回每种标签所需的最小 MIME，并记录来自渲染 PID 的首包
prerequisites.en: The simulator can return minimal MIME-appropriate data for each tag and record the first packet from the renderer PID.

analysis.zh: 每个 token 的渲染器源首包分别证明对应标签可发起服务端请求；响应被下载不等于内容可读或可回传。未支持标签是该路径阴性，不能覆盖其他加载器。
analysis.en: A renderer-origin first packet for each token proves that tag can make a server-side request; downloading a response does not imply readable or exfiltratable content. An unsupported tag is negative for that path only and does not cover other loaders.

opsecTips.zh: 每个模拟路径只接受一次请求并返回极小静态体，不提供重定向、压缩炸弹或主动内容
opsecTips.en: Each simulator path accepts one request and returns a tiny static body with no redirects, compression bombs, or active content.

opsecTips.zh: 逐标签使用新工作目录和短超时，防止媒体加载器重试造成额外流量
opsecTips.en: Use a fresh working directory and short timeout for each tag to prevent media-loader retries from creating extra traffic.

description.zh: 绕过对 img/link 标签的过滤规则：封面图属性触发同等资源加载；元数据进入渲染管线即成功。
description.en: Trigger an identical fetch via the poster attribute past img/link filtering; metadata entering the render pipeline confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对媒体元素白名单：字体源同样触发服务端取回；内部目标收到请求即成功。
description.en: Fetch through a font source past media-element allowlists; the internal target receiving a request confirms success.

description.zh: 绕过对静态资源类型的枚举校验：字幕轨道属性加载任意 URL；访问日志出现内部来源即成功。
description.en: Load an arbitrary URL via the track attribute past static-resource enumeration; an internal-sourced entry in access logs confirms success.
